w|anggaran.text: Tahun ini anggaran ruang redaksi dipotong, jadi Budi jarang liputan ke luar kota.
w|anggaran.en: This year the newsroom's budget was cut, so Budi rarely covers stories out of town.
w|anggaran.ko: 올해 편집국 예산이 깎여서 부디는 지방 취재를 거의 못 가요.

w|anggaran.text: Siti harus pintar membagi anggaran untuk buku baru dan perbaikan atap.
w|anggaran.en: Siti has to split the budget wisely between new books and roof repairs.
w|anggaran.ko: 시티는 새 책과 지붕 수리에 예산을 잘 나눠야 해요.

w|anggota.en: The new member has been introduced.

w|anggur.text: Mereka memanen anggur di kebun setiap musim gugur.
w|anggur.en: They harvest grapes in the vineyard every autumn.

w|angin.en: Close the window, the wind's coming in.

w|angka.en: The number on that board is wrong.
She is good at remembering phone numbers.

w|angkasa.en: The sky looks dark without clouds.

w|angkatan.text: Angkatan baru mulai berlatih hari ini.
w|angkatan.en: The new class starts training today.

w|angkatan.text: Dia berasal dari angkatan yang sama.
w|angkatan.en: He comes from the same class year.

w|angsa.text: Sepasang angsa putih berenang pelan di bagian sungai yang tenang.
w|angsa.en: A pair of white swans swim slowly in the calm part of the river.
w|angsa.ko: 흰 백조 한 쌍이 강의 잔잔한 곳에서 천천히 헤엄쳐요.

w|angsa.text: Di dinding apotek tergantung lukisan angsa yang berenang di danau.
w|angsa.en: A painting of a swan swimming on a lake hangs on the pharmacy wall.
w|angsa.ko: 약국 벽에는 호수에서 헤엄치는 백조 그림이 걸려 있어요.

w|anti.text: Obat anti nyeri itu cepat bekerja.
Anti korupsi menjadi fokus kampanye mereka.
w|anti.en: Anti-corruption became the focus of their campaign.

w|antik.text: Di ruang kepala sekolah ada jam dinding antik peninggalan zaman Belanda.
w|antik.en: In the principal's office there's an antique wall clock from the Dutch era.
w|antik.ko: 교장실에는 네덜란드 시대에 남겨진 골동품 벽시계가 있어요.

w|antik.text: Rina membungkus lemari antik warisan neneknya dengan selimut tebal.
w|antik.en: Rina wrapped the antique wardrobe inherited from her grandmother in a thick blanket.
w|antik.ko: 리나는 할머니께 물려받은 골동품 옷장을 두꺼운 담요로 쌌어요.

w|antusias.text: Rudi antusias merencanakan kejutan ulang tahun untuk kakaknya.
w|antusias.en: Rudi is excited about planning a surprise birthday for his sister.
w|antusias.ko: 루디는 누나 생일 깜짝 파티를 신나게 준비하고 있어요.

w|antusias.text: Rina antusias mendaftar kelas menyelam untuk pertama kalinya.
w|antusias.en: Rina eagerly signed up for a diving class for the first time.
w|antusias.ko: 리나는 처음으로 다이빙 수업에 신나게 등록했어요.

w|anugerah.text: Guru favorit Eko menerima anugerah guru teladan dari pemerintah daerah.
w|anugerah.en: Eko's favorite teacher received a model teacher award from the local government.
w|anugerah.ko: 에코가 좋아하는 선생님은 지방 정부에서 모범 교사상을 받았어요.

w|anugerah.text: Ayu menerima anugerah pelukis muda berbakat dari dinas kebudayaan.
w|anugerah.en: Ayu received the talented young painter award from the culture office.
w|anugerah.ko: 아유는 문화청에서 재능 있는 젊은 화가상을 받았어요.

w|apa.en: What do you want to eat?

w|apabila.text: Siswa boleh pulang lebih awal apabila guru sedang rapat.
w|apabila.en: Students may go home early when the teachers have a meeting.
w|apabila.ko: 선생님들이 회의를 할 때는 학생들이 일찍 집에 가도 돼요.

w|apabila.text: Siti berjanji akan datang ke reuni berikutnya apabila tidak ada jadwal jaga.
w|apabila.en: Siti promised to come to the next reunion if she isn't on call.
w|apabila.ko: 시티는 당직이 없으면 다음 동창회에 오겠다고 약속했어요.

w|apalagi.text: Aku lelah, apalagi setelah berjalan jauh.
w|apalagi.en: I'm tired, especially after walking far.
The weather is bad, especially in the mountains.

w|apartemen.en: His apartment is on the upper floor.
They moved to a new apartment.

w|apel.text: Dia membawa apel untuk bekal sekolah.
w|apel.en: She brought an apple for school lunch.

w|api.en: The stove fire is still on.

w|aplikasi.text: Andi memakai aplikasi kamus untuk mengerjakan tugas bahasa Jerman.
w|aplikasi.en: Andi uses a dictionary app to do his German homework.
w|aplikasi.ko: 안디는 독일어 숙제를 할 때 사전 앱을 써요.

w|aplikasi.text: Rumah sakit meluncurkan aplikasi untuk mendaftar antrean dokter.
w|aplikasi.en: The hospital launched an app for booking a place in the doctor's queue.
w|aplikasi.ko: 병원은 진료 대기 접수를 하는 앱을 내놓았어요.

w|argumen.text: Dalam debat, argumen Dimas didukung data yang kuat.
w|argumen.en: In the debate, Dimas's argument was backed by strong data.
w|argumen.ko: 토론에서 디마스의 주장은 탄탄한 자료로 뒷받침됐어요.

w|argumen.text: Putri dan kakaknya sempat beradu argumen soal harga menu baru.
w|argumen.en: Putri and her brother had an argument about the price of the new menu.
w|argumen.ko: 푸트리와 오빠는 새 메뉴 가격을 두고 언쟁을 벌였어요.

w|arloji.text: Bayu membersihkan arloji tua yang ia beli dari seorang kakek di pojok pasar.
w|arloji.en: Bayu cleaned the old wristwatch he bought from an old man in the corner of the market.
w|arloji.ko: 바유는 시장 구석 할아버지에게서 산 낡은 손목시계를 닦았어요.

w|arloji.text: Suami Intan memberinya arloji emas sebagai mahar.
w|arloji.en: Intan's husband gave her a gold wristwatch as the dowry.
w|arloji.ko: 인탄의 남편은 신부 지참금으로 금 손목시계를 줬어요.

w|armada.text: Eko meliput penambahan armada bus kota yang baru.
w|armada.en: Eko covered the addition of new buses to the city bus fleet.
w|armada.ko: 에코는 새로 들어온 시내버스 차량 취재를 맡았어요.

w|armada.text: Perusahaan ojek mengirim ponsel seluruh armada pengemudinya ke toko Ayu untuk diservis.
w|armada.en: A motorbike taxi company sent the phones of its whole fleet of drivers to Ayu's shop for servicing.
w|armada.ko: 오토바이 택시 회사가 기사 전원의 휴대폰을 아유 가게에 수리 맡겼어요.

w|aroma.text: Dari kantin tercium aroma nasi goreng yang bikin Budi lapar.
w|aroma.en: The smell of fried rice drifted from the canteen and made Budi hungry.
w|aroma.ko: 매점에서 볶음밥 냄새가 풍겨 와서 부디는 배가 고파졌어요.

w|aroma.text: Rumah baru itu masih menyimpan aroma cat yang tajam, jadi Siti membuka semua jendela.
w|aroma.en: The new house still had a sharp smell of paint, so Siti opened all the windows.
w|aroma.ko: 새집에 페인트 냄새가 아직 독하게 남아 있어서 시티는 창문을 다 열었어요.

w|arsip.text: Foto kelulusan angkatan pertama masih tersimpan di arsip sekolah.
w|arsip.en: The graduation photo of the first class is still kept in the school archive.
w|arsip.ko: 첫 졸업생들의 졸업 사진이 아직 학교 기록 보관실에 남아 있어요.

w|arsip.text: Rudi membawa arsip majalah sekolah dari tahun mereka lulus.
w|arsip.en: Rudi brought the archive of school magazines from the year they graduated.
w|arsip.ko: 루디는 졸업하던 해의 교지 묶음을 가져왔어요.

w|arsitek.text: Setiap Jumat, arsitek proyek itu datang untuk memeriksa hasil kerja Agus.
w|arsitek.en: Every Friday, the project's architect comes to check Agus's work.
w|arsitek.ko: 매주 금요일 그 프로젝트의 건축가가 아구스의 작업을 점검하러 와요.

w|arsitek.text: Rak buku yang dipesan Wati dirancang oleh seorang arsitek muda.
w|arsitek.en: The bookshelf Wati ordered was designed by a young architect.
w|arsitek.ko: 와티가 주문한 책장은 젊은 건축가가 디자인했어요.

w|artefak.text: Properti panggung yang dipakai Eko adalah tiruan artefak dari zaman kerajaan.
w|artefak.en: The stage prop Eko uses is a replica of an artifact from the royal era.
w|artefak.ko: 에코가 쓰는 소품은 왕조 시대 유물의 모조품이에요.

w|artefak.text: Lemari kayu di toko Ayu sudah sangat tua, hampir seperti artefak.
w|artefak.en: The wooden cupboard in Ayu's shop is so old it's almost like an artifact.
w|artefak.ko: 아유 가게의 나무 찬장은 너무 오래돼서 거의 유물 같아요.

w|arti.text: Apa arti kata itu dalam bahasa asing?
w|arti.en: What is the meaning of that word in the foreign language?

w|arti.text: Arti hidupnya berubah setelah kejadian itu.
w|arti.en: The meaning of his life changed after that incident.
w|arti.ko: 그 일 이후로 삶의 의미가 바뀌었어.

w|artikel.text: Dia menulis artikel untuk majalah ilmiah.
w|artikel.en: She wrote an article for a science magazine.

w|artileri.text: Bunyi artileri dalam adegan perang dibuat dari rekaman yang diputar keras.
w|artileri.en: The artillery sounds in the war scene come from a recording played loudly.
w|artileri.ko: 전쟁 장면의 포성은 녹음을 크게 틀어서 만든 거예요.

w|artileri.text: Di toko Ayu ada televisi tua yang sedang menayangkan film perang dengan suara artileri.
w|artileri.en: In Ayu's shop there's an old TV showing a war film with the sound of artillery.
w|artileri.ko: 아유 가게의 낡은 TV에서 포성이 울리는 전쟁 영화가 나오고 있었어요.

w|artis.text: Seorang artis terkenal datang ke sekolah Budi untuk acara pentas seni.
w|artis.en: A famous celebrity came to Budi's school for the arts festival.
w|artis.ko: 유명 연예인이 학예회를 맞아 부디네 학교에 왔어요.

w|artis.text: Kata tetangga, rumah di seberang Siti dulu milik seorang artis sinetron.
w|artis.en: According to the neighbors, the house across from Siti used to belong to a soap opera actor.
w|artis.ko: 이웃 말로는 시티네 맞은편 집이 예전에 드라마 배우 집이었대요.

w|arus.text: Polisi mengalihkan arus lalu lintas di depan balai kota karena ada pawai.
w|arus.en: The police diverted traffic in front of city hall because of a parade.
w|arus.ko: 행진 때문에 경찰이 시청 앞 차량을 우회시켰어요.

w|arus.text: Lampu ruang latihan mati karena arus listrik tiba-tiba putus.
w|arus.en: The practice room lights went out because the electric current suddenly cut off.
w|arus.ko: 갑자기 전기가 끊겨서 연습실 불이 꺼졌어요.

w|arwah.text: Anak-anak suka bercerita tentang arwah penunggu gedung sekolah tua.
w|arwah.en: The children love telling stories about the spirit said to haunt the old school building.
w|arwah.ko: 아이들은 오래된 학교 건물에 산다는 귀신 이야기를 즐겨 해요.

w|arwah.text: Sebelum makan, para alumni berdoa untuk arwah teman yang sudah tiada.
w|arwah.en: Before eating, the alumni prayed for the soul of a friend who had passed away.
w|arwah.ko: 식사 전에 동문들은 세상을 떠난 친구의 영혼을 위해 기도했어요.

w|asal.en: As long as he's kind, I agree.
Where does this fruit come from?

w|asam.text: Fajar menambahkan sedikit air jeruk supaya rasa kuenya agak asam.
w|asam.en: Fajar added a little orange juice so the cake would taste slightly sour.
w|asam.ko: 파자르는 케이크 맛이 살짝 새콤하도록 오렌지 즙을 조금 넣었어요.

w|asam.text: Kaki Lestari terasa pegal karena asam laktat setelah lari jauh.
w|asam.en: Lestari's legs felt sore from lactic acid after the long run.
w|asam.ko: 오래 달린 뒤 레스타리의 다리는 젖산 때문에 뻐근했어요.

w|asap.text: Asap tebal keluar dari dapur itu.
w|asap.en: Thick smoke came out of that kitchen.

w|asap.text: Aku bisa mencium asap dari kebakaran.
w|asap.en: I can smell smoke from the fire.

w|aset.text: Rumah itu adalah aset berharga bagi keluarganya.
w|aset.en: That house is a valuable asset for his family.

w|aset.text: Aset perusahaan terus bertambah tiap tahun.
w|aset.en: The company's assets keep growing every year.

w|asin.text: Instruktur bilang sup buatan Andi sedikit terlalu asin.
w|asin.en: The instructor said Andi's soup was a little too salty.
w|asin.ko: 강사는 안디가 만든 수프가 조금 짜다고 했어요.

w|asin.text: Rani menulis bahwa angin laut di kotanya terasa asin setiap pagi.
w|asin.en: Rani wrote that the sea breeze in her town tastes salty every morning.
w|asin.ko: 라니는 자기 동네 바닷바람이 아침마다 짭짤하다고 썼어요.

w|asisten.en: The doctor's assistant prepared the exam tools.

w|asisten.text: Dia bekerja sebagai asisten di kantor.
w|asisten.en: She works as an assistant in the office.

w|asosiasi.text: Sekolah Dimas bergabung dengan asosiasi sekolah penggerak lingkungan.
w|asosiasi.en: Dimas's school joined an association of environmental pioneer schools.
w|asosiasi.ko: 디마스의 학교는 환경 선도 학교 협회에 가입했어요.

w|asosiasi.text: Putri bergabung dengan asosiasi pengusaha restoran di kotanya.
w|asosiasi.en: Putri joined the restaurant owners' association in her city.
w|asosiasi.ko: 푸트리는 자기 도시의 식당 경영자 협회에 가입했어요.

w|aspek.text: Bagi Budi, kebersihan kandang adalah aspek yang paling penting di klinik.
w|aspek.en: For Budi, cage cleanliness is the most important aspect of the clinic.
w|aspek.ko: 부디에게는 우리 청결이 병원에서 가장 중요한 부분이에요.

w|aspek.text: Siti memikirkan setiap aspek sebelum membuka penginapan kecil di desanya.
w|aspek.en: Siti thought through every aspect before opening a small guesthouse in her village.
w|aspek.ko: 시티는 마을에 작은 민박을 열기 전에 모든 면을 꼼꼼히 따져 봤어요.

w|asrama.text: Mahasiswa baru tinggal di asrama kampus.
w|asrama.en: New students live in the campus dormitory.

w|asrama.text: Asrama itu penuh selama musim ujian.
w|asrama.en: That dormitory is full during exam season.
w|asrama.ko: 그 기숙사는 시험 기간에 가득 차.

w|astaga.en: Oh no, I forgot the key!
Oh my, the rain is pouring.

w|astronomi.text: Teman Eko yang suka astronomi menunjuk rasi bintang di langit malam.
w|astronomi.en: Eko's friend who loves astronomy pointed out constellations in the night sky.
w|astronomi.ko: 천문학을 좋아하는 에코의 친구가 밤하늘의 별자리를 가리켰어요.

w|astronomi.text: Ayu mendengarkan siniar tentang astronomi selama latihan lari jarak jauh.
w|astronomi.en: Ayu listens to a podcast about astronomy during long-distance training runs.
w|astronomi.ko: 아유는 장거리 달리기 훈련 중에 천문학 팟캐스트를 들어요.

w|astronot.text: Waktu kecil, Bayu ingin jadi astronot, bukan kepala gudang.
w|astronot.en: As a child, Bayu wanted to be an astronaut, not a warehouse chief.
w|astronot.ko: 어릴 때 바유는 창고장이 아니라 우주비행사가 되고 싶었어요.

w|astronot.text: Di toko buku bandara, Intan membeli buku biografi seorang astronot.
w|astronot.en: At the airport bookshop, Intan bought an astronaut's biography.
w|astronot.ko: 공항 서점에서 인탄은 한 우주비행사의 전기를 샀어요.

w|asuhan.text: Di lantai dasar ada tempat penitipan anak, dan anak asuhan Bu Rina ramah sekali.
w|asuhan.en: There is a daycare on the ground floor, and the children in Mrs. Rina's care are very friendly.
w|asuhan.ko: 일 층에 어린이집이 있는데, 리나 선생님이 돌보는 아이들이 아주 상냥해요.

w|asuhan.text: Intan berbincang dengan seorang perawat yang membawa bayi asuhan ke dokter.
w|asuhan.en: Intan chatted with a nurse who was taking a baby in her care to the doctor.
w|asuhan.ko: 인탄은 돌보는 아기를 데리고 병원에 가는 간호사와 이야기를 나눴어요.

w|asuransi.en: His car insurance has already expired.

w|asyik.text: Budi begitu asyik membaca surat itu sampai lupa makan malam.
w|asyik.en: Budi was so absorbed in reading the letter that he forgot dinner.
w|asyik.ko: 부디는 편지 읽기에 푹 빠져서 저녁 먹는 것도 잊었어요.

w|asyik.text: Siti asyik mendengarkan musik sampai tidak sadar sudah melewati sepuluh kilometer.
w|asyik.en: Siti was so into her music that she didn't notice she had passed ten kilometers.
w|asyik.ko: 시티는 음악에 빠져서 십 킬로미터를 지난 줄도 몰랐어요.

w|atap.text: Atap rumah bocor saat hujan deras.
w|atap.en: The house roof leaks during heavy rain.

w|atap.text: Mereka memperbaiki atap sebelum musim hujan.
w|atap.en: They repaired the roof before the rainy season.

w|atas.en: The book is on the table.

w|atasan.en: The boss asked for the report before noon.

w|atasan.text: Dia berbicara dengan atasan tentang cuti.
w|atasan.en: He spoke with his superior about leave.

w|atlet.text: Sepupu Fajar adalah atlet bulu tangkis yang baru pulang dari pertandingan.
w|atlet.en: Fajar's cousin is a badminton athlete who just returned from a tournament.
w|atlet.ko: 파자르의 사촌은 시합에서 막 돌아온 배드민턴 선수예요.

w|atlet.text: Saat musim hujan tiba, Lestari melihat para atlet tetap berlatih di stadion.
w|atlet.en: When the rainy season arrives, Lestari sees the athletes keep training at the stadium.
w|atlet.ko: 우기가 와도 레스타리는 선수들이 경기장에서 계속 훈련하는 모습을 봐요.

w|atmosfer.text: Langit malam di sana sangat jernih karena atmosfer di pegunungan bebas polusi.
w|atmosfer.en: The night sky there is very clear because the mountain atmosphere is free of pollution.
w|atmosfer.ko: 그곳 밤하늘은 산의 대기에 오염이 없어서 아주 맑아요.

w|atmosfer.text: Sebelum konser dimulai, atmosfer di dalam stadion sudah sangat meriah.
w|atmosfer.en: Before the concert started, the atmosphere inside the stadium was already electric.
w|atmosfer.ko: 공연이 시작되기 전부터 경기장 안 분위기는 이미 아주 뜨거웠어요.

w|aturan.en: The new rules are already in effect.

w|audisi.text: Dia ikut audisi untuk peran utama.
w|audisi.en: She joined an audition for the lead role.

w|aula.text: Konferensi pers gubernur diadakan di aula kantor gubernuran.
w|aula.en: The governor's press conference was held in the hall of the governor's office.

w|aula.text: Ayu diundang mengisi pelatihan servis ponsel di aula balai desa.
w|aula.en: Ayu was invited to give a phone repair training session in the village hall.
w|aula.ko: 아유는 마을 회관 강당에서 휴대폰 수리 교육을 해 달라는 초대를 받았어요.

w|awak.en: The ship crew is ready to leave.
All the flight crew are safe.

w|awal.en: It was wrong from the start.

w|awan.en: Dark clouds covered the whole sky.

w|awan.text: Pesawat terbang di atas awan putih.
w|awan.en: The plane flew above white clouds.

w|awas.text: Dimas berseru kepada adiknya, "Hei, awas, tanah di sini licin!"
w|awas.en: Dimas called out to his little brother, "Hey, watch out, the ground here is slippery!"
w|awas.ko: 디마스가 동생에게 "야, 조심해, 여기 땅 미끄러워!" 하고 외쳤어요.

w|awas.text: Satpam berteriak kepada Putri, "Mbak, awas mobil!"
w|awas.en: The security guard shouted to Putri, "Miss, watch out for the car!"
w|awas.ko: 경비원이 푸트리에게 "아가씨, 차 조심해요!" 하고 소리쳤어요.

w|ayam.en: The fried chicken is really good.
He raises chickens in the yard.

w|ayat.text: Seorang pengacara dalam drama itu membacakan ayat kedua dari pasal undang-undang.
w|ayat.en: A lawyer in the play reads out the second paragraph of an article of the law.
w|ayat.ko: 연극 속 변호사가 법조문 제2항을 읽어요.

w|ayat.text: Kepala desa membacakan ayat dalam peraturan desa tentang pembagian air.
w|ayat.en: The village head reads out a clause in the village regulation on water sharing.
w|ayat.ko: 이장은 물 배분에 관한 마을 규정의 조항을 읽어요.

w|ayunan.text: Andi memperbaiki ayunan kayu di teras untuk anak-anaknya.
w|ayunan.en: Andi fixed the wooden swing on the porch for his children.
w|ayunan.ko: 안디는 아이들을 위해 현관 나무 그네를 고쳤어요.

w|ayunan.text: Gerakan kereta terasa seperti ayunan yang membuat Dewi mengantuk.
w|ayunan.en: The train's motion feels like a swing that makes Dewi sleepy.
w|ayunan.ko: 열차의 흔들림이 그네처럼 느껴져서 데위는 졸려요.

w|bab.text: Peraturan soal parkir dijelaskan di bab ketiga buku panduan warga.
w|bab.en: The parking rules are explained in the third chapter of the residents' handbook.
w|bab.ko: 주차 규정은 주민 안내서 셋째 장에 나와 있어요.

w|bab.text: Buku teori musik Wati baru sampai bab tentang akor.
w|bab.en: Wati's music theory book has only reached the chapter on chords.
w|bab.ko: 와티의 음악 이론 책은 이제 막 화음 장에 들어섰어요.

w|babak.en: The first round of the match was very exciting.

w|babak.text: Mereka menang di babak final kemarin.
w|babak.en: They won in the final round yesterday.

w|babi.text: Babi itu berlari di sekitar kandang.
w|babi.en: That pig is running around the pen.

w|babi.text: Petani memberi makan babi setiap pagi.
w|babi.en: The farmer feeds the pigs every morning.
w|babi.ko: 농부가 매일 아침 돼지에게 먹이를 줘.

w|badai.en: The storm destroyed the neighbor's roof.

w|badai.text: Kapal bertahan di tengah badai besar.
w|badai.en: The ship held on through a great storm.

w|badan.en: His body was shaking from the cold.

w|badan.text: Olahraga membuat badan menjadi lebih sehat.

w|badut.text: Badut di pesta ulang tahun membuat anak tertawa.
w|badut.en: The clown at the birthday party made the kids laugh.
w|badut.ko: 생일 파티 광대가 아이들을 웃게 했어.

w|badut.text: Seorang badut berjalan di tengah keramaian.
w|badut.en: A clown walked through the crowd.
w|badut.ko: 광대 한 명이 사람들 사이를 걸었어.

w|bagai.text: Ruang bawah tanah museum gelap dan sunyi bagai gua.
w|bagai.en: The museum's basement room is dark and quiet like a cave.
w|bagai.ko: 박물관 지하 전시실은 동굴처럼 어둡고 조용해요.

w|bagai.text: Menjelang Lebaran, pasar penuh sesak bagai lautan manusia.
w|bagai.en: Ahead of Eid, the market is packed like a sea of people.
w|bagai.ko: 르바란을 앞두고 시장은 인파로 바다를 이뤄요.

w|bagaikan.en: My heart is like a calm sea.
Time passed like a gentle breeze.

w|bagaimana.en: What else am I supposed to do?

w|bagasi.text: Agus menaruh tas besar dan tikar di bagasi mobil.
w|bagasi.en: Agus put the big bag and the mat in the car's trunk.
w|bagasi.ko: 아구스는 큰 가방과 돗자리를 자동차 트렁크에 넣었어요.

w|bagasi.text: Wati menawarkan koper dengan ruang bagasi tambahan kepada seorang turis.
w|bagasi.en: Wati offered a tourist a suitcase with extra luggage space.
w|bagasi.ko: 와티는 한 관광객에게 수납공간이 더 넓은 여행 가방을 권했어요.

w|bahu.text: Perawat menepuk bahu Agus supaya dia tidak tegang.
w|bahu.en: The nurse patted Agus on the shoulder so he wouldn't be tense.
w|bahu.ko: 간호사가 긴장하지 말라고 아구스의 어깨를 토닥였어요.

w|bahu.text: Wati memikul papan kayu di bahu menuju lantai atas.
w|bahu.en: Wati carried a wooden plank on her shoulder up to the top floor.
w|bahu.ko: 와티는 나무 판자를 어깨에 메고 위층으로 올라갔어요.

w|bahwa.en: They said the meeting was canceled.

w|baikan.en: They finally made up after arguing.

w|baikan.text: Baikan itu membuat suasana rumah lebih tenang.
w|baikan.en: That reconciliation made the home atmosphere calmer.
w|baikan.ko: 그 화해로 집 분위기가 더 편안해졌어.

w|baja.text: Jembatan itu dibuat dari baja kuat.
w|baja.en: That bridge is made of strong steel.

w|bajak.text: Petani memakai bajak untuk mengolah tanah.
w|bajak.en: The farmer uses a plow to work the soil.

w|bajak.text: Bajak itu tertinggal di gudang lama.
w|bajak.en: That plow was left in the old shed.

w|bakal.en: He is going to become a great leader.

w|bakal.text: Bakal hujan sore ini menurut ramalan.
w|bakal.en: It is going to rain this afternoon according to the forecast.
w|bakal.ko: 예보에 따르면 오늘 오후에 비가 올 거야.

w|bakat.text: Bakat menyanyinya sudah terlihat sejak kecil.
w|bakat.en: Her singing talent has shown since childhood.
w|bakat.ko: 그녀의 노래 재능은 어릴 때부터 보였어.

w|bakat.text: Dia punya bakat menggambar yang luar biasa.
w|bakat.en: He has an extraordinary talent for drawing.
w|bakat.ko: 그는 그림에 대한 뛰어난 재능이 있어.

w|bakteri.text: Luka yang tidak dibersihkan bisa terinfeksi bakteri, kata Budi.
w|bakteri.en: A wound that isn't cleaned can get infected by bacteria, Budi said.
w|bakteri.ko: 닦지 않은 상처는 세균에 감염될 수 있다고 부디가 말했어요.

w|bakteri.text: Siti selalu merebus air sungai dulu supaya bakteri di dalamnya mati.
w|bakteri.en: Siti always boils river water first so the bacteria in it die.
w|bakteri.ko: 시티는 강물 속 세균이 죽도록 늘 먼저 끓여요.

w|baku.text: Bu Guru meminta Rudi menulis karangan dalam bahasa Indonesia yang baku.
w|baku.en: The teacher asked Rudi to write the essay in standard Indonesian.
w|baku.ko: 선생님은 루디에게 작문을 표준 인도네시아어로 쓰라고 했어요.

w|baku.text: Petugas kelurahan meminta Rina mengisi formulir pindah yang baku.
w|baku.en: The village office clerk asked Rina to fill out the standard moving form.
w|baku.ko: 동사무소 직원은 리나에게 정해진 전출 양식을 채우라고 했어요.

w|balai.text: Pentas seni sekolah Dimas diadakan di balai desa.
w|balai.en: Dimas's school art show was held at the village hall.
w|balai.ko: 디마스 학교의 예술 공연은 마을 회관에서 열렸어요.

w|balai.text: Restoran Putri menerima pesanan katering untuk acara di balai kota.
w|balai.en: Putri's restaurant took a catering order for an event at city hall.
w|balai.ko: 푸트리네 식당은 시청 행사용 케이터링 주문을 받았어요.

w|balap.text: Teman sebangku Rudi bercita-cita jadi juara balap sepeda.
w|balap.en: Rudi's deskmate dreams of becoming a bicycle racing champion.
w|balap.ko: 루디의 짝꿍은 자전거 경주 챔피언이 되는 게 꿈이에요.

w|balap.text: Suara motor balap dari sirkuit dekat rumah baru membuat Rina sulit tidur.
w|balap.en: The noise of racing motorcycles from the track near the new house made it hard for Rina to sleep.
w|balap.ko: 새집 근처 서킷에서 나는 경주용 오토바이 소리 때문에 리나는 잠들기 힘들었어요.

w|balapan.en: The bicycle race started this morning.

w|balapan.text: Dia menang dalam balapan lari sekolah.
w|balapan.en: He won in the school running race.

w|balasan.text: Dia menunggu balasan pesan itu dengan cemas.
w|balasan.en: She anxiously waited for a reply to that message.
w|balasan.ko: 그녀는 그 메시지 답장을 초조하게 기다렸어.

w|balasan.text: Balasan marahnya membuat suasana semakin tegang.
w|balasan.en: His angry reply made the mood even tenser.
w|balasan.ko: 그의 화난 대답이 분위기를 더 긴장되게 만들었어.

w|balet.text: Bayu menonton pertunjukan balet anak-anak untuk rubrik budaya.
w|balet.en: Bayu watched a children's ballet performance for the culture section.
w|balet.ko: 바유는 문화면 기사를 위해 어린이 발레 공연을 봤어요.

w|balet.text: Adik Intan ikut kelas balet setiap Sabtu di dekat kantor.
w|balet.en: Intan's younger sister takes ballet class every Saturday near the office.
w|balet.ko: 인탄의 여동생은 토요일마다 사무실 근처에서 발레 수업을 들어요.

w|balkon.text: Agus menanam cabai dalam pot di balkon apartemennya.
w|balkon.en: Agus grows chilies in pots on his apartment balcony.
w|balkon.ko: 아구스는 아파트 발코니 화분에 고추를 키워요.

w|balkon.text: Bunga kertas di balkon Wati mekar penuh di awal musim kemarau.
w|balkon.en: The bougainvillea on Wati's balcony blooms fully at the start of the dry season.
w|balkon.ko: 건기가 시작되면 와티네 발코니의 부겐빌레아가 활짝 펴요.

w|balok.text: Langit-langit unit Agus punya balok kayu yang sengaja dibiarkan terlihat.
w|balok.en: The ceiling of Agus's unit has wooden beams deliberately left exposed.
w|balok.ko: 아구스네 집 천장에는 일부러 드러나게 둔 나무 들보가 있어요.

w|balok.text: Angin kencang menjatuhkan balok kayu dari gudang tetangga Wati.
w|balok.en: Strong winds knocked a wooden beam off Wati's neighbor's shed.
w|balok.ko: 강풍에 와티 이웃집 창고에서 나무 들보가 떨어졌어요.

w|balon.text: Pojok anak di perpustakaan dihias balon warna-warni untuk hari dongeng.
w|balon.en: The children's corner of the library was decorated with colorful balloons for story day.
w|balon.ko: 동화의 날을 맞아 도서관 어린이 코너가 알록달록한 풍선으로 꾸며졌어요.

w|balon.text: Seorang anak kecil membawa balon merah naik ke gerbong Putri.
w|balon.en: A small child brought a red balloon onto Putri's carriage.
w|balon.ko: 어린아이가 빨간 풍선을 들고 푸트리네 칸에 탔어요.

w|ban.text: Ban mobil itu kempes di jalan tol.
w|ban.en: The car tire went flat on the highway.
w|ban.ko: 그 차 타이어가 고속도로에서 바람 빠졌어.

w|ban.text: Montir mengganti ban belakang yang rusak.
w|ban.en: The mechanic replaced the damaged rear tire.

w|bandar.text: Fajar membaca berita bahwa polisi menangkap bandar narkoba yang memakai jasa kurir.
w|bandar.en: Fajar read news that the police caught a drug dealer who used courier services.
w|bandar.ko: 파자르는 경찰이 택배를 이용한 마약상을 잡았다는 기사를 읽었어요.

w|bandar.text: Guru bilang dulu kota itu adalah bandar dagang rempah yang ramai.
w|bandar.en: The teacher said that the city used to be a busy spice-trading port.
w|bandar.ko: 선생님은 그 도시가 예전에 향신료 무역으로 붐비던 항구였다고 했어요.

w|bandara.en: We arrived at the airport early in the morning.

w|bandara.text: Bandara itu sangat sibuk hari ini.
w|bandara.en: That airport is very busy today.

w|banding.text: Sebagai banding, Bu Guru memperlihatkan nilai Andi semester lalu.
w|banding.en: For comparison, the teacher showed Andi's grades from last semester.
w|banding.ko: 비교하려고 선생님은 안디의 지난 학기 성적을 보여 줬어요.

w|banding.text: Harga daging tahun ini naik tajam bila dijadikan banding dengan tahun lalu.
w|banding.en: Meat prices this year rose sharply when compared with last year.
w|banding.ko: 올해 고기값은 작년과 비교하면 크게 올랐어요.

w|bang.text: Bang, tolong bantu angkat kotak ini.
w|bang.en: Bro, please help lift this box.
w|bang.ko: 형, 이 상자 드는 거 좀 도와줘.

w|bang.text: Aku kenal bang itu dari pasar.
w|bang.en: I know that guy from the market.

w|banget.text: Aku senang banget bisa bertemu kamu.
w|banget.en: I'm really happy I could meet you.
w|banget.ko: 널 만날 수 있어서 정말 기뻐.

w|banget.text: Filmnya bagus banget dari awal sampai akhir.
w|banget.en: The movie was really good from start to finish.
w|banget.ko: 그 영화는 처음부터 끝까지 정말 좋았어.

w|bangkai.text: Bau busuk dari bangkai burung di semak-semak membuat Rudi menutup hidung.
w|bangkai.en: The stench of a dead bird in the bushes made Rudi hold his nose.
w|bangkai.ko: 덤불 속 새 사체에서 나는 악취 때문에 루디는 코를 막았어요.

w|bangkai.text: Lirik lagu itu menyamakan cinta lama dengan bangkai kapal di dasar laut.
w|bangkai.en: The song's lyrics compare an old love to a shipwreck on the seabed.
w|bangkai.ko: 그 노래 가사는 옛사랑을 바다 밑 난파선에 빗대요.

w|bangkit.text: Dia bangkit dari kursi dengan cepat.
w|bangkit.en: He rose from the chair quickly.
Rise up and face the new challenge.

w|bangkrut.text: Kontraktor lama proyek ini bangkrut, jadi pekerjaan sempat berhenti setahun.
w|bangkrut.en: The project's previous contractor went bankrupt, so the work stopped for a year.
w|bangkrut.ko: 이 공사의 예전 시공사가 파산해서 일이 일 년 동안 멈췄어요.

w|bangkrut.text: Rina pindah ke kantor ini karena perusahaan lamanya bangkrut.
w|bangkrut.en: Rina moved to this office because her old company went bankrupt.
w|bangkrut.ko: 리나는 전 회사가 파산해서 이 회사로 옮겼어요.

w|bangsa.en: This nation has a long history.
w|bangsa.ko: 이 나라는 긴 역사를 가지고 있어.

w|bangsa.en: National unity must be guarded together.

w|bangsawan.text: Bangsawan itu tinggal di istana lama.
w|bangsawan.en: That noble lived in an old palace.

w|bangsawan.text: Kisah bangsawan sering muncul di drama.
w|bangsawan.en: Stories of nobles often appear in dramas.

w|banjir.text: Warga desa pesisir itu masih ingat banjir rob tahun lalu.
w|banjir.en: The coastal villagers still remember last year's tidal flood.
w|banjir.ko: 그 해안 마을 주민들은 작년 밀물 홍수를 아직 기억해요.

w|banjir.text: Saat banjir datang, para tetangga membantu Ayu mengangkat lemari.
w|banjir.en: When the flood came, the neighbors helped Ayu lift her cupboard.
w|banjir.ko: 홍수가 났을 때 이웃들이 아유를 도와 장롱을 옮겼어요.

w|bank.text: Aku harus ke bank hari ini.
w|bank.en: I have to go to the bank today.
The bank is closed on Sunday.

w|bankir.text: Seorang bankir datang ke proyek untuk memastikan pinjaman dipakai sesuai rencana.
w|bankir.en: A banker came to the site to make sure the loan was used as planned.
w|bankir.ko: 은행원 한 명이 대출금이 계획대로 쓰이는지 확인하러 현장에 왔어요.

w|bankir.text: Kakak Wati yang bekerja sebagai bankir selalu mengingatkannya soal belanja berlebihan.
w|bankir.en: Wati's older sibling, who works as a banker, always warns her about overspending.
w|bankir.ko: 은행원으로 일하는 와티의 언니는 늘 과소비를 조심하라고 해요.

w|bantal.text: Eko memakai tas ranselnya sebagai bantal ketika tidur di bawah pohon.
w|bantal.en: Eko used his backpack as a pillow when he slept under a tree.
w|bantal.ko: 에코는 나무 아래서 잘 때 배낭을 베개로 썼어요.

w|bantal.text: Ayu meminjamkan bantal tambahan kepada tetangga yang kedatangan tamu.
w|bantal.en: Ayu lent an extra pillow to a neighbor who had guests.
w|bantal.ko: 아유는 손님이 온 이웃에게 베개를 하나 더 빌려줬어요.

w|banteng.text: Dimas pelan-pelan mendekati banteng yang sedang makan rumput.
w|banteng.en: Dimas slowly approached the bull that was eating grass.
w|banteng.ko: 디마스는 풀을 뜯고 있는 들소에게 천천히 다가갔어요.

w|banteng.text: Di televisi ada film dokumenter tentang banteng liar di Jawa.
w|banteng.en: There was a documentary on TV about wild banteng in Java.
w|banteng.ko: 텔레비전에서 자와섬의 야생 들소에 관한 다큐멘터리를 했어요.

w|bapak.text: Bapak pulang lebih awal hari ini.
Saya berbicara dengan bapak di telepon.
w|bapak.en: I spoke with father on the phone.

w|barak.text: Para pemain berlatih di bekas barak tentara yang dijadikan studio.
w|barak.en: The actors rehearse in a former army barracks turned into a studio.
w|barak.ko: 배우들은 스튜디오로 바뀐 옛 군 막사에서 연습해요.

w|barak.text: Saat longsor, warga mengungsi sementara ke barak darurat di lapangan.
w|barak.en: During the landslide, residents temporarily evacuated to emergency barracks in the field.
w|barak.ko: 산사태 때 주민들은 운동장의 임시 막사로 잠시 대피했어요.

w|barangkali.text: Guru bilang barangkali ujian akhir akan diundur seminggu.
w|barangkali.en: The teacher said the final exam might be postponed by a week.
w|barangkali.ko: 선생님은 기말시험이 아마 일주일 미뤄질 거라고 했어요.

w|barangkali.text: Pasien di kamar sebelah barangkali bisa pulang besok pagi.
w|barangkali.en: The patient in the next room might be able to go home tomorrow morning.
w|barangkali.ko: 옆 병실 환자는 아마 내일 아침에 퇴원할 수 있을 거예요.

w|barat.en: The wind is blowing from the west.
That city is located in the west.

w|berakting.text: Adik Fajar yang suka berakting membuat video lucu untuk promosi toko.
w|berakting.en: Fajar's younger brother, who loves acting, made funny videos to promote the shop.
w|berakting.ko: 연기를 좋아하는 파자르의 동생은 가게 홍보용으로 웃긴 영상을 찍었어요.

w|berakting.text: Teman Lestari yang dulu berakting di teater sekarang jadi pembawa acara lomba.
w|berakting.en: Lestari's friend who used to act in theater is now the race's emcee.
w|berakting.ko: 예전에 연극을 했던 레스타리의 친구는 지금 대회 사회자예요.

w|beralasan.text: Pemilik anjing itu beralasan tidak sempat datang karena macet.
w|beralasan.en: The dog's owner gave traffic as the reason for not making it.
w|beralasan.ko: 그 개 주인은 차가 막혀서 못 왔다고 핑계를 댔어요.

w|beralasan.text: Siti menolak pindah ke kota, beralasan udara gunung lebih sehat untuk anaknya.
w|beralasan.en: Siti refused to move to the city, reasoning that the mountain air is healthier for her child.
w|beralasan.ko: 시티는 산 공기가 아이에게 더 좋다며 도시로 이사하기를 거절했어요.

w|beralih.text: Banyak layanan di balai kota sudah beralih ke sistem daring.
w|beralih.en: Many services at city hall have switched to an online system.

w|beralih.text: Wati awalnya belajar gitar, lalu beralih ke biola.
w|beralih.en: Wati first learned guitar, then switched to violin.
w|beralih.ko: 와티는 처음엔 기타를 배우다가 바이올린으로 바꿨어요.

w|berambut.text: Petugas loket yang berambut putih itu sudah bekerja di balai kota selama puluhan tahun.
w|berambut.en: The white-haired clerk at the counter has worked at city hall for decades.
w|berambut.ko: 그 창구의 백발 직원은 시청에서 수십 년 동안 일했어요.

w|berambut.text: Guru biola Wati adalah seorang perempuan berambut keriting yang sangat sabar.
w|berambut.en: Wati's violin teacher is a curly-haired woman who is very patient.
w|berambut.ko: 와티의 바이올린 선생님은 곱슬머리에 아주 참을성 있는 분이에요.

w|berandalan.text: Dulu Fajar dianggap berandalan di kampungnya, tapi sekarang ia guru yang dihormati.
w|berandalan.en: Fajar used to be considered a delinquent in his village, but now he's a respected teacher.
w|berandalan.ko: 예전에 파자르는 동네에서 불량배로 여겨졌지만 지금은 존경받는 선생님이에요.

w|berandalan.text: Lestari menulis laporan tentang anak-anak berandalan yang kini aktif di sanggar musik.
w|berandalan.en: Lestari wrote a report about former delinquent kids who are now active in a music studio.
w|berandalan.ko: 레스타리는 한때 불량했던 아이들이 이제 음악 교실에서 활동하는 이야기를 기사로 썼어요.

w|beranggapan.text: Banyak murid beranggapan pelajaran kimia itu sulit, padahal Andi menyukainya.
w|beranggapan.en: Many students assume chemistry is hard, but Andi likes it.
w|beranggapan.ko: 많은 학생들이 화학은 어렵다고 여기지만 안디는 화학을 좋아해요.

w|beranggapan.text: Nenek beranggapan tahun baru harus dirayakan bersama keluarga besar.
w|beranggapan.en: Grandma believes the new year must be celebrated with the extended family.
w|beranggapan.ko: 할머니는 새해는 온 집안이 함께 보내야 한다고 생각하세요.

w|beranjak.text: Agus enggan beranjak dari sofa karena hujan deras di luar.
w|beranjak.en: Agus was reluctant to get up from the sofa because of the heavy rain outside.
w|beranjak.ko: 밖에 비가 세차게 와서 아구스는 소파에서 일어나기 싫었어요.

w|beranjak.text: Pagi yang dingin membuat Wati malas beranjak dari tempat tidur.
w|beranjak.en: The cold morning made Wati reluctant to get out of bed.
w|beranjak.ko: 추운 아침이라 와티는 침대에서 일어나기 싫었어요.

w|berantakan.en: His room was messy after the small party.

w|berantakan.text: Meja kerja itu terlihat berantakan sekali.

w|berarti.en: His silence doesn't mean he's angry.

w|beras.text: Selain tepung, Fajar juga memakai tepung beras untuk kue tradisional.
w|beras.en: Besides wheat flour, Fajar also uses rice flour for traditional cakes.
w|beras.ko: 파자르는 밀가루 말고도 전통 과자에 쌀가루를 써요.

w|beras.text: Ayah Lestari membawa sekarung beras dari kampung untuk anaknya.
w|beras.en: Lestari's father brought a sack of rice from the village for his daughter.
w|beras.ko: 레스타리의 아버지는 딸을 위해 고향에서 쌀 한 포대를 가져왔어요.

w|berasumsi.text: Budi berasumsi hujan akan turun minggu ini karena langit sudah mendung.
w|berasumsi.en: Budi assumed it would rain this week because the sky was already cloudy.
w|berasumsi.ko: 하늘이 벌써 흐려서 부디는 이번 주에 비가 올 거라고 생각했어요.

w|berasumsi.text: Kru berasumsi lampu cadangan sudah dibawa, ternyata tertinggal di gudang.
w|berasumsi.en: The crew assumed the spare lights had been brought, but they were left in the storeroom.
w|berasumsi.ko: 제작진은 예비 조명을 가져온 줄 알았는데 창고에 두고 왔어요.

w|berbagai.en: Various options are available on the menu.

w|berbagai.text: Dia mencoba berbagai cara untuk belajar.
w|berbagai.en: She tried various ways to study.

w|berbagi.en: Let's share food with the neighbors.

w|berbagi.text: Berbagi cerita membuat kami lebih dekat.

w|berbahagia.text: Budi ikut berbahagia atas kelahiran anak pertama Andi.
w|berbahagia.en: Budi shares in the happiness over the birth of Andi's first child.
w|berbahagia.ko: 부디는 안디의 첫아이 출생을 함께 기뻐해요.

w|berbahagia.text: Keluarga Siti berbahagia melihat medali pertamanya.
w|berbahagia.en: Siti's family was happy to see her first medal.
w|berbahagia.ko: 시티 가족은 그녀의 첫 메달을 보고 행복해했어요.

w|berbahasa.text: Sekolah Andi mewajibkan siswa berbahasa Inggris setiap hari Jumat.
w|berbahasa.en: Andi's school requires students to speak English every Friday.
w|berbahasa.ko: 안디의 학교는 금요일마다 학생들에게 영어로 말하게 해요.

w|berbahasa.text: Dewi sering membantu pasien asing yang tidak bisa berbahasa Indonesia.
w|berbahasa.en: Dewi often helps foreign patients who can't speak Indonesian.
w|berbahasa.ko: 데위는 인도네시아어를 못 하는 외국인 환자들을 자주 도와줘요.

w|berbahaya.en: It's so dangerous to play here.

w|berbakat.en: That child is talented in music.

w|berbakat.text: Berbakat saja tidak cukup tanpa latihan.
w|berbakat.en: Being talented alone is not enough without practice.

w|berbalik.en: The situation can reverse at any time.

w|berbaring.text: Dia berbaring di sofa setelah bekerja.
w|berbaring.en: He lay on the sofa after work.

w|berbaring.text: Pasien diminta berbaring di tempat tidur.
w|berbaring.en: The patient was asked to lie on the bed.

w|berbaris.text: Anak-anak sekolah berbaris di depan pintu museum sambil menunggu pemandu.
w|berbaris.en: Schoolchildren lined up in front of the museum entrance while waiting for the guide.
w|berbaris.ko: 학생들이 박물관 입구 앞에 줄을 서서 안내원을 기다렸어요.

w|berbaris.text: Pagi-pagi, para pembeli sudah berbaris di depan kios tahu yang terkenal itu.
w|berbaris.en: Early in the morning, shoppers were already lined up in front of the famous tofu stall.
w|berbaris.ko: 아침 일찍부터 그 유명한 두부 가게 앞에는 손님들이 줄을 섰어요.

w|berbasa-basi.text: Rudi sempat berbasa-basi dengan penjaga pos sebelum mulai mendaki.
w|berbasa-basi.en: Rudi made small talk with the post guard before starting the climb.
w|berbasa-basi.ko: 루디는 등산을 시작하기 전에 초소 경비원과 잠깐 인사말을 나눴어요.

w|berbasa-basi.text: Saat antre, Rina berbasa-basi dengan penonton di sebelahnya soal cuaca.
w|berbasa-basi.en: While waiting in line, Rina made small talk about the weather with the person next to her.
w|berbasa-basi.ko: 줄을 서는 동안 리나는 옆 사람과 날씨 이야기로 가볍게 말을 나눴어요.

w|berbasis.text: Gedung itu memakai sistem keamanan berbasis kartu akses.
w|berbasis.en: That building uses a security system based on access cards.
w|berbasis.ko: 그 건물은 출입 카드 방식의 보안 시스템을 써요.

w|berbasis.text: Intan memesan tiket lewat aplikasi berbasis daring.
w|berbasis.en: Intan booked her ticket through an online-based app.

w|berbau.text: Ruang laboratorium kimia selalu berbau cuka.
w|berbau.en: The chemistry lab always smells of vinegar.
w|berbau.ko: 화학 실험실에서는 늘 식초 냄새가 나요.

w|berbau.text: Kotak makanan dari katering berbau rendang yang harum.
w|berbau.en: The catering food boxes smelled of fragrant rendang.
w|berbau.ko: 케이터링 도시락에서 향긋한 른당 냄새가 났어요.

w|berbaur.text: Di pasar loak, turis dan warga lokal berbaur mencari barang murah.
w|berbaur.en: At the flea market, tourists and locals mingle, looking for bargains.
w|berbaur.ko: 벼룩시장에서는 관광객과 동네 사람들이 섞여 싼 물건을 찾아요.

w|berbaur.text: Keluarga Intan dari Jawa dan keluarga suaminya dari Sumatra cepat berbaur di pesta.
w|berbaur.en: Intan's family from Java and her husband's family from Sumatra mingled quickly at the party.
w|berbaur.ko: 자바 출신 인탄의 가족과 수마트라 출신 남편의 가족은 잔치에서 금세 어울렸어요.

w|berbelanja.text: Setiap Minggu pagi, Bayu suka berbelanja barang bekas di pasar loak dekat stasiun.
w|berbelanja.en: Every Sunday morning, Bayu likes shopping for secondhand goods at the flea market near the station.
w|berbelanja.ko: 매주 일요일 아침 바유는 역 근처 벼룩시장에서 중고 물건 사는 걸 좋아해요.

w|berbelanja.text: Seminggu sebelum menikah, Intan sibuk berbelanja oleh-oleh untuk keluarga calon suaminya.
w|berbelanja.en: A week before the wedding, Intan was busy shopping for gifts for her future husband's family.
w|berbelanja.ko: 결혼 일주일 전에 인탄은 예비 시댁 식구들에게 줄 선물을 사느라 바빴어요.

w|berbentuk.text: Atap gedung itu nanti berbentuk kubah besar.
w|berbentuk.en: The building's roof will be shaped like a big dome.
w|berbentuk.ko: 그 건물 지붕은 큰 돔 모양이 될 거예요.

w|berbentuk.text: Kartu akses Rina berbentuk seperti gantungan kunci kecil.
w|berbentuk.en: Rina's access card is shaped like a small keyring.
w|berbentuk.ko: 리나의 출입 카드는 작은 열쇠고리 모양이에요.

w|berbicara.en: We talked for a long time.

w|berbincang.text: Saat istirahat, Agus suka berbincang dengan penjaga sekolah.
w|berbincang.en: At break time, Agus likes chatting with the school caretaker.
w|berbincang.ko: 쉬는 시간에 아구스는 학교 관리인 아저씨와 이야기 나누는 걸 좋아해요.

w|berbincang.text: Setelah berenang, Wati berbincang dengan ibu-ibu lain di kafe kolam.
w|berbincang.en: After swimming, Wati chatted with the other mothers at the pool café.
w|berbincang.ko: 수영 후에 와티는 수영장 카페에서 다른 엄마들과 이야기를 나눴어요.

w|berbisik.text: Di balik tirai, Bayu berbisik mengingatkan rekannya soal dialog berikutnya.
w|berbisik.en: Behind the curtain, Bayu whispered to remind his colleague of the next line.
w|berbisik.ko: 막 뒤에서 바유는 동료에게 다음 대사를 속삭여 알려 줬어요.

w|berbisik.text: Saat presentasi, Dodi berbisik kepada Intan bahwa slidenya terbalik.
w|berbisik.en: During the presentation, Dodi whispered to Intan that her slide was upside down.
w|berbisik.ko: 발표 중에 도디가 인탄에게 슬라이드가 거꾸로 됐다고 속삭였어요.

w|berbisnis.text: Rudi ingin berbisnis bahan bangunan setelah pensiun dari proyek.
w|berbisnis.en: Rudi wants to do business in building materials after retiring from site work.
w|berbisnis.ko: 루디는 현장 일을 그만두면 건축 자재 장사를 하고 싶어요.

w|berbisnis.text: Rekan baru Rina bercerita bahwa ayahnya berbisnis kopi di Toraja.
w|berbisnis.en: Rina's new colleague said her father runs a coffee business in Toraja.
w|berbisnis.ko: 리나의 새 동료는 아버지가 토라자에서 커피 사업을 한다고 했어요.

w|berbohong.en: Lying will only make things worse.

w|berbulan-bulan.text: Lift di gedung Bayu rusak berbulan-bulan sebelum akhirnya diganti.
w|berbulan-bulan.en: The elevator in Bayu's building was broken for months before it was finally replaced.
w|berbulan-bulan.ko: 바유네 건물 엘리베이터는 몇 달이나 고장 났다가 마침내 교체됐어요.

w|berbulan-bulan.text: Intan sudah merencanakan perjalanan itu berbulan-bulan sebelumnya.
w|berbulan-bulan.en: Intan had planned that trip months in advance.
w|berbulan-bulan.ko: 인탄은 그 여행을 몇 달 전부터 계획했어요.

w|berbulu.text: Agus menemukan anak burung berbulu abu-abu yang jatuh dari sarangnya.
w|berbulu.en: Agus found a grey-feathered chick that had fallen from its nest.
w|berbulu.ko: 아구스는 둥지에서 떨어진 회색 깃털의 새끼 새를 찾았어요.

w|berbulu.text: Wati alergi hewan berbulu, jadi dia selalu menyimpan obat antihistamin.
w|berbulu.en: Wati is allergic to furry animals, so she always keeps antihistamines.
w|berbulu.ko: 와티는 털 있는 동물에 알레르기가 있어서 항히스타민제를 늘 챙겨 둬요.

w|berbunyi.text: Telepon berbunyi di tengah rapat penting.
w|berbunyi.en: The phone rang in the middle of an important meeting.

w|berbunyi.text: Alarm berbunyi keras membangunkan semua orang.
w|berbunyi.en: The alarm rang loudly and woke everyone.

w|berburu.text: Mereka berburu di hutan setiap musim dingin.
w|berburu.en: They hunt in the forest every winter.

w|berburu.text: Harimau itu keluar untuk berburu malam hari.
w|berburu.en: That tiger went out to hunt at night.

w|bercahaya.text: Kunang-kunang bercahaya di sawah saat awal musim hujan.
w|bercahaya.en: Fireflies glow in the rice fields at the start of the rainy season.

w|bercahaya.text: Lantai kayu yang baru dipoles tampak bercahaya terkena sinar matahari.
w|bercahaya.en: The newly polished wooden floor looked glowing in the sunlight.
w|bercahaya.ko: 새로 광을 낸 나무 바닥이 햇빛을 받아 반짝였어요.

w|bercakap.text: Agus belajar bercakap dengan teman sebangkunya dalam bahasa Inggris.
w|bercakap.en: Agus practices conversing with his deskmate in English.
w|bercakap.ko: 아구스는 짝꿍과 영어로 대화하는 연습을 해요.

w|bercakap.text: Di pinggir kolam, Wati bercakap dengan pelatih renangnya.
w|bercakap.en: At the edge of the pool, Wati talked with her swimming coach.
w|bercakap.ko: 수영장 가장자리에서 와티는 수영 코치와 이야기했어요.

w|bercerai.ko: 그들은 함께한 지 여러 해 만에 이혼했어.

w|bercerai.text: Orang tuanya bercerai saat dia masih kecil.
w|bercerai.en: His parents divorced when he was still little.

w|bercerita.en: Grandma likes to tell stories before bed.
w|bercerita.ko: 할머니는 잠들기 전에 이야기하는 걸 좋아해.

w|bercerita.en: He started telling about his vacation.

w|berciuman.text: Di film yang diputar saat pelajaran bahasa, ada adegan pasangan berciuman di stasiun.
w|berciuman.en: In the film shown during language class, there's a scene of a couple kissing at a station.
w|berciuman.ko: 국어 시간에 튼 영화에는 연인이 기차역에서 입맞추는 장면이 있어요.

w|berciuman.text: Semua orang bersorak saat pasangan pengantin baru dari angkatan mereka berciuman di panggung.
w|berciuman.en: Everyone cheered when the newlywed couple from their year kissed on stage.
w|berciuman.ko: 같은 학년 출신 신혼부부가 무대에서 입을 맞추자 모두 환호했어요.

w|berdagang.text: Sebelum bekerja di pabrik, Dimas pernah berdagang sayur di pasar.
w|berdagang.en: Before working at the factory, Dimas used to sell vegetables at the market.
w|berdagang.ko: 디마스는 공장에서 일하기 전에 시장에서 채소 장사를 했어요.

w|berdagang.text: Ibu Sari masih berdagang kue di pasar pagi.
w|berdagang.en: Sari's mother still sells cakes at the morning market.
w|berdagang.ko: 사리의 어머니는 아직도 아침 시장에서 떡을 팔아요.

w|berdamai.text: Setelah bertengkar seminggu, Eko akhirnya berdamai dengan sahabatnya.
w|berdamai.en: After fighting for a week, Eko finally made peace with his best friend.
w|berdamai.ko: 일주일 동안 싸운 끝에 에코는 마침내 단짝과 화해했어요.

w|berdamai.text: Ayu belajar berdamai dengan kesalahan kecil di lukisannya.
w|berdamai.en: Ayu is learning to make peace with small mistakes in her paintings.
w|berdamai.ko: 아유는 그림 속 작은 실수를 받아들이는 법을 배우고 있어요.

w|berdandan.text: Sebelum tampil di siaran langsung, Budi berdandan sebentar di toilet kantor.
w|berdandan.en: Before appearing on the live broadcast, Budi quickly groomed himself in the office restroom.
w|berdandan.ko: 생방송에 나가기 전 부디는 사무실 화장실에서 잠깐 몸단장을 했어요.

w|berdandan.text: Siti tidak sempat berdandan karena harus membuka perpustakaan pagi-pagi.
w|berdandan.en: Siti didn't have time to get dressed up because she had to open the library early.
w|berdandan.ko: 시티는 아침 일찍 도서관을 열어야 해서 꾸밀 시간이 없었어요.

w|berdansa.text: Mereka berdansa di tengah lantai pesta.
w|berdansa.en: They danced in the middle of the party floor.

w|berdansa.text: Dia suka berdansa setiap akhir pekan.
w|berdansa.en: She likes to dance every weekend.

w|berdarah.en: His nose bled after he fell.

w|berdasarkan.en: That decision is based on the latest data.
w|berdasarkan.ko: 그 결정은 최신 자료를 바탕으로 했어.

w|berdasarkan.en: Based on the report, it will rain hard.
w|berdasarkan.ko: 보고에 따르면 비가 세차게 올 거야.

w|berdaya.text: Pabrik itu memasang mesin baru yang berdaya besar tapi hemat listrik.
w|berdaya.en: The factory installed new machines that are powerful but energy-efficient.
w|berdaya.ko: 그 공장은 힘은 세지만 전기는 적게 드는 새 기계를 들여놓았어요.

w|berdaya.text: Intan merasa tidak berdaya waktu penerbangannya dibatalkan.
w|berdaya.en: Intan felt helpless when her flight was cancelled.
w|berdaya.ko: 비행이 취소되자 인탄은 어쩔 수 없는 무력감을 느꼈어요.

w|berdebar.text: Jantung Bayu berdebar saat melihat kamera langka itu dijual murah.
w|berdebar.en: Bayu's heart pounded when he saw that rare camera being sold cheaply.
w|berdebar.ko: 그 희귀한 카메라가 싸게 팔리는 걸 보고 바유의 가슴이 두근거렸어요.

w|berdebar.text: Hati Intan berdebar ketika penghulu mulai membacakan akad.
w|berdebar.en: Intan's heart raced when the officiant began reading the marriage vows.
w|berdebar.ko: 혼인 주례가 서약문을 읽기 시작하자 인탄의 가슴이 두근거렸어요.

w|berdebat.text: Jangan berdebat jika emosi sedang tinggi.
w|berdebat.en: Don't debate when emotions are high.

w|berdekatan.text: Proyek Agus berdekatan dengan sekolah, jadi mereka tidak boleh bekerja saat jam pelajaran ujian.
w|berdekatan.en: Agus's project is close to a school, so they can't work during exam hours.
w|berdekatan.ko: 아구스의 현장은 학교와 가까워서 시험 시간에는 작업할 수 없어요.

w|berdekatan.text: Gudang penjual itu berdekatan dengan rumah Wati, jadi paketnya sampai dalam sehari.
w|berdekatan.en: The seller's warehouse is near Wati's house, so the package arrived within a day.
w|berdekatan.ko: 그 판매자의 창고가 와티 집과 가까워서 택배가 하루 만에 도착했어요.

w|berdering.text: Bel istirahat berdering, dan murid-murid berlarian ke kantin.
w|berdering.en: The break bell rang, and the students ran to the canteen.
w|berdering.ko: 쉬는 시간 종이 울리자 학생들이 매점으로 뛰어갔어요.

w|berdering.text: Telepon Siti terus berdering karena sopir truk bingung mencari alamat.
w|berdering.en: Siti's phone kept ringing because the truck driver couldn't find the address.
w|berdering.ko: 트럭 기사가 주소를 못 찾아 헤매서 시티 전화가 계속 울렸어요.

w|berdetak.text: Jantung Rudi berdetak kencang saat menemukan foto lama mereka berdua.
w|berdetak.en: Rudi's heart beat fast when he found an old photo of the two of them.
w|berdetak.ko: 둘이 찍은 옛날 사진을 찾았을 때 루디의 심장이 빠르게 뛰었어요.

w|berdetak.text: Jantung Rina berdetak cepat saat menekan tombol peluncuran.
w|berdetak.en: Rina's heart was beating fast as she pressed the launch button.
w|berdetak.ko: 출시 버튼을 누를 때 리나의 심장이 빠르게 뛰었어요.

w|berdiam.text: Selama akad berlangsung, semua tamu berdiam dan mendengarkan dengan khidmat.
w|berdiam.en: While the vows were taking place, all the guests stayed silent and listened solemnly.
w|berdiam.ko: 혼인 서약이 진행되는 동안 하객들은 모두 숨죽이고 엄숙하게 들었어요.

w|berdiam.text: Saat hujan deras, Lestari lebih suka berdiam di rumah sambil membaca.
w|berdiam.en: When it pours, Lestari prefers to stay at home reading.
w|berdiam.ko: 비가 세차게 올 때 레스타리는 집에 머물며 책 읽는 걸 더 좋아해요.

w|berdiskusi.text: Di mobil, Agus dan teman-temannya berdiskusi soal tujuan berikutnya.
w|berdiskusi.en: In the car, Agus and his friends discussed where to go next.
w|berdiskusi.ko: 차 안에서 아구스와 친구들은 다음 목적지를 의논했어요.

w|berdiskusi.text: Para pegawai berdiskusi tentang cara menata etalase untuk musim liburan.
w|berdiskusi.en: The staff discussed how to arrange the display window for the holiday season.
w|berdiskusi.ko: 직원들은 휴가철에 맞춰 진열장을 꾸밀 방법을 의논했어요.

w|berdosa.text: Berbuat jahat dianggap berdosa di agama.
w|berdosa.en: Doing harm is considered sinful in religion.

w|berdua.en: Let's just go the two of us.
The two of them sat in the park.

w|berduel.text: Dua anak di pasar berduel dengan pedang kayu yang baru dibeli ayah mereka.
w|berduel.en: Two kids at the market dueled with wooden swords their father had just bought.
w|berduel.ko: 시장에서 두 아이가 아빠가 막 사 준 나무칼로 결투를 벌였어요.

w|berduel.text: Dua penari pencak silat berduel di depan pelaminan untuk menyambut pengantin.
w|berduel.en: Two pencak silat dancers dueled in front of the dais to welcome the couple.
w|berduel.ko: 두 명의 펜착 실랏 무용수가 신랑 신부를 맞이하려고 단상 앞에서 겨루기를 했어요.

w|bereaksi.text: Murid-murid bereaksi heboh ketika kepala sekolah mengumumkan libur tambahan.
w|bereaksi.en: The students reacted excitedly when the principal announced an extra holiday.
w|bereaksi.ko: 교장 선생님이 휴일을 하루 더 준다고 발표하자 학생들이 들썩였어요.

w|bereaksi.text: Anjing Siti bereaksi gugup saat masuk rumah yang masih asing.
w|bereaksi.en: Siti's dog reacted nervously when it entered the unfamiliar house.
w|bereaksi.ko: 시티네 개는 낯선 집에 들어가자 불안해했어요.

w|beredar.text: Video latihan Bayu sempat beredar di grup anggota gym.
w|beredar.en: Bayu's workout video circulated in the gym members' group chat.
w|beredar.ko: 바유의 운동 영상이 헬스장 회원 단톡방에 돌았어요.

w|beredar.text: Kabar restoran itu akan tutup sempat beredar, tapi ternyata hanya renovasi.
w|beredar.en: A rumor that the restaurant would close went around, but it was only a renovation.
w|beredar.ko: 그 식당이 문을 닫는다는 소문이 돌았지만 알고 보니 수리만 하는 거였어요.

w|berenang.en: Kids like swimming in the pool.
I learned to swim since childhood.

w|berencana.en: We plan to vacation at the beach.

w|beres.text: Semua urusan sudah beres sebelum malam.
w|beres.en: All matters were settled before night.
w|beres.ko: 모든 일이 밤 전에 다 끝났어.

w|beres.en: Just relax, everything will be fine.

w|berevolusi.text: Rina bercerita bahwa perusahaan lamanya terus berevolusi mengikuti teknologi.
w|berevolusi.en: Rina said her old company kept evolving with technology.
w|berevolusi.ko: 리나는 예전 회사가 기술을 따라 계속 진화했다고 했어요.

w|berevolusi.text: Hotel kecil itu berevolusi menjadi resor besar dalam dua puluh tahun.
w|berevolusi.en: That small hotel evolved into a big resort over twenty years.
w|berevolusi.ko: 그 작은 호텔은 이십 년 만에 큰 리조트로 발전했어요.

w|berfoto.text: Setelah renovasi selesai, keluarga Andi berfoto di depan rumah.
w|berfoto.en: After the renovation was done, Andi's family took a photo in front of the house.
w|berfoto.ko: 수리가 끝나자 안디 가족은 집 앞에서 사진을 찍었어요.

w|berfoto.text: Para turis berfoto di peron stasiun tua yang bergaya kolonial.
w|berfoto.en: The tourists take photos on the platform of the old colonial-style station.
w|berfoto.ko: 관광객들이 식민지풍 옛 역 승강장에서 사진을 찍어요.

w|berfungsi.text: Mesin ini masih berfungsi dengan baik.
Lampu jalan tidak berfungsi sejak kemarin.
w|berfungsi.en: The street light has not functioned since yesterday.

w|bergabung.text: Dia ingin bergabung dengan tim kami.
w|bergabung.en: He wants to join our team.
There's still time to join now.

w|bergairah.text: Andi menulis bahwa ia masih bergairah mengajar anak-anak di desa.
w|bergairah.en: Andi writes that he is still passionate about teaching children in the village.
w|bergairah.ko: 안디는 아직도 마을 아이들을 가르치는 데 열정이 넘친다고 써요.

w|bergairah.text: Siti merasa bergairah setiap kali musim lomba lari dimulai.
w|bergairah.en: Siti feels excited every time the running season begins.
w|bergairah.ko: 시티는 마라톤 시즌이 시작될 때마다 의욕이 넘쳐요.

w|berganti.text: Setelah pelajaran olahraga, Eko berganti baju di ruang ganti.
w|berganti.en: After PE, Eko changed clothes in the locker room.
w|berganti.ko: 체육 시간이 끝나고 에코는 탈의실에서 옷을 갈아입었어요.

w|berganti.text: Warna langit di lukisan Ayu berganti dari jingga ke ungu.
w|berganti.en: The color of the sky in Ayu's painting shifts from orange to purple.
w|berganti.ko: 아유의 그림 속 하늘색은 주황에서 보라로 바뀌어요.

w|bergantung.en: The result depends on our effort.

w|bergantung.text: Jangan terlalu bergantung pada orang lain.
w|bergantung.en: Don't depend too much on other people.

w|bergaul.text: Anak itu mudah bergaul dengan teman baru.
w|bergaul.en: That child easily socializes with new friends.
w|bergaul.ko: 그 아이는 새 친구와 쉽게 어울려.

w|bergaul.text: Dia jarang bergaul di luar kerja.
w|bergaul.en: He rarely socializes outside of work.
w|bergaul.ko: 그는 일 밖에서 거의 어울리지 않아.

w|bergaya.text: Di atas panggung, Eko bergaya seperti bangsawan tua yang sombong.
w|bergaya.en: On stage, Eko acted like an arrogant old nobleman.
w|bergaya.ko: 무대 위에서 에코는 거만한 늙은 귀족처럼 굴었어요.

w|bergaya.text: Anak SMA itu suka bergaya di depan cermin kecil di toko Ayu.
w|bergaya.en: That high school kid likes to pose in front of the little mirror in Ayu's shop.
w|bergaya.ko: 그 고등학생은 아유 가게의 작은 거울 앞에서 폼 잡는 걸 좋아해요.

w|bergegas.en: They hurried toward the train station.
Just hurry before the shop closes.

w|bergembira.text: Budi bergembira mendengar Andi akan pindah ke kota yang sama.
w|bergembira.en: Budi rejoiced to hear that Andi will move to the same city.
w|bergembira.ko: 안디가 같은 도시로 이사 온다는 소식에 부디는 기뻐했어요.

w|bergembira.text: Siti dan teman-temannya bergembira setelah semua berhasil finis.
w|bergembira.en: Siti and her friends rejoiced after they all managed to finish.

w|bergemuruh.text: Suara truk pengangkut pasir bergemuruh di depan rumah Andi sejak pagi.
w|bergemuruh.en: The sound of the sand truck has been rumbling in front of Andi's house since morning.
w|bergemuruh.ko: 아침부터 모래 운반 트럭 소리가 안디네 집 앞에서 우르릉거려요.

w|bergemuruh.text: Kereta bergemuruh saat melintasi jembatan besi di atas sungai.
w|bergemuruh.en: The train rumbled as it crossed the iron bridge over the river.
w|bergemuruh.ko: 열차가 강 위 철교를 건널 때 우르릉거렸어요.

w|bergeser.text: Jadwal pengiriman paket Fajar bergeser dua hari karena libur nasional.
w|bergeser.en: Fajar's delivery schedule shifted two days because of a national holiday.
w|bergeser.ko: 공휴일 때문에 파자르의 택배 배송 일정이 이틀 밀렸어요.

w|bergeser.text: Lestari bergeser sedikit supaya teman di sebelahnya bisa memakai kompor.
w|bergeser.en: Lestari shifted over a little so the friend next to her could use the stove.
w|bergeser.ko: 레스타리는 옆 친구가 가스레인지를 쓸 수 있게 조금 비켜섰어요.

w|bergetar.text: Suara Rina bergetar waktu dia menuduh Budi mengambil uangnya.
w|bergetar.en: Rina's voice trembled when she accused Budi of taking her money.
w|bergetar.ko: 리나는 부디가 돈을 가져갔다고 따질 때 목소리가 떨렸어요.

w|bergetar.text: Lantai rumah lama Siti bergetar setiap kali truk lewat.
w|bergetar.en: The floor of Siti's old house shook every time a truck passed.
w|bergetar.ko: 시티의 예전 집은 트럭이 지나갈 때마다 바닥이 흔들렸어요.

w|bergoyang.text: Rudi ingat mereka bergoyang mengikuti lagu dangdut di pesta pernikahan kakak Bayu.
w|bergoyang.en: Rudi remembers them swaying to dangdut songs at Bayu's sister's wedding.
w|bergoyang.ko: 루디는 바유 누나의 결혼식에서 둘이 당둣 노래에 맞춰 몸을 흔들던 걸 기억해요.

w|bergoyang.text: Saat ada gempa kecil, monitor di meja Rina sempat bergoyang.
w|bergoyang.en: During a small earthquake, the monitor on Rina's desk swayed for a moment.
w|bergoyang.ko: 작은 지진이 났을 때 리나 책상 위 모니터가 잠깐 흔들렸어요.

w|bergulat.text: Agus bergulat dengan soal fisika itu hampir satu jam.
w|bergulat.en: Agus wrestled with that physics problem for almost an hour.
w|bergulat.ko: 아구스는 그 물리 문제와 거의 한 시간을 씨름했어요.

w|bergulat.text: Waktu kecil, Wati bergulat dengan rasa takut air selama bertahun-tahun.
w|bergulat.en: As a child, Wati struggled with her fear of water for years.
w|bergulat.ko: 어릴 때 와티는 몇 년 동안 물 공포증과 씨름했어요.

w|bergurau.text: Agus dan teman-temannya sering bergurau di kantin sampai lupa waktu.
w|bergurau.en: Agus and his friends often joke around in the canteen until they lose track of time.
w|bergurau.ko: 아구스와 친구들은 매점에서 시간 가는 줄 모르고 농담을 주고받아요.

w|bergurau.text: Penjaga kolam suka bergurau dengan anak-anak yang datang pagi.
w|bergurau.en: The lifeguard likes joking with the kids who come in the morning.
w|bergurau.ko: 수영장 안전요원은 아침에 오는 아이들과 농담하는 걸 좋아해요.

w|berhadapan.text: Dia berhadapan dengan lawan yang tangguh.
Dua tim berhadapan di final yang menegangkan.
w|berhadapan.en: Two teams faced each other in a tense final.

w|berhak.en: Every citizen is entitled to receive education.
w|berhak.ko: 모든 시민은 교육을 받을 권리가 있어.

w|berhak.text: Dia berhak menolak permintaan yang tidak adil.
w|berhak.en: She has the right to refuse an unfair request.
w|berhak.ko: 그는 불공정한 요청을 거절할 권리가 있어.

w|berhalusinasi.text: Setelah berjam-jam di bawah terik matahari, Eko merasa seperti berhalusinasi.
w|berhalusinasi.en: After hours under the blazing sun, Eko felt as if he were hallucinating.
w|berhalusinasi.ko: 몇 시간이나 뙤약볕 아래 있었더니 에코는 환각을 보는 것 같았어요.

w|berhalusinasi.text: Kakek di sebelah rumah Ayu kadang berhalusinasi karena demam tinggi.
w|berhalusinasi.en: The old man next door to Ayu sometimes hallucinates because of a high fever.
w|berhalusinasi.ko: 아유네 옆집 할아버지는 고열 때문에 가끔 헛것을 봐요.

w|berhari-hari.text: Kabut asap menyelimuti kota Dimas berhari-hari selama kemarau panjang.
w|berhari-hari.en: Haze blanketed Dimas's town for days during the long dry season.
w|berhari-hari.ko: 긴 건기 동안 연무가 며칠씩 디마스네 도시를 뒤덮었어요.

w|berhari-hari.text: Putri mengampelas lantai kayu itu berhari-hari sampai halus.
w|berhari-hari.en: Putri sanded the wooden floor for days until it was smooth.
w|berhari-hari.ko: 푸트리는 나무 바닥을 매끈해질 때까지 며칠 동안 사포질했어요.

w|berhati-hati.en: Be careful on the slippery road.

w|berhubungan.en: That is related to this case.

w|berhutang.en: He still owes a lot of money.
w|berhutang.ko: 그는 아직 돈을 많이 빚지고 있어.

w|berhutang.en: Owing money to a friend makes me embarrassed.

w|berikut.en: The following is the list of participants.

w|berikutnya.en: Next we'll discuss the money issue.

w|berinteraksi.text: Di lapangan, Agus berinteraksi dengan tukang, sopir truk, dan pengawas setiap hari.
w|berinteraksi.en: On site, Agus interacts with builders, truck drivers, and supervisors every day.
w|berinteraksi.ko: 현장에서 아구스는 매일 인부, 트럭 기사, 감독관과 소통해요.

w|berinteraksi.text: Wati jarang berinteraksi dengan penjual, kecuali kalau barangnya rusak.
w|berinteraksi.en: Wati rarely interacts with sellers, unless the item arrives damaged.
w|berinteraksi.ko: 와티는 물건이 망가져서 오지 않는 한 판매자와 거의 연락하지 않아요.

w|berinvestasi.text: Pemilik proyek ingin berinvestasi lagi di perumahan dekat stasiun.
w|berinvestasi.en: The project owner wants to invest again in housing near the station.
w|berinvestasi.ko: 건축주는 역 근처 주택에 다시 투자하고 싶어 해요.

w|berinvestasi.text: Setelah sering belanja daring, Wati ingin berinvestasi kecil-kecilan lewat aplikasi juga.
w|berinvestasi.en: After shopping online so often, Wati wants to make small investments through an app too.
w|berinvestasi.ko: 온라인 쇼핑을 자주 하다 보니 와티는 앱으로 소액 투자도 해 보고 싶어졌어요.

w|berisi.text: Kotak hadiah berisi buku dan pena.
w|berisi.en: The gift box contains a book and a pen.
w|berisi.ko: 선물 상자에 책과 펜이 들어 있어.

w|berisik.text: Ruangan itu terlalu berisik untuk belajar.
w|berisik.en: That room is too noisy for studying.
The old machine sounds very noisy.

w|berisiko.text: Bekerja tanpa helm di area pengelasan sangat berisiko.
w|berisiko.en: Working without a helmet in the welding area is very risky.
w|berisiko.ko: 용접 구역에서 안전모 없이 일하는 건 아주 위험해요.

w|berisiko.text: Putri menulis bahwa mengirim uang tunai lewat pos itu berisiko.
w|berisiko.en: Putri writes that sending cash by post is risky.
w|berisiko.ko: 푸트리는 우편으로 현금을 보내는 건 위험하다고 썼어요.

w|beristirahat.en: We need to rest for a moment.

w|berjabat.text: Setelah musim panen, Dimas berjabat tangan dengan para petani di desa pamannya.
w|berjabat.en: After the harvest season, Dimas shook hands with the farmers in his uncle's village.
w|berjabat.ko: 수확철이 끝나고 디마스는 삼촌 마을의 농부들과 악수했어요.

w|berjabat.text: Putri berjabat tangan dengan kontraktor setelah harga disepakati.
w|berjabat.en: Putri shook hands with the contractor after they agreed on a price.

w|berjaga.text: Malam perkemahan, Eko dan dua temannya berjaga di dekat api unggun.
w|berjaga.en: On the camping night, Eko and two friends kept watch near the campfire.
w|berjaga.ko: 캠프 날 밤 에코와 친구 둘은 모닥불 곁에서 보초를 섰어요.

w|berjaga.text: Saat pameran, Ayu bergantian berjaga di samping karya-karyanya.
w|berjaga.en: During the exhibition, Ayu took turns keeping watch beside her works.
w|berjaga.ko: 전시회 동안 아유는 돌아가며 자기 작품 옆을 지켰어요.

w|berjaga-jaga.text: Eko membawa jas hujan untuk berjaga-jaga kalau badai datang.
w|berjaga-jaga.en: Eko brought a raincoat just in case a storm came.
w|berjaga-jaga.ko: 에코는 폭풍이 올 경우를 대비해 우비를 챙겼어요.

w|berjaga-jaga.text: Bapak-bapak di kompleks Ayu bergiliran berjaga-jaga di pos ronda.
w|berjaga-jaga.en: The men in Ayu's complex take turns keeping watch at the guard post.
w|berjaga-jaga.ko: 아유네 단지 아저씨들은 돌아가며 초소에서 경비를 서요.

w|berjalan-jalan.text: Setiap pagi Agus suka berjalan-jalan di sekitar penginapan.
w|berjalan-jalan.en: Every morning Agus likes to take a walk around the guesthouse.
w|berjalan-jalan.ko: 아구스는 아침마다 숙소 주변을 산책하는 걸 좋아해요.

w|berjalan-jalan.text: Pada hari Minggu banyak keluarga datang hanya untuk berjalan-jalan di mal.
w|berjalan-jalan.en: On Sundays many families come just to stroll around the mall.
w|berjalan-jalan.ko: 일요일에는 그냥 쇼핑몰을 구경하러 오는 가족이 많아요.

w|berjam-jam.text: Bayu berjam-jam menunggu teknisi internet yang tak kunjung datang.
w|berjam-jam.en: Bayu waited for hours for the internet technician, who never showed up.
w|berjam-jam.ko: 바유는 끝내 오지 않는 인터넷 기사를 몇 시간이나 기다렸어요.

w|berjam-jam.text: Kereta itu tertahan berjam-jam karena ada pohon tumbang di rel.
w|berjam-jam.en: The train was held up for hours because a tree had fallen on the tracks.
w|berjam-jam.ko: 선로에 나무가 쓰러져서 기차가 몇 시간이나 멈춰 있었어요.

w|berjanji.text: Berjanji itu mudah, menepatinya yang sulit.
w|berjanji.en: Promising is easy; keeping it is hard.

w|berjarak.text: Lapak-lapak di pasar loak itu hanya berjarak satu langkah satu sama lain.
w|berjarak.en: The stalls at the flea market are only a step apart from each other.
w|berjarak.ko: 그 벼룩시장의 노점들은 서로 한 걸음 정도밖에 떨어져 있지 않아요.

w|berjarak.text: Meja tamu diatur berjarak cukup jauh agar orang mudah lewat.
w|berjarak.en: The guest tables were set far enough apart so people could pass easily.
w|berjarak.ko: 손님 테이블은 사람들이 쉽게 지나갈 수 있도록 넉넉한 간격을 두고 배치됐어요.

w|berjaya.text: Tim futsal penghuni gedung Bayu berjaya dalam turnamen antarapartemen.
w|berjaya.en: The futsal team of residents from Bayu's building triumphed in the inter-apartment tournament.
w|berjaya.ko: 바유네 건물 입주민 풋살팀이 아파트 대항 대회에서 이겼어요.

w|berjaya.text: Intan membaca brosur tentang kerajaan yang dulu berjaya di Jawa Timur.
w|berjaya.en: Intan read a brochure about a kingdom that once flourished in East Java.
w|berjaya.ko: 인탄은 예전에 동부 자와에서 번성했던 왕국에 관한 안내 책자를 읽었어요.

w|berjudi.text: Paman Fajar dulu kehilangan tokonya karena suka berjudi.
w|berjudi.en: Fajar's uncle once lost his shop because he liked to gamble.
w|berjudi.ko: 파자르의 삼촌은 도박을 좋아해서 가게를 잃은 적이 있어요.

w|berjudi.text: Beberapa penonton berjudi soal siapa yang akan finis pertama.
w|berjudi.en: Some spectators gambled on who would finish first.
w|berjudi.ko: 몇몇 관중은 누가 일등으로 들어올지 내기를 했어요.

w|berjumpa.text: Kami berjumpa lagi setelah lama tidak bertemu.
w|berjumpa.en: We met again after not seeing each other for a long time.
w|berjumpa.ko: 우리는 오래 못 본 뒤에 다시 만났어.

w|berjumpa.en: She hopes to meet her mentor.

w|berkabung.text: Saat keluarga berkabung atas kepergian nenek, Rudi dan kakaknya duduk berdampingan lagi.
w|berkabung.en: While the family mourned their grandmother's passing, Rudi and his sister sat side by side again.
w|berkabung.ko: 가족이 할머니를 잃고 슬퍼할 때 루디와 누나는 다시 나란히 앉았어요.

w|berkabung.text: Desa nelayan itu sedang berkabung karena seorang nelayan senior meninggal dunia.
w|berkabung.en: The fishing village is in mourning because a senior fisherman passed away.
w|berkabung.ko: 그 어촌은 원로 어부가 세상을 떠나서 애도 중이에요.

w|berkah.text: Kepala sekolah bilang hujan setelah kemarau panjang itu sebuah berkah.
w|berkah.en: The principal said the rain after the long drought was a blessing.
w|berkah.ko: 교장 선생님은 긴 가뭄 끝에 온 비가 축복이라고 했어요.

w|berkah.text: Bisa berkumpul lengkap di rumah adalah berkah bagi keluarga Ayu.
w|berkah.en: Being able to gather all together at home is a blessing for Ayu's family.
w|berkah.ko: 집에 다 같이 모일 수 있다는 게 아유네 가족에게는 축복이에요.

w|berkaitan.text: Keluhan warga minggu ini kebanyakan berkaitan dengan sampah.
w|berkaitan.en: Most of this week's resident complaints are related to rubbish.
w|berkaitan.ko: 이번 주 주민 민원은 대부분 쓰레기와 관련돼 있어요.

w|berkaitan.text: Pelajaran teori minggu ini berkaitan dengan tangga nada minor.
w|berkaitan.en: This week's theory lesson is related to minor scales.
w|berkaitan.ko: 이번 주 이론 수업은 단음계와 관련 있어요.

w|berkali-kali.text: Dimas sudah membaca novel detektif itu berkali-kali.
w|berkali-kali.en: Dimas has read that detective novel many times.
w|berkali-kali.ko: 디마스는 그 추리 소설을 여러 번 읽었어요.

w|berkali-kali.text: Kereta berhenti berkali-kali di stasiun kecil sepanjang jalur selatan.
w|berkali-kali.en: The train stopped many times at small stations along the southern line.
w|berkali-kali.ko: 기차는 남쪽 노선의 작은 역마다 여러 번 섰어요.

w|berkarat.text: Ayunan di halaman sekolah Eko sudah berkarat dan berderit.
w|berkarat.en: The swing in Eko's schoolyard is rusty and creaks.
w|berkarat.ko: 에코 학교 마당의 그네는 녹슬어서 삐걱거려요.

w|berkarat.text: Ayu memakai paku berkarat sebagai bahan karya kolase.
w|berkarat.en: Ayu used rusty nails as material for a collage.
w|berkarat.ko: 아유는 녹슨 못을 콜라주 재료로 썼어요.

w|berkas.text: Meja Bayu penuh berkas laporan yang harus ditandatangani.
w|berkas.en: Bayu's desk is full of report files that need signing.
w|berkas.ko: 바유의 책상에는 서명해야 할 보고서 서류가 가득해요.

w|berkas.text: Intan menyimpan berkas visa di map plastik supaya tidak kusut.
w|berkas.en: Intan keeps her visa documents in a plastic folder so they don't get creased.
w|berkas.ko: 인탄은 비자 서류가 구겨지지 않게 비닐 파일에 넣어 둬요.

w|berkat.en: We succeeded thanks to our friends' help.
Thanks to hard work, the result is satisfying.

w|berkedip.text: Lampu di lorong sekolah terus berkedip sejak kemarin.
w|berkedip.en: The light in the school hallway has kept flickering since yesterday.
w|berkedip.ko: 학교 복도 불이 어제부터 계속 깜빡거려요.

w|berkedip.text: Lampu ruang tamu di rumah baru Rina berkedip-kedip, jadi tukang listrik dipanggil.
w|berkedip.en: The living room light in Rina's new house kept blinking, so an electrician was called.
w|berkedip.ko: 리나의 새집 거실 등이 깜빡거려서 전기 기사를 불렀어요.

w|berkelahi.text: Dua anak itu berkelahi di halaman sekolah.
w|berkelahi.en: Those two kids fought in the schoolyard.
w|berkelahi.ko: 그 두 아이가 학교 마당에서 싸웠어.

w|berkelahi.en: Don't fight just because of a misunderstanding.

w|berkelakuan.text: Anak-anak di gedung itu berkelakuan baik di dekat kolam renang.
w|berkelakuan.en: The children in that building behave well near the swimming pool.
w|berkelakuan.ko: 그 건물 아이들은 수영장 근처에서 얌전히 행동해요.

w|berkelakuan.text: Petugas menegur penumpang yang berkelakuan kasar kepada pedagang asongan.
w|berkelakuan.en: The officer reprimanded a passenger who behaved rudely to a street vendor.
w|berkelakuan.ko: 직원이 행상에게 무례하게 군 승객을 나무랐어요.

w|berkelas.text: Gaun pengantin Rina sederhana tetapi terlihat berkelas.
w|berkelas.en: Rina's wedding dress is simple but looks classy.

w|berkelas.text: Lestari menginap di hotel berkelas saat liburan akhir tahun di pegunungan.
w|berkelas.en: Lestari stayed at a classy hotel during the year-end holiday in the mountains.
w|berkelas.ko: 레스타리는 연말 휴가 때 산속의 고급 호텔에 묵었어요.

w|berkeliaran.text: Anjing itu berkeliaran di sekitar rumah.
w|berkeliaran.en: That dog wandered around the house.

w|berkeliaran.text: Jangan berkeliaran terlalu jauh di malam hari.
w|berkeliaran.en: Don't wander too far at night.

w|berkeliling.en: We went around the city by bicycle.
She likes to wander around the market early.
w|berkeliling.ko: 그녀는 아침 일찍 시장을 돌아다니는 걸 좋아해.

w|berkemah.text: Malam itu Agus dan teman-temannya berkemah di bawah bintang.
w|berkemah.en: That night Agus and his friends camped under the stars.
w|berkemah.ko: 그날 밤 아구스와 친구들은 별 아래에서 캠핑했어요.

w|berkemah.text: Pelanggan yang hobi berkemah biasanya langsung naik ke lantai empat.
w|berkemah.en: Customers who love camping usually go straight up to the fourth floor.
w|berkemah.ko: 캠핑을 좋아하는 손님들은 보통 바로 사 층으로 올라가요.

w|berkemas.text: Malam sebelum berangkat, Agus berkemas sampai jam satu pagi.
w|berkemas.en: The night before leaving, Agus packed until one in the morning.
w|berkemas.ko: 떠나기 전날 밤, 아구스는 새벽 한 시까지 짐을 쌌어요.

w|berkemas.text: Wati membantu pembeli berkemas sebelum mereka pindah ke luar kota.
w|berkemas.en: Wati helped a customer pack before they moved out of town.
w|berkemas.ko: 와티는 다른 도시로 이사하는 손님의 짐 싸는 걸 도와줬어요.

w|berkembang.text: Kota kecil itu terus berkembang pesat.
w|berkembang.en: That small town keeps developing rapidly.
w|berkembang.ko: 그 작은 도시가 계속 빠르게 발전해.

w|berkembang.en: The growth of the business keeps her busy.

w|berkenalan.text: Andi berkenalan dengan Rina pada hari pertama Rina masuk kerja.
w|berkenalan.en: Andi got acquainted with Rina on her first day at work.
w|berkenalan.ko: 안디는 리나가 출근한 첫날 리나와 인사를 나눴어요.

w|berkenalan.text: Dewi berkenalan dengan banyak orang dari berbagai kota di meja resepsionis.
w|berkenalan.en: Dewi gets to know lots of people from different cities at the reception desk.
w|berkenalan.ko: 데위는 프런트에서 여러 도시에서 온 많은 사람과 알게 돼요.

w|berkencan.text: Mereka mulai berkencan musim panas lalu.
Berkencan butuh kejujuran dari kedua pihak.
w|berkencan.en: Dating needs honesty from both sides.

w|berkendara.text: Dia suka berkendara di jalan pantai.
w|berkendara.en: She likes driving along the coastal road.
w|berkendara.ko: 그는 해안 도로를 운전하는 걸 좋아해.

w|berkendara.text: Berkendara malam hari membutuhkan konsentrasi tinggi.
w|berkendara.en: Driving at night needs high concentration.

w|berkeringat.text: Telapak tangan Agus berkeringat saat duduk di kursi periksa.
w|berkeringat.en: Agus's palms were sweating as he sat in the dental chair.
w|berkeringat.ko: 진료 의자에 앉자 아구스의 손바닥에 땀이 났어요.

w|berkeringat.text: Wati berkeringat deras saat membongkar lantai keramik di siang bolong.
w|berkeringat.en: Wati sweated heavily ripping up the ceramic floor in the midday heat.
w|berkeringat.ko: 와티는 한낮에 타일 바닥을 뜯어내느라 땀을 뻘뻘 흘렸어요.

w|berkhianat.text: Dalam pidatonya, Fajar berjanji tidak akan pernah berkhianat kepada istrinya.
w|berkhianat.en: In his speech, Fajar promised never to betray his wife.
w|berkhianat.ko: 연설에서 파자르는 아내를 절대 배신하지 않겠다고 약속했어요.

w|berkhianat.text: Dalam wawancaranya, mantan pejabat itu mengaku tidak pernah berkhianat kepada negara.
w|berkhianat.en: In his interview, the former official claimed he had never betrayed the country.
w|berkhianat.ko: 인터뷰에서 그 전직 공무원은 나라를 배신한 적이 없다고 주장했어요.

w|berkilau.text: Kostum sang ratu berkilau di bawah lampu sorot.
w|berkilau.en: The queen's costume sparkles under the spotlight.

w|berkilau.text: Embun pagi berkilau di daun-daun teh di belakang rumah Ayu.
w|berkilau.en: The morning dew sparkles on the tea leaves behind Ayu's house.
w|berkilau.ko: 아침 이슬이 아유네 집 뒤 찻잎 위에서 반짝여요.

w|berkomitmen.text: Budi berkomitmen untuk tidak lagi membakar jerami setelah panen.
w|berkomitmen.en: Budi has committed to no longer burning straw after the harvest.
w|berkomitmen.ko: 부디는 추수 뒤에 더 이상 볏짚을 태우지 않기로 다짐했어요.

w|berkomitmen.text: Siti berkomitmen untuk menyelesaikan film ini meskipun jadwalnya padat.
w|berkomitmen.en: Siti is committed to finishing this film even though her schedule is packed.
w|berkomitmen.ko: 시티는 일정이 빡빡해도 이 영화를 끝까지 마치기로 했어요.

w|berkompromi.text: Kata Budi, persahabatan bertahan lama karena kita mau berkompromi.
w|berkompromi.en: Budi says a friendship lasts because we are willing to compromise.
w|berkompromi.ko: 부디는 서로 타협할 줄 알아야 우정이 오래간다고 해요.

w|berkompromi.text: Siti dan pelatihnya akhirnya berkompromi soal jadwal latihan.
w|berkompromi.en: Siti and her coach finally compromised on the training schedule.
w|berkompromi.ko: 시티와 코치는 결국 훈련 일정을 두고 타협했어요.

w|berkomunikasi.en: It is important to communicate clearly.

w|berkonsentrasi.text: Agus sulit berkonsentrasi karena suara bor dari gedung sebelah.
w|berkonsentrasi.en: Agus found it hard to concentrate because of the drilling from the next building.
w|berkonsentrasi.ko: 옆 건물 드릴 소리 때문에 아구스는 집중하기 어려웠어요.

w|berkonsentrasi.text: Sebelum lomba, Wati menutup mata untuk berkonsentrasi.
w|berkonsentrasi.en: Before the race, Wati closed her eyes to concentrate.
w|berkonsentrasi.ko: 경기 전에 와티는 집중하려고 눈을 감았어요.

w|berkonsultasi.text: Dimas berkonsultasi dengan guru BK soal pilihan jurusan kuliah.
w|berkonsultasi.en: Dimas consulted the school counselor about his choice of college major.
w|berkonsultasi.ko: 디마스는 대학 전공 선택에 대해 상담 선생님과 상의했어요.

w|berkonsultasi.text: Sebelum membuka cabang baru, Putri berkonsultasi dengan seorang akuntan.
w|berkonsultasi.en: Before opening a new branch, Putri consulted an accountant.
w|berkonsultasi.ko: 새 지점을 열기 전에 푸트리는 회계사와 상의했어요.

w|berkontribusi.text: Semua saudara ikut berkontribusi dalam biaya pesta pernikahan.
w|berkontribusi.en: All the relatives contributed to the cost of the wedding party.
w|berkontribusi.ko: 친척들이 모두 결혼 잔치 비용을 보탰어요.

w|berkontribusi.text: Warga kampung berkontribusi menanam pohon sebelum musim hujan tiba.
w|berkontribusi.en: The villagers contributed by planting trees before the rainy season arrived.
w|berkontribusi.ko: 마을 사람들은 우기가 오기 전에 나무를 심는 데 힘을 보탰어요.

w|berkorban.text: Ibu Agus rela berkorban waktu kerja untuk menemaninya ke klinik.
w|berkorban.en: Agus's mother was willing to give up work time to go with him to the clinic.
w|berkorban.ko: 아구스의 어머니는 일하는 시간을 내서 기꺼이 치과에 같이 와 줬어요.

w|berkorban.text: Wati rela berkorban tabungannya demi menyelamatkan rumah peninggalan keluarga.
w|berkorban.en: Wati was willing to sacrifice her savings to save the family house.
w|berkorban.ko: 와티는 집안에서 물려받은 집을 지키려고 기꺼이 저금을 털었어요.

w|berkuasa.text: Raja itu berkuasa selama puluhan tahun.
w|berkuasa.ko: 그 왕이 수십 년 동안 권력을 가졌어.

w|berkuasa.text: Siapa yang berkuasa di wilayah ini?
w|berkuasa.en: Who is in power in this region?
w|berkuasa.ko: 이 지역에서 누가 권력을 잡고 있어?

w|berkuda.text: Saat karyawisata ke pantai, Dimas mencoba berkuda untuk pertama kali.
w|berkuda.en: On the school trip to the beach, Dimas tried horseback riding for the first time.
w|berkuda.ko: 바닷가 현장 학습에서 디마스는 처음으로 말을 타 봤어요.

w|berkuda.text: Sebuah keluarga mampir ke restoran Putri setelah berkuda di bukit.
w|berkuda.en: A family stopped by Putri's restaurant after horseback riding in the hills.
w|berkuda.ko: 한 가족이 언덕에서 말을 타고 나서 푸트리네 식당에 들렀어요.

w|berkumpul.text: Teman-teman berkumpul di taman sore ini.
w|berkumpul.en: Friends are gathering in the park this afternoon.

w|berkumpul.text: Mari berkumpul di depan gerbang sekolah.
w|berkumpul.en: Let's gather in front of the school gate.

w|berkunjung.text: Mereka berkunjung ke rumah nenek kemarin.
Wisatawan berkunjung ke museum setiap hari.
w|berkunjung.en: Tourists visit the museum every day.

w|berkurang.text: Hukuman terdakwa berkurang karena dia mau bekerja sama dengan polisi.
w|berkurang.en: The defendant's sentence was reduced because he agreed to cooperate with the police.
w|berkurang.ko: 피고인은 경찰에 협조하기로 해서 형량이 줄었어요.

w|berkurang.text: Stok beras Lestari berkurang drastis menjelang akhir bulan.
w|berkurang.en: Lestari's rice stock drops sharply towards the end of the month.
w|berkurang.ko: 월말이 다가오면 레스타리 가게의 쌀 재고가 크게 줄어요.

w|berlagak.text: Sepupu Rudi berlagak seperti pembawa acara profesional di depan kamera.
w|berlagak.en: Rudi's cousin acted like a professional emcee in front of the camera.
w|berlagak.ko: 루디의 사촌은 카메라 앞에서 전문 사회자인 척했어요.

w|berlagak.text: Rina tahu narasumber itu hanya berlagak tahu soal anggaran desa.
w|berlagak.en: Rina knew the source was only pretending to know about the village budget.
w|berlagak.ko: 리나는 그 취재원이 마을 예산을 아는 척만 한다는 걸 알았어요.

w|berlaku.en: The new rule takes effect tomorrow.

w|berlaku.text: Tiket ini berlaku sampai akhir bulan.
w|berlaku.en: This ticket is valid until the end of the month.

w|berlalu.text: Waktu berlalu begitu cepat tahun ini.
w|berlalu.en: Time has passed so quickly this year.

w|berlalu.text: Mobil itu berlalu tanpa berhenti sebentar.
w|berlalu.en: That car passed by without stopping at all.
w|berlalu.ko: 그 차는 잠깐도 멈추지 않고 지나갔어.

w|berlangsung.en: The match lasted for two hours.

w|berlangsung.text: Rapat penting sedang berlangsung di lantai atas.
w|berlangsung.en: An important meeting is taking place upstairs.

w|berlanjut.en: The meeting continued after a short break.

w|berlanjut.text: Masalah itu berlanjut tanpa solusi jelas.
w|berlanjut.en: That problem continued without a clear solution.
w|berlanjut.ko: 그 문제는 분명한 해결책 없이 계속됐어.

w|berlapis.text: Paket kaca itu dibungkus plastik gelembung berlapis supaya tidak pecah.
w|berlapis.en: The glass parcel was wrapped in layered bubble wrap so it wouldn't break.
w|berlapis.ko: 유리 택배는 깨지지 않게 뽁뽁이로 여러 겹 싸여 있었어요.

w|berlapis.text: Hari ini Lestari belajar membuat kue lapis berlapis sembilan.
w|berlapis.en: Today Lestari is learning to make a nine-layer layered cake.
w|berlapis.ko: 오늘 레스타리는 아홉 겹짜리 레이어 케이크 만드는 법을 배워요.

w|berlari.text: Anjing Dimas berlari menggiring domba-domba ke kandang.
w|berlari.en: Dimas's dog ran, herding the sheep into the pen.
w|berlari.ko: 디마스의 개가 뛰어다니며 양 떼를 우리로 몰았어요.

w|berlari.text: Putri berlari mengejar bus yang hampir berangkat.
w|berlari.en: Putri ran to catch the bus that was about to leave.
w|berlari.ko: 푸트리는 막 떠나려는 버스를 잡으려고 뛰었어요.

w|berlawanan.text: Dalam lomba debat, Andi dan Laras duduk di kubu yang berlawanan.
w|berlawanan.en: In the debate contest, Andi and Laras sat on opposing sides.
w|berlawanan.ko: 토론 대회에서 안디와 라라스는 서로 반대편에 앉았어요.

w|berlawanan.text: Dewi dan adiknya punya pendapat berlawanan soal menu malam tahun baru.
w|berlawanan.en: Dewi and her brother have opposite opinions about the New Year's Eve menu.
w|berlawanan.ko: 데위와 동생은 새해 전날 밤 메뉴에 대해 의견이 정반대예요.

w|berlayar.en: The ship will sail tomorrow morning.

w|berlayar.text: Mereka suka berlayar di laut tenang.
w|berlayar.en: They like to sail on a calm sea.
w|berlayar.ko: 그들은 잔잔한 바다에서 항해하는 걸 좋아해.

w|berlebihan.text: Berlebihan gula membuat teh terlalu manis.
w|berlebihan.en: Too much sugar makes the tea too sweet.

w|berlian.text: Berlian itu berkilau di bawah cahaya.
w|berlian.en: That diamond sparkled under the light.

w|berlian.text: Dia memakai cincin berlian di jari.
w|berlian.en: She wore a diamond ring on her finger.

w|berlibur.text: Sudah lama Agus ingin berlibur tanpa rencana yang kaku.
w|berlibur.en: Agus had long wanted to go on holiday without a rigid plan.
w|berlibur.ko: 아구스는 오래전부터 빡빡한 계획 없이 휴가를 떠나고 싶었어요.

w|berlibur.text: Banyak keluarga membeli baju renang sebelum berlibur ke Bali.
w|berlibur.en: Many families buy swimsuits before going on holiday to Bali.
w|berlibur.ko: 많은 가족이 발리로 휴가 가기 전에 수영복을 사요.

w|berlindung.text: Warga berlindung di bawah jembatan saat hujan.
