w|berlindung.en: Residents took shelter under the bridge in the rain.

w|berlindung.text: Anak-anak berlindung di balik punggung ibunya.
w|berlindung.en: The children hid behind their mother's back.

w|berlomba.text: Dua anak anjing berlomba mengejar bola di ruang tunggu.
w|berlomba.en: Two puppies raced to chase the ball in the waiting room.
w|berlomba.ko: 강아지 두 마리가 대기실에서 공을 쫓아 경주했어요.

w|berlomba.text: Banyak tim berlomba menemukan obat untuk penyakit itu.
w|berlomba.en: Many teams are racing to find a cure for that disease.
w|berlomba.ko: 많은 팀이 그 병의 치료제를 찾으려고 경쟁하고 있어요.

w|berlutut.en: He knelt down to tie his shoes.
w|berlutut.ko: 그는 신발 끈을 매려고 무릎을 꿇었어.

w|berlutut.en: They knelt in front of the altar.

w|bermain-main.en: The children are playing around in the yard.
Don't play around with people's feelings.

w|bermakna.text: Bagi Budi, hujan pertama setelah kemarau selalu terasa bermakna.
w|bermakna.en: For Budi, the first rain after the dry season always feels meaningful.
w|bermakna.ko: 부디에게 건기 뒤 첫 비는 늘 의미 있게 느껴져요.

w|bermakna.text: Adegan perpisahan di stasiun itu paling bermakna bagi Siti.
w|bermakna.en: The farewell scene at the station was the most meaningful to Siti.
w|bermakna.ko: 역에서의 이별 장면이 시티에게 가장 의미 있었어요.

w|bermaksud.en: I didn't mean it that way.

w|bermanfaat.text: Air hujan yang Budi tampung sangat bermanfaat saat kemarau.
w|bermanfaat.en: The rainwater Budi collects is very useful in the dry season.
w|bermanfaat.ko: 부디가 받아 둔 빗물은 건기에 아주 쓸모가 있어요.

w|bermanfaat.text: Masukan dari pelatih akting sangat bermanfaat bagi Siti.
w|bermanfaat.en: The acting coach's feedback was very helpful to Siti.
w|bermanfaat.ko: 연기 코치의 조언은 시티에게 큰 도움이 됐어요.

w|bermartabat.text: Andi kagum pada tokoh novel yang tetap bermartabat meski hidup miskin.
w|bermartabat.en: Andi admires the novel's character who stays dignified despite being poor.
w|bermartabat.ko: 안디는 가난해도 품위를 잃지 않는 소설 속 인물에 감탄해요.

w|bermartabat.text: Dewi ingin semua karyawan diperlakukan secara bermartabat, termasuk petugas kebersihan.
w|bermartabat.en: Dewi wants all employees treated with dignity, including the cleaning staff.
w|bermartabat.ko: 디위는 청소 직원을 포함해 모든 직원이 존중받기를 바라요.

w|bermasalah.text: Proyek menjadi bermasalah setelah hujan deras.
w|bermasalah.en: The project became troubled after heavy rain.

w|bermata.text: Tukang kayu itu memotong papan dengan gergaji bermata tajam.
w|bermata.en: The carpenter cut the board with a sharp-toothed saw.
w|bermata.ko: 그 목수는 날이 날카로운 톱으로 판자를 잘랐어요.

w|bermata.text: Boneka yang dipesan Wati untuk keponakannya bermata biru dan berambut keriting.
w|bermata.en: The doll Wati ordered for her niece has blue eyes and curly hair.
w|bermata.ko: 와티가 조카에게 주려고 주문한 인형은 눈이 파랗고 머리가 곱슬이에요.

w|bermimpi.en: Last night I dreamed about the sea.

w|bermimpi.text: Anak itu sering bermimpi menjadi pilot.
w|bermimpi.en: That child often dreams of becoming a pilot.
w|bermimpi.ko: 그 아이는 자주 조종사가 되는 꿈을 꿔.

w|berminat.text: Rudi bertanya apakah Bayu masih berminat belajar fotografi.
w|berminat.en: Rudi asked whether Bayu is still interested in learning photography.
w|berminat.ko: 루디는 바유가 아직 사진을 배우고 싶은지 물었어요.

w|berminat.text: Dua perusahaan besar berminat membeli saham perusahaan Rina.
w|berminat.en: Two large companies are interested in buying shares in Rina's company.
w|berminat.ko: 대기업 두 곳이 리나 회사의 지분을 사고 싶어 해요.

w|berminggu-minggu.text: Sawah milik paman Dimas kering berminggu-minggu karena hujan tak kunjung turun.
w|berminggu-minggu.en: Dimas's uncle's rice field stayed dry for weeks because the rain never came.
w|berminggu-minggu.ko: 비가 오지 않아서 디마스 삼촌의 논은 몇 주 동안 말라 있었어요.

w|berminggu-minggu.text: Putri menunggu berminggu-minggu sampai genteng antik pesanannya datang.
w|berminggu-minggu.en: Putri waited weeks for the antique roof tiles she ordered to arrive.
w|berminggu-minggu.ko: 푸트리는 주문한 옛날 기와가 올 때까지 몇 주를 기다렸어요.

w|bermoral.text: Bayu percaya pemimpin yang baik harus jujur dan bermoral.
w|bermoral.en: Bayu believes a good leader must be honest and have good morals.
w|bermoral.ko: 바유는 좋은 리더라면 정직하고 도덕적이어야 한다고 믿어요.

w|bermoral.text: Di majalah pesawat ada cerita tentang tokoh yang bermoral tinggi.
w|bermoral.en: The in-flight magazine has a story about a person of high morals.
w|bermoral.ko: 기내 잡지에 도덕성이 높은 인물 이야기가 실려 있어요.

w|bermula.text: Usaha roti Fajar bermula dari dapur kecil di rumah ibunya.
w|bermula.en: Fajar's bread business started in a small kitchen at his mother's house.
w|bermula.ko: 파자르의 빵 사업은 어머니 집의 작은 부엌에서 시작됐어요.

w|bermula.text: Kecintaan Lestari pada lari bermula dari lomba kecil di sekolah.
w|bermula.en: Lestari's love of running began with a small race at school.
w|bermula.ko: 레스타리의 달리기 사랑은 학교의 작은 대회에서 시작됐어요.

w|bernapas.text: Tarik napas dalam dan bernapas pelan.
w|bernapas.en: Take a deep breath and breathe slowly.
He had trouble breathing after running.

w|bernegosiasi.text: Mandor harus bernegosiasi dengan pemasok soal harga besi.
w|bernegosiasi.en: The foreman had to negotiate with the supplier over the price of steel.
w|bernegosiasi.ko: 십장은 철근 값을 두고 납품업자와 협상해야 했어요.

w|bernegosiasi.text: Rina sempat bernegosiasi soal gaji sebelum menandatangani kontrak.
w|bernegosiasi.en: Rina negotiated her salary before signing the contract.
w|bernegosiasi.ko: 리나는 계약서에 서명하기 전에 연봉 협상을 했어요.

w|berniat.text: Saya berniat pindah ke kota lain.
w|berniat.en: I intend to move to another city.
Good intentions alone are not enough.

w|bernilai.text: Pengalaman ini bernilai bagi masa depanmu.
w|bernilai.en: This experience is valuable for your future.
w|bernilai.ko: 이 경험은 네 미래에 가치 있어.

w|bernyanyi.en: The children are singing on stage.

w|beroperasi.text: Mesin cetak koran itu beroperasi sepanjang malam.
w|beroperasi.en: The newspaper's printing press runs all night.

w|beroperasi.text: Toko servis Ayu beroperasi dari pagi sampai jam sembilan malam.
w|beroperasi.en: Ayu's repair shop operates from morning until nine at night.
w|beroperasi.ko: 아유의 수리점은 아침부터 밤 아홉 시까지 문을 열어요.

w|berpacaran.text: Fajar dan Rina sudah berpacaran selama lima tahun sebelum menikah.
w|berpacaran.en: Fajar and Rina dated for five years before getting married.
w|berpacaran.ko: 파자르와 리나는 결혼 전에 오 년 동안 연애했어요.

w|berpacaran.text: Lestari mulai berpacaran dengan Bayu pada musim hujan dua tahun lalu.
w|berpacaran.en: Lestari started dating Bayu during the rainy season two years ago.
w|berpacaran.ko: 레스타리는 이 년 전 우기에 바유와 사귀기 시작했어요.

w|berpakaian.en: The children are getting dressed for school.
w|berpakaian.ko: 아이들이 학교 갈 옷을 입고 있어.

w|berpakaian.text: Dia berpakaian rapi sebelum wawancara kerja.
w|berpakaian.en: He dressed neatly before the job interview.

w|berpaling.text: Budi tidak berpaling dari papan tulis selama Pak Hadi menjelaskan rumus.
w|berpaling.en: Budi didn't turn away from the whiteboard while Mr. Hadi explained the formula.
w|berpaling.ko: 하디 선생님이 공식을 설명하는 동안 부디는 칠판에서 눈을 떼지 않았어요.

w|berpaling.text: Siti berpaling sekali lagi ke rumah lamanya sebelum masuk mobil.
w|berpaling.en: Siti turned back to look at her old house once more before getting into the car.
w|berpaling.ko: 시티는 차에 타기 전에 옛집을 한 번 더 돌아봤어요.

w|berpartisipasi.text: Semua murid kelas Dimas wajib berpartisipasi dalam lomba kebersihan kelas.
w|berpartisipasi.en: All students in Dimas's class must take part in the clean classroom contest.
w|berpartisipasi.ko: 디마스네 반 학생은 모두 교실 청결 대회에 참여해야 해요.

w|berpartisipasi.text: Restoran Putri berpartisipasi dalam festival kuliner kota.
w|berpartisipasi.en: Putri's restaurant took part in the city food festival.
w|berpartisipasi.ko: 푸트리네 식당은 시 음식 축제에 참가했어요.

w|berpegang.text: Untuk sambal, Fajar selalu berpegang pada resep asli neneknya.
w|berpegang.en: For sambal, Fajar always sticks to his grandmother's original recipe.
w|berpegang.ko: 삼발을 만들 때 파자르는 늘 할머니의 원래 레시피를 지켜요.

w|berpegang.text: Lestari berpegang pada satu aturan: jangan beli barang yang tidak akan dipakai.
w|berpegang.en: Lestari holds to one rule: don't buy things you won't use.
w|berpegang.ko: 레스타리는 쓰지 않을 물건은 사지 않는다는 규칙 하나를 지켜요.

w|berpegangan.text: Waktu kecil, Budi dan Rina selalu berpegangan tangan saat menyeberang jalan.
w|berpegangan.en: As children, Budi and Rina always held hands when crossing the street.
w|berpegangan.ko: 어렸을 때 부디와 리나는 길을 건널 때 늘 손을 잡았어요.

w|berpegangan.text: Anak-anak Siti berpegangan pada pagar tangga yang belum dicat.
w|berpegangan.en: Siti's children held onto the unpainted stair railing.
w|berpegangan.ko: 시티의 아이들은 아직 칠하지 않은 계단 난간을 붙잡았어요.

w|berpelukan.text: Para peserta berpelukan di akhir kelas setelah menerima sertifikat.
w|berpelukan.en: The participants hugged each other at the end of class after getting their certificates.
w|berpelukan.ko: 참가자들은 수료증을 받고 수업이 끝날 때 서로 껴안았어요.

w|berpelukan.text: Dewi menempelkan foto mereka berpelukan saat wisuda di surat itu.
w|berpelukan.en: Dewi attached a photo of them hugging at graduation to the letter.
w|berpelukan.ko: 데위는 졸업식 때 둘이 껴안고 찍은 사진을 편지에 붙였어요.

w|berpencar.text: Setelah apel pagi, para tukang berpencar ke bagian masing-masing.
w|berpencar.en: After the morning briefing, the builders spread out to their own sections.
w|berpencar.ko: 아침 조회가 끝나자 인부들은 각자 맡은 곳으로 흩어졌어요.

w|berpencar.text: Saat jam makan siang, para karyawan berpencar mencari warung favorit masing-masing.
w|berpencar.en: At lunchtime, the employees scattered to find their favourite food stalls.
w|berpencar.ko: 점심시간이 되자 직원들은 각자 좋아하는 식당을 찾아 흩어졌어요.

w|berpendapat.text: Kolumnis tamu berpendapat bahwa trotoar kota harus diperlebar.
w|berpendapat.en: The guest columnist argued that the city's sidewalks should be widened.
w|berpendapat.ko: 객원 칼럼니스트는 시의 보도를 넓혀야 한다고 주장했어요.

w|berpendapat.text: Salah satu programmer berpendapat bahwa aplikasi itu harus punya mode gelap.
w|berpendapat.en: One of the programmers argued that the app should have a dark mode.
w|berpendapat.ko: 프로그래머 한 명은 앱에 다크 모드가 꼭 있어야 한다고 생각해요.

w|berpengalaman.text: Mandor lebih percaya pada tukang yang berpengalaman untuk memasang rangka atap.
w|berpengalaman.en: The foreman trusts experienced builders more to put up the roof frame.
w|berpengalaman.ko: 십장은 지붕 뼈대를 올리는 일은 경험 많은 인부를 더 믿어요.

w|berpengalaman.text: Rina dibimbing oleh analis berpengalaman selama tiga bulan pertama.
w|berpengalaman.en: Rina is mentored by an experienced analyst for her first three months.
w|berpengalaman.ko: 리나는 처음 석 달 동안 경험 많은 분석가에게 지도를 받아요.

w|berpengaruh.text: Menurut Dimas, makanan yang terlalu asin sangat berpengaruh pada kesehatan ginjal kucing.
w|berpengaruh.en: According to Dimas, overly salty food has a big effect on a cat's kidney health.
w|berpengaruh.ko: 디마스 말로는 너무 짠 음식이 고양이 콩팥 건강에 큰 영향을 줘요.

w|berpengaruh.text: Suhu ruangan ternyata berpengaruh besar pada hasil percobaan.
w|berpengaruh.en: The room temperature turned out to have a big effect on the experiment's results.
w|berpengaruh.ko: 알고 보니 실내 온도가 실험 결과에 큰 영향을 줬어요.

w|berperan.text: Dalam drama sekolah, Dimas berperan sebagai pahlawan nasional.
w|berperan.en: In the school play, Dimas plays a national hero.
w|berperan.ko: 학교 연극에서 디마스는 민족 영웅 역을 맡아요.

w|berperan.text: Nenek Putri berperan besar dalam menciptakan resep sambal restoran.
w|berperan.en: Putri's grandmother played a big role in creating the restaurant's chili sauce recipe.
w|berperan.ko: 푸트리의 할머니는 식당 삼발 소스 레시피를 만드는 데 큰 역할을 했어요.

w|berperang.en: Going to war is not the only way out.

w|berperilaku.text: Anak-anak yang berperilaku baik selama diperiksa mendapat stiker dari perawat.
w|berperilaku.en: Children who behave well during the check-up get a sticker from the nurse.
w|berperilaku.ko: 진료 중에 얌전히 있는 아이들은 간호사에게 스티커를 받아요.

w|berperilaku.text: Kucing liar di halaman mulai berperilaku jinak sejak Wati memberinya makan.
w|berperilaku.en: The stray cat in the yard has started behaving tamely since Wati began feeding it.
w|berperilaku.ko: 와티가 먹이를 준 뒤로 마당의 길고양이가 순하게 굴기 시작했어요.

w|berpesta.en: They partied until late at night.

w|berpesta.text: Berpesta di rumah tetangga terdengar gaduh.
w|berpesta.en: Partying at the neighbor's house sounded loud.

w|berpihak.text: Wasit lomba tidak boleh berpihak kepada sekolah mana pun.
w|berpihak.en: The contest referee must not side with any school.
w|berpihak.ko: 대회 심판은 어느 학교 편도 들어서는 안 돼요.

w|berpihak.text: Waktu memilih lagu, Ayah berpihak pada pilihan Dewi.
w|berpihak.en: When choosing songs, Dad sided with Dewi's choice.
w|berpihak.ko: 노래를 고를 때 아빠는 데위가 고른 쪽을 들어줬어요.

w|berpikiran.text: Andi senang punya rekan yang berpikiran terbuka seperti Rina.
w|berpikiran.en: Andi is glad to have an open-minded coworker like Rina.
w|berpikiran.ko: 안디는 리나처럼 생각이 열린 동료가 있어서 좋아요.

w|berpikiran.text: Manajer Dewi berpikiran bahwa layanan cepat lebih penting dari lobi mewah.
w|berpikiran.en: Dewi's manager thinks fast service matters more than a fancy lobby.
w|berpikiran.ko: 데위의 매니저는 화려한 로비보다 빠른 서비스가 더 중요하다고 생각해요.

w|berpindah.text: Setiap minggu kambing-kambing Dimas berpindah ke padang rumput yang lain.
w|berpindah.en: Every week Dimas's goats move to a different pasture.
w|berpindah.ko: 디마스의 염소들은 매주 다른 풀밭으로 옮겨 가요.

w|berpindah.text: Putri berpindah ke kursi dekat jendela supaya lebih terang.
w|berpindah.en: Putri moved to the seat by the window so it would be brighter.
w|berpindah.ko: 푸트리는 더 밝은 창가 자리로 옮겨 앉았어요.

w|berpisah.text: Mereka berpisah di stasiun dengan sedih.
w|berpisah.en: They parted at the station sadly.
Parting for a while does not mean it ends.

w|berpose.text: Anak Andi berpose di samping pintu yang baru dicat merah.
w|berpose.en: Andi's child posed next to the freshly painted red door.
w|berpose.ko: 안디의 아이가 새로 빨갛게 칠한 문 옆에서 포즈를 잡았어요.

w|berpose.text: Seorang anak berpose di depan lokomotif uap di museum stasiun.
w|berpose.en: A child poses in front of the steam locomotive at the station museum.
w|berpose.ko: 한 아이가 역 박물관의 증기 기관차 앞에서 포즈를 잡아요.

w|berpura-pura.en: He pretended not to hear my call.
w|berpura-pura.ko: 그는 내 부름을 못 들은 척했어.

w|berpura-pura.en: Pretending to be sick so he can take time off.
w|berpura-pura.ko: 쉴 수 있게 아픈 척하는 거야.

w|berputar.en: That wheel is spinning very fast.

w|berputar.text: Kepalaku berputar setelah naik komidi putar.
w|berputar.en: My head spun after riding the merry-go-round.
w|berputar.ko: 회전목을 탄 뒤에 머리가 빙빙 돌았어.

w|berputar-putar.text: Rudi dan teman-temannya tersesat dan berputar-putar di hutan selama satu jam.
w|berputar-putar.en: Rudi and his friends got lost and went around in circles in the forest for an hour.
w|berputar-putar.ko: 루디와 친구들은 길을 잃고 숲에서 한 시간 동안 빙빙 돌았어요.

w|berputar-putar.text: Antrean penonton berputar-putar mengelilingi gedung konser sejak sore.
w|berputar-putar.en: The line of concertgoers had been winding around the concert hall since the afternoon.
w|berputar-putar.ko: 관객 줄이 오후부터 공연장을 빙 둘러 감고 있었어요.

w|bersabar.text: Agus meminta warga di ruang tunggu untuk bersabar sebentar.
w|bersabar.en: Agus asked the residents in the waiting room to be patient for a moment.
w|bersabar.ko: 아구스는 대기실 주민들에게 조금만 기다려 달라고 했어요.

w|bersabar.text: Guru piano meminta Wati bersabar karena tangan kirinya butuh waktu untuk terbiasa.
w|bersabar.en: The piano teacher asked Wati to be patient because her left hand needs time to get used to it.
w|bersabar.ko: 피아노 선생님은 왼손이 익숙해지려면 시간이 걸린다며 와티에게 참으라고 했어요.

w|bersahabat.text: Warga sekitar proyek cukup bersahabat dan sering mengantar kopi.
w|bersahabat.en: The residents around the site are quite friendly and often bring coffee.
w|bersahabat.ko: 현장 주변 주민들은 꽤 친절해서 커피를 자주 가져다줘요.

w|bersahabat.text: Suasana kantor baru Rina ternyata sangat bersahabat.
w|bersahabat.en: The atmosphere at Rina's new office turned out to be very friendly.
w|bersahabat.ko: 리나의 새 회사 분위기는 알고 보니 아주 화기애애했어요.

w|bersaing.text: Koran cetak sekarang harus bersaing dengan berita di media sosial.
w|bersaing.en: Print newspapers now have to compete with news on social media.
w|bersaing.ko: 종이 신문은 이제 소셜 미디어 뉴스와 경쟁해야 해요.

w|bersaing.text: Toko Ayu harus bersaing dengan pusat servis resmi di mal.
w|bersaing.en: Ayu's shop has to compete with the official service center at the mall.
w|bersaing.ko: 아유 가게는 쇼핑몰 정식 서비스 센터와 경쟁해야 해요.

w|bersaksi.text: Saksi akan bersaksi di pengadilan besok.
w|bersaksi.en: The witness will testify in court tomorrow.

w|bersaksi.text: Bersaksi jujur adalah kewajiban setiap warga.
w|bersaksi.en: Testifying honestly is every citizen's duty.
w|bersaksi.ko: 정직하게 증언하는 것은 모든 시민의 의무야.

w|bersalah.text: Bersalah atau tidak, kita harus adil.
w|bersalah.en: Guilty or not, we must be fair.

w|bersamaan.text: Mereka tiba di stasiun secara bersamaan.
w|bersamaan.en: They arrived at the station at the same time.

w|bersamaan.text: Dua alarm berbunyi bersamaan tadi pagi.
w|bersamaan.en: Two alarms rang at the same time this morning.
w|bersamaan.ko: 오늘 아침 알람 두 개가 동시에 울렸어.

w|bersandar.text: Saat istirahat, Dimas bersandar di dinding gudang sambil minum kopi.
w|bersandar.en: During the break, Dimas leans against the warehouse wall while drinking coffee.
w|bersandar.ko: 쉬는 시간에 디마스는 커피를 마시며 창고 벽에 기대요.

w|bersandar.text: Putri menulis surat sambil bersandar di kursi rotan dekat jendela.
w|bersandar.en: Putri writes the letter while leaning back in a rattan chair by the window.
w|bersandar.ko: 푸트리는 창가 등나무 의자에 기대어 편지를 써요.

w|bersandiwara.text: Adik Agus bersandiwara pura-pura sakit supaya tidak disuruh mencari kayu bakar.
w|bersandiwara.en: Agus's little brother put on an act of being sick so he wouldn't be sent to gather firewood.
w|bersandiwara.ko: 아구스의 동생은 땔감 구하러 가기 싫어서 아픈 척 연기를 했어요.

w|bersandiwara.text: Wati curiga pelanggan itu bersandiwara supaya bisa membeli obat tanpa resep.
w|bersandiwara.en: Wati suspected the customer was putting on an act to buy medicine without a prescription.
w|bersandiwara.ko: 와티는 그 손님이 처방전 없이 약을 사려고 연기한다고 의심했어요.

w|bersantai.text: Mereka bersantai di taman setelah makan siang.
w|bersantai.en: They relaxed in the park after lunch.

w|bersantai.text: Bersantai sejenak membuat pikiran lebih jernih.
w|bersantai.en: Relaxing for a moment clears the mind.
w|bersantai.ko: 잠깐 쉬는 것이 머리를 맑게 해.

w|bersatu.en: They united to solve the problem.

w|bersatu.text: Bersatu kita lebih kuat dari sendiri.
w|bersatu.en: United we are stronger than alone.

w|bersaudara.en: They are siblings even though they rarely meet.

w|bersaudara.text: Kami merasa bersaudara setelah perjalanan panjang itu.
w|bersaudara.en: We felt like siblings after that long journey.
w|bersaudara.ko: 그 긴 여행 뒤 우리는 형제처럼 느꼈어.

w|bersedia.en: I'm willing to help you anytime.

w|bersedih.text: Rudi bersedih ketika mendengar ayah Bayu sudah meninggal.
w|bersedih.en: Rudi grieved when he heard that Bayu's father had passed away.
w|bersedih.ko: 루디는 바유의 아버지가 돌아가셨다는 소식을 듣고 슬퍼했어요.

w|bersedih.text: Rina tidak sempat bersedih meski investor pertama menolak proposalnya.
w|bersedih.en: Rina had no time to be sad even though the first investor rejected her proposal.
w|bersedih.ko: 첫 투자자가 제안을 거절했지만 리나는 슬퍼할 겨를도 없었어요.

w|bersejarah.text: Bayu membeli kartu pos bergambar gedung bersejarah di kota lama.
w|bersejarah.en: Bayu bought postcards with pictures of historic buildings in the old town.
w|bersejarah.ko: 바유는 구시가지의 역사적인 건물이 그려진 엽서를 샀어요.

w|bersejarah.text: Intan dan suaminya berfoto di depan gedung bersejarah peninggalan zaman Belanda.
w|bersejarah.en: Intan and her husband took photos in front of a historic building from the Dutch era.
w|bersejarah.ko: 인탄 부부는 네덜란드 시대에 지어진 역사적인 건물 앞에서 사진을 찍었어요.

w|bersekolah.text: Seorang anak di kursi depan bercerita bahwa ia bersekolah di kota sebelah.
w|bersekolah.en: A child in the front seat said that he goes to school in the next town.
w|bersekolah.ko: 앞자리 아이는 옆 동네에서 학교에 다닌다고 이야기했어요.

w|bersekolah.text: Adik Putri masih bersekolah, tapi sudah ikut membantu menguji aplikasi.
w|bersekolah.en: Putri's younger sibling is still in school but already helps test the app.
w|bersekolah.ko: 푸트리의 동생은 아직 학생이지만 벌써 앱 테스트를 돕고 있어요.

w|bersekongkol.text: Teman-teman Fajar bersekongkol menyembunyikan sepatu pengantin pria sebagai lelucon.
w|bersekongkol.en: Fajar's friends conspired to hide the groom's shoes as a joke.
w|bersekongkol.ko: 파자르의 친구들은 장난으로 신랑 신발을 숨기려고 짰어요.

w|bersekongkol.text: Laporan Lestari membongkar pejabat yang bersekongkol dengan kontraktor untuk menaikkan harga proyek.
w|bersekongkol.en: Lestari's report exposed officials who conspired with contractors to inflate project prices.
w|bersekongkol.ko: 레스타리의 기사는 공사비를 부풀리려고 업자와 공모한 공무원들을 폭로했어요.

w|berselancar.text: Malam-malam Andi berselancar di internet mencari ide desain dapur.
w|berselancar.en: At night Andi surfs the internet looking for kitchen design ideas.
w|berselancar.ko: 안디는 밤마다 인터넷을 뒤지며 부엌 디자인 아이디어를 찾아요.

w|berselancar.text: Dewi berselancar di media sosial sambil menunggu kereta tiba.
w|berselancar.en: Dewi browses social media while waiting for the train to arrive.
w|berselancar.ko: 데위는 열차를 기다리며 소셜 미디어를 둘러봐요.

w|berselingkuh.text: Di kantin, Andi mendengar gosip bahwa manajer lama berselingkuh dengan sekretarisnya.
w|berselingkuh.en: In the canteen, Andi heard gossip that the old manager had an affair with his secretary.
w|berselingkuh.ko: 구내식당에서 안디는 예전 관리자가 비서와 바람을 피웠다는 소문을 들었어요.

w|berselingkuh.text: Dalam novel yang Dewi baca di jam istirahat, seorang suami berselingkuh di hotel mewah.
w|berselingkuh.en: In the novel Dewi reads on her break, a husband has an affair at a luxury hotel.
w|berselingkuh.ko: 데위가 쉬는 시간에 읽는 소설에서 한 남편이 호화 호텔에서 바람을 피워요.

w|bersemangat.en: She was so enthusiastic welcoming the guests.

w|bersemangat.text: Tim itu bermain dengan sangat bersemangat.

w|bersenang-senang.en: They're having fun at the beach.

w|bersenjata.en: Fully armed, they entered the forest.
w|bersenjata.ko: 완전 무장한 채로 그들은 숲에 들어갔어.

w|bersenjata.en: That group is known to be armed.
w|bersenjata.ko: 그 무리는 무장한 것으로 알려져 있어.

w|bersiap.en: We have to get ready now.

w|bersiap-siap.text: Jam empat pagi, Fajar sudah bersiap-siap menguleni adonan.
w|bersiap-siap.en: At four in the morning, Fajar is already getting ready to knead the dough.
w|bersiap-siap.ko: 새벽 네 시에 파자르는 벌써 반죽을 치댈 준비를 해요.

w|bersiap-siap.text: Ratusan pelari bersiap-siap di garis start sejak subuh.
w|bersiap-siap.en: Hundreds of runners were getting ready at the starting line from dawn.
w|bersiap-siap.ko: 수백 명의 달리기 선수가 새벽부터 출발선에서 준비하고 있었어요.

w|bersifat.text: Pemimpin redaksi menegaskan bahwa rapat itu bersifat rahasia.
w|bersifat.en: The editor-in-chief stressed that the meeting was confidential.

w|bersifat.text: Data pengguna di aplikasi itu bersifat pribadi dan tidak boleh dibagikan.
w|bersifat.en: User data in the app is private and must not be shared.
w|bersifat.ko: 그 앱의 사용자 정보는 개인 정보라 공유하면 안 돼요.

w|bersih.text: Dimas selalu memastikan air minum ternaknya tetap bersih.
w|bersih.en: Dimas always makes sure his livestock's drinking water stays clean.
w|bersih.ko: 디마스는 늘 가축이 마시는 물이 깨끗한지 확인해요.

w|bersih.text: Setelah semua piring dicuci, dapur Putri jadi bersih lagi.
w|bersih.en: After all the dishes were washed, Putri's kitchen was clean again.
w|bersih.ko: 설거지를 다 하고 나니 푸트리의 부엌이 다시 깨끗해졌어요.

w|bersikap.en: He stayed calm in the meeting.

w|bersikeras.en: He insisted on paying the bill himself.

w|bersikeras.text: Bersikeras tidak membantu dalam situasi ini.
w|bersikeras.en: Insisting does not help in this situation.
w|bersikeras.ko: 이 상황에선 고집이 도움이 안 돼.

w|bersimpati.text: Rudi bersimpati pada Bayu yang harus merawat ibunya sendirian.
w|bersimpati.en: Rudi sympathizes with Bayu, who has to care for his mother alone.
w|bersimpati.ko: 루디는 혼자 어머니를 돌봐야 하는 바유를 안타깝게 여겨요.

w|bersimpati.text: Rina bersimpati pada karyawan yang harus bekerja sambil merawat anak kecil.
w|bersimpati.en: Rina sympathizes with employees who have to work while caring for small children.
w|bersimpati.ko: 리나는 어린아이를 돌보며 일해야 하는 직원들의 처지를 이해해요.

w|bersin.text: Kucing itu terus bersin karena alergi debu.
w|bersin.en: The cat keeps sneezing because of a dust allergy.
w|bersin.ko: 그 고양이는 먼지 알레르기 때문에 계속 재채기를 해요.

w|bersin.text: Debu di gudang membuat Putri bersin berkali-kali.
w|bersin.en: The dust in the storeroom made Putri sneeze again and again.
w|bersin.ko: 창고 먼지 때문에 푸트리는 여러 번 재채기를 했어요.

w|bersinar.en: The sun is shining brightly this morning.
The shining of the stars adorns the sky.

w|bersiul.text: Eko bersiul pelan sambil berjalan mencari kayu bakar.
w|bersiul.en: Eko whistled softly as he walked looking for firewood.
w|bersiul.ko: 에코는 땔감을 찾으러 걸으며 휘파람을 살짝 불었어요.

w|bersiul.text: Penonton bersiul dan bertepuk tangan saat Ayu melewati garis setengah jalan.
w|bersiul.en: Spectators whistled and clapped as Ayu passed the halfway mark.
w|bersiul.ko: 아유가 중간 지점을 지나자 관중들이 휘파람을 불고 박수를 쳤어요.

w|bersorak.text: Anak-anak bersorak waktu pustakawan mengumumkan pemenang lomba membaca.
w|bersorak.en: The children cheered when the librarian announced the winner of the reading contest.
w|bersorak.ko: 사서가 독서 대회 우승자를 발표하자 아이들이 환호했어요.

w|bersorak.text: Penumpang di gerbong Putri bersorak saat kereta akhirnya berangkat.
w|bersorak.en: The passengers in Putri's carriage cheered when the train finally departed.
w|bersorak.ko: 기차가 마침내 출발하자 푸트리네 칸 승객들이 환호했어요.

w|bersuara.text: Koki muda di restoran itu jarang berani bersuara saat rapat menu dengan pemilik.
w|bersuara.en: The young cooks at that restaurant rarely dare to speak up in menu meetings with the owner.
w|bersuara.ko: 그 식당의 젊은 요리사들은 주인과의 메뉴 회의에서 좀처럼 말을 못 해요.

w|bersuara.text: Radio tua milik Lestari masih bisa bersuara meskipun antenanya patah.
w|bersuara.en: Lestari's old radio can still make sound even though its antenna is broken.
w|bersuara.ko: 레스타리의 낡은 라디오는 안테나가 부러졌는데도 아직 소리가 나요.

w|bersulang.text: Mari bersulang untuk masa depan yang lebih baik.
w|bersulang.en: Let's toast to a better future.
They toasted after signing the agreement.

w|bersumpah.en: He swore he would be honest.

w|bersungguh-sungguh.text: Kepala koki melihat Fajar bersungguh-sungguh berlatih memotong sayur dengan cepat.
w|bersungguh-sungguh.en: The head chef saw Fajar seriously practicing cutting vegetables fast.
w|bersungguh-sungguh.ko: 주방장은 파자르가 채소를 빨리 써는 연습을 열심히 하는 걸 봤어요.

w|bersungguh-sungguh.text: Sebelum dijual, setiap barang dibersihkan Lestari dengan bersungguh-sungguh.
w|bersungguh-sungguh.en: Before selling, Lestari cleans every item carefully and seriously.
w|bersungguh-sungguh.ko: 레스타리는 팔기 전에 물건 하나하나를 정성껏 닦아요.

w|bersyarat.text: Bank memberi Andi pinjaman bersyarat untuk merenovasi rumah.
w|bersyarat.en: The bank gave Andi a conditional loan to renovate the house.
w|bersyarat.ko: 은행은 안디에게 집 수리를 위한 조건부 대출을 해 줬어요.

w|bersyarat.text: Tiket promo itu bersifat bersyarat dan tidak bisa dibatalkan.
w|bersyarat.en: The promo ticket comes with conditions and cannot be canceled.
w|bersyarat.ko: 그 할인표는 조건이 붙어 있어서 취소할 수 없어요.

w|bersyukur.en: He is grateful for his family's support.

w|bersyukur.text: Mari bersyukur atas hari yang aman.
w|bersyukur.en: Let's be grateful for a safe day.

w|bertabrakan.text: Dua perahu nelayan hampir bertabrakan di dekat dermaga karena ombak tinggi.
w|bertabrakan.en: Two fishing boats nearly collided near the pier because of high waves.
w|bertabrakan.ko: 높은 파도 때문에 어선 두 척이 부두 근처에서 부딪칠 뻔했어요.

w|bertabrakan.text: Sepeda anak Ayu dan motor tetangga bertabrakan di gang sempit.
w|bertabrakan.en: Ayu's child's bicycle and the neighbor's motorbike collided in the narrow alley.
w|bertabrakan.ko: 좁은 골목에서 아유네 아이 자전거와 이웃 오토바이가 부딪쳤어요.

w|bertahun-tahun.text: Pak satpam itu sudah bertahun-tahun menjaga gedung apartemen Bayu.
w|bertahun-tahun.en: That security guard has guarded Bayu's apartment building for years.
w|bertahun-tahun.ko: 그 경비원은 몇 년째 바유네 아파트 건물을 지키고 있어요.

w|bertahun-tahun.text: Intan sudah bertahun-tahun memakai jalur kereta yang sama untuk mudik.
w|bertahun-tahun.en: Intan has used the same train route for years to go home for the holidays.
w|bertahun-tahun.ko: 인탄은 몇 년째 같은 기차 노선으로 고향에 가요.

w|bertambah.en: The number of students grows every year.
His weight increased after the holiday.

w|bertanding.text: Penghuni apartemen itu bertanding bulu tangkis di lapangan atap setiap Minggu.
w|bertanding.en: The residents of that apartment building play badminton matches on the rooftop court every Sunday.
w|bertanding.ko: 그 아파트 입주민들은 일요일마다 옥상 코트에서 배드민턴 시합을 해요.

w|bertanding.text: Dua pemuda di gerbong itu sedang menuju Bandung untuk bertanding catur.
w|bertanding.en: Two young men in that carriage were heading to Bandung to compete in chess.
w|bertanding.ko: 그 객차의 두 청년은 체스 시합을 하러 반둥으로 가는 길이었어요.

w|bertanya-tanya.text: Semua murid bertanya-tanya siapa guru baru yang akan mengajar matematika.
w|bertanya-tanya.en: All the students were wondering who the new math teacher would be.
w|bertanya-tanya.ko: 학생들은 모두 새 수학 선생님이 누구일지 궁금해했어요.

w|bertanya-tanya.text: Ayu bertanya-tanya kenapa kakaknya belum pulang juga.
w|bertanya-tanya.en: Ayu wondered why her older brother still hadn't come home.
w|bertanya-tanya.ko: 아유는 오빠가 왜 아직도 안 오는지 궁금했어요.

w|bertaruh.text: Mereka tidak boleh bertaruh di sini.
w|bertaruh.en: They are not allowed to bet here.

w|bertaruh.text: Aku tidak mau bertaruh soal itu.
w|bertaruh.en: I don't want to wager on that.

w|bertekad.text: Budi bertekad membereskan salah paham itu sebelum makan malam.
w|bertekad.en: Budi was determined to clear up the misunderstanding before dinner.
w|bertekad.ko: 부디는 저녁 먹기 전에 그 오해를 풀겠다고 마음먹었어요.

w|bertekad.text: Siti bertekad selesai membongkar kardus dalam seminggu.
w|bertekad.en: Siti is determined to finish unpacking the boxes within a week.
w|bertekad.ko: 시티는 일주일 안에 상자를 다 풀겠다고 마음먹었어요.

w|berteman.text: Dia mudah berteman dengan siapa saja.
w|berteman.en: He easily makes friends with anyone.

w|bertempur.en: The troops fought on the front line.
They had to fight to survive.

w|bertengkar.en: They often quarrel over small things.

w|bertengkar.text: Bertengkar di depan umum itu memalukan.

w|bertentangan.text: Pendapat Dimas soal pupuk kimia bertentangan dengan pendapat ayahnya.
w|bertentangan.en: Dimas's opinion on chemical fertilizer goes against his father's.
w|bertentangan.ko: 화학 비료에 대한 디마스의 생각은 아버지 생각과 정반대예요.

w|bertentangan.text: Berita di dua situs itu saling bertentangan, jadi Putri bingung.
w|bertentangan.en: The news on those two sites contradicted each other, so Putri was confused.
w|bertentangan.ko: 두 사이트의 기사가 서로 엇갈려서 푸트리는 헷갈렸어요.

w|bertepuk.text: Budi ingat mereka bertepuk tangan paling keras saat Andi menang lomba pidato.
w|bertepuk.en: Budi remembers they clapped the loudest when Andi won the speech contest.
w|bertepuk.ko: 부디는 안디가 웅변 대회에서 이겼을 때 자기들이 가장 크게 박수 쳤던 걸 기억해요.

w|bertepuk.text: Anak-anak di pinggir jalan bertepuk tangan setiap kali pelari lewat.
w|bertepuk.en: Children by the roadside clapped every time a runner passed.
w|bertepuk.ko: 길가의 아이들은 주자가 지나갈 때마다 박수를 쳤어요.

w|bertiga.en: The three of us went to the beach.

w|bertiga.text: Mereka makan siang bertiga di kafe.
w|bertiga.en: The three of them had lunch at a cafe.

w|bertingkah.en: Acting arrogant makes friends pull away.

w|bertopeng.text: Andi melampirkan foto mereka berdua bertopeng di pesta sekolah dulu.
w|bertopeng.en: Andi encloses a photo of the two of them in masks at an old school party.
w|bertopeng.ko: 안디는 예전 학교 파티에서 둘이 가면을 쓴 사진을 동봉해요.

w|bertopeng.text: Beberapa peserta berlari bertopeng pahlawan super untuk menghibur anak-anak.
w|bertopeng.en: Some participants ran wearing superhero masks to entertain the children.
w|bertopeng.ko: 몇몇 참가자는 아이들을 즐겁게 하려고 슈퍼히어로 가면을 쓰고 달렸어요.

w|bertugas.en: The police are on duty keeping the night safe.
w|bertugas.ko: 경찰이 밤 안전을 지키는 임무를 맡아.

w|bertugas.en: Being on duty here makes him proud.
w|bertugas.ko: 여기서 근무하는 게 그를 자랑스럽게 해.

w|bertukar.text: Sebelum pentas, Bayu dan Rina bertukar kostum karena ukurannya tertukar.
w|bertukar.en: Before the show, Bayu and Rina swapped costumes because the sizes had been mixed up.
w|bertukar.ko: 공연 전에 바유와 리나는 사이즈가 바뀌어서 의상을 서로 바꿨어요.

w|bertukar.text: Intan dan Dodi bertukar nomor telepon setelah rapat dengan klien.
w|bertukar.en: Intan and Dodi exchanged phone numbers after the client meeting.
w|bertukar.ko: 인탄과 도디는 고객 미팅이 끝나고 전화번호를 주고받았어요.

w|bertunangan.text: Andi baru tahu Rina sudah bertunangan dengan teman kuliahnya.
w|bertunangan.en: Andi just found out that Rina is engaged to her university friend.
w|bertunangan.ko: 안디는 리나가 대학 친구와 약혼했다는 걸 이제야 알았어요.

w|bertunangan.text: Pasangan yang baru bertunangan memesan kamar dengan pemandangan laut.
w|bertunangan.en: A newly engaged couple booked a room with a sea view.
w|bertunangan.ko: 막 약혼한 커플이 바다 전망 방을 예약했어요.

w|berturut-turut.text: Kota Dimas dilanda banjir tiga tahun berturut-turut.
w|berturut-turut.en: Dimas's town was hit by floods three years in a row.
w|berturut-turut.ko: 디마스네 도시는 삼 년 연속 홍수를 겪었어요.

w|berturut-turut.text: Putri bekerja tiga akhir pekan berturut-turut untuk mengecat ulang dinding.
w|berturut-turut.en: Putri worked three weekends in a row to repaint the walls.
w|berturut-turut.ko: 푸트리는 벽을 다시 칠하려고 주말 세 번을 연달아 일했어요.

w|beruang.text: Beruang itu hidup di hutan dingin.
w|beruang.en: That bear lives in a cold forest.
The children were afraid of seeing a bear.

w|berujung.text: Jalan setapak yang dipilih Rudi ternyata berujung di sebuah air terjun kecil.
w|berujung.en: The path Rudi chose turned out to end at a small waterfall.
w|berujung.ko: 루디가 고른 오솔길은 알고 보니 작은 폭포에서 끝났어요.

w|berujung.text: Desak-desakan di pintu masuk hampir berujung ricuh.
w|berujung.en: The pushing and shoving at the entrance almost ended in chaos.
w|berujung.ko: 입구에서 밀치락달치락하던 게 하마터면 소동으로 번질 뻔했어요.

w|berulang.text: Andi sudah berulang kali melapor soal motor yang parkir di depan rumahnya.
w|berulang.en: Andi has reported the motorbike parked in front of his house many times.
w|berulang.ko: 안디는 집 앞에 세워진 오토바이 때문에 여러 번 신고했어요.

w|berulang.text: Dewi melatih tembakan bebas berulang kali sampai tangannya pegal.
w|berulang.en: Dewi practiced free throws over and over until her arms ached.
w|berulang.ko: 데위는 팔이 저릴 때까지 자유투를 몇 번이고 연습했어요.

w|berulang-ulang.text: Adik Dimas bertanya berulang-ulang kapan musim hujan selesai.
w|berulang-ulang.en: Dimas's little brother asked over and over when the rainy season would end.
w|berulang-ulang.ko: 디마스의 동생은 우기가 언제 끝나냐고 몇 번이고 물었어요.

w|berulang-ulang.text: Putri mengukur pintu itu berulang-ulang agar engselnya pas.
w|berulang-ulang.en: Putri measured the door over and over so the hinges would fit.
w|berulang-ulang.ko: 푸트리는 경첩이 딱 맞도록 그 문을 몇 번이고 쟀어요.

w|berumur.text: Pohon itu sudah berumur puluhan tahun.
w|berumur.en: That tree is already decades old.
w|berumur.ko: 그 나무는 이미 수십 년이나 됐어.

w|berumur.en: He is the same age as my older sibling.

w|berurusan.text: Aku tidak mau berurusan dengan orang kasar.
w|berurusan.en: I don't want to deal with rude people.
w|berurusan.ko: 나는 거친 사람과 상대하고 싶지 않아.

w|berurusan.text: Dia terpaksa berurusan dengan masalah hukum.
w|berurusan.en: He had to deal with a legal problem.
w|berurusan.ko: 그는 어쩔 수 없이 법적 문제를 상대했어.

w|berusia.en: Her child is five years old.

w|berusia.text: Gedung itu berusia lebih dari seabad.
w|berusia.en: That building is more than a century old.

w|berutang.en: He has owed his friend for a long time.
w|berutang.ko: 그는 친구에게 오래 빚을 지고 있어.

w|berutang.en: Owing a large debt made him anxious.

w|berwarna.en: That flower is pink in color.
The sky is orange at dusk.

w|berwenang.text: Hanya petugas berwenang yang boleh masuk.
w|berwenang.ko: 권한 있는 직원만 들어갈 수 있어.

w|berwenang.text: Berwenang atau tidak, dia harus ikut aturan.
w|berwenang.en: Authorized or not, he must follow the rules.
w|berwenang.ko: 권한이 있든 없든 그는 규칙을 따라야 해.

w|besar-besaran.text: Teater Eko sedang mengadakan promosi besar-besaran untuk drama musikal barunya.
w|besar-besaran.en: Eko's theater is running a massive promotion for its new musical.
w|besar-besaran.ko: 에코의 극단은 새 뮤지컬을 위해 대대적인 홍보를 하고 있어요.

w|besar-besaran.text: Minimarket di ujung jalan sedang mengadakan diskon besar-besaran, jadi toko Ayu sepi.
w|besar-besaran.en: The minimarket at the end of the street is having a huge sale, so Ayu's shop is quiet.
w|besar-besaran.ko: 길 끝 편의점이 대대적인 할인을 해서 아유의 가게가 한산해요.

w|beserta.text: Andi meminjam ensiklopedia beserta peta lama untuk tugas sejarahnya.
w|beserta.en: Andi borrowed an encyclopedia along with an old map for his history assignment.
w|beserta.ko: 안디는 역사 과제를 하려고 백과사전과 함께 옛 지도를 빌렸어요.

w|beserta.text: Dewi mengirim laporan keuangan beserta lampiran kuitansi kepada atasannya.
w|beserta.en: Dewi sent the financial report along with the receipt attachments to her boss.
w|beserta.ko: 디위는 영수증 첨부 파일과 함께 재무 보고서를 상사에게 보냈어요.

w|besi.en: That fence is made of iron.

w|betapa.text: Aku baru sadar betapa lelahnya dia.
w|betapa.en: I just realized how tired she is.

w|betina.text: Kasus itu bermula dari hilangnya seekor sapi betina milik warga.
w|betina.en: The case started with the disappearance of a villager's cow.
w|betina.ko: 그 사건은 주민의 암소 한 마리가 사라진 데서 시작됐어요.

w|betina.text: Ayam betina milik tetangga sering bertelur di belakang warung.
w|betina.en: The neighbour's hen often lays eggs behind the shop.
w|betina.ko: 이웃집 암탉이 가게 뒤에서 자주 알을 낳아요.

w|beton.text: Dinding beton apartemen itu cukup tebal sehingga suara tetangga jarang terdengar.
w|beton.en: The apartment's concrete walls are thick enough that neighbors are rarely heard.
w|beton.ko: 그 아파트 콘크리트 벽은 두꺼워서 이웃 소리가 잘 안 들려요.

w|beton.text: Warga desa membangun tanggul beton supaya sungai tidak meluap lagi.
w|beton.en: The villagers built a concrete embankment so the river wouldn't overflow again.
w|beton.ko: 마을 사람들은 강이 다시 넘치지 않도록 콘크리트 둑을 쌓았어요.

w|biara.text: Kelas Andi berkunjung ke biara tua di bukit untuk pelajaran sejarah.
w|biara.en: Andi's class visited an old monastery on the hill for a history lesson.
w|biara.ko: 안디네 반은 역사 수업으로 언덕 위 오래된 수도원에 견학을 갔어요.

w|biara.text: Bibi Dewi tinggal di biara dan selalu mengirim kue kering setiap akhir tahun.
w|biara.en: Dewi's aunt lives in a convent and always sends cookies at the end of every year.
w|biara.ko: 데위의 이모는 수녀원에 살고 해마다 연말이면 쿠키를 보내 줘요.

w|biarawan.text: Fajar mengundang seorang biarawan tua, guru bahasa Inggrisnya waktu SMA.
w|biarawan.en: Fajar invited an old monk who had been his English teacher in high school.
w|biarawan.ko: 파자르는 고등학교 때 영어 선생님이었던 나이 든 수도사를 초대했어요.

w|biarawan.text: Lestari meliput seorang biarawan yang mengajar anak-anak di daerah perbatasan.
w|biarawan.en: Lestari covered a monk who teaches children in the border area.
w|biarawan.ko: 레스타리는 국경 지역에서 아이들을 가르치는 수도사를 취재했어요.

w|biarawati.text: Bibi Rina, seorang biarawati, mengirim surat ucapan selamat dari biara.
w|biarawati.en: Rina's aunt, a nun, sent a congratulatory letter from the convent.
w|biarawati.ko: 수녀인 리나의 이모가 수녀원에서 축하 편지를 보냈어요.

w|biarawati.text: Para biarawati di bukit itu menanam bunga baru setiap pergantian musim.
w|biarawati.en: The nuns on that hill plant new flowers at every change of season.
w|biarawati.ko: 그 언덕의 수녀들은 철이 바뀔 때마다 새 꽃을 심어요.

w|biaya.en: The travel cost is too expensive.

w|bibir.en: Lips are dry from the hot weather.
She bites her lip when nervous.

w|bidang.en: He is an expert in the technology field.
They work in the education field.

w|bijak.text: Bijak sekali keputusan yang kamu buat.
w|bijak.en: The decision you made is very wise.

w|bijak.text: Nenek memberi nasihat yang bijak padaku.
w|bijak.ko: 할머니가 내게 현명한 조언을 해 주셨어.

w|bijaksana.text: Bijaksana untuk mendengarkan nasihat orang tua.
w|bijaksana.en: It is wise to listen to parents' advice.

w|biji.text: Eko membelah kelapa muda dan membuang biji salak yang dia makan sebelumnya.
w|biji.en: Eko split a young coconut and threw away the snakefruit seeds he had eaten earlier.
w|biji.ko: 에코는 어린 코코넛을 쪼개고 아까 먹은 살락 씨를 버렸어요.

w|biji.text: Bu Sri memberi Ayu biji cabai untuk ditanam di pot.
w|biji.en: Mrs. Sri gave Ayu chili seeds to plant in a pot.
w|biji.ko: 스리 아주머니가 아유에게 화분에 심을 고추씨를 줬어요.

w|bikin.text: Teman-teman Eko mau bikin kelompok belajar sebelum ujian.
w|bikin.en: Eko's friends want to set up a study group before the exam.
w|bikin.ko: 에코의 친구들은 시험 전에 스터디 모임을 만들고 싶어 해요.

w|bikin.text: Hari ini Ayu mau bikin kue cokelat bersama adiknya.
w|bikin.en: Today Ayu wants to make chocolate cake with her little sister.
w|bikin.ko: 오늘 아유는 동생이랑 초콜릿 케이크를 만들고 싶어 해요.

w|biksu.text: Waktu liburan ke Thailand, Rina bertemu biksu yang mengajarinya meditasi.
w|biksu.en: On holiday in Thailand, Rina met a monk who taught her meditation.
w|biksu.ko: 태국에 휴가 갔을 때 리나는 명상을 가르쳐 준 승려를 만났어요.

w|biksu.text: Rombongan biksu dari Thailand menginap dua malam di hotel itu.
w|biksu.en: A group of monks from Thailand stayed two nights at the hotel.
w|biksu.ko: 태국에서 온 승려 일행이 그 호텔에 이틀 밤 묵었어요.

w|bila.en: If it rains, we turn back.
If you need to, just call.

w|bilik.text: Andi mengubah bilik kecil di belakang dapur menjadi ruang cuci.
w|bilik.en: Andi turned the small cubicle behind the kitchen into a laundry room.
w|bilik.ko: 안디는 부엌 뒤 작은 칸을 세탁실로 바꿨어요.

w|bilik.text: Dewi mencari bilik telepon di stasiun karena baterai ponselnya habis.
w|bilik.en: Dewi looked for a phone booth at the station because her phone battery was dead.
w|bilik.ko: 휴대폰 배터리가 다 돼서 데위는 역에서 공중전화 부스를 찾았어요.

w|binasa.text: Pemandu bercerita bahwa hutan itu hampir binasa karena kebakaran puluhan tahun lalu.
w|binasa.en: The guide said that forest nearly perished in a fire decades ago.
w|binasa.ko: 가이드는 그 숲이 수십 년 전 산불로 거의 사라질 뻔했다고 했어요.

w|binasa.text: Semangat Ayu seakan binasa ketika hujan deras turun di tengah lomba.
w|binasa.en: Ayu's spirit seemed to die when heavy rain came down mid-race.
w|binasa.ko: 대회 도중 폭우가 쏟아지자 아유의 의욕이 꺾이는 듯했어요.

w|bingung.en: His face looked so confused then.
w|bingung.ko: 그때 그의 얼굴이 정말 혼란스러워 보였어.

w|bintang.en: The stars in the sky are beautiful.

w|biola.text: Setiap Sabtu sore ada pertunjukan biola kecil di aula perpustakaan.
w|biola.en: Every Saturday afternoon there's a small violin performance in the library hall.
w|biola.ko: 토요일 오후마다 도서관 강당에서 작은 바이올린 공연이 열려요.

w|biola.text: Dewi kadang berlatih biola di ruang rapat kosong saat jam makan siang.
w|biola.en: Dewi sometimes practices violin in an empty meeting room at lunchtime.
w|biola.ko: 디위는 가끔 점심시간에 빈 회의실에서 바이올린 연습을 해요.

w|biologi.text: Fajar dulu kuliah biologi, jadi dia paham kenapa daging harus disimpan dingin.
w|biologi.en: Fajar used to study biology, so he understands why meat has to be kept cold.
w|biologi.ko: 파자르는 예전에 생물학을 공부해서 고기를 차갑게 보관해야 하는 이유를 알아요.

w|biologi.text: Penjual buku bekas memberi Lestari buku pelajaran biologi seharga sepuluh ribu.
w|biologi.en: The used-book seller gave Lestari a biology textbook for ten thousand rupiah.
w|biologi.ko: 헌책 장수가 레스타리에게 생물학 교과서를 만 루피아에 줬어요.

w|biologis.text: Pemandu bilang daun-daun yang jatuh akan terurai lewat proses biologis.
w|biologis.en: The guide said the fallen leaves will break down through a biological process.
w|biologis.ko: 가이드는 떨어진 잎들이 생물학적 과정을 통해 분해된다고 말했어요.

w|biologis.text: Rina bercanda bahwa menonton konser sudah jadi kebutuhan biologis baginya.
w|biologis.en: Rina jokes that going to concerts has become a biological need for her.
w|biologis.ko: 리나는 공연 보는 게 자기한테는 생리적 욕구가 됐다고 농담해요.

w|bioskop.text: Terdakwa mengaku sedang menonton film di bioskop pada malam itu.
w|bioskop.en: The defendant claimed he was watching a film at the cinema that night.
w|bioskop.ko: 피고인은 그날 밤 영화관에서 영화를 보고 있었다고 주장했어요.

w|bioskop.text: Para remaja membeli camilan di warung Lestari sebelum pergi ke bioskop.
w|bioskop.en: The teenagers buy snacks at Lestari's shop before going to the cinema.
w|bioskop.ko: 십 대들은 영화관에 가기 전에 레스타리 가게에서 간식을 사요.

w|biro.text: Desain gedung itu dibuat oleh biro arsitek dari kota sebelah.
w|biro.en: The building was designed by an architecture firm from the neighbouring city.
w|biro.ko: 그 건물은 옆 도시 건축 사무소가 설계했어요.

w|biro.text: Rina harus mengurus dokumen di biro perjalanan untuk tugas luar kota minggu depan.
w|biro.en: Rina has to sort out documents at the travel agency for next week's business trip.
w|biro.ko: 리나는 다음 주 출장 때문에 여행사에서 서류를 처리해야 해요.

w|biru.en: The sky is bright blue today.

w|biru.ko: 저 파란 옷이 너한테 잘 어울려.

w|bis.text: Bis kota berhenti di depan sekolah.
w|bis.en: The city bus stops in front of the school.

w|bis.text: Kami naik bis ke pusat kota.
w|bis.en: We took the bus to downtown.

w|bisa.en: Can you slow down a bit?

w|bisbol.text: Fajar memesan sarung tangan bisbol untuk keponakannya yang tinggal di luar negeri.
w|bisbol.en: Fajar ordered a baseball glove for his nephew who lives abroad.
w|bisbol.ko: 파자르는 외국에 사는 조카에게 야구 글러브를 주문해 줬어요.

w|bisbol.text: Kelas hari ini membuat hot dog dan jagung bakar seperti di stadion bisbol.
w|bisbol.en: Today's class made hot dogs and grilled corn like at a baseball stadium.
w|bisbol.ko: 오늘 수업에서는 야구장처럼 핫도그와 구운 옥수수를 만들었어요.

w|biskuit.text: Andi menghancurkan biskuit untuk dijadikan dasar kue keju.
w|biskuit.en: Andi crushed biscuits to make the base for the cheesecake.
w|biskuit.ko: 안디는 치즈케이크 바닥을 만들려고 비스킷을 부쉈어요.

w|biskuit.text: Dewi mengirim sekaleng biskuit mentega bersama suratnya.
w|biskuit.en: Dewi sent a tin of butter biscuits along with her letter.
w|biskuit.ko: 데위는 편지와 함께 버터 비스킷 한 통을 보냈어요.

w|bisu.text: Burung beo milik Pak Hasan mendadak bisu sejak pindah kandang.
w|bisu.en: Mr. Hasan's parrot suddenly went silent after moving to a new cage.
w|bisu.ko: 하산 씨의 앵무새는 새장을 옮긴 뒤 갑자기 말을 안 해요.

w|bisu.text: Siti mengajari anak tetangga yang bisu bahasa isyarat sederhana.
w|bisu.en: Siti teaches the neighbor's mute child simple sign language.
w|bisu.ko: 시티는 말을 못 하는 이웃 아이에게 간단한 수어를 가르쳐요.

w|bius.text: Kucing liar itu harus diberi bius sebelum lukanya dijahit.
w|bius.en: The stray cat had to be given anesthesia before its wound was stitched.
w|bius.ko: 그 길고양이는 상처를 꿰매기 전에 마취를 해야 했어요.

w|bius.text: Putri membaca sejarah penemuan obat bius di perpustakaan kampus.
w|bius.en: Putri read about the history of the discovery of anesthetics in the campus library.
w|bius.ko: 푸트리는 캠퍼스 도서관에서 마취제 발견의 역사를 읽었어요.

w|blok.text: Blok apartemen itu baru selesai dibangun.
w|blok.en: That apartment block was just finished.
He lives in the next block.

w|bocah.en: That kid is playing in the yard.

w|bocor.text: Atap perpustakaan sekolah bocor setiap kali hujan deras.
w|bocor.en: The school library roof leaks every time it rains hard.
w|bocor.ko: 비가 세게 올 때마다 학교 도서관 지붕이 새요.

w|bocor.text: Rahasia kejutan untuk guru wali kelas sempat bocor ke grup obrolan.
w|bocor.en: The secret surprise for the homeroom teacher briefly leaked into the group chat.
w|bocor.ko: 담임 선생님을 위한 깜짝 선물 비밀이 단톡방에 새어 나갈 뻔했어요.

w|bola.en: The kids are playing ball in the park.

w|boneka.en: Her favorite doll went missing in the park.

w|boneka.text: Anak itu memeluk boneka sebelum tidur.
w|boneka.en: The child hugged the doll before sleeping.
w|boneka.ko: 그 아이는 잠들기 전에 인형을 안았어.

w|bonus.text: Para tukang dijanjikan bonus kalau atap selesai sebelum musim hujan.
w|bonus.en: The builders were promised a bonus if the roof is finished before the rainy season.
w|bonus.ko: 인부들은 우기 전에 지붕을 끝내면 보너스를 받기로 했어요.

w|bonus.text: Rina dengar karyawan di sini dapat bonus akhir tahun yang lumayan.
w|bonus.en: Rina heard that employees here get a decent year-end bonus.
w|bonus.ko: 리나는 여기 직원들이 연말 보너스를 꽤 받는다고 들었어요.

w|bor.text: Andi meminjam bor dari tetangga untuk memasang rak dinding.
w|bor.en: Andi borrowed a drill from a neighbor to put up a wall shelf.
w|bor.ko: 안디는 벽 선반을 달려고 이웃에게 드릴을 빌렸어요.

w|bor.text: Suara bor dari proyek jalur ganda terdengar jelas saat kereta melambat.
w|bor.en: The sound of drills from the double-track project could be heard clearly as the train slowed.
w|bor.ko: 열차가 속도를 줄이자 복선 공사의 드릴 소리가 또렷이 들렸어요.

w|bordil.text: Drama sejarah itu berlatar kota pelabuhan yang penuh bordil dan kedai minuman.
w|bordil.en: The historical drama is set in a port town full of brothels and taverns.
w|bordil.ko: 그 역사극은 사창가와 주점이 가득한 항구 도시가 배경이에요.

w|bordil.text: Dalam buku sejarah desa, Ayu membaca bahwa dulu ada bordil di dekat perkebunan Belanda.
w|bordil.en: In the village history book, Ayu reads that there was once a brothel near the Dutch plantation.
w|bordil.ko: 마을 역사책에서 아유는 옛날 네덜란드 농장 근처에 사창가가 있었다는 걸 읽어요.

w|borgol.text: Dalam adegan penangkapan, Bayu memakai borgol plastik dari gudang properti.
w|borgol.en: In the arrest scene, Bayu wears plastic handcuffs from the props store.
w|borgol.ko: 체포 장면에서 바유는 소품 창고에서 가져온 플라스틱 수갑을 차요.

w|borgol.text: Dodi bercanda bahwa jam kantor terasa seperti borgol yang tidak kelihatan.
w|borgol.en: Dodi joked that office hours feel like invisible handcuffs.
w|borgol.ko: 도디는 근무 시간이 눈에 안 보이는 수갑 같다고 농담했어요.

w|bos.en: He met the boss this morning.

w|bosan.text: Aku bosan menunggu di sini lama-lama.
w|bosan.en: I'm bored of waiting here for so long.

w|bosan.text: Anak itu tampak bosan di kelas.
w|bosan.en: That child looked bored in class.

w|botak.text: Saksi menggambarkan pelaku sebagai pria botak berkacamata hitam.
w|botak.en: The witness described the perpetrator as a bald man wearing dark glasses.
w|botak.ko: 증인은 범인을 선글라스를 쓴 대머리 남자라고 묘사했어요.

w|botak.text: Pak Darto yang botak selalu membeli kopi sachet setiap pagi.
w|botak.en: Bald Mr Darto always buys a sachet of coffee every morning.
w|botak.ko: 대머리인 다르토 아저씨는 매일 아침 봉지 커피를 사요.

w|botol.text: Botol air itu jatuh dari meja.
w|botol.en: That water bottle fell off the table.

w|botol.text: Dia mengisi botol sebelum pergi lari.
w|botol.en: She filled the bottle before going for a run.
w|botol.ko: 그는 달리러 가기 전에 병에 물을 채웠어.

w|brankas.text: Uang gaji disimpan di brankas kantor sampai hari pembayaran.
w|brankas.en: The wage money is kept in the office safe until payday.
w|brankas.ko: 월급 돈은 지급일까지 사무실 금고에 보관돼요.

w|brankas.text: Kamar hotel Intan punya brankas kecil untuk menyimpan paspor.
w|brankas.en: Intan's hotel room has a small safe for keeping her passport.
w|brankas.ko: 인탄의 호텔 방에는 여권을 넣어 둘 작은 금고가 있어요.

w|brilian.text: Ide Budi untuk proyek daur ulang dianggap brilian oleh juri.
w|brilian.en: The judges thought Budi's idea for the recycling project was brilliant.
w|brilian.ko: 심사위원들은 부디의 재활용 프로젝트 아이디어가 기발하다고 봤어요.

w|brilian.text: Ide adik Siti untuk memberi label warna pada setiap kardus ternyata brilian.
w|brilian.en: Siti's younger sibling's idea of color-labeling every box turned out to be brilliant.
w|brilian.ko: 상자마다 색깔 표시를 붙이자는 동생 아이디어는 정말 기발했어요.

w|brutal.text: Dalam pelajaran sejarah, Budi membaca tentang perang brutal di masa penjajahan.
w|brutal.en: In history class, Budi read about a brutal war during the colonial period.
w|brutal.ko: 부디는 역사 시간에 식민지 시대의 잔혹한 전쟁에 대해 읽었어요.

w|brutal.text: Wartawan di antara alumni bercerita tentang liputannya mengenai konflik brutal di luar negeri.
w|brutal.en: A journalist among the alumni talked about covering a brutal conflict abroad.
w|brutal.ko: 동문 중 한 기자가 해외의 참혹한 분쟁을 취재한 이야기를 했어요.

w|buas.text: Jaksa menyebut kasus ini melibatkan perdagangan satwa buas secara ilegal.
w|buas.en: The prosecutor said this case involves the illegal trade of wild animals.
w|buas.ko: 검사는 이 사건이 야생 맹수를 불법으로 거래한 일과 관련 있다고 했어요.

w|buas.text: Anak-anak suka membeli stiker bergambar binatang buas di warung Lestari.
w|buas.en: Children like buying stickers of wild animals at Lestari's shop.
w|buas.ko: 아이들은 레스타리 가게에서 맹수 그림 스티커를 즐겨 사요.

w|buat.en: She made a cake this morning.

w|buatan.text: Kue buatan ibu rasanya enak sekali.
w|buatan.en: The cake Mom made tastes really good.
w|buatan.ko: 엄마가 만든 케이크 맛이 정말 좋아.

w|buatan.text: Ini produk buatan lokal yang bagus.
w|buatan.en: This is a good locally made product.

w|buaya.text: Kata petugas desa, di sungai dekat sawah pernah terlihat buaya.
w|buaya.en: The village officer said a crocodile was once seen in the river near the rice fields.
w|buaya.ko: 마을 담당자 말로는 논 근처 강에서 악어가 목격된 적이 있대요.

w|buaya.text: Adik Putri juga takut melihat buaya yang diam seperti patung.
w|buaya.en: Putri's little sister was also scared of the crocodile that stayed still like a statue.
w|buaya.ko: 푸트리의 동생은 동상처럼 꼼짝 않는 악어도 무서워했어요.

w|bubar.text: Antrean pasien baru bubar setelah klinik tutup pukul delapan malam.
w|bubar.en: The line of patients only cleared after the clinic closed at eight in the evening.
w|bubar.ko: 환자 줄은 치과가 저녁 여덟 시에 문을 닫고 나서야 흩어졌어요.

w|bubar.text: Para tetangga yang menonton di pagar bubar setelah tembok lama berhasil dirobohkan.
w|bubar.en: The neighbours watching by the fence dispersed after the old wall was knocked down.
w|bubar.ko: 울타리에서 구경하던 이웃들은 옛 벽이 무너지자 흩어졌어요.

w|bubuk.text: Kopi bubuk di dapur redaksi selalu habis sebelum tengah malam.
w|bubuk.en: The ground coffee in the newsroom kitchen always runs out before midnight.
w|bubuk.ko: 편집국 탕비실 분말 커피는 자정 전에 늘 바닥나요.

w|bubuk.text: Ayu memakai bubuk silika untuk mengeringkan ponsel yang kena air.
w|bubuk.en: Ayu uses silica powder to dry phones that got wet.
w|bubuk.ko: 아유는 물에 젖은 휴대폰을 말리려고 실리카 가루를 써요.

w|bubur.text: Andi menambahkan jahe ke bubur supaya rasanya lebih hangat.
w|bubur.en: Andi added ginger to the porridge to give it a warmer taste.
w|bubur.ko: 안디는 죽 맛이 더 따뜻하도록 생강을 넣었어요.

w|bubur.text: Dewi rindu bubur ayam di warung dekat asrama mereka dulu.
w|bubur.en: Dewi misses the chicken porridge from the stall near their old dormitory.
w|bubur.ko: 데위는 예전 기숙사 근처 가게의 닭죽이 그리워요.

w|budak.text: Cerita tentang budak itu sangat menyentuh.
w|budak.en: The story about that slave is very moving.

w|budak.text: Mereka membebaskan budak dari penjara gelap.
w|budak.en: They freed the slave from the dark prison.
w|budak.ko: 그들은 어두운 감옥에서 노예를 풀어 줬어.

w|budaya.text: Budaya lokal dijaga oleh masyarakat desa.
w|budaya.en: Local culture is preserved by the village community.

w|budaya.text: Dia mempelajari budaya Jepang dengan tekun.

w|budi.text: Eko tidak akan melupakan budi baik guru yang membantunya waktu sakit.
w|budi.en: Eko will never forget the kindness of the teacher who helped him when he was sick.
w|budi.ko: 에코는 아플 때 자기를 도와준 선생님의 은혜를 잊지 않을 거예요.

w|budi.text: Ibu Ayu selalu mengajarkan anak-anaknya untuk membalas budi orang yang menolong mereka.
w|budi.en: Ayu's mother always teaches her children to repay the kindness of people who help them.
w|budi.ko: 아유의 어머니는 늘 아이들에게 도와준 사람의 은혜를 갚으라고 가르쳐요.

w|bukit.text: Kami mendaki bukit sebelum matahari terbit.
w|bukit.en: We climbed the hill before sunrise.
w|bukit.ko: 우리는 해 뜨기 전에 언덕을 올랐어.

w|bukit.text: Bukit hijau itu tampak dari jendela.
w|bukit.en: That green hill is visible from the window.

w|buku.en: I forgot to bring the book.

w|bulan.en: There are many events this month.
Look at the moon in the night sky.

w|bulat.text: Lubang untuk tiang itu harus benar-benar bulat agar pipa bisa masuk.
w|bulat.en: The hole for the pillar has to be perfectly round so the pipe can fit.
w|bulat.ko: 파이프가 들어가려면 기둥 구멍이 완전히 둥글어야 해요.

w|bulat.text: Rapat perkenalan Rina diadakan di meja bulat dekat jendela.
w|bulat.en: Rina's introduction meeting was held at the round table by the window.
w|bulat.ko: 리나의 첫인사 회의는 창가의 둥근 탁자에서 열렸어요.

w|bulu.en: That cat's fur is very soft.
There is fur on her black coat.

w|bumi.en: We have to protect the earth.

w|bunga.en: The flowers in the garden bloomed.

w|buntu.text: Diskusi kelompok Budi sempat buntu karena tidak ada yang mau mengalah.
w|buntu.en: Budi's group discussion hit a dead end because no one would give in.
w|buntu.ko: 아무도 양보하지 않아서 부디네 조 토론이 한동안 막혔어요.

w|buntu.text: Rumah lama Siti ada di ujung gang buntu dekat sekolah.
w|buntu.en: Siti's old house is at the end of a dead-end alley near the school.
w|buntu.ko: 시티의 옛집은 학교 근처 막다른 골목 끝에 있어요.

w|bunyi.en: The school bell sound rang loudly.

w|bunyi.text: Aku mendengar bunyi aneh dari dapur.
w|bunyi.en: I heard a strange sound from the kitchen.

w|buronan.text: Klub drama Eko memainkan cerita tentang seorang buronan yang akhirnya menyerah.
w|buronan.en: Eko's drama club performed a story about a fugitive who finally gives himself up.
w|buronan.ko: 에코네 연극부는 끝내 자수하는 도망자 이야기를 공연했어요.

w|buronan.text: Keluarga Ayu menonton film tentang detektif yang mengejar buronan.
w|buronan.en: Ayu's family watched a film about a detective chasing a fugitive.
w|buronan.ko: 아유네 가족은 탈주범을 쫓는 형사 영화를 봤어요.

w|buru-buru.text: Dia buru-buru pergi karena hampir terlambat.
w|buru-buru.en: He left in a hurry because he was almost late.
w|buru-buru.ko: 거의 늦을 뻔해서 그는 서둘러 떠났어.

w|buru-buru.text: Buru-buru saja, bus sebentar lagi datang.
w|buru-buru.en: Hurry up, the bus will arrive soon.

w|buruan.text: Dalam cerita rakyat yang dibaca Eko, rusa menjadi buruan raja.
w|buruan.en: In the folk tale Eko read, a deer became the king's prey.
w|buruan.ko: 에코가 읽은 민담에서 사슴은 왕의 사냥감이 됐어요.

w|buruan.text: Ayu menggambar harimau yang sedang mengintai buruan di balik semak.
w|buruan.en: Ayu drew a tiger stalking its prey behind the bushes.
w|buruan.ko: 아유는 덤불 뒤에서 사냥감을 노리는 호랑이를 그렸어요.

w|buruh.text: Ratusan buruh keluar dari gerbang pabrik saat sirene berbunyi.
w|buruh.en: Hundreds of laborers poured out of the factory gate when the siren sounded.
w|buruh.ko: 사이렌이 울리자 노동자 수백 명이 공장 문을 나섰어요.

w|buruh.text: Ayah Putri dulu buruh pelabuhan yang selalu pulang larut malam.
w|buruh.en: Putri's father was a dock worker who always came home late at night.
w|buruh.ko: 푸트리의 아버지는 늘 밤늦게 귀가하던 항구 노동자였어요.

w|burung.en: That bird sings early in the morning.
There's a bird in the tree.

w|bus.text: Kami naik bus ke pusat kota.
w|bus.en: We took the bus to downtown.
That bus is full of passengers.

w|busuk.text: Buah itu sudah busuk di kulkas.
w|busuk.en: That fruit has already gone rotten in the fridge.

w|busuk.text: Bau busuk datang dari tempat sampah.
w|busuk.en: A rotten smell came from the trash.

w|busur.text: Untuk hobi memanah, Fajar membeli busur kayu dari penjual di Bandung.
w|busur.en: For his archery hobby, Fajar bought a wooden bow from a seller in Bandung.
w|busur.ko: 파자르는 활쏘기 취미 때문에 반둥의 판매자에게서 나무 활을 샀어요.

w|busur.text: Lestari menghias kue ulang tahun dengan bentuk busur dan panah dari cokelat.
w|busur.en: Lestari decorated the birthday cake with a bow and arrow made of chocolate.
w|busur.ko: 레스타리는 생일 케이크를 초콜릿 활과 화살로 장식했어요.

w|buta.en: He has been illiterate since childhood.
