w|dinasti.text: Dinding restoran Putri dihias lukisan raja-raja dari dinasti lama.
w|dinasti.en: The walls of Putri's restaurant are decorated with paintings of kings from old dynasties.
w|dinasti.ko: 푸트리네 식당 벽은 옛 왕조 왕들의 그림으로 꾸며져 있어요.

w|dinding.en: Hang the photo on the wall.

w|dingin.en: The weather today is very cold.

w|dini.text: Pada dini hari, udara di desa Budi terasa sangat dingin.
w|dini.en: In the early hours, the air in Budi's village feels very cold.
w|dini.ko: 새벽에는 부디네 마을 공기가 아주 차가워요.

w|dini.text: Siti sudah harus berdandan sejak dini hari untuk adegan matahari terbit.
w|dini.en: Siti had to get made up from the early hours for the sunrise scene.
w|dini.ko: 해돋이 장면 때문에 시티는 새벽부터 분장을 해야 했어요.

w|dinosaurus.text: Anak-anak membangun patung dinosaurus dari pasir di dekat Eko.
w|dinosaurus.en: The children built a sand dinosaur near Eko.
w|dinosaurus.ko: 아이들이 에코 근처에서 모래로 공룡 조각을 만들었어요.

w|dinosaurus.text: Ayu menghadiahi anak tetangga buku bergambar tentang dinosaurus.
w|dinosaurus.en: Ayu gave the neighbor's child a picture book about dinosaurs.
w|dinosaurus.ko: 아유는 이웃 아이에게 공룡 그림책을 선물했어요.

w|diperbolehkan.text: Pengunjung diperbolehkan masuk setelah jam buka.
w|diperbolehkan.en: Visitors are allowed in after opening time.
w|diperbolehkan.ko: 방문객은 개장 후에 들어갈 수 있어.

w|diperbolehkan.text: Anak-anak tidak diperbolehkan bermain di sini.
w|diperbolehkan.en: Children are not allowed to play here.

w|dirawat.text: Teman Agus sempat dirawat di puskesmas karena keracunan makanan.
w|dirawat.en: Agus's friend was briefly treated at the community clinic for food poisoning.
w|dirawat.ko: 아구스의 친구는 식중독으로 보건소에서 잠깐 치료를 받았어요.

w|dirawat.text: Rekan kerja Wati sedang dirawat di rumah sakit, jadi Wati menggantikan jadwalnya.
w|dirawat.en: Wati's coworker is in the hospital, so Wati is covering her shifts.
w|dirawat.ko: 와티의 동료가 입원해 있어서 와티가 대신 근무하고 있어요.

w|direktur.text: Direktur memanggil seluruh staf ke ruang rapat.
w|direktur.en: The director called all staff to the meeting room.

w|direktur.text: Dia baru saja diangkat menjadi direktur.

w|disengaja.text: Polisi masih menyelidiki apakah kebakaran pasar itu disengaja atau tidak.
w|disengaja.en: The police are still investigating whether the market fire was deliberate.
w|disengaja.ko: 경찰은 시장 화재가 고의였는지 아직 조사하고 있어요.

w|disengaja.text: Intan menegaskan bahwa bug itu tidak disengaja dan langsung diperbaiki.
w|disengaja.en: Intan made it clear that the bug wasn't intentional and was fixed right away.
w|disengaja.ko: 인탄은 그 버그가 고의가 아니었고 바로 고쳤다고 분명히 했어요.

w|disiplin.text: Pelatih pramuka sangat menekankan disiplin waktu.
w|disiplin.en: The scout leader puts a strong emphasis on punctuality.
w|disiplin.ko: 스카우트 지도자는 시간 규율을 아주 강조해요.

w|disiplin.text: Siti berterima kasih kepada guru yang dulu mengajarinya disiplin belajar.
w|disiplin.en: Siti thanked the teacher who once taught her study discipline.
w|disiplin.ko: 시티는 예전에 공부하는 습관을 길러 준 선생님께 감사 인사를 했어요.

w|disitu.en: There is an empty seat over there.

w|disitu.text: Kami menunggu disitu sampai hujan reda.
w|disitu.en: We waited over there until the rain stopped.
w|disitu.ko: 비가 그칠 때까지 우리는 저기서 기다렸어.

w|diskon.text: Menjelang sore, banyak pedagang memberi diskon supaya barangnya cepat habis.
w|diskon.en: Toward evening, many traders give discounts so their goods sell out quickly.
w|diskon.ko: 오후 늦게가 되면 많은 상인들이 물건을 빨리 팔려고 할인을 해 줘요.

w|diskon.text: Intan mendapat diskon besar karena memesan katering jauh-jauh hari.
w|diskon.en: Intan got a big discount because she booked the catering well in advance.
w|diskon.ko: 인탄은 케이터링을 일찍 예약해서 크게 할인받았어요.

w|distrik.text: Pengadilan distrik itu menangani ratusan perkara setiap tahun.
w|distrik.en: That district court handles hundreds of cases every year.
w|distrik.ko: 그 지방 법원은 해마다 수백 건의 사건을 처리해요.

w|distrik.text: Pemasok dari distrik sebelah datang mengantar telur dua kali seminggu.
w|distrik.en: A supplier from the next district comes to deliver eggs twice a week.
w|distrik.ko: 옆 지역 납품업자가 일주일에 두 번 달걀을 배달하러 와요.

w|ditakdirkan.text: Kisah itu seolah ditakdirkan berakhir bahagia.
w|ditakdirkan.en: That story seems destined to end happily.
w|ditakdirkan.ko: 그 이야기는 행복하게 끝나도록 운명인 듯해.

w|diundang.text: Kami diundang ke pernikahan teman lama.
w|diundang.en: We were invited to an old friend's wedding.

w|diundang.text: Dia diundang berbicara di konferensi itu.
w|diundang.en: He was invited to speak at that conference.

w|divisi.en: The sales division hit the monthly target.

w|divisi.text: Dia pindah ke divisi baru minggu ini.
w|divisi.en: She moved to a new division this week.
w|divisi.ko: 그녀는 이번 주에 새 부서로 옮겼어.

w|doa.text: Ibunya mengirim doa sebelum dia berangkat.
w|doa.en: His mother sent a prayer before he left.
w|doa.ko: 어머니가 그가 떠나기 전에 기도를 보냈어.

w|doa.en: That short prayer calmed her heart.
w|doa.ko: 그 짧은 기도가 마음을 가라앉혀 주었어.

w|dokter.en: I have to see a doctor.

w|doktor.text: Salah satu pelanggan tetap restoran itu seorang doktor ekonomi yang selalu memesan sup buntut.
w|doktor.en: One of the restaurant's regulars is a doctor of economics who always orders oxtail soup.
w|doktor.ko: 그 식당 단골 중 한 명은 늘 꼬리곰탕을 시키는 경제학 박사예요.

w|doktor.text: Di lapak jas bekas, Lestari menemukan toga doktor yang masih rapi.
w|doktor.en: At the used-suit stall, Lestari found a doctoral gown still in good shape.
w|doktor.ko: 중고 양복 노점에서 레스타리는 아직 깔끔한 박사 가운을 찾았어요.

w|dokumen.text: Dokumen itu hilang di meja kerja.
w|dokumen.en: That document went missing on the desk.

w|dokumen.text: Tolong simpan dokumen di folder aman.
w|dokumen.en: Please keep the document in a safe folder.
w|dokumen.ko: 그 문서를 안전한 폴더에 보관해 줘.

w|dolar.en: The price is a hundred dollars.

w|domba.text: Domba itu makan rumput di padang.
w|domba.en: That sheep is eating grass in the field.
w|domba.ko: 그 양이 들판에서 풀을 먹고 있어.

w|domba.en: The farmer cares for a flock of sheep.

w|dompet.text: Dia lupa membawa dompet ke kantor.
w|dompet.en: He forgot to bring his wallet to the office.
w|dompet.ko: 그는 지갑을 사무실에 가져가는 걸 잊었어.

w|dompet.text: Dompet hitam itu jatuh di bawah kursi.
w|dompet.en: That black wallet fell under the chair.
w|dompet.ko: 그 검은 지갑이 의자 아래로 떨어졌어.

w|donat.text: Andi menaburkan gula halus di atas donat yang masih hangat.
w|donat.en: Andi sprinkled powdered sugar on the still-warm doughnuts.
w|donat.ko: 안디는 아직 따뜻한 도넛 위에 슈가파우더를 뿌렸어요.

w|donat.text: Rani bercerita bahwa toko donat langganan mereka sudah tutup.
w|donat.en: Rani wrote that their favorite doughnut shop has closed.
w|donat.ko: 라니는 둘이 자주 가던 도넛 가게가 문을 닫았다고 했어요.

w|dong.text: Ceritakan saja dong apa yang terjadi.
w|dong.en: Just tell me what happened, okay?

w|dongeng.en: Grandma reads a fairy tale before bedtime.
w|dongeng.ko: 할머니가 자기 전에 동화를 읽어 줘.

w|dongeng.text: Dongeng itu mengajarkan kejujuran kepada anak.
w|dongeng.en: That fairy tale teaches honesty to children.

w|dorongan.text: Berkat dorongan redakturnya, Eko berani menulis kolom opini pertamanya.
w|dorongan.en: Thanks to his editor's encouragement, Eko dared to write his first opinion column.
w|dorongan.ko: 편집장의 격려 덕분에 에코는 첫 칼럼을 쓸 용기를 냈어요.

w|dorongan.text: Ayu membuka toko sendiri berkat dorongan ayahnya.
w|dorongan.en: Ayu opened her own shop thanks to her father's encouragement.
w|dorongan.ko: 아유는 아버지의 응원 덕분에 자기 가게를 열었어요.

w|dosa.en: He feels he carries a great sin.
w|dosa.ko: 그는 큰 죄를 지고 있다고 느껴.

w|dosis.text: Dimas menghitung dosis obat berdasarkan berat badan kelinci itu.
w|dosis.en: Dimas calculated the dose of medicine based on the rabbit's weight.
w|dosis.ko: 디마스는 토끼 몸무게에 맞춰 약 용량을 계산했어요.

w|dosis.text: Tim Putri mencoba dosis yang lebih rendah pada percobaan berikutnya.
w|dosis.en: Putri's team tried a lower dose in the next experiment.
w|dosis.ko: 푸트리 팀은 다음 실험에서 더 낮은 용량을 시도했어요.

w|drama.en: They watched a Korean drama together.

w|dramatis.text: Adegan terakhir sangat dramatis sampai banyak penonton menangis.
w|dramatis.en: The final scene was so dramatic that many in the audience cried.
w|dramatis.ko: 마지막 장면이 너무 극적이어서 많은 관객이 울었어요.

w|dramatis.text: Penjualan kuartal ini naik secara dramatis berkat ide Intan.
w|dramatis.en: Sales this quarter rose dramatically thanks to Intan's idea.
w|dramatis.ko: 인탄의 아이디어 덕분에 이번 분기 매출이 크게 뛰었어요.

w|drum.text: Andi menabuh drum di band sekolah saat pentas seni.
w|drum.en: Andi plays the drums in the school band at the arts show.
w|drum.ko: 안디는 예술제에서 학교 밴드의 드럼을 쳐요.

w|drum.text: Suara drum dari pawai di luar terdengar sampai ke bangsal.
w|drum.en: The sound of drums from the parade outside could be heard all the way to the ward.
w|drum.ko: 밖에서 열린 행진의 북소리가 병동까지 들렸어요.

w|dugaan.en: The police's initial suspicion turned out wrong.

w|dugaan.text: Menurut dugaan saya, dia akan terlambat.
w|dugaan.en: According to my guess, he will be late.

w|duit.text: Bayu bercanda bahwa duit di dompetnya selalu habis setiap kali ke pasar loak.
w|duit.en: Bayu joked that the cash in his wallet always runs out every time he goes to the flea market.
w|duit.ko: 바유는 벼룩시장에 갈 때마다 지갑 속 돈이 늘 바닥난다고 농담했어요.

w|duit.text: Tante Intan bilang tidak perlu repot, cukup kasih duit saja di amplop.
w|duit.en: Intan's aunt said there was no need to fuss; just put some cash in an envelope.
w|duit.ko: 인탄의 이모는 번거롭게 할 것 없이 봉투에 돈만 넣으면 된다고 했어요.

w|dukun.text: Nenek Fajar bercerita bahwa dulu orang sering bertanya pada dukun soal hari baik untuk menikah.
w|dukun.en: Fajar's grandmother says people used to ask a shaman about lucky days to marry.
w|dukun.ko: 파자르의 할머니는 옛날엔 결혼하기 좋은 날을 무당에게 묻곤 했다고 해요.

w|dukun.text: Dalam cerita rakyat, seorang dukun memanggil hujan setelah kemarau panjang.
w|dukun.en: In a folk tale, a shaman summons rain after a long drought.
w|dukun.ko: 민담에서 무당이 긴 가뭄 끝에 비를 불러요.

w|dukungan.ko: 가족의 지원이 그를 더 강하게 만들었어.

w|dukungan.text: Kami memberi dukungan penuh kepada tim.
w|dukungan.en: We give full support to the team.

w|duluan.text: Kamu duluan saja; aku menyusul nanti.
w|duluan.en: You go first; I'll follow later.
w|duluan.ko: 너 먼저 가; 나는 나중에 따라갈게.

w|duluan.text: Duluan dia sudah sampai di sana.

w|dungu.text: Dalam pidatonya, Fajar bercanda bahwa dulu ia merasa dungu setiap kali bicara dengan Rina.
w|dungu.en: In his speech, Fajar joked that he used to feel foolish every time he spoke to Rina.
w|dungu.ko: 파자르는 연설에서 예전엔 리나와 말할 때마다 바보가 된 기분이었다고 농담했어요.

w|dungu.text: Lestari merasa dungu karena lupa membawa payung di tengah musim hujan.
w|dungu.en: Lestari felt foolish for forgetting her umbrella in the middle of the rainy season.
w|dungu.ko: 레스타리는 한창 우기에 우산을 깜빡해서 바보가 된 기분이었어요.

w|duta.text: Sekolah Eko dikunjungi seorang duta besar yang bercerita tentang pekerjaannya.
w|duta.en: Eko's school was visited by an ambassador who talked about his work.
w|duta.ko: 에코네 학교에 대사 한 분이 와서 자기 일에 대해 이야기했어요.

w|duta.text: Waktu libur, Ayu menonton berita tentang duta lingkungan dari kampusnya.
w|duta.en: During the holiday, Ayu watched a news report about an environmental ambassador from her campus.
w|duta.ko: 방학 동안 아유는 자기 대학 출신 환경 홍보대사에 관한 뉴스를 봤어요.

w|efek.text: Obat itu punya efek samping ringan.
w|efek.en: That medicine has a mild side effect.

w|efek.text: Efek cahaya membuat foto lebih dramatis.
w|efek.en: The lighting effect makes the photo more dramatic.
w|efek.ko: 빛 효과가 사진을 더 극적으로 만들어.

w|efektif.text: Patroli malam terbukti efektif mengurangi pencurian di kampung Andi.
w|efektif.en: Night patrols have proven effective at reducing theft in Andi's neighborhood.
w|efektif.ko: 야간 순찰은 안디네 동네 도난을 줄이는 데 효과가 있었어요.

w|efektif.text: Pertahanan zona ternyata efektif menahan pemain tinggi lawan.
w|efektif.en: The zone defense turned out to be effective at stopping the opponent's tall players.
w|efektif.ko: 지역 방어가 상대 장신 선수를 막는 데 효과적이었어요.

w|efisien.text: Alat pengaduk semen yang baru jauh lebih efisien daripada yang lama.
w|efisien.en: The new cement mixer is much more efficient than the old one.
w|efisien.ko: 새 시멘트 믹서는 옛것보다 훨씬 효율적이에요.

w|efisien.text: Wati merasa belanja kebutuhan dapur secara daring lebih efisien daripada ke pasar.
w|efisien.en: Wati feels that buying kitchen supplies online is more efficient than going to the market.
w|efisien.ko: 와티는 부엌 살림을 온라인으로 사는 게 시장에 가는 것보다 효율적이라고 느껴요.

w|egois.text: Egois sekali kalau hanya memikirkan diri sendiri.
w|egois.en: It is so selfish to only think of yourself.

w|ekonomi.text: Ekonomi negara itu tumbuh stabil tahun ini.
w|ekonomi.en: That country's economy grew steadily this year.
w|ekonomi.ko: 그 나라 경제는 올해 안정적으로 성장했어.

w|ekonomi.text: Dia kuliah jurusan ekonomi di universitas.
w|ekonomi.en: She majors in economics at the university.

w|ekor.text: Kucing itu mengibas ekor dengan cepat.
w|ekor.en: That cat flicked its tail quickly.

w|ekor.text: Ekor ikan itu berwarna oranye cerah.
w|ekor.en: That fish's tail is bright orange.

w|eksekutif.text: Malam ini rombongan eksekutif bank memesan meja panjang di restoran tempat Fajar bekerja.
w|eksekutif.en: Tonight a group of bank executives booked a long table at the restaurant where Fajar works.
w|eksekutif.ko: 오늘 밤 은행 임원들이 파자르가 일하는 식당에 긴 테이블을 예약했어요.

w|eksekutif.text: Tas kulit yang dibeli Lestari tampaknya dulu milik seorang eksekutif.
w|eksekutif.en: The leather bag Lestari bought seems to have once belonged to an executive.
w|eksekutif.ko: 레스타리가 산 가죽 가방은 예전에 어느 임원의 것이었던 것 같아요.

w|eksklusif.text: Budi mengirim undangan eksklusif ke pameran lukisannya untuk Andi.
w|eksklusif.en: Budi sends Andi an exclusive invitation to his painting exhibition.
w|eksklusif.ko: 부디는 안디에게 자기 그림 전시회 특별 초대장을 보내요.

w|eksklusif.text: Pelari elite mendapat ruang istirahat eksklusif di dekat garis akhir.
w|eksklusif.en: Elite runners get an exclusive rest area near the finish line.
w|eksklusif.ko: 엘리트 주자들은 결승선 근처에 전용 휴게 공간을 받아요.

w|eksperimen.text: Ahli forensik menjelaskan hasil eksperimen yang dilakukan di laboratorium.
w|eksperimen.en: The forensic expert explained the results of the experiment carried out in the lab.
w|eksperimen.ko: 법의학 전문가가 실험실에서 한 실험 결과를 설명했어요.

w|eksperimen.text: Anak Lestari membeli cuka dan soda kue untuk eksperimen di sekolah.
w|eksperimen.en: Lestari's child bought vinegar and baking soda for an experiment at school.
w|eksperimen.ko: 레스타리의 아이는 학교 실험에 쓸 식초와 베이킹소다를 샀어요.

w|ekspresi.text: Sutradara meminta Bayu memperbaiki ekspresi wajahnya di adegan sedih.
w|ekspresi.en: The director asked Bayu to work on his facial expression in the sad scene.
w|ekspresi.ko: 연출가는 바유에게 슬픈 장면에서 표정을 고치라고 했어요.

w|ekspresi.text: Dari ekspresi bosnya, Intan tahu rapat itu tidak berjalan lancar.
w|ekspresi.en: From her boss's expression, Intan knew the meeting hadn't gone well.
w|ekspresi.ko: 인탄은 상사의 표정을 보고 회의가 잘 안 풀렸다는 걸 알았어요.

w|ekstra.text: Menjelang tahun baru, polisi menambah penjagaan ekstra di jalan utama.
w|ekstra.en: Ahead of New Year, the police add extra guards on the main road.
w|ekstra.ko: 새해를 앞두고 경찰은 큰길에 경비를 더 세워요.

w|ekstra.text: Menjelang final, Dewi berlatih ekstra pada malam hari.
w|ekstra.en: Ahead of the final, Dewi does extra practice at night.
w|ekstra.ko: 결승을 앞두고 데위는 밤에 추가 훈련을 해요.

w|elang.text: Seekor elang terbang rendah mencari anak ayam di halaman Dimas.
w|elang.en: An eagle flew low looking for chicks in Dimas's yard.
w|elang.ko: 독수리 한 마리가 디마스네 마당에서 병아리를 찾으며 낮게 날았어요.

w|elang.text: Saat istirahat, Putri menonton video elang menangkap ikan.
w|elang.en: During her break, Putri watched a video of an eagle catching fish.
w|elang.ko: 쉬는 시간에 푸트리는 독수리가 물고기를 잡는 영상을 봤어요.

w|elegan.text: Kostum ratu dalam drama itu terlihat sangat elegan di bawah lampu panggung.
w|elegan.en: The queen's costume in the play looked very elegant under the stage lights.
w|elegan.ko: 그 연극의 여왕 의상은 무대 조명 아래에서 아주 우아해 보였어요.

w|elegan.text: Ayu menata etalase dengan rapi agar tokonya terlihat sedikit lebih elegan.
w|elegan.en: Ayu arranges the display case neatly so her shop looks a bit more elegant.
w|elegan.ko: 아유는 가게가 조금 더 고급스러워 보이도록 진열장을 깔끔하게 정리해요.

w|elektronik.text: Musik pengiring drama itu dimainkan dengan alat musik elektronik.
w|elektronik.en: The play's accompanying music was performed on electronic instruments.
w|elektronik.ko: 그 연극의 반주는 전자 악기로 연주됐어요.

w|elektronik.text: Kantor Intan sekarang memakai tanda tangan elektronik untuk semua kontrak.
w|elektronik.en: Intan's office now uses electronic signatures for all contracts.
w|elektronik.ko: 인탄의 회사는 이제 모든 계약에 전자 서명을 써요.

w|elemen.text: Dimas mencari buku kimia tentang tabel elemen untuk tugas sekolah.
w|elemen.en: Dimas looked for a chemistry book about the table of elements for a school assignment.
w|elemen.ko: 디마스는 학교 숙제로 원소 주기율표에 관한 화학책을 찾았어요.

w|elemen.text: Lampu kereta mati karena salah satu elemen pemanas di gerbong terbakar.
w|elemen.en: The train lights went out because one of the heating elements in the carriage burned out.
w|elemen.ko: 객차의 전열 소자 하나가 타는 바람에 기차 불이 꺼졌어요.

w|elite.text: Bayu menulis tentang perumahan mewah yang hanya bisa dibeli kaum elite.
w|elite.en: Bayu wrote about luxury housing that only the elite can afford.
w|elite.ko: 바유는 상류층만 살 수 있는 고급 주택단지에 대해 썼어요.

w|elite.text: Intan tidak mau aplikasinya hanya dipakai kalangan elite di kota besar.
w|elite.en: Intan doesn't want her app to be used only by the elite in big cities.
w|elite.ko: 인탄은 자기 앱을 대도시 상류층만 쓰는 걸 원하지 않아요.

w|email.text: Saya mengirim email konfirmasi tadi pagi.
w|email.en: I sent a confirmation email this morning.
w|email.ko: 나는 오늘 아침 확인 이메일을 보냈어.

w|email.text: Email penting itu masuk ke folder spam.
w|email.en: That important email went into the spam folder.
w|email.ko: 그 중요한 이메일이 스팸 폴더로 들어갔어.

w|emas.en: That ring is made of gold.
The price of gold went up again.

w|ember.text: Saat hujan, Andi menaruh ember di bawah atap yang bocor.
w|ember.en: When it rains, Andi puts a bucket under the leaking roof.
w|ember.ko: 비가 오면 안디는 새는 지붕 아래에 양동이를 받쳐 둬요.

w|ember.text: Seorang ibu di peron membawa ember berisi ikan segar.
w|ember.en: A woman on the platform carries a bucket of fresh fish.
w|ember.ko: 승강장의 한 아주머니가 싱싱한 생선이 든 양동이를 들고 있어요.

w|emosi.en: He finds it hard to control his emotions.
Strong emotion showed on her face.

w|emosional.text: Pidato itu sangat emosional bagi para hadirin.
w|emosional.en: That speech was very emotional for the audience.

w|emosional.text: Dia menjadi emosional saat membaca surat itu.
w|emosional.en: She became emotional while reading that letter.
w|emosional.ko: 그는 그 편지를 읽으며 감정적이 됐어.

w|enam.text: Ada enam kursi di ruangan itu.
w|enam.en: There are six chairs in that room.
w|enam.ko: 그 방에는 의자 여섯 개가 있어.

w|enam.text: Enam orang sudah menunggu di luar.
w|enam.en: Six people are already waiting outside.
w|enam.ko: 여섯 명이 이미 밖에서 기다리고 있어.

w|energi.text: Energi matahari bisa menghemat biaya listrik.
w|energi.en: Solar energy can save on electricity costs.
w|energi.ko: 태양 에너지로 전기세를 아낄 수 있어.

w|energi.text: Dia kehabisan energi setelah berlari jauh.
w|energi.en: He ran out of energy after running far.
w|energi.ko: 멀리 달린 뒤 그는 기운이 다 빠졌어.

w|engkau.text: Aku percaya engkau bisa menyelesaikan ini.
w|engkau.en: I believe you can finish this.
w|engkau.ko: 난 네가 이걸 해낼 수 있다고 믿어.

w|entah.en: I don't know why I'm sad.

w|enyah.text: Enyah dari sini sebelum masalah bertambah.
w|enyah.en: Get out of here before the problem grows.

w|enyah.text: Dia menyuruh burung itu enyah dari jendela.
w|enyah.en: She told the bird to go away from the window.
w|enyah.ko: 그는 새에게 창에서 저리 가라고 했어.

w|episode.text: Episode baru akan tayang malam ini.
w|episode.en: A new episode will air tonight.
I've already watched the last episode.

w|era.text: Kakek Budi bilang di era mudanya musim hujan datang lebih tepat waktu.
w|era.en: Budi's grandfather says that in his youth the rainy season came more on time.
w|era.ko: 부디의 할아버지는 젊었을 때는 우기가 더 제때 왔다고 해요.

w|era.text: Film itu bercerita tentang keluarga di era tahun tujuh puluhan.
w|era.en: The film tells the story of a family in the seventies era.
w|era.ko: 그 영화는 칠십 년대 시대의 한 가족 이야기를 담고 있어요.

w|erat.text: Dimas memegang erat buku langka itu supaya tidak jatuh.
w|erat.en: Dimas held the rare book tightly so it wouldn't fall.
w|erat.ko: 디마스는 그 희귀본이 떨어지지 않게 꼭 붙잡았어요.

w|erat.text: Putri memeluk erat ibunya sebelum naik ke gerbong.
w|erat.en: Putri hugged her mother tightly before boarding the carriage.
w|erat.ko: 푸트리는 기차에 오르기 전에 엄마를 꼭 안았어요.

w|eropa.text: Eropa menarik banyak wisatawan setiap musim.
w|eropa.en: Europe attracts many tourists every season.

w|eropa.text: Dia belajar sejarah eropa di kampus.
w|eropa.en: She studies European history on campus.

w|es.en: The ice on the road has melted.

w|esok.text: Kata ramalan cuaca, esok pagi akan berkabut di daerah Budi.
w|esok.en: According to the forecast, tomorrow morning will be foggy in Budi's area.
w|esok.ko: 일기 예보에 따르면 내일 아침 부디네 지역에 안개가 낀대요.

w|esok.text: Sutradara bilang adegan di pasar akan diambil esok hari.
w|esok.en: The director said the market scene would be shot tomorrow.
w|esok.ko: 감독은 시장 장면을 내일 찍을 거라고 했어요.

w|etika.text: Eko mengajarkan etika panggung kepada pemain baru, misalnya datang tepat waktu.
w|etika.en: Eko teaches stage etiquette to new actors, such as arriving on time.
w|etika.ko: 에코는 신인 배우들에게 시간 지키기 같은 무대 예절을 가르쳐요.

w|etika.text: Para pemandu gunung punya etika untuk tidak meninggalkan sampah di jalur pendakian.
w|etika.en: Mountain guides have an ethic of not leaving trash on hiking trails.
w|etika.ko: 산악 가이드들은 등산로에 쓰레기를 남기지 않는다는 윤리가 있어요.

w|evakuasi.text: Polisi memimpin evakuasi warga ketika sungai di dekat kantor meluap.
w|evakuasi.en: The police led the evacuation of residents when the river near the station overflowed.
w|evakuasi.ko: 경찰서 근처 강이 넘쳤을 때 경찰이 주민 대피를 이끌었어요.

w|evakuasi.text: Pertandingan dihentikan dan penonton menjalani evakuasi karena alarm kebakaran berbunyi.
w|evakuasi.en: The match was stopped and spectators were evacuated because the fire alarm went off.
w|evakuasi.ko: 화재경보가 울려서 경기가 중단되고 관중이 대피했어요.

w|fajar.text: Fajar merah mewarnai langit pagi itu.
w|fajar.en: A red dawn colored the morning sky.
w|fajar.ko: 붉은 새벽이 그날 아침 하늘을 물들였어.

w|fakta.text: Itu fakta yang tidak bisa dibantah.
w|fakta.en: That's a fact that can't be denied.

w|faktor.text: Menurut Agus, cuaca adalah faktor terbesar yang memperlambat pekerjaan di lapangan.
w|faktor.en: According to Agus, the weather is the biggest factor slowing down work on site.
w|faktor.ko: 아구스 말로는 날씨가 현장 작업을 늦추는 가장 큰 요인이에요.

w|faktor.text: Harga yang murah bukan satu-satunya faktor yang dipertimbangkan Wati.
w|faktor.en: A low price isn't the only factor Wati considers.
w|faktor.ko: 싼 가격만 와티가 고려하는 요인은 아니에요.

w|fantasi.text: Cerpen Budi penuh fantasi tentang naga dan kerajaan di bawah laut.
w|fantasi.en: Budi's short story is full of fantasy about dragons and an undersea kingdom.
w|fantasi.ko: 부디의 단편 소설은 용과 바닷속 왕국에 관한 판타지로 가득해요.

w|fantasi.text: Siti bilang cita-citanya dulu menjadi astronaut hanyalah fantasi anak kecil.
w|fantasi.en: Siti said her old dream of becoming an astronaut was just a child's fantasy.
w|fantasi.ko: 시티는 어릴 때 우주 비행사가 되겠다던 꿈은 그냥 아이의 공상이었다고 했어요.

w|fantastis.en: The view from the summit is fantastic.
Their performance last night was fantastic.

w|fasilitas.en: This hotel's facilities are very complete.
w|fasilitas.ko: 이 호텔 시설이 아주 잘 갖춰져 있어.

w|fasilitas.en: The school added new sports facilities.

w|favorit.text: Restoran favorit kami tutup hari ini.
w|favorit.en: Our favorite restaurant is closed today.

w|februari.text: Biasanya angin kencang mulai mereda pada akhir bulan Februari.
w|februari.en: The strong winds usually start to die down at the end of February.
w|februari.ko: 강한 바람은 보통 이월 말이면 잦아들기 시작해요.

w|februari.text: Tukang kayu berjanji menyelesaikan tangga baru sebelum akhir Februari.
w|februari.en: The carpenter promised to finish the new staircase before the end of February.
w|februari.ko: 목수는 이월 말 전에 새 계단을 끝내겠다고 약속했어요.

w|federasi.text: Kelompok teater Eko bergabung dengan federasi teater nasional.
w|federasi.en: Eko's theater group joined the national theater federation.
w|federasi.ko: 에코의 극단은 전국 연극 연맹에 가입했어요.

w|federasi.text: Kelompok tani desa itu kini menjadi anggota federasi petani kopi.
w|federasi.en: The village farmers' group is now a member of the coffee farmers' federation.
w|federasi.ko: 그 마을 농민 모임은 이제 커피 농민 연합의 회원이에요.

w|fenomena.text: Pemandu menjelaskan bahwa kabut tebal di pagi hari adalah fenomena biasa di lembah ini.
w|fenomena.en: The guide explained that thick morning fog is a common phenomenon in this valley.
w|fenomena.ko: 가이드는 아침의 짙은 안개가 이 골짜기에서는 흔한 현상이라고 설명했어요.

w|fenomena.text: Para kritikus menyebut popularitas penyanyi muda itu sebagai fenomena tahun ini.
w|fenomena.en: Critics call the young singer's popularity the phenomenon of the year.
w|fenomena.ko: 비평가들은 그 젊은 가수의 인기를 올해의 현상이라고 불러요.

w|festival.text: Festival musik itu menarik banyak pengunjung.
w|festival.en: That music festival attracts many visitors.
w|festival.ko: 그 음악 축제는 많은 방문객을 끌어들여.

w|festival.text: Kami menonton festival lampion di malam hari.
w|festival.en: We watched the lantern festival at night.

w|fiksi.text: Di perpustakaan sekolah, Rudi lebih suka meminjam buku fiksi daripada buku pelajaran.
w|fiksi.en: In the school library, Rudi prefers borrowing fiction to textbooks.
w|fiksi.ko: 학교 도서관에서 루디는 교과서보다 소설책 빌리는 걸 더 좋아해요.

w|fiksi.text: Rina menyumbangkan satu dus buku fiksi ke perpustakaan desa.
w|fiksi.en: Rina donated a box of fiction books to the village library.
w|fiksi.ko: 리나는 소설책 한 상자를 마을 도서관에 기증했어요.

w|film.en: Want to watch a movie tonight?

w|final.text: Tim kami lolos ke babak final.
w|final.en: Our team advanced to the final round.
The match final was broadcast live.

w|firasat.text: Dalam suratnya, Rudi menulis bahwa dia punya firasat buruk sebelum pindah kota.
w|firasat.en: In his letter, Rudi wrote that he had a bad feeling before moving to another city.
w|firasat.ko: 루디는 편지에 다른 도시로 이사하기 전에 불길한 예감이 들었다고 썼어요.

w|firasat.text: Rina punya firasat bahwa aplikasi baru mereka akan laku di kalangan mahasiswa.
w|firasat.en: Rina has a hunch that their new app will be popular among university students.
w|firasat.ko: 리나는 새 앱이 대학생들 사이에서 잘될 거라는 예감이 들어요.

w|fisik.en: That athlete's physique is very strong.

w|fisika.text: Ilmu fisika yang Bayu pelajari di kampus ternyata berguna untuk merawat mesin.
w|fisika.en: The physics Bayu studied at university turned out to be useful for maintaining machines.
w|fisika.ko: 바유가 대학에서 배운 물리학이 기계 정비에 쓸모가 있었어요.

w|fisika.text: Di ruang tunggu, Intan membaca buku fisika untuk persiapan ujian.
w|fisika.en: In the waiting room, Intan read a physics book to prepare for an exam.
w|fisika.ko: 대기실에서 인탄은 시험 준비로 물리학 책을 읽었어요.

w|flu.text: Agus sempat menunda jadwal periksa karena terkena flu.
w|flu.en: Agus postponed his appointment because he caught the flu.
w|flu.ko: 아구스는 독감에 걸려서 진료 날짜를 미뤘어요.

w|flu.text: Gara-gara tidur di rumah yang belum berjendela, Wati terserang flu.
w|flu.en: Because she slept in the house before it had windows, Wati came down with the flu.
w|flu.ko: 창문도 없는 집에서 자는 바람에 와티는 독감에 걸렸어요.

w|fokus.en: He lost focus for a moment.

w|forensik.text: Museum polisi punya ruang yang menjelaskan cara kerja tim forensik.
w|forensik.en: The police museum has a room that explains how forensic teams work.
w|forensik.ko: 경찰 박물관에는 법의학 팀이 어떻게 일하는지 설명하는 방이 있어요.

w|forensik.text: Penjual koran di pasar senang mengobrol dengan Rina soal sinetron forensik kesukaannya.
w|forensik.en: The newspaper seller at the market enjoys chatting with Rina about his favorite forensic drama.
w|forensik.ko: 시장 신문 장수는 즐겨 보는 법의학 드라마 이야기를 리나와 나누길 좋아해요.

w|formasi.text: Pelatih menyuruh Rudi berdiri di belakang dalam formasi barisan upacara.
w|formasi.en: The coach told Rudi to stand at the back of the ceremony line formation.
w|formasi.ko: 코치는 루디에게 행사 대열에서 뒤에 서라고 했어요.

w|formasi.text: Para pengangkut menyusun kardus Rina dalam formasi rapi di dalam truk.
w|formasi.en: The movers stacked Rina's boxes in a neat formation inside the truck.
w|formasi.ko: 이삿짐센터 직원들이 리나의 상자들을 트럭 안에 가지런히 쌓았어요.

w|formulir.text: Sebelum mulai kerja, Fajar mengisi formulir data karyawan di kantor manajer.
w|formulir.en: Before starting work, Fajar filled out an employee data form in the manager's office.
w|formulir.ko: 일을 시작하기 전에 파자르는 매니저 사무실에서 직원 정보 양식을 작성했어요.

w|formulir.text: Untuk membuka lapak, Lestari harus mengisi formulir pendaftaran dari panitia.
w|formulir.en: To open a stall, Lestari has to fill out a registration form from the organizers.
w|formulir.ko: 노점을 열려면 레스타리는 주최 측의 신청서를 작성해야 해요.

w|fosil.text: Eko menemukan fosil kerang di batu kapur dekat air terjun.
w|fosil.en: Eko found a shell fossil in the limestone near the waterfall.
w|fosil.ko: 에코는 폭포 옆 석회암에서 조개 화석을 발견했어요.

w|fosil.text: Medali maraton tahun ini berbentuk fosil ikan purba dari daerah setempat.
w|fosil.en: This year's marathon medal is shaped like a fossil of an ancient local fish.
w|fosil.ko: 올해 마라톤 메달은 그 지역 고대 물고기 화석 모양이에요.

w|foto.en: Our vacation photo is really nice.

w|fotografer.text: Seorang fotografer memotret proses produksi untuk katalog baru.
w|fotografer.en: A photographer took pictures of the production process for the new catalog.
w|fotografer.ko: 한 사진작가가 새 카탈로그에 쓸 생산 과정을 찍었어요.

w|fotografer.text: Kakak Sari dulu jadi fotografer di acara wisuda mereka.
w|fotografer.en: Sari's older sibling was the photographer at their graduation.
w|fotografer.ko: 사리의 언니는 둘의 졸업식에서 사진사를 맡았어요.

w|frekuensi.text: Radio balai kota mengudara pada frekuensi yang bisa didengar seluruh kota.
w|frekuensi.en: The city hall radio broadcasts on a frequency that can be heard across the whole city.
w|frekuensi.ko: 시청 라디오는 도시 전체에서 들을 수 있는 주파수로 방송해요.

w|frekuensi.text: Guru fisika musik menjelaskan bahwa nada tinggi punya frekuensi lebih besar.
w|frekuensi.en: The music physics teacher explained that high notes have a higher frequency.
w|frekuensi.ko: 음향 물리 선생님은 높은 음일수록 진동수가 크다고 설명했어요.

w|frustrasi.text: Rudi merasa frustrasi karena kakaknya terus memotong penjelasannya.
w|frustrasi.en: Rudi felt frustrated because his sister kept cutting off his explanation.
w|frustrasi.ko: 누나가 계속 말을 끊어서 루디는 답답했어요.

w|frustrasi.text: Rina mulai frustrasi karena layang-layangnya terus jatuh ke pasir.
w|frustrasi.en: Rina started getting frustrated because her kite kept falling onto the sand.
w|frustrasi.ko: 연이 자꾸 모래에 떨어져서 리나는 답답해지기 시작했어요.

w|fungsi.text: Fajar menjelaskan fungsi saksi ahli kepada kliennya.
w|fungsi.en: Fajar explained the role of an expert witness to his client.
w|fungsi.ko: 파자르는 의뢰인에게 전문가 증인의 역할을 설명했어요.

w|fungsi.text: Lestari masih memakai kulkas tua yang fungsi pendinginnya sudah lemah.
w|fungsi.en: Lestari still uses an old fridge whose cooling function is already weak.
w|fungsi.ko: 레스타리는 냉각 기능이 약해진 낡은 냉장고를 아직 써요.

w|gabungan.text: Pabrik itu dikelola oleh gabungan beberapa perusahaan lokal.
w|gabungan.en: The factory is run by a group of several local companies.
w|gabungan.ko: 그 공장은 여러 지역 회사의 연합이 운영해요.

w|hasrat.text: Rina menahan hasrat untuk menambah fitur baru sebelum yang lama stabil.
w|hasrat.en: Rina held back the urge to add new features before the old ones were stable.
w|hasrat.ko: 리나는 기존 기능이 안정되기 전에 새 기능을 넣고 싶은 마음을 참았어요.

w|haus.en: I am thirsty after running a long way.

w|haus.text: Haus akan ilmu membuatnya terus belajar.
w|haus.en: A thirst for knowledge keeps her studying.
w|haus.ko: 지식에 대한 갈증이 그녀를 계속 공부하게 해.

w|hawa.text: Eko tidak menyangka hawa malam di perkemahan bisa sedingin itu.
w|hawa.en: Eko didn't expect the night air at the campsite to be that cold.
w|hawa.ko: 에코는 캠프장의 밤공기가 그렇게 추울 줄 몰랐어요.

w|hawa.text: Ayu memilih berlari pagi agar tidak kepanasan karena hawa siang terlalu terik.
w|hawa.en: Ayu chose to run in the morning to avoid overheating because the midday heat is too fierce.
w|hawa.ko: 한낮 더위가 너무 심해서 아유는 더위 먹지 않으려고 아침에 뛰기로 했어요.

w|helikopter.text: Helikopter terbang rendah di atas kota.
w|helikopter.en: A helicopter flew low over the city.
The victims were evacuated by helicopter.

w|helm.text: Agus menyewa motor dan meminjam helm dari pemilik penginapan.
w|helm.en: Agus rented a motorbike and borrowed a helmet from the guesthouse owner.
w|helm.ko: 아구스는 오토바이를 빌리고 숙소 주인에게 헬멧도 빌렸어요.

w|helm.text: Anak laki-laki itu memilih helm sepeda berwarna merah.
w|helm.en: The boy chose a red bicycle helmet.
w|helm.ko: 그 남자아이는 빨간 자전거 헬멧을 골랐어요.

w|hendak.text: Dia hendak pulang ketika hujan mulai turun.
w|hendak.en: He was about to go home when rain started.
w|hendak.ko: 비가 내리기 시작할 때 그는 집에 가려 했어.

w|hendak.en: Wanting to ask, she raised her hand.

w|heran.en: I was surprised to see the result.

w|heran.text: Heran sekali dia bisa datang cepat.
w|heran.en: It is surprising he could arrive so fast.
w|heran.ko: 그가 그렇게 빨리 올 수 있다니 신기해.

w|hiburan.text: Musik adalah hiburan favoritnya setelah kerja.
w|hiburan.en: Music is her favorite entertainment after work.
w|hiburan.ko: 음악은 퇴근 후 그녀가 가장 좋아하는 오락이야.

w|hidangan.text: Untuk acara pernikahan, Fajar menyiapkan hidangan penutup berupa kue sus.
w|hidangan.en: For a wedding, Fajar prepared cream puffs as dessert.
w|hidangan.ko: 결혼식을 위해 파자르는 디저트로 슈크림을 준비했어요.

w|hidangan.text: Setelah lomba, keluarga Lestari menyiapkan hidangan ayam bakar di rumah.
w|hidangan.en: After the race, Lestari's family prepared a grilled chicken dish at home.
w|hidangan.ko: 대회가 끝나고 레스타리네 가족은 집에서 닭구이 요리를 준비했어요.

w|hidrogen.text: Teman Eko menjelaskan bahwa matahari sebagian besar terdiri dari hidrogen.
w|hidrogen.en: Eko's friend explained that the sun is mostly made of hydrogen.
w|hidrogen.ko: 에코의 친구는 태양이 대부분 수소로 이루어져 있다고 설명했어요.

w|hidrogen.text: Salah satu sponsor lomba adalah perusahaan bus berbahan bakar hidrogen.
w|hidrogen.en: One of the race sponsors is a hydrogen-fueled bus company.
w|hidrogen.ko: 대회 후원사 가운데 하나는 수소 버스 회사예요.

w|hidung.en: His nose is stuffed from a cold.

w|hijau.en: Those tree leaves are fresh green.

w|hingga.en: Until now he still hasn't come.

w|hitungan.text: Menurut hitungan kami, stok masih cukup.
w|hitungan.en: By our count, stock is still enough.

w|hiu.text: Hiu besar berenang di dekat karang.
w|hiu.en: A large shark is swimming near the reef.
The diver saw a shark from afar.

w|hobi.text: Eko punya hobi mengoleksi perangko dari berbagai negara.
w|hobi.en: Eko's hobby is collecting stamps from various countries.
w|hobi.ko: 에코의 취미는 여러 나라 우표를 모으는 거예요.

w|hobi.text: Sejak pensiun, ayah Ayu punya hobi baru, yaitu merawat tanaman hias.
w|hobi.en: Since retiring, Ayu's father has a new hobby: looking after ornamental plants.
w|hobi.ko: 은퇴한 뒤로 아유의 아버지는 관상용 화초 가꾸기라는 새 취미가 생겼어요.

w|hoki.text: Di sekolah Eko, hoki lapangan mulai populer di kalangan murid perempuan.
w|hoki.en: At Eko's school, field hockey is becoming popular among the girls.
w|hoki.ko: 에코의 학교에서는 필드하키가 여학생들 사이에서 인기를 얻고 있어요.

w|hoki.text: Adik Ayu minta dilukiskan pemain hoki es favoritnya.
w|hoki.en: Ayu's brother asked her to paint his favorite ice hockey player.
w|hoki.ko: 아유의 동생은 좋아하는 아이스하키 선수를 그려 달라고 했어요.

w|hore.text: Anak-anak berteriak “hore” waktu Pak Guru bilang ujian ditunda.
w|hore.en: The kids shouted "hooray" when the teacher said the exam was postponed.
w|hore.ko: 선생님이 시험이 미뤄졌다고 하자 아이들이 "만세" 하고 외쳤어요.

w|hore.text: Keponakan Dewi berteriak “hore” waktu kembang api pertama meletus.
w|hore.en: Dewi's nephew shouted "hooray" when the first firework burst.
w|hore.ko: 첫 불꽃이 터지자 데위의 조카가 "만세" 하고 외쳤어요.

w|hormat.text: Hormat kepada orang tua adalah kewajiban.
w|hormat.en: Respect for parents is a duty.
He paid respect to the teacher.

w|hormon.text: Menurut Budi, perubahan hormon membuat kucing betina gelisah saat musim kawin.
w|hormon.en: According to Budi, hormonal changes make female cats restless during mating season.
w|hormon.ko: 부디에 따르면 호르몬 변화 때문에 암고양이는 발정기에 안절부절못해요.

w|hormon.text: Dokter puskesmas bilang suasana hati Siti yang naik turun mungkin karena hormon selama hamil.
w|hormon.en: The health center doctor said Siti's mood swings might be due to hormones during pregnancy.
w|hormon.ko: 보건소 의사는 시티의 기분 변화가 임신 중 호르몬 때문일 수 있다고 했어요.

w|horor.text: Bayu menulis ulasan film horor lokal yang laris di bioskop.
w|horor.en: Bayu wrote a review of a local horror film that's a hit in cinemas.
w|horor.ko: 바유는 극장에서 흥행 중인 국내 공포 영화 리뷰를 썼어요.

w|horor.text: Pada malam Jumat, tim Intan menonton film horor bersama di kantor.
w|horor.en: On Thursday nights, Intan's team watches horror films together at the office.
w|horor.ko: 목요일 밤마다 인탄의 팀은 사무실에서 같이 공포 영화를 봐요.

w|hotel.en: That hotel is near the beach.

w|hukum.en: The law must be enforced fairly.
He studies law at the university.

w|hulu.text: Eko dan teman-temannya mendaki menyusuri sungai sampai ke hulu.
w|hulu.en: Eko and his friends hiked along the river all the way to its source.
w|hulu.ko: 에코와 친구들은 강을 따라 상류까지 올라갔어요.

w|hulu.text: Rute ultra maraton Ayu dimulai dari hulu sungai di kaki gunung.
w|hulu.en: Ayu's ultramarathon route starts from the river's source at the foot of the mountain.
w|hulu.ko: 아유의 울트라마라톤 코스는 산기슭의 강 상류에서 시작해요.

w|huruf.text: Anak itu belajar mengenal huruf Latin.
w|huruf.en: That child is learning Latin letters.
w|huruf.ko: 그 아이는 라틴 글자를 배우고 있어.

w|huruf.en: The first letter of her name is red.

w|hutan.en: That forest is dark and quiet.
They got lost in the forest.

w|hutang.text: Dia melunasi hutang sebelum akhir tahun.
w|hutang.en: He paid off the debt before year-end.
That debt made it hard for him to sleep.

w|ialah.text: Tujuan utama kita ialah belajar bersama.
w|ialah.en: Our main goal is to learn together.
w|ialah.ko: 우리 주된 목표는 함께 배우는 거야.

w|ialah.en: The problem is the lack of communication.

w|ibu kota.text: Perjalanan Dimas dimulai dari stasiun besar di ibu kota.
w|ibu kota.en: Dimas's journey started from the big station in the capital.
w|ibu kota.ko: 디마스의 여행은 수도의 큰 역에서 시작됐어요.

w|ibu kota.text: Perusahaan Putri baru pindah dari Bandung ke ibu kota bulan lalu.
w|ibu kota.en: Putri's company just moved from Bandung to the capital last month.
w|ibu kota.ko: 푸트리의 회사는 지난달 반둥에서 수도로 막 옮겼어요.

w|identitas.en: The victim's identity is still unknown.
Show your identity before entering the building.
w|identitas.ko: 건물에 들어가기 전에 신원을 보여 줘.

w|ikan.en: The fish in the pond are big now.

w|ikat.text: Dia memakai ikat pinggang kulit coklat.
w|ikat.en: He wore a brown leather belt.

w|ikatan.en: Their bond of friendship is very strong.
The family keeps the bond even from afar.

w|iklan.text: Iklan itu muncul di setiap saluran.
w|iklan.en: That ad appears on every channel.

w|iklan.text: Dia mengabaikan iklan di situs web.
w|iklan.en: He ignored the ads on the website.

w|iklim.text: Rudi membawa jaket tebal karena iklim di pegunungan ini sejuk sepanjang tahun.
w|iklim.en: Rudi brought a thick jacket because the climate in these mountains is cool all year.
w|iklim.ko: 이 산악 지대는 일 년 내내 서늘한 기후라서 루디는 두꺼운 재킷을 가져왔어요.

w|iklim.text: Konser itu sekaligus menggalang dana untuk kampanye perubahan iklim.
w|iklim.en: The concert also raised money for a climate change campaign.
w|iklim.ko: 그 공연은 기후 변화 캠페인을 위한 모금도 함께 했어요.

w|ikut.en: She came along to the market earlier.

w|ilahi.text: Lagu penutup drama itu dinyanyikan dengan suasana yang hampir ilahi.
w|ilahi.en: The closing song of the play was sung in an almost divine atmosphere.
w|ilahi.ko: 그 연극의 마지막 노래는 거의 신성한 분위기 속에서 불렸어요.

w|ilahi.text: Nenek pelanggan Ayu percaya rezeki adalah pemberian ilahi.
w|ilahi.en: An elderly customer of Ayu's believes that one's fortune is a divine gift.
w|ilahi.ko: 아유 가게 단골 할머니는 생계가 신이 주신 선물이라고 믿어요.

w|ilegal.en: Those illegal goods were seized by the police.

w|ilmiah.en: That scientific article is hard to understand.

w|ilmu.text: Dia belajar ilmu politik di kampus.
w|ilmu.en: She studies political science at campus.

w|ilmuwan.en: That scientist explained the research results.
Many scientists gathered at the conference.

w|ilusi.text: Guru seni menunjukkan gambar ilusi yang membuat garis lurus tampak bengkok.
w|ilusi.en: The art teacher showed an illusion picture that makes straight lines look bent.
w|ilusi.ko: 미술 선생님은 직선이 휘어 보이는 착시 그림을 보여 줬어요.

w|ilusi.text: Dokter menjelaskan bahwa pasien itu melihat ilusi karena demam tinggi.
w|ilusi.en: The doctor explained that the patient was seeing illusions because of a high fever.
w|ilusi.ko: 의사는 그 환자가 고열 때문에 헛것을 본 거라고 설명했어요.

w|imajinasi.text: Guru bahasa bilang tulisan Eko penuh imajinasi.
w|imajinasi.en: The language teacher said Eko's writing is full of imagination.
w|imajinasi.ko: 국어 선생님은 에코의 글이 상상력으로 가득하다고 했어요.

w|imajinasi.text: Adik Ayu menggambar istana awan dengan imajinasi yang luar biasa.
w|imajinasi.en: Ayu's little sister drew a castle in the clouds with amazing imagination.
w|imajinasi.ko: 아유의 동생은 놀라운 상상력으로 구름 위의 성을 그렸어요.

w|iman.text: Pak Agus bilang, iman yang kuat membantunya tetap sabar menghadapi warga yang marah.
w|iman.en: Mr. Agus said a strong faith helps him stay patient with angry residents.
w|iman.ko: 아구스 경관은 굳은 믿음 덕분에 화난 주민 앞에서도 참을 수 있다고 했어요.

w|iman.text: Sebelum pertandingan, Dewi berdoa agar imannya kuat menghadapi tekanan.
w|iman.en: Before the match, Dewi prays that her faith will stay strong under pressure.
w|iman.ko: 경기 전에 데위는 부담감 속에서도 믿음이 흔들리지 않게 기도해요.

w|imbalan.text: Dia menerima imbalan atas kerja kerasnya.
w|imbalan.en: He received a reward for his hard work.
w|imbalan.ko: 그는 열심히 일한 대가로 보상을 받았어.

w|imbalan.en: The reward offered is quite attractive.

w|impas.text: Setelah tawar-menawar lama, Bayu dan penjual sepakat harganya impas.
w|impas.en: After a long haggle, Bayu and the seller agreed on a price that left them even.
w|impas.ko: 한참 흥정한 끝에 바유와 판매자는 서로 손해 없는 가격에 합의했어요.

w|impas.text: Ayah Intan menghitung bahwa uang dari tamu cukup untuk membuat biaya pesta impas.
w|impas.en: Intan's father calculated that the money from guests was enough to break even on the party.
w|impas.ko: 인탄의 아버지는 손님들 축의금이면 잔치 비용이 본전은 된다고 계산했어요.

w|impian.en: His dream is to become a doctor.

w|imut.text: Anak kecil di barisan depan memakai topi kelinci yang imut.
w|imut.en: The little child in the front row wore a cute bunny hat.
w|imut.ko: 맨 앞줄 꼬마가 귀여운 토끼 모자를 쓰고 있었어요.

w|imut.text: Di meja Intan ada boneka kucing imut hadiah dari keponakannya.
w|imut.en: On Intan's desk there's a cute cat doll, a gift from her niece.
w|imut.ko: 인탄의 책상에는 조카가 선물한 귀여운 고양이 인형이 있어요.

w|inci.text: Layar televisi itu berukuran empat puluh inci.
w|inci.en: That television screen measures forty inches.

w|inci.text: Inci tambahan membuat bingkai terlalu besar.
w|inci.en: The extra inch made the frame too large.
w|inci.ko: 추가 인치 때문에 액자가 너무 커졌어.

w|individu.text: Kata penghulu, setiap individu dalam keluarga ikut menjaga rumah tangga baru itu.
w|individu.en: The officiant said every individual in the family helps look after the new household.
w|individu.ko: 혼인 주례는 가족 한 사람 한 사람이 새 가정을 함께 지켜 준다고 했어요.

w|individu.text: Rina menulis bahwa setiap individu berhak tahu ke mana uang pajaknya dipakai.
w|individu.en: Rina wrote that every individual has the right to know where their tax money goes.
w|individu.ko: 리나는 모든 개인이 세금이 어디에 쓰이는지 알 권리가 있다고 썼어요.

w|indra.text: Menurut Budi, indra penciuman anjing jauh lebih tajam daripada manusia.
w|indra.en: According to Budi, a dog's sense of smell is far sharper than a human's.
w|indra.ko: 부디에 따르면 개의 후각은 사람보다 훨씬 예민해요.

w|indra.text: Udara gunung yang bersih membuat indra penciuman Siti lebih peka.
w|indra.en: The clean mountain air makes Siti's sense of smell sharper.
w|indra.ko: 깨끗한 산 공기 덕분에 시티의 후각이 더 예민해요.

w|induk.text: Anak kucing itu terus mengeong mencari induk yang hilang di kebun sekolah.
w|induk.en: The kitten kept meowing, looking for its mother lost in the school garden.
w|induk.ko: 새끼 고양이가 학교 정원에서 사라진 어미를 찾아 계속 울었어요.

w|induk.text: Rudi sekarang bekerja di perusahaan induk sebuah grup media besar.
w|induk.en: Rudi now works at the parent company of a large media group.
w|induk.ko: 루디는 지금 큰 미디어 그룹의 모회사에서 일해요.

w|industri.text: Industri lokal menyerap banyak tenaga kerja.
w|industri.en: Local industry absorbs a lot of labor.
She works in the food industry.

w|infeksi.text: Dokter gigi bilang infeksi gusi bisa memengaruhi organ lain seperti jantung.
w|infeksi.en: The dentist said a gum infection can affect other organs like the heart.
w|infeksi.ko: 치과 의사는 잇몸 염증이 심장 같은 다른 장기에도 영향을 줄 수 있다고 했어요.

w|infeksi.text: Tangan Wati tergores paku berkarat, jadi dia cepat-cepat membersihkannya agar tidak infeksi.
w|infeksi.en: Wati scratched her hand on a rusty nail, so she cleaned it quickly to avoid infection.
w|infeksi.ko: 와티는 녹슨 못에 손이 긁혀서 덧나지 않게 얼른 소독했어요.

w|info.text: Info penting dikirim lewat pesan singkat.
w|info.en: Important info was sent via short message.

w|info.text: Tolong bagikan info jadwal kepada semua teman.
w|info.en: Please share the schedule info with all friends.
w|info.ko: 일정 정보를 모든 친구에게 공유해 줘.

w|informan.text: Dalam buku sejarah, Eko membaca tentang informan yang membantu para pejuang.
w|informan.en: In the history book, Eko read about an informant who helped the freedom fighters.
w|informan.ko: 에코는 역사책에서 독립투사들을 도운 정보원에 대해 읽었어요.

w|informan.text: Novel yang dibaca Ayu bercerita tentang informan polisi yang menyamar.
w|informan.en: The novel Ayu is reading is about an undercover police informant.
w|informan.ko: 아유가 읽는 소설은 신분을 숨긴 경찰 정보원 이야기예요.

w|informasi.en: That information has been widely shared.

w|ingatan.text: Ingatan tentang masa kecilnya masih jelas.
w|ingatan.en: His memories of childhood are still clear.
w|ingatan.ko: 어린 시절에 대한 기억은 아직 선명해.

w|ingatan.en: That event is etched in his memory.
w|ingatan.ko: 그 사건은 그의 기억에 새겨져 있어.

w|ingin.en: I just want to go home.

w|injil.text: Di rak agama, Andi melihat injil berbahasa Jawa yang dicetak seabad lalu.
w|injil.en: In the religion section, Andi saw a Javanese-language gospel printed a century ago.
w|injil.ko: 종교 책장에서 안디는 백 년 전에 찍은 자바어 복음서를 봤어요.

w|injil.text: Rekan Dewi membaca injil di pantri setiap pagi sebelum mulai kerja.
w|injil.en: Dewi's colleague reads the gospel in the pantry every morning before starting work.
w|injil.ko: 디위의 동료는 매일 아침 일을 시작하기 전에 탕비실에서 복음서를 읽어요.

w|insiden.text: Insiden itu terjadi di dekat stasiun.
w|insiden.en: That incident happened near the station.
The police are investigating yesterday's incident.

w|insinyur.text: Seorang insinyur muda datang memeriksa kekuatan tiang beton.
w|insinyur.en: A young engineer came to check the strength of the concrete pillars.
w|insinyur.ko: 젊은 엔지니어가 콘크리트 기둥의 강도를 점검하러 왔어요.

w|insinyur.text: Meja Rina berada di samping meja seorang insinyur listrik.
w|insinyur.en: Rina's desk is next to an electrical engineer's desk.

w|kakak.en: I'll call my older sibling first.

w|kakek.en: My grandfather lives in the village.

w|kaku.text: Wawancara pertama Eko dengan menteri terasa kaku karena dia gugup.
w|kaku.en: Eko's first interview with the minister felt stiff because he was nervous.
w|kaku.ko: 장관과의 첫 인터뷰는 에코가 긴장해서 딱딱했어요.

w|kaku.text: Tombol volume ponsel tua itu terasa kaku karena kotor.
w|kaku.en: The volume button on the old phone feels stiff because it's dirty.
w|kaku.ko: 그 오래된 휴대폰 음량 버튼은 때가 껴서 뻑뻑해요.

w|kala.text: Kakek Budi suka bercerita tentang kala desa ini masih dikelilingi hutan.
w|kala.en: Budi's grandfather likes talking about the time when this village was still surrounded by forest.
w|kala.ko: 부디의 할아버지는 이 마을이 아직 숲에 둘러싸여 있던 시절 이야기를 즐겨 해요.

w|kala.text: Siti memerankan seorang guru pada kala perang kemerdekaan.
w|kala.en: Siti plays a teacher in the time of the war of independence.
w|kala.ko: 시티는 독립 전쟁 시절의 교사 역할을 맡았어요.

w|kalau.en: If it rains, I'll stay home.
Let me know when you get there.

w|kalender.text: Dimas menandai hari pertama musim hujan di kalender dapur.
w|kalender.en: Dimas marked the first day of the rainy season on the kitchen calendar.
w|kalender.ko: 디마스는 부엌 달력에 우기 첫날을 표시했어요.

w|kalender.text: Putri menemukan kalender tahun lama yang masih tergantung di dapur.
w|kalender.en: Putri found a calendar from years ago still hanging in the kitchen.
w|kalender.ko: 푸트리는 부엌에 아직 걸려 있는 오래전 달력을 발견했어요.

w|kaleng.text: Di gudang ada beberapa kaleng susu kental untuk isian roti.
w|kaleng.en: In the storeroom there are several cans of condensed milk for bread fillings.
w|kaleng.ko: 창고에는 빵 속에 넣을 연유 캔이 몇 개 있어요.

w|kaleng.text: Di pos minum, relawan memberi Lestari minuman isotonik dalam kaleng.
w|kaleng.en: At the drinks station, a volunteer gave Lestari an isotonic drink in a can.
w|kaleng.ko: 급수대에서 자원봉사자가 레스타리에게 캔에 든 이온 음료를 줬어요.

w|kalimat.text: Kalimat itu terlalu panjang untuk dibaca.
w|kalimat.en: That sentence is too long to read.

w|kalimat.text: Guru meminta siswa menulis kalimat sederhana.
w|kalimat.en: The teacher asked students to write a simple sentence.
w|kalimat.ko: 선생님이 학생들에게 간단한 문장을 쓰라고 하셨어.

w|kalkun.text: Untuk kelas spesial akhir tahun, Andi belajar memanggang daging kalkun utuh.
w|kalkun.en: For the special year-end class, Andi learned to roast a whole turkey.
w|kalkun.ko: 연말 특별 수업에서 안디는 칠면조 한 마리를 통째로 굽는 법을 배웠어요.

w|kalkun.text: Rani menulis bahwa keluarga suaminya selalu makan kalkun panggang saat hari raya.
w|kalkun.en: Rani wrote that her husband's family always eats roast turkey on holidays.
w|kalkun.ko: 라니는 시댁에서 명절마다 칠면조 구이를 먹는다고 썼어요.

w|kalung.en: That gold necklace belonged to her grandmother.

w|kalung.text: Dia memakai kalung mutiara ke pesta.
w|kalung.en: She wore a pearl necklace to the party.

w|kamar.en: She's waiting in the hotel room.

w|kambing.text: Kambing itu makan rumput di padang.
w|kambing.en: That goat ate grass in the field.

w|kambing.text: Petani memelihara kambing di belakang rumah.
w|kambing.en: The farmer keeps goats behind the house.

w|kamis.text: Hujan pertama tahun ini turun pada hari Kamis sore.
w|kamis.en: The first rain of the year fell on Thursday afternoon.
w|kamis.ko: 올해 첫 비는 목요일 오후에 내렸어요.

w|kamis.text: Pada hari Kamis, Siti harus syuting adegan hujan buatan.
w|kamis.en: On Thursday, Siti has to shoot a scene with artificial rain.
w|kamis.ko: 목요일에 시티는 인공 비 장면을 찍어야 해요.

w|kamp.en: The refugee camp needs medical help.

w|kamp.text: Anak-anak belajar di kamp musim panas.
w|kamp.en: The children study at summer camp.

w|kampanye.text: Menjelang pemilu, redaksi sibuk meliput kampanye para calon.
w|kampanye.en: Ahead of the election, the newsroom is busy covering the candidates' campaigns.
w|kampanye.ko: 선거를 앞두고 편집국은 후보들의 선거 운동 취재로 바빠요.

w|kampanye.text: Ayu membuat kampanye diskon ganti baterai menjelang tahun ajaran baru.
w|kampanye.en: Ayu ran a battery replacement discount campaign ahead of the new school year.
w|kampanye.ko: 아유는 새 학기를 앞두고 배터리 교체 할인 행사를 열었어요.

w|kampung.text: Dalam perjalanan, Agus mampir ke kampung neneknya di Jawa Tengah.
w|kampung.en: On the way, Agus stopped by his grandmother's village in Central Java.
w|kampung.ko: 가는 길에 아구스는 중부 자와에 있는 할머니 마을에 들렀어요.

w|kampung.text: Setiap Lebaran, Wati pulang ke kampung halamannya di Solo.
w|kampung.en: Every Eid, Wati goes back to her hometown in Solo.
w|kampung.ko: 와티는 르바란마다 솔로에 있는 고향에 가요.

w|kampus.en: New students explore the campus together.
That campus is full of shady trees.

w|kancing.text: Bayu suka mengoleksi kancing kuningan dari seragam zaman dulu.
w|kancing.en: Bayu likes collecting brass buttons from old-time uniforms.
w|kancing.ko: 바유는 옛날 제복의 놋쇠 단추를 모으는 걸 좋아해요.

w|kancing.text: Satu kancing kebaya Intan lepas, jadi perias cepat menjahitnya.
w|kancing.en: One button came off Intan's kebaya, so the makeup artist quickly sewed it back on.
w|kancing.ko: 인탄의 크바야 단추가 하나 떨어져서 메이크업 담당이 재빨리 꿰매 줬어요.

w|kandang.en: The chicken coop is cleaned every morning.
The dog sleeps inside the kennel.

w|kandidat.text: Sutradara masih memilih kandidat pemeran utama dari lima orang.
w|kandidat.en: The director is still choosing the lead actor from five candidates.
w|kandidat.ko: 연출가는 아직 다섯 명 중에서 주연 후보를 고르고 있어요.

w|kandidat.text: Hari ini Intan mewawancarai tiga kandidat untuk posisi desainer.
w|kandidat.en: Today Intan interviewed three candidates for the designer position.
w|kandidat.ko: 인탄은 오늘 디자이너 자리에 지원한 후보 세 명을 면접했어요.

w|kandungan.text: Budi selalu membaca kandungan makanan kucing sebelum merekomendasikannya.
w|kandungan.en: Budi always reads the contents of cat food before recommending it.
w|kandungan.ko: 부디는 고양이 사료를 추천하기 전에 늘 성분을 읽어요.

w|kandungan.text: Saat kandungan Siti berumur tujuh bulan, keluarga mengadakan selamatan kecil.
w|kandungan.en: When Siti was seven months pregnant, the family held a small thanksgiving gathering.
w|kandungan.ko: 시티가 임신 일곱 달이 됐을 때 가족이 작은 감사 잔치를 열었어요.

w|kangen.text: Di akhir surat, Budi menulis bahwa ia kangen main bola bersama Andi.
w|kangen.en: At the end of the letter, Budi writes that he misses playing football with Andi.
w|kangen.ko: 편지 끝에 부디는 안디와 공 차던 게 그립다고 써요.

w|kangen.text: Siti kangen suasana lomba yang ramai setelah lama tidak ikut.
w|kangen.en: Siti misses the lively race atmosphere after not taking part for a long time.
w|kangen.ko: 오랫동안 대회에 안 나간 시티는 북적이는 대회 분위기가 그리워요.

w|kanselir.text: Dalam drama itu, Eko berperan sebagai kanselir yang licik.
w|kanselir.en: In the play, Eko plays a cunning chancellor.
w|kanselir.ko: 그 연극에서 에코는 교활한 재상 역을 맡아요.

w|kanselir.text: Di televisi warung, Ayu menonton berita tentang kanselir baru di sebuah negara Eropa.
w|kanselir.en: On the stall's television, Ayu watches news about a new chancellor in a European country.
w|kanselir.ko: 아유는 가게 텔레비전에서 어느 유럽 나라의 새 총리 소식을 봐요.

w|kantong.en: That plastic bag is already torn.

w|kantong.text: Dia menyimpan kunci di kantong celana.
w|kantong.en: He keeps the key in his pants pocket.
w|kantong.ko: 그는 바지 주머니에 열쇠를 넣어 둬.

w|kantung.text: Bayu memasukkan uang receh ke kantung kecil di pinggangnya.
w|kantung.en: Bayu put the coins into the small pouch at his waist.
w|kantung.ko: 바유는 동전을 허리춤의 작은 주머니에 넣었어요.

w|kantung.text: Intan menyimpan amplop dari tamu di dalam kantung kain yang dijahit ibunya.
w|kantung.en: Intan kept the envelopes from guests in a cloth pouch her mother had sewn.
w|kantung.ko: 인탄은 손님들의 봉투를 엄마가 꿰매 준 천 주머니에 넣어 뒀어요.

w|kaos.text: Toko itu memberi bonus kaos gratis untuk setiap pembelian di atas dua ratus ribu.
w|kaos.en: That shop gives a free T-shirt for every purchase over two hundred thousand.
w|kaos.ko: 그 가게는 이십만 루피아 넘게 사면 티셔츠를 공짜로 줘요.

w|kaos.text: Saat menggoreng, kaos Lestari terkena cipratan saus sambal.
w|kaos.en: While frying, Lestari's T-shirt got splattered with chili sauce.
w|kaos.ko: 튀기는 동안 레스타리의 티셔츠에 칠리소스가 튀었어요.

w|kapak.text: Di samping alat pemadam api tersimpan sebuah kapak untuk keadaan darurat.
w|kapak.en: An axe is kept next to the fire extinguisher for emergencies.
w|kapak.ko: 소화기 옆에 비상용 도끼가 보관돼 있어요.

w|kapak.text: Di dinding gerbong ada kapak kecil untuk memecahkan kaca saat darurat.
w|kapak.en: On the carriage wall there is a small axe for breaking the glass in an emergency.
w|kapak.ko: 객차 벽에는 비상시 유리를 깨는 작은 도끼가 있어요.

w|kapasitas.text: Gedung teater kota itu punya kapasitas sekitar lima ratus penonton.
w|kapasitas.en: The city theater has a capacity of about five hundred spectators.
w|kapasitas.ko: 그 시립 극장은 관객을 오백 명쯤 수용할 수 있어요.

w|kapasitas.text: Kulkas di toko Ayu sudah penuh dan tidak ada kapasitas lagi untuk minuman baru.
w|kapasitas.en: The fridge in Ayu's shop is full and has no more capacity for new drinks.
w|kapasitas.ko: 아유 가게의 냉장고는 꽉 차서 새 음료를 넣을 자리가 없어요.

w|kapsul.text: Budi menyembunyikan kapsul obat di dalam sepotong sosis supaya anjingnya mau menelan.
w|kapsul.en: Budi hid the medicine capsule inside a piece of sausage so the dog would swallow it.
w|kapsul.ko: 부디는 개가 삼키도록 약 캡슐을 소시지 조각 안에 숨겼어요.

w|kapsul.text: Puskesmas desa memberi Siti kapsul vitamin untuk anak-anaknya.
w|kapsul.en: The village health center gave Siti vitamin capsules for her children.
w|kapsul.ko: 마을 보건소는 시티에게 아이들 먹일 비타민 캡슐을 줬어요.

w|karakter.text: Karakter utama film itu sangat kuat.
w|karakter.en: The main character of that film is very strong.

w|karangan.text: Waktu SD, Agus pernah menulis karangan tentang cita-citanya menjadi insinyur.
w|karangan.en: In elementary school, Agus once wrote an essay about his dream of becoming an engineer.
w|karangan.ko: 초등학생 때 아구스는 엔지니어가 되는 꿈에 대해 작문을 쓴 적이 있어요.

w|karangan.text: Wati memesan kumpulan karangan penulis favoritnya dari toko buku daring.
w|karangan.en: Wati ordered a collection of essays by her favorite writer from an online bookstore.
w|karangan.ko: 와티는 온라인 서점에서 좋아하는 작가의 수필집을 주문했어요.

w|karantina.text: Kucing yang baru datang dari penampungan harus masuk karantina selama dua minggu.
w|karantina.en: Cats newly arrived from the shelter must go into quarantine for two weeks.
w|karantina.ko: 보호소에서 막 온 고양이는 두 주 동안 격리에 들어가야 해요.

w|karantina.text: Sapi baru yang dibeli Pak Lurah harus menjalani karantina sebelum digabung dengan sapi lain.
w|karantina.en: The new cow the village head bought has to go through quarantine before joining the other cows.
w|karantina.ko: 이장님이 산 새 소는 다른 소들과 합치기 전에 격리를 거쳐야 해요.

w|karbon.text: Guru Agus bilang hutan menyimpan banyak karbon dan membantu mendinginkan bumi.
w|karbon.en: Agus's teacher says forests store a lot of carbon and help cool the earth.
w|karbon.ko: 아구스의 선생님은 숲이 탄소를 많이 저장해서 지구를 식히는 데 도움이 된다고 해요.

w|karbon.text: Wati menjual masker berlapis karbon aktif untuk pengendara motor.
w|karbon.en: Wati sells activated carbon masks for motorbike riders.
w|karbon.ko: 와티는 오토바이 운전자용 활성탄 마스크를 팔아요.

w|kardinal.text: Rubrik dunia memuat berita tentang kardinal yang dipilih menjadi kepala gereja.
w|kardinal.en: The world section carried news about the cardinal chosen to lead the church.
w|kardinal.ko: 국제면에 교회 수장으로 뽑힌 추기경 소식이 실렸어요.

w|kardinal.text: Burung kardinal merah jadi maskot aplikasi baru buatan tim Intan.
w|kardinal.en: A red cardinal bird became the mascot of the new app made by Intan's team.
w|kardinal.ko: 빨간 홍관조가 인탄 팀이 만든 새 앱의 마스코트가 됐어요.

w|karena.en: I'm late because of the traffic.

w|karet.text: Ban sepeda itu terbuat dari karet tebal.
w|karet.en: That bicycle tire is made of thick rubber.
w|karet.ko: 그 자전거 타이어는 두꺼운 고무로 만들어졌어.

w|karet.text: Karet penghapus ini sudah aus dan kotor.
w|karet.en: This rubber eraser is already worn and dirty.
w|karet.ko: 이 고무 지우개는 이미 닳고 더러워졌어.

w|kargo.text: Di stasiun transit, Dimas melihat kereta kargo panjang yang membawa batu bara.
w|kargo.en: At the transit station, Dimas saw a long cargo train carrying coal.
w|kargo.ko: 환승역에서 디마스는 석탄을 실은 긴 화물 열차를 봤어요.

w|kargo.text: Aplikasi Putri membantu perusahaan logistik melacak kiriman kargo secara langsung.
w|kargo.en: Putri's app helps logistics companies track cargo shipments in real time.
w|kargo.ko: 푸트리의 앱은 물류 회사가 화물 배송을 실시간으로 추적하도록 도와줘요.

w|karir.text: Dia membangun karir di bidang desain.
w|karir.en: She is building a career in design.
w|karir.ko: 그녀는 디자인 분야에서 경력을 쌓고 있어.

w|karir.text: Karir barunya membuatnya lebih percaya diri.
w|karir.en: His new career makes him more confident.
w|karir.ko: 새 경력이 그를 더 자신감 있게 해.

w|karpet.text: Pasir dari kaki Eko mengotori karpet di ruang tamu penginapan.
w|karpet.en: Sand from Eko's feet dirtied the carpet in the guesthouse living room.
w|karpet.ko: 에코의 발에 묻은 모래가 숙소 거실 카펫을 더럽혔어요.

w|karpet.text: Ayu menjemur karpet di pagar sambil mengobrol dengan Bu Sri.
w|karpet.en: Ayu aired the carpet on the fence while chatting with Mrs. Sri.
w|karpet.ko: 아유는 스리 아주머니와 수다를 떨며 카펫을 울타리에 널었어요.

w|kartel.text: Di pelajaran ekonomi, Rudi belajar bahwa kartel bisa membuat harga barang naik.
w|kartel.en: In economics class, Rudi learned that a cartel can make prices go up.
w|kartel.ko: 경제 시간에 루디는 카르텔이 물건값을 올릴 수 있다는 걸 배웠어요.

w|kartel.text: Sambil berkemas, Rina menonton film tentang kartel narkoba di laptop.
w|kartel.en: While packing, Rina watched a film about a drug cartel on her laptop.
w|kartel.ko: 짐을 싸면서 리나는 노트북으로 마약 카르텔 영화를 봤어요.

w|kartu.en: I forgot to bring my ID card.
His credit card was declined at the register.

w|kartun.text: Adik Andi langsung lari ke rak kartun begitu masuk perpustakaan.
w|kartun.en: Andi's little brother ran straight to the cartoon shelf as soon as he entered the library.
w|kartun.ko: 안디의 동생은 도서관에 들어서자마자 만화 책장으로 달려갔어요.

w|kartun.text: Rekan Dewi menempelkan kartun lucu tentang rapat di papan pengumuman.
w|kartun.en: Dewi's colleague pinned a funny cartoon about meetings on the notice board.
w|kartun.ko: 디위의 동료가 회의에 관한 웃긴 만화를 게시판에 붙였어요.

w|karung.text: Seorang ibu menjual baju bekas yang ditumpuk di atas karung goni.
w|karung.en: A woman was selling used clothes piled on top of a burlap sack.
w|karung.ko: 한 아주머니가 마대 위에 쌓은 헌 옷을 팔고 있었어요.

w|karung.text: Keluarga suami Intan membawa sekarung beras sebagai seserahan.
w|karung.en: Intan's husband's family brought a sack of rice as a wedding gift.
w|karung.ko: 인탄 남편의 가족은 혼수로 쌀 한 자루를 가져왔어요.

w|karunia.text: Guru agama bilang kecerdasan adalah karunia yang harus dipakai untuk kebaikan.
w|karunia.en: The religion teacher said intelligence is a gift that should be used for good.
w|karunia.ko: 종교 선생님은 똑똑함은 좋은 일에 써야 하는 선물이라고 했어요.

w|karunia.text: Bagi keluarga itu, kesembuhan anak mereka adalah karunia yang luar biasa.
w|karunia.en: For that family, their child's recovery is an extraordinary blessing.
w|karunia.ko: 그 가족에게 아이가 나은 건 정말 큰 축복이에요.

w|karya.text: Karya seni itu dipajang di galeri.
w|karya.en: That artwork is displayed in the gallery.

w|karya.text: Dia menyelesaikan karya barunya minggu ini.
w|karya.en: She finished her new work this week.
w|karya.ko: 그녀는 이번 주에 새 작품을 끝냈어.

w|karyawan.text: Karyawan baru mulai bekerja hari ini.
w|karyawan.en: The new employee starts work today.

w|kasar.en: His language is too rough for children.
Your attitude earlier was so rude.

w|kaset.text: Bayu menemukan kaset lagu lama milik ayahnya di dalam kardus pindahan.
w|kaset.en: Bayu found his father's old music cassettes in a moving box.
w|kaset.ko: 바유는 이삿짐 상자에서 아버지의 옛 노래 카세트테이프를 찾았어요.

w|kaset.text: Bapak di kursi seberang masih mendengarkan kaset dangdut dengan walkman.
w|kaset.en: The man in the seat across still listens to dangdut cassettes on a walkman.
w|kaset.ko: 맞은편 아저씨는 아직도 워크맨으로 당둣 카세트를 들어요.

w|kategori.ko: 그 아파트 쓰레기는 유기물과 무기물 종류로 나눠 버려요.

w|kawat.text: Lestari mengikat tumpukan kardus bekas dengan kawat.

w|kawat.ko: 레스타리는 헌 상자 더미를 철사로 묶었어요.

w|kawin.ko: 리나는 계약이 연장되면 내년에 결혼할 계획이에요.
