w|menyewa.ko: 우리는 휴가를 위해 차를 빌릴 거야.

w|menyewa.text: Menyewa kamar di sini cukup murah.
w|menyewa.en: Renting a room here is fairly cheap.
w|menyewa.ko: 여기서 방을 빌리는 건 꽤 싸.

w|menyewakan.text: Sekolah masak itu juga menyewakan dapurnya untuk acara ulang tahun.
w|menyewakan.en: The cooking school also rents out its kitchen for birthday parties.
w|menyewakan.ko: 그 요리 학교는 생일 파티용으로 부엌을 빌려주기도 해요.

w|menyewakan.text: Rani sekarang menyewakan kamar kosong di rumahnya untuk mahasiswa.
w|menyewakan.en: Rani now rents out the empty room in her house to university students.
w|menyewakan.ko: 라니는 지금 집의 빈방을 대학생에게 세놓아요.

w|menyia-nyiakan.text: Dimas bilang jangan menyia-nyiakan obat dengan memberikannya tanpa resep.
w|menyia-nyiakan.en: Dimas said not to waste medicine by giving it without a prescription.
w|menyia-nyiakan.ko: 디마스는 처방 없이 약을 줘서 낭비하지 말라고 했어요.

w|menyia-nyiakan.text: Putri tidak mau menyia-nyiakan kesempatan magang di laboratorium itu.
w|menyia-nyiakan.en: Putri doesn't want to waste the chance to intern at that laboratory.
w|menyia-nyiakan.ko: 푸트리는 그 연구소에서 인턴을 할 기회를 놓치고 싶지 않아요.

w|menyiapkan.en: We have to prepare those documents.

w|menyimpan.en: He keeps money in the bank.

w|menyimpang.text: Pelatih menegur Bayu karena gerakan punggungnya menyimpang dari posisi yang benar.
w|menyimpang.en: The trainer corrected Bayu because his back movement strayed from the correct position.
w|menyimpang.ko: 바유의 허리 동작이 바른 자세에서 벗어나서 트레이너가 지적했어요.

w|menyimpang.text: Obrolan keluarga Intan sering menyimpang dari topik awal ke cerita masa kecil.
w|menyimpang.en: Intan's family conversations often drift from the original topic to childhood stories.
w|menyimpang.ko: 인탄 가족의 대화는 처음 주제에서 자주 어린 시절 이야기로 새요.

w|menyimpulkan.text: Dari peta, Agus menyimpulkan bahwa jalan lewat gunung lebih cepat.
w|menyimpulkan.en: From the map, Agus concluded that the mountain road was faster.
w|menyimpulkan.ko: 지도를 보고 아구스는 산길이 더 빠르다고 결론 내렸어요.

w|menyimpulkan.text: Dari laporan penjualan, Wati menyimpulkan bahwa sepatu putih paling laris.
w|menyimpulkan.en: From the sales report, Wati concluded that white shoes sell best.
w|menyimpulkan.ko: 판매 보고서를 보고 와티는 흰 신발이 가장 잘 팔린다고 결론 내렸어요.

w|menyinggung.text: Rudi tidak bermaksud menyinggung arsitek saat mengkritik desain tangga.
w|menyinggung.en: Rudi didn't mean to offend the architect when he criticised the stair design.
w|menyinggung.ko: 루디는 계단 설계를 지적할 때 건축가 기분을 상하게 할 생각은 없었어요.

w|menyinggung.text: Rina takut menyinggung rekan kerja kalau terlalu banyak bertanya.
w|menyinggung.en: Rina is afraid of offending her coworkers if she asks too many questions.
w|menyinggung.ko: 리나는 질문을 너무 많이 하면 동료들 기분을 상하게 할까 봐 걱정이에요.

w|menyingkir.en: Please step aside from that path.
He got out of the way as soon as the police came.

w|menyingkirkan.en: Please get rid of those old items.
He wants to get rid of bad habits.

w|menyiram.text: Tiap sore Agus menyiram tanah proyek supaya debunya tidak beterbangan.
w|menyiram.en: Every afternoon Agus waters the site's ground so the dust doesn't fly around.
w|menyiram.ko: 아구스는 먼지가 날리지 않도록 매일 오후 현장 땅에 물을 뿌려요.

w|menyiram.text: Wati membeli selang baru untuk menyiram tanaman di teras.
w|menyiram.en: Wati bought a new hose to water the plants on the terrace.
w|menyiram.ko: 와티는 테라스 화분에 물을 주려고 새 호스를 샀어요.

w|menyisakan.text: Redaktur memangkas tulisan Budi dan hanya menyisakan tiga paragraf.
w|menyisakan.en: The editor cut Budi's piece down and left only three paragraphs.
w|menyisakan.ko: 편집자는 부디의 글을 줄여 세 단락만 남겼어요.

w|menyisakan.text: Rombongan pelajar itu hanya menyisakan dua buku sejarah di rak.
w|menyisakan.en: The group of students left only two history books on the shelf.
w|menyisakan.ko: 학생 단체가 다녀간 뒤 책장에는 역사책이 두 권만 남았어요.

w|menyisir.text: Budi menyisir rambut dengan jari sebelum masuk ruang rapat.
w|menyisir.en: Budi combed his hair with his fingers before entering the meeting room.
w|menyisir.ko: 부디는 회의실에 들어가기 전에 손가락으로 머리를 빗었어요.

w|menyisir.text: Siti menyisir setiap rak untuk mencari kamus yang hilang.
w|menyisir.en: Siti combed through every shelf looking for the missing dictionary.
w|menyisir.ko: 시티는 없어진 사전을 찾으려고 책장을 샅샅이 뒤졌어요.

w|menyita.text: Petugas bea cukai menyita kain impor yang tidak punya izin.
w|menyita.en: Customs officers seized imported cloth that had no permit.
w|menyita.ko: 세관 직원이 허가 없는 수입 원단을 압수했어요.

w|menyita.text: Petugas menyita botol parfum besar dari tas kabin Intan.
w|menyita.en: The officer confiscated a large perfume bottle from Intan's cabin bag.
w|menyita.ko: 직원이 인탄의 기내 가방에서 큰 향수병을 압수했어요.

w|menyuap.text: Rina pernah menolak seorang pemasok yang mencoba menyuap timnya.
w|menyuap.en: Rina once turned down a supplier who tried to bribe her team.
w|menyuap.ko: 리나는 자기 팀에 뇌물을 주려던 납품업자를 거절한 적이 있어요.

w|menyuap.text: Seorang tamu mencoba menyuap satpam supaya bisa parkir di depan lobi.
w|menyuap.en: A guest tried to bribe the security guard so he could park in front of the lobby.
w|menyuap.ko: 한 손님이 로비 앞에 주차하려고 경비원에게 뒷돈을 주려 했어요.

w|menyulitkan.text: Bulu kucing yang terlalu tebal menyulitkan Budi menemukan kutu.
w|menyulitkan.en: The cat's very thick fur made it hard for Budi to find the fleas.
w|menyulitkan.ko: 너무 두꺼운 고양이 털 때문에 부디는 벼룩을 찾기 힘들었어요.

w|menyulitkan.text: Jalan berlumpur menyulitkan Siti membawa sayur ke pasar.
w|menyulitkan.en: The muddy road made it hard for Siti to carry vegetables to the market.
w|menyulitkan.ko: 진흙길 때문에 시티는 채소를 시장에 가져가기가 힘들었어요.

w|menyumbangkan.text: Gym itu menyumbangkan alat-alat lama ke sekolah olahraga di desa.
w|menyumbangkan.en: The gym donated its old equipment to a sports school in the village.
w|menyumbangkan.ko: 그 헬스장은 낡은 기구를 시골의 체육 학교에 기증했어요.

w|menyumbangkan.text: Restoran itu menyumbangkan makanan sisa yang masih layak ke panti asuhan.
w|menyumbangkan.en: The restaurant donates leftover food that is still good to an orphanage.
w|menyumbangkan.ko: 그 식당은 아직 먹을 만한 남은 음식을 보육원에 기부해요.

w|menyuntik.text: Dimas menyuntik kambing itu dengan cepat sebelum hewan itu sempat berontak.
w|menyuntik.en: Dimas injected the goat quickly before the animal had a chance to struggle.
w|menyuntik.ko: 디마스는 염소가 버둥대기 전에 재빨리 주사를 놓았어요.

w|menyuntik.text: Asisten lab menyuntik tikus percobaan dengan cairan pewarna.
w|menyuntik.en: The lab assistant injected the test mice with a dye solution.
w|menyuntik.ko: 실험 조교가 실험용 쥐에게 염료 용액을 주사했어요.

w|menyuntikkan.text: Sebelum berangkat, perawat menyuntikkan vaksin tifus ke lengan Dimas.
w|menyuntikkan.en: Before he left, a nurse injected a typhoid vaccine into Dimas's arm.
w|menyuntikkan.ko: 떠나기 전에 간호사가 디마스의 팔에 장티푸스 백신을 놓았어요.

w|menyuntikkan.text: Seorang investor siap menyuntikkan dana besar ke perusahaan rintisan Putri.
w|menyuntikkan.en: An investor is ready to inject a large amount of money into Putri's startup.
w|menyuntikkan.ko: 한 투자자가 푸트리의 스타트업에 큰 자금을 투입할 준비가 돼 있어요.

w|menyuruh.en: Mom told me to clean the room.
Ordering other people around isn't a solution.

w|menyusahkan.text: Andi tidak mau menyusahkan ibunya, jadi dia berangkat sekolah naik sepeda sendiri.
w|menyusahkan.en: Andi didn't want to trouble his mother, so he rode his bike to school on his own.
w|menyusahkan.ko: 안디는 엄마를 번거롭게 하기 싫어서 혼자 자전거를 타고 학교에 갔어요.

w|menyusahkan.text: Hujan deras bisa menyusahkan rencana pesta di halaman, kata Dewi cemas.
w|menyusahkan.en: Heavy rain could spoil the plan for a party in the yard, Dewi said anxiously.
w|menyusahkan.ko: 폭우가 오면 마당 파티 계획이 곤란해질 수 있다고 데위가 걱정했어요.

w|menyusul.text: Andi datang lebih dulu, lalu istrinya menyusul membawa fotokopi KTP.
w|menyusul.en: Andi came first, and then his wife followed with a photocopy of his ID card.
w|menyusul.ko: 안디가 먼저 오고, 아내가 신분증 사본을 들고 뒤따라왔어요.

w|menyusul.text: Setelah tertinggal di babak pertama, tim Dewi mulai menyusul skor lawan.
w|menyusul.en: After falling behind in the first half, Dewi's team started catching up with the opponent's score.
w|menyusul.ko: 전반에 뒤졌던 데위네 팀은 상대 점수를 따라잡기 시작했어요.

w|menyusun.text: Para tukang menyusun bata merah dengan rapi untuk dinding belakang.
w|menyusun.en: The builders laid red bricks neatly for the back wall.
w|menyusun.ko: 인부들이 뒷벽에 쓸 붉은 벽돌을 가지런히 쌓았어요.

w|menyusun.text: Sore itu Rina menyusun daftar tugas untuk minggu pertamanya.
w|menyusun.en: That afternoon Rina put together a to-do list for her first week.
w|menyusun.ko: 그날 오후 리나는 첫 주에 할 일 목록을 정리했어요.

w|menyusup.text: Sisa makanan bisa menyusup ke celah gigi dan menyebabkan lubang.
w|menyusup.en: Food remains can get into the gaps between teeth and cause cavities.
w|menyusup.ko: 음식 찌꺼기가 이 틈에 끼어 들어가 충치를 만들 수 있어요.

w|menyusup.text: Air hujan menyusup lewat celah genteng dan membasahi plafon.
w|menyusup.en: Rainwater seeped through the gaps in the roof tiles and soaked the ceiling.
w|menyusup.ko: 빗물이 기와 틈으로 스며들어 천장을 적셨어요.

w|menyusuri.text: Dalam kegiatan alam, Agus menyusuri sungai kecil di belakang sekolah.
w|menyusuri.en: During the nature activity, Agus walked along the small river behind the school.
w|menyusuri.ko: 자연 체험 시간에 아구스는 학교 뒤 개울을 따라 걸었어요.

w|menyusuri.text: Wati berjalan pelan menyusuri tepi kolam yang licin.
w|menyusuri.en: Wati walked slowly along the slippery edge of the pool.
w|menyusuri.ko: 와티는 미끄러운 수영장 가장자리를 따라 천천히 걸었어요.

w|meracuni.text: Menurut berita, pabrik di kota lain ditutup karena limbahnya meracuni sungai.
w|meracuni.en: According to the news, a factory in another city was shut down because its waste poisoned the river.
w|meracuni.ko: 뉴스에 따르면 다른 도시의 한 공장은 폐수로 강을 오염시켜 문을 닫았대요.

w|meracuni.text: Intan menonton film tentang ratu yang berusaha meracuni musuhnya.
w|meracuni.en: Intan watched a film about a queen who tries to poison her enemy.
w|meracuni.ko: 인탄은 적을 독살하려는 여왕에 관한 영화를 봤어요.

w|meragukan.en: I doubt the truth of that news.

w|merah.en: That red flower is very pretty.
Red is the color of courage.

w|merahasiakan.text: Budi merahasiakan nilai ulangannya dari kakaknya.
w|merahasiakan.en: Budi kept his test score a secret from his older sibling.
w|merahasiakan.ko: 부디는 시험 점수를 형에게 비밀로 했어요.

w|merahasiakan.text: Siti merahasiakan alamat barunya supaya bisa memberi kejutan kepada teman-teman.
w|merahasiakan.en: Siti kept her new address secret so she could surprise her friends.
w|merahasiakan.ko: 시티는 친구들을 깜짝 놀라게 하려고 새 주소를 비밀로 했어요.

w|meraih.text: Dia meraih gelas di rak paling atas.
w|meraih.en: She reached for a glass on the top shelf.
w|meraih.ko: 그는 맨 위 선반의 컵을 집었어.

w|meraih.text: Tim itu meraih kemenangan di final.
w|meraih.en: That team achieved victory in the final.

w|merakit.text: Rudi semalaman merakit lampu hias untuk gerbang rumah pengantin.
w|merakit.en: Rudi spent all night assembling decorative lights for the bride's house gate.
w|merakit.ko: 루디는 밤새 신부 집 대문에 달 장식 조명을 조립했어요.

w|merakit.text: Rina meliput bengkel kecil yang merakit sepeda listrik dari barang bekas.
w|merakit.en: Rina covered a small workshop that assembles electric bikes from used parts.
w|merakit.ko: 리나는 중고 부품으로 전기 자전거를 조립하는 작은 공방을 취재했어요.

w|meramalkan.text: Pedagang buku itu meramalkan harga komik lama akan naik beberapa tahun lagi.
w|meramalkan.en: The book dealer predicts that old comics will go up in price in a few years.
w|meramalkan.ko: 그 책 장수는 몇 년 뒤면 옛날 만화책 값이 오를 거라고 내다봐요.

w|meramalkan.text: Nenek Intan meramalkan hujan tidak akan turun pada hari pernikahan cucunya.
w|meramalkan.en: Intan's grandmother predicted that it wouldn't rain on her granddaughter's wedding day.
w|meramalkan.ko: 인탄의 할머니는 손녀 결혼식 날에는 비가 오지 않을 거라고 장담했어요.

w|merampas.text: Ombak besar merampas sandal Eko yang tertinggal di pinggir air.
w|merampas.en: A big wave snatched away the sandals Eko had left at the water's edge.
w|merampas.ko: 큰 파도가 물가에 두고 온 에코의 샌들을 휩쓸어 갔어요.

w|merampas.text: Ayu membaca berita tentang preman yang merampas ponsel di jalan dekat rumahnya.
w|merampas.en: Ayu read news about a thug who snatched a phone on the street near her house.
w|merampas.ko: 아유는 집 근처 길에서 깡패가 휴대폰을 빼앗았다는 기사를 읽었어요.

w|merampok.text: Pencuri itu mencoba merampok toko kecil.
w|merampok.en: That thief tried to rob a small shop.
w|merampok.ko: 그 도둑이 작은 가게를 털려 했어.

w|merampok.text: Mereka tidak akan merampok orang lain.
w|merampok.en: They will not rob other people.
w|merampok.ko: 그들은 다른 사람을 강도질하지 않을 거야.

w|merancang.text: Para siswa kelas sebelas sedang merancang kostum untuk pentas seni.
w|merancang.en: The eleventh-grade students are designing costumes for the arts show.
w|merancang.ko: 고등학교 이 학년 학생들이 예술제 의상을 디자인하고 있어요.

w|merancang.text: Siti dan Rudi merancang acara reuni ini sejak tiga bulan lalu.
w|merancang.en: Siti and Rudi have been planning this reunion since three months ago.
w|merancang.ko: 시티와 루디는 석 달 전부터 이번 동창회를 계획했어요.

w|merangkak.text: Lalu lintas merangkak pelan, jadi Eko terlambat tiba di lokasi kebakaran.
w|merangkak.en: Traffic crawled along slowly, so Eko arrived late at the fire scene.
w|merangkak.ko: 차가 엉금엉금 기어가는 바람에 에코는 화재 현장에 늦게 도착했어요.

w|merangkak.text: Bayi pelanggan merangkak di lantai toko sementara ibunya menunggu.
w|merangkak.en: The customer's baby crawled on the shop floor while the mother waited.
w|merangkak.ko: 손님 아기가 엄마를 기다리는 동안 가게 바닥을 기어다녔어요.

w|merapikan.text: Sebelum tirai dibuka, Eko merapikan kostum para pemain.
w|merapikan.en: Before the curtain opens, Eko tidies the actors' costumes.
w|merapikan.ko: 막이 오르기 전에 에코는 배우들의 의상을 매만져요.

w|merapikan.text: Setiap pagi Ayu merapikan tumpukan kayu bakar di samping rumah.
w|merapikan.en: Every morning Ayu tidies the pile of firewood beside the house.
w|merapikan.ko: 아유는 매일 아침 집 옆의 장작 더미를 정리해요.

w|merasuki.text: Rudi menulis bahwa rasa rindu seperti merasuki pikirannya setiap musim hujan.
w|merasuki.en: Rudi wrote that longing seems to take over his mind every rainy season.
w|merasuki.ko: 루디는 우기마다 그리움이 마음을 사로잡는 것 같다고 썼어요.

w|merasuki.text: Ide membuat aplikasi sendiri seolah merasuki Rina sejak kuliah.
w|merasuki.en: The idea of making her own app seems to have possessed Rina since university.
w|merasuki.ko: 자기만의 앱을 만들겠다는 생각이 대학 때부터 리나를 사로잡은 것 같아요.

w|merawat.text: Dia suka merawat tanaman di balkon.
w|merawat.en: She likes tending plants on the balcony.
w|merawat.ko: 그는 베란다 식물을 가꾸는 걸 좋아해.

w|merawat.text: Perawat itu merawat pasien dengan sabar.
w|merawat.en: That nurse cares for patients patiently.
w|merawat.ko: 그 간호사가 환자를 참을성 있게 돌봐.

w|merayakan.text: Kami merayakan ulang tahunnya di rumah.
w|merayakan.en: We celebrated her birthday at home.

w|merayap.text: Seekor cicak merayap di dinding ruang tunggu klinik.
w|merayap.en: A gecko crept along the wall of the clinic's waiting room.
w|merayap.ko: 도마뱀 한 마리가 병원 대기실 벽을 기어갔어요.

w|merayap.text: Kabut pagi pelan-pelan merayap turun dari puncak menuju rumah Siti.
w|merayap.en: The morning fog slowly crept down from the peak toward Siti's house.
w|merayap.ko: 아침 안개가 산꼭대기에서 시티네 집 쪽으로 천천히 기어 내려왔어요.

w|merayu.text: Penjual mesin itu terus merayu Bayu supaya membeli model paling mahal.
w|merayu.en: The machine salesman kept sweet-talking Bayu into buying the most expensive model.
w|merayu.ko: 그 기계 판매원은 바유에게 가장 비싼 모델을 사라고 계속 꼬드겼어요.

w|merayu.text: Adik Intan merayu ibunya supaya dibelikan mainan di toko bandara.
w|merayu.en: Intan's little brother sweet-talked their mother into buying him a toy at the airport shop.
w|merayu.ko: 인탄의 동생은 공항 가게에서 장난감을 사 달라고 엄마를 졸랐어요.

w|merebus.text: Instruktur mengajari Andi merebus telur supaya kuningnya tetap lembut.
w|merebus.en: The instructor taught Andi to boil eggs so the yolks stay soft.
w|merebus.ko: 강사는 안디에게 노른자가 부드럽게 남도록 달걀 삶는 법을 가르쳤어요.

w|merebus.text: Dewi ingat ibunya selalu merebus jagung setiap kali Rani menginap.
w|merebus.en: Dewi remembers her mother always boiled corn whenever Rani stayed over.
w|merebus.ko: 데위는 라니가 자고 갈 때마다 어머니가 옥수수를 삶아 주셨던 걸 기억해요.

w|merebut.text: Mereka mencoba merebut kembali kota itu.
w|merebut.en: They tried to seize the city back.

w|merebut.text: Anak itu merebut mainan dari adiknya.
w|merebut.en: That child snatched the toy from his sibling.

w|mereda.text: Bayu menunggu hujan mereda di bawah tenda pedagang buku.
w|mereda.en: Bayu waited for the rain to ease off under the book seller's tent.
w|mereda.ko: 바유는 책 장수의 천막 아래에서 비가 그치기를 기다렸어요.

w|mereda.text: Untungnya, hujan mulai mereda tepat sebelum tamu berdatangan.
w|mereda.en: Luckily, the rain started to ease just before the guests arrived.
w|mereda.ko: 다행히 손님들이 오기 직전에 비가 잦아들기 시작했어요.

w|merek.text: Bayu tidak peduli merek, yang penting jaketnya masih bagus.
w|merek.en: Bayu doesn't care about the brand; what matters is that the jacket is still in good shape.
w|merek.ko: 바유는 상표는 상관없고 재킷 상태만 좋으면 돼요.

w|merek.text: Intan memilih sepatu pengantin dari merek lokal yang dibuat dengan tangan.
w|merek.en: Intan chose bridal shoes from a local brand that makes them by hand.
w|merek.ko: 인탄은 손으로 만드는 국내 브랜드의 웨딩 슈즈를 골랐어요.

w|merekam.text: Mereka merekam wawancara di studio kecil.
w|merekam.en: They are recording the interview in a small studio.
w|merekam.ko: 그들은 작은 스튜디오에서 인터뷰를 녹음하고 있어.

w|merekomendasikan.text: Teman kantor Fajar merekomendasikan toko daring yang jual barang elektronik murah.
w|merekomendasikan.en: Fajar's office friend recommended an online shop that sells cheap electronics.
w|merekomendasikan.ko: 파자르의 회사 친구가 싼 전자제품을 파는 온라인 가게를 추천했어요.

w|merekomendasikan.text: Guru merekomendasikan gula aren untuk kolak supaya rasanya lebih harum.
w|merekomendasikan.en: The teacher recommended palm sugar for the kolak so it would taste more fragrant.
w|merekomendasikan.ko: 선생님은 콜락에 야자당을 넣으면 향이 더 좋다고 권했어요.

w|merekrut.text: Pabrik sedang merekrut tiga puluh penjahit untuk musim ramai.
w|merekrut.en: The factory is recruiting thirty tailors for the busy season.
w|merekrut.ko: 공장은 바쁜 철을 맞아 재봉사 서른 명을 뽑고 있어요.

w|merekrut.text: Maskapai itu sedang merekrut pilot muda lewat program beasiswa.
w|merekrut.en: The airline is recruiting young pilots through a scholarship program.
w|merekrut.ko: 그 항공사는 장학 프로그램으로 젊은 조종사를 뽑고 있어요.

w|merelakan.text: Budi belajar merelakan masa lalu dan memaafkan sahabatnya.
w|merelakan.en: Budi is learning to let go of the past and forgive his friend.
w|merelakan.ko: 부디는 지난 일을 내려놓고 친구를 용서하는 법을 배우고 있어요.

w|merelakan.text: Karena cedera, Siti harus merelakan kesempatan ikut lomba di luar kota.
w|merelakan.en: Because of an injury, Siti had to give up the chance to race out of town.
w|merelakan.ko: 부상 때문에 시티는 다른 도시 대회에 나갈 기회를 포기해야 했어요.

w|meremehkan.text: Pak Agus mengingatkan Andi agar tidak meremehkan pesan penipuan di ponsel.
w|meremehkan.en: Mr. Agus reminded Andi not to underestimate scam messages on his phone.
w|meremehkan.ko: 아구스 경관은 안디에게 휴대폰 사기 문자를 가볍게 보지 말라고 했어요.

w|meremehkan.text: Lawan meremehkan tim Dewi, padahal akhirnya mereka kalah jauh.
w|meremehkan.en: The opponents underestimated Dewi's team, but in the end they lost by a wide margin.
w|meremehkan.ko: 상대 팀은 데위네 팀을 얕봤는데 결국 크게 졌어요.

w|merencanakan.en: We are planning a trip to the mountain.

w|merencanakan.text: Dia suka merencanakan semuanya jauh-jauh hari.
w|merencanakan.en: She likes to plan everything far in advance.
w|merencanakan.ko: 그는 모든 걸 미리미리 계획하는 걸 좋아해.

w|merendahkan.text: Fajar kesal karena ada penjual yang merendahkan pembeli di kolom komentar.
w|merendahkan.en: Fajar was annoyed because a seller belittled a buyer in the comments.
w|merendahkan.ko: 파자르는 한 판매자가 댓글 창에서 구매자를 깔보는 걸 보고 짜증이 났어요.

w|merendahkan.text: Guru yang baik tidak pernah merendahkan masakan peserta yang gagal.
w|merendahkan.en: A good teacher never belittles a participant's failed dish.
w|merendahkan.ko: 좋은 선생님은 참가자가 망친 요리를 절대 깔보지 않아요.

w|merengek.text: Anak Dimas merengek minta ikut setiap kali ayahnya berangkat ke pabrik.
w|merengek.en: Dimas's child whines to come along every time his father leaves for the factory.
w|merengek.ko: 디마스의 아이는 아빠가 공장에 갈 때마다 따라가겠다고 칭얼대요.

w|merengek.text: Putri tertawa membaca cerita tentang anak Sari yang merengek minta kucing.
w|merengek.en: Putri laughs reading the story about Sari's child whining for a cat.
w|merengek.ko: 푸트리는 고양이를 사 달라고 조르는 사리 아이 이야기를 읽고 웃어요.

w|merenggut.text: Seorang warga bercerita bahwa banjir bandang pernah merenggut banyak rumah di lembah itu.
w|merenggut.en: A local resident told how a flash flood once swept away many houses in that valley.
w|merenggut.ko: 한 주민은 예전에 돌발 홍수가 그 골짜기의 집을 많이 앗아 갔다고 말했어요.

w|merenggut.text: Seorang pencopet merenggut tas seorang ibu di eskalator.
w|merenggut.en: A pickpocket snatched a woman's bag on the escalator.
w|merenggut.ko: 소매치기가 에스컬레이터에서 한 여성의 가방을 낚아챘어요.

w|merenovasi.text: Pengelola berencana merenovasi lobi apartemen tahun depan.
w|merenovasi.en: The management plans to renovate the apartment lobby next year.
w|merenovasi.ko: 관리실은 내년에 아파트 로비를 리모델링할 계획이에요.

w|merenovasi.text: Wati ingin merenovasi atap rumah sebelum musim hujan berikutnya.
w|merenovasi.en: Wati wants to renovate the roof before the next rainy season.
w|merenovasi.ko: 와티는 다음 우기 전에 지붕을 고치고 싶어 해요.

w|merepotkan.text: Agus tidak mau merepotkan pamannya, jadi dia menginap di hotel kecil.
w|merepotkan.en: Agus didn't want to trouble his uncle, so he stayed at a small hotel.
w|merepotkan.ko: 아구스는 삼촌에게 폐를 끼치기 싫어서 작은 호텔에 묵었어요.

w|merepotkan.text: Wati sabar menghadapi pembeli yang suka merepotkan pegawai.
w|merepotkan.en: Wati is patient with customers who like to give staff a hard time.
w|merepotkan.ko: 와티는 직원을 귀찮게 하는 손님도 참을성 있게 대해요.

w|meretas.text: Anak Budi membaca berita tentang orang yang meretas situs badan cuaca.
w|meretas.en: Budi's son read a news story about someone who hacked the weather agency's website.
w|meretas.ko: 부디의 아들은 누군가 기상청 사이트를 해킹했다는 기사를 읽었어요.

w|meretas.text: Dalam film itu, tokoh adik Siti adalah remaja yang pandai meretas komputer.
w|meretas.en: In the film, the character of Siti's younger brother is a teenager who is good at hacking computers.
w|meretas.ko: 그 영화에서 시티의 동생 역은 컴퓨터 해킹을 잘하는 십 대예요.

w|meriah.text: Andi menggambarkan pesta panen di desanya yang meriah.
w|meriah.en: Andi describes the lively harvest festival in his village.
w|meriah.ko: 안디는 마을의 떠들썩한 추수 잔치를 묘사해요.

w|meriah.text: Suasana di garis akhir sangat meriah dengan musik dan sorakan.
w|meriah.en: The atmosphere at the finish line was very festive with music and cheering.
w|meriah.ko: 결승선 분위기는 음악과 환호로 아주 떠들썩했어요.

w|meriam.text: Di halaman kantor polisi ada meriam tua peninggalan zaman penjajahan.
w|meriam.en: In the yard of the police station there is an old cannon from the colonial era.
w|meriam.ko: 경찰서 마당에는 식민지 시대에 남은 낡은 대포가 있어요.

w|meriam.text: Tembakan tiga angka Dewi melesat seperti peluru meriam.
w|meriam.en: Dewi's three-point shot flew like a cannonball.

w|merilis.text: Bulan ini pabrik merilis katalog kain motif batik yang baru.
w|merilis.en: This month the factory released a new catalogue of batik-pattern fabrics.
w|merilis.ko: 이번 달 공장은 바틱 무늬 원단 신제품 카탈로그를 냈어요.

w|merilis.text: Penyanyi favorit Intan baru merilis album dan kebetulan satu pesawat dengannya.
w|merilis.en: Intan's favorite singer just released an album and happened to be on the same plane.
w|merilis.ko: 인탄이 좋아하는 가수가 막 앨범을 냈는데 우연히 같은 비행기를 탔어요.

w|merinding.text: Rudi merinding membaca pesan panjang yang ditulis kakaknya tengah malam.
w|merinding.en: Rudi got goosebumps reading the long message his sister wrote at midnight.
w|merinding.ko: 루디는 누나가 한밤중에 쓴 긴 메시지를 읽고 소름이 돋았어요.

w|merinding.text: Rina merinding ketika air laut yang dingin menyentuh kakinya.
w|merinding.en: Rina got goosebumps when the cold seawater touched her feet.
w|merinding.ko: 차가운 바닷물이 발에 닿자 리나는 소름이 돋았어요.

w|meringankan.text: Kompres hangat bisa meringankan nyeri sendi pada anjing tua.
w|meringankan.en: A warm compress can ease joint pain in old dogs.
w|meringankan.ko: 따뜻한 찜질은 늙은 개의 관절 통증을 덜어 줄 수 있어요.

w|meringankan.text: Kerja bakti warga sangat meringankan beban Siti setelah atap rumahnya bocor.
w|meringankan.en: The villagers' communal work greatly eased Siti's burden after her roof leaked.
w|meringankan.ko: 주민들의 공동 작업 덕분에 지붕이 샌 뒤 시티의 짐이 크게 덜어졌어요.

w|merobek.text: Dia merobek surat lama tanpa membaca.
w|merobek.en: He tore up the old letter without reading it.
w|merobek.ko: 그는 읽지도 않고 낡은 편지를 찢었어.

w|merobohkan.text: Pemerintah kota berencana merobohkan bangunan pasar lama dan membangun yang baru.
w|merobohkan.en: The city government plans to tear down the old market building and build a new one.
w|merobohkan.ko: 시 당국은 옛 시장 건물을 허물고 새로 지을 계획이에요.

w|merobohkan.text: Angin kencang sempat merobohkan tenda dekorasi sehari sebelum pernikahan Intan.
w|merobohkan.en: A strong wind knocked down the decoration tent the day before Intan's wedding.
w|merobohkan.ko: 인탄의 결혼식 전날 강풍에 장식 천막이 쓰러졌어요.

w|merokok.en: Smoking is prohibited inside the building.
w|merokok.ko: 건물 안에서는 담배를 피우면 안 돼.

w|merpati.text: Kakek Agus memelihara burung merpati di pondok dekat hutan.
w|merpati.en: Agus's grandfather keeps pigeons in a hut near the forest.
w|merpati.ko: 아구스의 할아버지는 숲 근처 오두막에서 비둘기를 길러요.

w|merpati.text: Di alun-alun depan apotek, anak-anak memberi makan burung merpati.
w|merpati.en: In the square in front of the pharmacy, children feed the pigeons.
w|merpati.ko: 약국 앞 광장에서 아이들이 비둘기에게 모이를 줘요.

w|mertua.text: Rina sedang belajar memasak rendang supaya disukai calon mertua.
w|mertua.en: Rina is learning to cook rendang so her future in-laws will like her.
w|mertua.ko: 리나는 예비 시부모님 마음에 들려고 른당 만드는 법을 배우고 있어요.

w|mertua.text: Dewi memesan kamar untuk mertua kakaknya yang datang dari Makassar.
w|mertua.en: Dewi booked a room for her sister's in-laws who came from Makassar.
w|mertua.ko: 데위는 마카사르에서 오는 언니의 시부모님 방을 예약했어요.

w|merugikan.text: Kata Bu Guru, mencontek hanya merugikan diri sendiri.
w|merugikan.en: The teacher said cheating only harms yourself.

w|merugikan.text: Pegawai yang sering datang terlambat bisa merugikan restoran Putri.
w|merugikan.en: Staff who often come late can hurt Putri's restaurant.
w|merugikan.ko: 자주 늦는 직원은 푸트리네 식당에 손해를 끼칠 수 있어요.

w|merunduk.text: Dia merunduk agar tidak terkena cabang pohon.
w|merunduk.en: He ducked so he would not hit the tree branch.
w|merunduk.ko: 그는 나뭇가지에 안 걸리려고 몸을 숙였어.

w|merunduk.text: Merunduk di balik meja membuatnya aman.
w|merunduk.en: Ducking behind the table kept her safe.
w|merunduk.ko: 탁자 뒤에 몸을 숙여서 그녀는 안전했어.

w|meski.en: Even though tired, he kept working.
I came even though it poured.

w|meskipun.en: Even though it was raining, he still came.
She kept smiling even though she was tired.

w|mesti.en: You must go home before dark.

w|mesti.text: Kita mesti jujur satu sama lain.
w|mesti.en: We must be honest with each other.

w|meter.en: That table is two meters long.
The water meter at home is broken.

w|metode.text: Guru menjelaskan metode belajar yang lebih mudah.
w|metode.en: The teacher explained an easier learning method.
w|metode.ko: 선생님이 더 쉬운 학습 방법을 설명했어.

w|metode.text: Metode ini sudah dipakai di banyak sekolah.
w|metode.en: This method is already used in many schools.
w|metode.ko: 이 방법은 이미 많은 학교에서 쓰여.

w|mewah.en: That luxury hotel faces the sea.
Luxurious does not always mean comfortable.

w|mewakili.text: Dia akan mewakili sekolah di kompetisi itu.
w|mewakili.en: She will represent the school in that competition.
w|mewakili.ko: 그는 그 대회에서 학교를 대표할 거야.

w|mewakili.text: Pengacara itu mewakili klien dengan baik.
w|mewakili.en: That lawyer represents the client well.

w|mewarisi.text: Eko mewarisi bakat menggambar dari ayahnya.
w|mewarisi.en: Eko inherited his drawing talent from his father.

w|mewarisi.text: Ayu mewarisi kotak kuas tua milik neneknya yang dulu pelukis batik.
w|mewarisi.en: Ayu inherited an old box of brushes from her grandmother, who was a batik painter.
w|mewarisi.ko: 아유는 바틱 화가였던 할머니의 오래된 붓 상자를 물려받았어요.

w|mewariskan.text: Instruktur itu ingin mewariskan resep rendang keluarganya kepada murid-murid.
w|mewariskan.en: The instructor wants to pass down her family's rendang recipe to her students.
w|mewariskan.ko: 그 강사는 집안의 른당 요리법을 학생들에게 물려주고 싶어 해요.

w|mewariskan.text: Nenek Dewi ingin mewariskan kalung emasnya kepada cucu perempuan pertama.
w|mewariskan.en: Dewi's grandmother wants to pass down her gold necklace to her first granddaughter.
w|mewariskan.ko: 데위의 할머니는 금목걸이를 첫 손녀에게 물려주고 싶어 하세요.

w|mewawancarai.text: Wartawan lokal mewawancarai Bayu tentang kondisi kerja di pabrik.
w|mewawancarai.en: A local journalist interviewed Bayu about working conditions at the factory.
w|mewawancarai.ko: 지역 기자가 공장 근무 환경에 대해 바유를 인터뷰했어요.

w|mewawancarai.text: Seorang reporter mewawancarai Intan tentang keterlambatan penerbangan.
w|mewawancarai.en: A reporter interviewed Intan about the flight delay.
w|mewawancarai.ko: 한 기자가 항공편 지연에 대해 인탄을 인터뷰했어요.

w|mewujudkan.text: Agus bekerja keras untuk mewujudkan taman bermain di setiap kelurahan.
w|mewujudkan.en: Agus works hard to make a playground in every urban ward a reality.
w|mewujudkan.ko: 아구스는 동마다 놀이터를 만들려고 열심히 일해요.

w|mewujudkan.text: Wati berlatih setiap hari untuk mewujudkan mimpinya bermain di orkestra.
w|mewujudkan.en: Wati practices every day to make her dream of playing in an orchestra come true.
w|mewujudkan.ko: 와티는 오케스트라에서 연주하는 꿈을 이루려고 매일 연습해요.

w|meyakini.text: Orang tua di desa Budi meyakini suara katak adalah tanda hujan akan turun.
w|meyakini.en: Elders in Budi's village believe the sound of frogs is a sign that rain is coming.
w|meyakini.ko: 부디네 마을 어르신들은 개구리 소리가 비 올 징조라고 믿어요.

w|meyakini.text: Siti meyakini film ini akan disukai penonton muda.
w|meyakini.en: Siti is convinced this film will be liked by young audiences.
w|meyakini.ko: 시티는 이 영화가 젊은 관객에게 사랑받을 거라고 믿어요.

w|meyakinkan.en: He managed to convince the team.

w|mie.text: Saat istirahat siang, Fajar makan mie ayam di warung sebelah.
w|mie.en: At lunch break, Fajar eats chicken noodles at the stall next door.
w|mie.ko: 점심시간에 파자르는 옆 노점에서 닭고기 국수를 먹어요.

w|mie.text: Lestari menghindari mie instan selama masa latihan.
w|mie.en: Lestari avoids instant noodles during training.

w|mikrofon.text: Sebelum tirai dibuka, kru memasang mikrofon kecil di kerah baju Eko.
w|mikrofon.en: Before the curtain opened, the crew attached a small microphone to Eko's collar.
w|mikrofon.ko: 막이 오르기 전에 스태프가 에코의 옷깃에 작은 마이크를 달았어요.

w|mikrofon.text: Anak-anak suka meminjam mikrofon mainan yang dijual di toko Ayu.
w|mikrofon.en: The kids like to borrow the toy microphone sold in Ayu's shop.
w|mikrofon.ko: 아이들은 아유 가게에서 파는 장난감 마이크를 빌려 놀기 좋아해요.

w|miliar.text: Investasi itu bernilai beberapa miliar rupiah.
w|miliar.en: That investment is worth several billion rupiah.

w|miliar.text: Miliar orang menonton siaran langsung itu.
w|miliar.en: Billions of people watched that live broadcast.

w|miliaran.text: Dalam drama itu, si pedagang serakah bermimpi punya harta miliaran rupiah.
w|miliaran.en: In the play, the greedy merchant dreams of having billions of rupiah.
w|miliaran.ko: 그 연극에서 욕심 많은 상인은 수십억 루피아의 재산을 꿈꿔요.

w|miliaran.text: Ayu heran ada orang yang mau menghabiskan miliaran rupiah hanya untuk membangun minimarket.
w|miliaran.en: Ayu is amazed that people would spend billions of rupiah just to build a minimarket.
w|miliaran.ko: 아유는 편의점 하나 짓는 데 수십억 루피아를 쓰는 사람들이 신기해요.

w|milik.en: That house belongs to his family.

w|militer.en: The military is ready to move.

w|mimpi.text: Aku punya mimpi aneh tadi malam.
w|mimpi.en: I had a weird dream last night.

w|minggir.en: Move aside for a sec, okay?

w|minuman.en: What drink do you want to order?

w|minyak.en: Add a little oil to the pan.
The cooking oil is almost gone.

w|mirip.en: Your face looks like your mom's.

w|misalnya.text: Ambil buah, misalnya apel atau pisang.
w|misalnya.en: Take fruit, for example an apple or a banana.
w|misalnya.ko: 과일 좀 먹어, 예를 들면 사과나 바나나.

w|misalnya.text: Misalnya kamu terlambat, telepon saja dulu.
w|misalnya.en: For example if you are late, just call first.
w|misalnya.ko: 예를 들어 늦으면 먼저 전화만 해.

w|misi.en: We finished carrying out the mission.

w|misil.text: Di pelajaran sejarah, Agus membaca tentang perlombaan misil di masa Perang Dingin.
w|misil.en: In history class, Agus read about the missile race during the Cold War.
w|misil.ko: 역사 시간에 아구스는 냉전 시대 미사일 경쟁에 대해 읽었어요.

w|misil.text: Adik Wati punya pistol air berbentuk misil yang bisa menembak jauh.
w|misil.en: Wati's brother has a missile-shaped water gun that shoots far.
w|misil.ko: 와티의 동생은 멀리 쏘는 미사일 모양 물총을 갖고 있어요.

w|miskin.text: Keluarga miskin itu tetap saling mendukung.
w|miskin.en: That poor family still supports each other.
w|miskin.ko: 그 가난한 가족은 그래도 서로 도와.

w|miskin.text: Dia tumbuh di lingkungan yang miskin.
w|miskin.en: He grew up in a poor environment.

w|misteri.text: Misteri itu belum terpecahkan sampai sekarang.
w|misteri.en: That mystery has not been solved until now.
This mystery film makes me curious.
w|misteri.ko: 이 미스터리 영화가 나를 궁금하게 해.

w|misterius.en: A mysterious sound came from the attic.

w|misterius.text: Dia menerima surat misterius tadi malam.
w|misterius.en: She received a mysterious letter last night.
w|misterius.ko: 그는 어젯밤 수수께끼 같은 편지를 받았어.

w|mitos.text: Dimas membaca kumpulan mitos dari seluruh Nusantara.
w|mitos.en: Dimas read a collection of myths from across the archipelago.
w|mitos.ko: 디마스는 누산타라 곳곳의 신화 모음집을 읽었어요.

w|mitos.text: Penjaga warung di stasiun bercerita tentang mitos hantu di terowongan tua.
w|mitos.en: The stall keeper at the station told a myth about a ghost in the old tunnel.
w|mitos.ko: 역 매점 주인은 옛 터널에 귀신이 있다는 전설을 들려줬어요.

w|modern.ko: 그 현대적인 건물이 도심에 서 있어.

w|modern.en: This kitchen design feels very modern.

w|mogok.ko: 옆 공장 노동자들이 임금 인상을 요구하며 사흘 동안 파업했어요.

w|molekul.text: Sambil menyeduh kopi, Dimas menjelaskan kepada Rudi bahwa molekul air bergerak lebih cepat saat dipanaskan.
w|molekul.en: While brewing coffee, Dimas explained to Rudi that water molecules move faster when heated.
w|molekul.ko: 커피를 내리면서 디마스는 루디에게 물 분자가 데워지면 더 빨리 움직인다고 설명했어요.

w|molekul.text: Rina merasa setiap molekul di tubuhnya ikut bergetar saat bas berdentum.
w|molekul.en: Rina felt every molecule in her body vibrate when the bass boomed.
w|molekul.ko: 베이스가 쿵쿵 울릴 때 리나는 몸의 분자 하나하나가 같이 떨리는 것 같았어요.

w|momen.en: That moment will always be remembered.

w|momen.text: Tunggu momen yang tepat untuk bicara.
w|momen.en: Wait for the right moment to speak.

w|monster.en: That child is afraid of monsters.
The monster in that movie is terrifying.

w|monyet.en: That monkey climbed a tall tree.
The kids laughed watching the monkey.

w|motel.text: Mereka bermalam di motel dekat jalan tol.
w|motel.en: They stayed overnight at a motel near the highway.
w|motel.ko: 그들은 고속도로 근처 모텔에서 하룻밤을 냈어.

w|motel.text: Motel itu bersih meski harganya murah.
w|motel.en: That motel is clean even though the price is low.

w|motif.en: The walls of the city hall auditorium are decorated with the region's distinctive batik motifs.
w|motif.ko: 시청 강당 벽은 지역 고유의 바틱 무늬로 꾸며져 있어요.

w|motif.en: The song Wati wrote is built on a simple melodic motif that repeats.
w|motif.ko: 와티가 만든 곡은 반복되는 단순한 선율 동기로 이루어져 있어요.

w|motor.text: Motor itu mogok di tengah jalan.
w|motor.en: That motorcycle broke down in the middle of the road.
w|motor.ko: 그 오토바이가 길 한가운데서 고장 났어.

w|motor.en: He goes to work by motorcycle.

w|muak.text: Aku sudah muak dengan alasan yang sama.
w|muak.en: I'm already sick of the same excuses.

w|muak.text: Dia merasa muak setelah makan terlalu banyak.
w|muak.en: He felt sick after eating too much.
w|muak.ko: 그는 너무 많이 먹은 뒤 속이 메스껐어.

w|mual.text: Bayu merasa mual karena minum susu protein terlalu cepat.
w|mual.en: Bayu felt nauseous from drinking his protein shake too fast.
w|mual.ko: 바유는 단백질 셰이크를 너무 빨리 마셔서 속이 메스꺼웠어요.

w|mual.en: Intan's younger sibling felt nauseous after smelling durian from the next table.
w|mual.ko: 인탄의 동생은 옆 테이블의 두리안 냄새를 맡고 속이 메스꺼웠어요.

w|muatan.text: Gerbong di belakang Dimas penuh muatan pupuk untuk petani.
w|muatan.en: The carriage behind Dimas was full of a load of fertilizer for farmers.
w|muatan.ko: 디마스 뒤 칸은 농민들에게 갈 비료 짐으로 가득했어요.

w|muatan.text: Sistem Putri bisa menghitung muatan truk agar tidak melebihi batas jalan.
w|muatan.en: Putri's system can calculate a truck's load so it doesn't exceed the road limit.
w|muatan.ko: 푸트리의 시스템은 트럭 적재량이 도로 한도를 넘지 않도록 계산할 수 있어요.

w|mudah-mudahan.text: Eko berharap mudah-mudahan nilai rapornya naik semester ini.
w|mudah-mudahan.en: Eko hopes his report card grades will go up this semester.
w|mudah-mudahan.ko: 에코는 이번 학기 성적이 오르기를 바라요.

w|mudah-mudahan.text: Kata Ayu, mudah-mudahan lukisannya terpilih untuk pameran bulan depan.
w|mudah-mudahan.en: Ayu said she hopes her painting will be chosen for next month's exhibition.
w|mudah-mudahan.ko: 아유는 다음 달 전시회에 자기 그림이 뽑혔으면 좋겠다고 했어요.

w|muka.text: Muka anak itu berseri setelah mendapat hadiah.
w|muka.en: That child's face lit up after getting a gift.
w|muka.ko: 그 아이 얼굴이 선물을 받고 환해졌어.

w|muka.en: She washed her face before sleeping.

w|mukjizat.text: Kata sutradara, pertunjukan bisa selesai tepat waktu itu sudah mukjizat.
w|mukjizat.en: The director said it was a miracle the show finished on time.
w|mukjizat.ko: 감독은 공연이 제시간에 끝난 것만 해도 기적이라고 말했어요.

w|mukjizat.text: Bisa bertahan di dekat minimarket besar terasa seperti mukjizat bagi toko Ayu.
w|mukjizat.en: Surviving near a big minimarket feels like a miracle for Ayu's shop.
w|mukjizat.ko: 큰 편의점 근처에서 버티는 게 아유의 가게에는 기적처럼 느껴져요.

w|mulus.text: Operasi pengangkatan tumor kecil pada anjing itu berjalan mulus.
w|mulus.en: The operation to remove a small tumor from the dog went smoothly.
w|mulus.ko: 그 개의 작은 종양 제거 수술은 순조롭게 끝났어요.

w|mulus.text: Jalan menuju desa Siti sekarang sudah mulus setelah diaspal.
w|mulus.en: The road to Siti's village is now smooth after being paved.
w|mulus.ko: 시티네 마을로 가는 길은 포장된 뒤로 이제 매끈해요.

w|mulut.en: Shut your mouth for a moment.
His mouth was full of food.

w|muncul.en: A new problem showed up again.

w|mundur.en: That car is backing up slowly.
We'd better step back for now.

w|mungkin.ko: 아마 그 사람 깜빡한 것 같아.

w|muntah.text: Anak itu muntah setelah makan terlalu cepat.
w|muntah.en: That child threw up after eating too fast.
w|muntah.ko: 그 아이는 너무 빨리 먹은 뒤 토했어.

w|muntah.text: Dia merasa ingin muntah di mobil.
w|muntah.en: He felt like throwing up in the car.
w|muntah.ko: 그는 차 안에서 토할 것 같았어.

w|murah.text: Harga buah di pasar sangat murah.

w|murahan.text: Tas murahan itu cepat rusak setelah dipakai.

w|murahan.text: Murahan bukan berarti kualitasnya selalu buruk.
w|murahan.en: Cheap does not always mean the quality is bad.
w|murahan.ko: 싸구려라고 해서 품질이 항상 나쁜 건 아니야.

w|murid.text: Murid baru duduk di bangku depan.
w|murid.en: The new student sat in the front seat.
The teacher helps students who struggle.

w|murka.text: Dalam legenda setempat, badai besar adalah tanda murka penguasa laut.
w|murka.en: In the local legend, a great storm is a sign of the sea ruler's wrath.

w|naif.en: Rudi is a bit naive for thinking all the guests came without being invited.

w|nakal.en: That child is very naughty today.
His behavior in class was so naughty.

w|naksir.en: Rudi's sister thought Rudi had a crush on her best friend, but he was only helping with coursework.

w|naksir.ko: 리나의 친구는 늘 인사해 주는 젊은 안전요원에게 반했어요.

w|naluri.ko: 오빠로서 부디는 동생 리나를 지키려는 본능이 있어요.

w|organik.en: The vegetables for this class are supplied by an organic farm on the edge of town.
w|organik.ko: 이 수업 채소는 도시 외곽의 유기농 농장에서 들어와요.

w|organik.text: Rani sekarang bekerja di pertanian organik dan mengirim foto sawahnya kepada Dewi.
w|organik.en: Rani now works on an organic farm and sent Dewi photos of her rice fields.
w|organik.ko: 라니는 지금 유기농 농장에서 일하고 데위에게 논 사진을 보냈어요.

w|organisme.text: Eko menunjukkan organisme kecil yang hidup di genangan air dekat tenda.
w|organisme.en: Eko pointed out tiny organisms living in a puddle near the tent.
w|organisme.ko: 에코는 텐트 옆 물웅덩이에 사는 작은 생물들을 보여 줬어요.

w|organisme.text: Pelatih Ayu bilang tubuh manusia adalah organisme yang bisa beradaptasi dengan latihan keras.
w|organisme.en: Ayu's coach said the human body is an organism that can adapt to hard training.
w|organisme.ko: 아유의 코치는 사람 몸이 힘든 훈련에 적응할 수 있는 유기체라고 했어요.

w|otak.en: The human brain is very complex.

w|otomatis.text: Sistem menyimpan data secara otomatis setiap malam.
w|otomatis.en: The system saves data automatically every night.
w|otomatis.ko: 시스템이 매일 밤 데이터를 자동으로 저장해.

w|otopsi.text: Di ruang ganti, dua anggota gym membahas film detektif tentang hasil otopsi yang dipalsukan.
w|otopsi.en: In the locker room, two gym members discuss a detective film about a faked autopsy result.
w|otopsi.ko: 탈의실에서 헬스장 회원 둘이 조작된 부검 결과를 다룬 탐정 영화 이야기를 해요.

w|otopsi.text: Sambil makan, paman Intan menceritakan novel misteri tentang dokter yang melakukan otopsi.
w|otopsi.en: While eating, Intan's uncle describes a mystery novel about a doctor who performs an autopsy.
w|otopsi.ko: 인탄의 삼촌은 밥을 먹으며 부검하는 의사가 나오는 추리 소설 이야기를 해요.

w|otoritas.text: Sekolah Andi harus mendapat izin dari otoritas pendidikan sebelum membuka kelas baru.
w|otoritas.en: Andi's school must get permission from the education authority before opening a new class.
w|otoritas.ko: 안디의 학교는 새 반을 열기 전에 교육 당국의 허가를 받아야 해요.

w|otoritas.text: Karena otoritas kota melarang pesta kembang api di dekat bandara, Dewi memilih taman lain.
w|otoritas.en: Because the city authority banned fireworks near the airport, Dewi chose a different park.
w|otoritas.ko: 시 당국이 공항 근처 불꽃놀이를 금지해서 데위는 다른 공원을 골랐어요.

w|otot.text: Otot kakinya sakit setelah berlari jauh.
w|otot.en: His leg muscles hurt after running far.
w|otot.ko: 멀리 뛴 뒤 다리 근육이 아팠어.

w|pabrik.en: He works at a textile factory.

w|pacaran.text: Mereka sudah pacaran selama dua tahun.
w|pacaran.en: They have been dating for two years.

w|pacaran.ko: 몰래 연애하는 게 그를 스트레스받게 했어.

w|padahal.text: Dia bilang sibuk, padahal sedang istirahat.
w|padahal.en: He said he was busy, even though he was resting.

w|padahal.text: Padahal hujan deras, mereka tetap berangkat.
w|padahal.en: Even though it poured, they still left.

w|padam.text: Listrik di sekolah Agus padam saat ujian berlangsung.
w|padam.en: The electricity at Agus's school went out during the exam.

w|padam.text: Lampu kolam renang tiba-tiba padam ketika Wati masih di dalam air.
w|padam.en: The pool lights suddenly went out while Wati was still in the water.
w|padam.ko: 와티가 아직 물속에 있을 때 수영장 불이 갑자기 꺼졌어요.

w|padang.en: The green field of grass stretched wide.

w|padang.text: Kuda berlari bebas di padang terbuka.
w|padang.en: Horses ran freely in the open field.

w|padat.text: Jadwal Bayu minggu ini sangat padat karena ada tiga pertunjukan.
w|padat.en: Bayu's schedule this week is very packed because there are three shows.
w|padat.ko: 이번 주에 공연이 세 번이나 있어서 바유의 일정이 아주 빡빡해요.

w|padat.text: Jalan menuju kantor Intan selalu padat pada jam berangkat kerja.
w|padat.en: The road to Intan's office is always congested at rush hour.
w|padat.ko: 인탄 회사로 가는 길은 출근 시간마다 늘 막혀요.

w|paduan.text: Andi ikut paduan suara sekolah karena suaranya cukup bagus.
w|paduan.en: Andi joined the school choir because his voice is pretty good.
w|paduan.ko: 안디는 목소리가 꽤 좋아서 학교 합창단에 들어갔어요.

w|paduan.text: Dewi menyukai paduan warna emas dan merah untuk hiasan meja.
w|paduan.en: Dewi likes the combination of gold and red for the table decorations.
w|paduan.ko: 데위는 식탁 장식에 금색과 빨간색 조합을 좋아해요.

w|pagar.text: Pagar kayu itu baru dicat putih.
w|pagar.en: That wooden fence was newly painted white.
w|pagar.ko: 그 나무 울타리가 새로 하얗게 칠해졌어.

w|pagar.en: The dog jumped over the fence behind the house.

w|pagi.en: This morning the air is cool.

w|paha.text: Pelatih menyuruh Bayu melatih otot paha dengan squat.
w|paha.en: The trainer told Bayu to train his thigh muscles with squats.
w|paha.ko: 트레이너는 바유에게 스쿼트로 허벅지 근육을 단련하라고 했어요.

w|paha.text: Anak Intan memilih ayam goreng bagian paha karena dagingnya empuk.
w|paha.en: Intan's child picks the fried chicken thigh because the meat is tender.
w|paha.ko: 인탄의 아이는 살이 연해서 닭다리 튀김을 골라요.

w|paham.en: Do you get what I mean?

w|pahit.text: Andi kaget karena saus buatannya terasa pahit akibat bawang putihnya gosong.
w|pahit.en: Andi was surprised that his sauce tasted bitter because the garlic had burned.
w|pahit.ko: 안디는 마늘이 타서 소스가 쓴맛이 나 깜짝 놀랐어요.

w|pahit.text: Dewi mengaku kopi tanpa gula masih terlalu pahit baginya.
w|pahit.en: Dewi admitted that coffee without sugar is still too bitter for her.
w|pahit.ko: 데위는 설탕 없는 커피가 아직 너무 쓰다고 털어놨어요.

w|pai.text: Kulit pai buatan Andi retak karena adonannya terlalu kering.
w|pai.en: The crust of Andi's pie cracked because the dough was too dry.
w|pai.ko: 반죽이 너무 말라서 안디가 만든 파이 껍질이 갈라졌어요.

w|pai.text: Dewi bercerita tentang pai apel pertama yang ia buat untuk ulang tahun ibunya.
w|pai.en: Dewi wrote about the first apple pie she made for her mother's birthday.
w|pai.ko: 데위는 어머니 생신에 처음 만든 사과 파이 얘기를 썼어요.

w|pajak.text: Dia membayar pajak sebelum batas waktu.
w|pajak.en: He paid the tax before the deadline.
The annual tax must be paid soon.

w|paket.text: Paket itu sampai di rumah pagi ini.
w|paket.en: That package arrived at home this morning.
w|paket.ko: 그 소포가 오늘 아침 집에 도착했어.

w|paket.text: Aku menunggu paket dari toko online.
w|paket.en: I'm waiting for a package from the online store.
w|paket.ko: 온라인 가게에서 온 소포를 기다리고 있어.

w|paksa.text: Jangan paksa anak jika dia takut.
w|paksa.en: Don't force the child if he is scared.

w|paku.text: Andi mencabut paku berkarat dari papan pintu yang lapuk.
w|paku.en: Andi pulled rusty nails out of the rotten door board.
w|paku.ko: 안디는 썩은 문짝에서 녹슨 못을 뽑았어요.

w|paku.text: Rok Dewi tersangkut paku kecil yang mencuat dari kursi kayu di stasiun.
w|paku.en: Dewi's skirt caught on a small nail sticking out of a wooden bench at the station.
w|paku.ko: 데위의 치마가 역 나무 의자에 튀어나온 작은 못에 걸렸어요.

w|palu.text: Eko meminjam palu dari nelayan untuk memperbaiki pintu pondok.
w|palu.en: Eko borrowed a hammer from a fisherman to fix the hut door.
w|palu.ko: 에코는 오두막 문을 고치려고 어부에게 망치를 빌렸어요.

w|palu.text: Suara palu dari rumah sebelah membangunkan Ayu pagi-pagi.
w|palu.en: The sound of a hammer from next door woke Ayu up early in the morning.
w|palu.ko: 옆집에서 들리는 망치 소리에 아유는 아침 일찍 깼어요.

w|paman.en: I'm staying at my uncle's house.

w|pamer.text: Sepupu Agus suka pamer ikan besar hasil pancingannya di media sosial.
w|pamer.en: Agus's cousin likes to show off the big fish he catches on social media.
w|pamer.ko: 아구스의 사촌은 낚은 큰 물고기를 SNS에 자랑하는 걸 좋아해요.

w|pamer.text: Wati tidak suka pelanggan yang pamer tahu semua obat dari internet.
w|pamer.en: Wati doesn't like customers who show off knowing every medicine from the internet.
w|pamer.ko: 와티는 인터넷에서 본 걸로 약을 다 아는 척 뽐내는 손님이 싫어요.

w|pameran.text: Sekolah mengadakan pameran karya siswa di aula.
w|pameran.en: The school held an exhibition of student work in the hall.
w|pameran.ko: 학교가 강당에서 학생 작품 전시회를 열었어요.

w|pameran.text: Panitia memasang pameran foto masa sekolah di sepanjang koridor.
w|pameran.en: The committee set up an exhibition of school-day photos along the corridor.
w|pameran.ko: 준비위원회는 복도를 따라 학창 시절 사진 전시를 꾸몄어요.

w|panah.en: The arrow shot toward the target.

w|panah.text: Dia menarik tali busur dan melepaskan panah.
w|panah.en: He drew the bowstring and released an arrow.

w|panas.en: The weather is so hot today.

w|pandai.text: Pandai sekali dia menjawab pertanyaan sulit.
w|pandai.en: She is so clever at answering hard questions.
w|pandai.ko: 어려운 질문에 답하는 게 정말 능숙해.

w|pandai.en: That child is good at playing the piano.

w|pandang.text: Dari sini pandang ke laut sangat indah.
w|pandang.en: From here the view of the sea is very beautiful.

w|pandang.text: Pandang pertamanya terhadap proyek itu negatif.
w|pandang.en: His first view of that project was negative.

w|pandangan.text: Kami berbeda pandangan soal isu itu.
w|pandangan.en: We have different views on that issue.
w|pandangan.ko: 우리는 그 문제에 대해 견해가 달라.

w|panduan.text: Setiap murid baru menerima buku panduan berisi peraturan sekolah.
w|panduan.en: Every new student receives a handbook containing the school rules.
w|panduan.ko: 신입생은 모두 학교 규칙이 담긴 안내 책자를 받아요.

w|panduan.text: Rina membaca buku panduan merakit lemari dari toko mebel.
w|panduan.en: Rina read the wardrobe assembly guide from the furniture store.
w|panduan.ko: 리나는 가구점에서 받은 옷장 조립 설명서를 읽었어요.

w|panen.text: Setelah panen, keluarga Agus mengadakan syukuran di tepi hutan.
w|panen.en: After the harvest, Agus's family held a thanksgiving meal at the edge of the forest.
w|panen.ko: 추수가 끝나고 아구스네 가족은 숲 가장자리에서 감사 잔치를 열었어요.

w|panen.text: Saat musim panen, banyak petani datang membeli salep untuk tangan yang lecet.
w|panen.en: During harvest season, many farmers come to buy ointment for chafed hands.
w|panen.ko: 추수철이면 손이 까진 농부들이 연고를 사러 많이 와요.

w|panggang.text: Ibu membuat ayam panggang untuk makan malam.
w|panggang.en: Mom made roast chicken for dinner.
Toast the bread until it turns brown.

w|panggung.text: Penyanyi naik ke panggung dengan tenang.
w|panggung.en: The singer stepped onto the stage calmly.
That stage is decorated with beautiful lights.
w|panggung.ko: 그 무대는 예쁜 조명으로 꾸며져 있어.

w|pangkalan.en: That military base is tightly guarded.
w|pangkalan.ko: 그 군사 기지는 厳重히 경비돼.

w|pangkalan.text: Kapal kembali ke pangkalan setelah misi.
w|pangkalan.en: The ship returned to base after the mission.

w|pangkat.text: Di dapur itu, pangkat Fajar masih juru masak junior.
w|pangkat.en: In that kitchen, Fajar's rank is still junior cook.
w|pangkat.ko: 그 주방에서 파자르의 직급은 아직 막내 요리사예요.

w|pangkat.text: Lencana pangkat tentara zaman dulu dijual bersama seragamnya di ujung pasar.
w|pangkat.en: Old army rank badges are sold along with uniforms at the end of the market.
w|pangkat.ko: 시장 끝에서는 옛 군대 계급장이 군복과 함께 팔려요.

w|panglima.text: Untuk tugas sejarah, Dimas menulis biografi seorang panglima perang kemerdekaan.
w|panglima.en: For a history assignment, Dimas wrote a biography of a commander in the war of independence.
w|panglima.ko: 역사 과제로 디마스는 독립 전쟁 사령관의 전기를 썼어요.

w|panglima.text: Kakek Putri adalah juru masak pribadi seorang panglima tentara pada masa muda.
w|panglima.en: In his youth, Putri's grandfather was the personal cook of an army commander.
w|panglima.ko: 푸트리의 할아버지는 젊었을 때 한 군 사령관의 전속 요리사였어요.

w|panik.en: Don't panic when an earthquake hits.

w|pantai.en: We're going to the beach tomorrow.

w|pantas.en: She deserves to get a gift.

w|panti.text: Mereka menyumbang ke panti asuhan setempat.
w|panti.en: They donated to the local orphanage.

w|panti.text: Panti lansia itu butuh lebih banyak relawan.
w|panti.en: That nursing home needs more volunteers.

w|papa.text: Papa pulang kerja lebih awal hari ini.
w|papa.en: Dad came home from work earlier today.
w|papa.ko: 아빠가 오늘 일을 일찍 마치고 왔어.

w|papa.text: Aku menelepon papa untuk minta saran.
w|papa.en: I called dad to ask for advice.

w|papan.en: The teacher writes notes on the board.

w|papan.text: Papan itu sudah retak di tengah.
w|papan.en: That board is already cracked in the middle.

w|parah.en: His condition is getting worse today.
The damage after the storm was so severe.

w|parasit.text: Agus melihat tanaman parasit menempel di batang pohon tua.
w|parasit.en: Agus saw a parasitic plant clinging to the trunk of an old tree.
w|parasit.ko: 아구스는 고목 줄기에 붙어 있는 기생 식물을 봤어요.

w|parasit.text: Wati memberikan obat cacing untuk anak yang terkena parasit usus.
w|parasit.en: Wati gave deworming medicine for a child with an intestinal parasite.
w|parasit.ko: 와티는 장 기생충에 걸린 아이에게 구충제를 줬어요.

w|parasut.text: Dari jendela kereta, Dimas melihat orang terjun dengan parasut di atas pantai.
w|parasut.en: From the train window, Dimas saw people skydiving with parachutes over the beach.
w|parasut.ko: 기차 창밖으로 디마스는 해변 위에서 낙하산을 타고 내려오는 사람들을 봤어요.

w|parasut.text: Dalam presentasi, Putri menyebut cadangan data sebagai parasut kalau server tiba-tiba rusak.
w|parasut.en: In the presentation, Putri called data backups a parachute in case the server suddenly breaks.
w|parasut.ko: 발표에서 푸트리는 데이터 백업을 서버가 갑자기 고장 날 때의 낙하산이라고 불렀어요.

w|parfum.text: Bayu menemukan botol parfum antik berbentuk burung di sebuah lapak.
w|parfum.en: Bayu found an antique bird-shaped perfume bottle at one of the stalls.
w|parfum.ko: 바유는 한 노점에서 새 모양의 골동품 향수병을 찾았어요.

w|parfum.text: Aroma parfum melati Intan tercium sampai ke ujung ruangan.
w|parfum.en: The scent of Intan's jasmine perfume could be smelled all the way to the end of the room.
w|parfum.ko: 인탄의 재스민 향수 냄새가 방 끝까지 퍼졌어요.

w|parit.text: Air hujan semalam mengalir deras di parit sekitar tenda Rudi.
w|parit.en: Last night's rainwater rushed through the ditch around Rudi's tent.
w|parit.ko: 어젯밤 빗물이 루디의 텐트 주위 도랑으로 세차게 흘렀어요.

w|parit.text: Hujan deras membuat parit di sekitar lapangan konser meluap.
w|parit.en: Heavy rain made the ditch around the concert field overflow.
w|parit.ko: 폭우 때문에 공연장 주변 도랑이 넘쳤어요.

w|parkir.text: Parkir di sini hanya untuk pelanggan.
w|parkir.en: Parking here is only for customers.

w|parkir.text: Sulit mencari tempat parkir sore ini.
w|parkir.en: It is hard to find a parking spot this afternoon.
w|parkir.ko: 오늘 오후에는 주차 자리를 찾기 힘들어.

w|parlemen.text: Bayu harus menunggu di gedung parlemen sampai sidang selesai malam hari.
w|parlemen.en: Bayu had to wait in the parliament building until the session ended at night.
w|parlemen.ko: 바유는 회의가 밤에 끝날 때까지 국회 건물에서 기다려야 했어요.

w|parlemen.text: Intan diundang ke parlemen untuk berbicara tentang perlindungan data pribadi.
w|parlemen.en: Intan was invited to parliament to talk about personal data protection.
w|parlemen.ko: 인탄은 개인 정보 보호에 관해 발표하러 국회에 초대받았어요.

w|partai.en: That party won the local election.

w|partikel.text: Sinar matahari pagi membuat partikel debu di hutan terlihat berkilau.
w|partikel.en: The morning sunlight makes the dust particles in the forest glitter.
w|partikel.ko: 아침 햇살에 숲속 먼지 알갱이가 반짝여 보여요.

w|partikel.text: Wati menyarankan masker untuk melindungi diri dari partikel asap kebakaran hutan.
w|partikel.en: Wati recommends masks to protect against smoke particles from forest fires.
w|partikel.ko: 와티는 산불 연기 입자를 막으려면 마스크를 쓰라고 권해요.

w|partner.text: Rudi sudah sepuluh tahun bekerja bersama partner yang sama di lapangan.
w|partner.en: Rudi has worked with the same partner on site for ten years.
w|partner.ko: 루디는 현장에서 같은 동료와 십 년째 함께 일해요.

w|partner.text: Manajer memperkenalkan Rina kepada partner bisnis dari Singapura.
w|partner.en: The manager introduced Rina to a business partner from Singapore.
w|partner.ko: 매니저가 싱가포르에서 온 사업 파트너에게 리나를 소개했어요.

w|paruh.text: Budi bekerja paruh waktu di toko buku dekat sekolah.
w|paruh.en: Budi works part-time at a bookshop near the school.
w|paruh.ko: 부디는 학교 근처 서점에서 아르바이트를 해요.

w|paruh.text: Sebagian besar teman Siti kini sudah memasuki usia paruh baya.
w|paruh.en: Most of Siti's friends are now entering middle age.
