w|penutupan.ko: 주민들은 산사태로 시내 가는 길이 막혀 실망했어요.

w|penyair.text: Seorang penyair membacakan puisi cinta untuk kedua mempelai.
w|penyair.en: A poet recited a love poem for the bride and groom.
w|penyair.ko: 한 시인이 신랑 신부를 위해 사랑 시를 낭송했어요.

w|penyair.text: Lestari suka membaca puisi seorang penyair tentang hujan bulan Juni.
w|penyair.en: Lestari likes reading a poet's poem about June rain.
w|penyair.ko: 레스타리는 유월의 비에 관한 어느 시인의 시를 즐겨 읽어요.

w|penyamaran.text: Dalam drama kelas, Budi berperan sebagai detektif dalam penyamaran.
w|penyamaran.en: In the class play, Budi plays a detective in disguise.
w|penyamaran.ko: 반 연극에서 부디는 변장한 탐정 역을 맡았어요.

w|penyamaran.text: Salah satu alumni datang dengan penyamaran sebagai pelayan untuk mengejutkan teman-temannya.
w|penyamaran.en: One of the alumni came disguised as a waiter to surprise his friends.
w|penyamaran.ko: 동문 한 명이 친구들을 놀래 주려고 웨이터로 변장하고 왔어요.

w|penyanyi.en: That singer performed my favorite song.
w|penyanyi.ko: 그 가수가 내가 좋아하는 노래를 불렀어.

w|penyanyi.en: She wants to become a famous singer.

w|penyebab.en: The cause of the accident is still being investigated by police.
w|penyebab.ko: 사고 원인은 아직 경찰이 조사 중이야.

w|penyebab.text: Stres menjadi penyebab utama sakit kepalanya.
w|penyebab.en: Stress became the main cause of her headache.

w|penyebaran.text: Lakon itu mengisahkan penyebaran kabar bohong di sebuah kampung kecil.
w|penyebaran.en: The play tells of the spread of a false rumor in a small village.
w|penyebaran.ko: 그 연극은 작은 마을에 거짓 소문이 퍼지는 이야기예요.

w|penyebaran.text: Petugas kesehatan berusaha mencegah penyebaran demam berdarah di desa.
w|penyebaran.en: Health workers are trying to prevent the spread of dengue fever in the village.
w|penyebaran.ko: 보건 요원들이 마을에 뎅기열이 퍼지는 걸 막으려고 애써요.

w|penyelamat.text: Penyelamat itu menarik korban dari sungai.
w|penyelamat.en: That rescuer pulled the victim from the river.
He is considered the team's savior.

w|penyelamatan.text: Pak Agus menerima penghargaan atas penyelamatan anak yang hanyut di sungai.
w|penyelamatan.en: Mr. Agus received an award for rescuing a child swept away in the river.
w|penyelamatan.ko: 아구스 경관은 강에 떠내려간 아이를 구한 공로로 상을 받았어요.

w|penyelamatan.text: Blok Dewi di detik terakhir menjadi penyelamatan penting bagi tim.
w|penyelamatan.en: Dewi's block in the final seconds was an important save for the team.
w|penyelamatan.ko: 마지막 몇 초에 나온 데위의 블록이 팀을 살렸어요.

w|penyelesaian.text: Target penyelesaian gedung itu mundur dua bulan karena hujan terus-menerus.
w|penyelesaian.en: The target completion date for the building was pushed back two months because of constant rain.
w|penyelesaian.ko: 계속 내린 비 때문에 그 건물의 완공 목표가 두 달 늦춰졌어요.

w|penyelesaian.text: Wati menunggu penyelesaian keluhannya sebelum memesan lagi dari toko itu.
w|penyelesaian.en: Wati is waiting for her complaint to be resolved before ordering from that shop again.
w|penyelesaian.ko: 와티는 그 가게에서 다시 주문하기 전에 불만 처리가 끝나길 기다리고 있어요.

w|penyelidikan.en: The police opened a new investigation.

w|penyelundup.text: Dalam drama itu, Eko berperan sebagai penyelundup yang membawa barang lewat pelabuhan.
w|penyelundup.en: In the play, Eko plays a smuggler who brings goods through the port.
w|penyelundup.ko: 그 연극에서 에코는 항구로 물건을 몰래 들여오는 밀수꾼 역을 해요.

w|penyelundup.text: Berita di televisi toko Ayu melaporkan penyelundup narkoba yang tertangkap di pelabuhan.
w|penyelundup.en: The news on the TV in Ayu's shop reported a drug smuggler caught at the port.
w|penyelundup.ko: 아유 가게 TV 뉴스에서 항구에서 붙잡힌 마약 밀수범 소식을 전했어요.

w|penyembuhan.text: Setelah cedera, Bayu menjalani proses penyembuhan selama dua bulan.
w|penyembuhan.en: After the injury, Bayu went through a two-month healing process.
w|penyembuhan.ko: 부상 후 바유는 두 달 동안 치료 과정을 거쳤어요.

w|penyembuhan.text: Keluarga Intan berdoa untuk penyembuhan paman yang masih dirawat.
w|penyembuhan.en: Intan's family prays for the recovery of the uncle who is still in hospital.
w|penyembuhan.ko: 인탄의 가족은 아직 입원 중인 삼촌이 낫기를 기도해요.

w|penyerang.text: Di tim sepak bola sekolah, Andi bermain sebagai penyerang.
w|penyerang.en: On the school football team, Andi plays as a striker.

w|penyerang.text: Adik Dewi pura-pura jadi penyerang dalam main bola di halaman.
w|penyerang.en: Dewi's brother pretended to be a striker in a football game in the yard.
w|penyerang.ko: 데위의 동생은 마당 공놀이에서 공격수 흉내를 냈어요.

w|penyerangan.en: That night attack shocked the residents.
w|penyerangan.ko: 그날 밤 공격이 주민들을 놀라게 했어.

w|penyerangan.en: The defense team was ready to face an assault.

w|penyergapan.text: Novel perang yang dipinjam Andi dibuka dengan penyergapan di hutan.
w|penyergapan.en: The war novel Andi borrowed opens with an ambush in the forest.
w|penyergapan.ko: 안디가 빌린 전쟁 소설은 숲속 매복 장면으로 시작해요.

w|penyergapan.text: Dewi menonton film aksi tentang penyergapan kapal penyelundup setelah pulang kerja.
w|penyergapan.en: After work, Dewi watched an action film about an ambush on a smugglers' ship.
w|penyergapan.ko: 디위는 퇴근 후 밀수선 매복 작전을 다룬 액션 영화를 봤어요.

w|penyesalan.text: Ada sedikit penyesalan karena Rudi jarang membalas surat Bayu dulu.
w|penyesalan.en: There is a little regret because Rudi rarely answered Bayu's letters in the past.
w|penyesalan.ko: 루디가 예전에 바유의 편지에 거의 답하지 않아서 조금 후회가 남아요.

w|penyesalan.text: Rina tidak mau ada penyesalan, jadi dia menguji fitur itu sekali lagi.
w|penyesalan.en: Rina didn't want any regrets, so she tested the feature once more.
w|penyesalan.ko: 리나는 후회하고 싶지 않아서 그 기능을 한 번 더 시험했어요.

w|penyidik.text: Eko memerankan seorang penyidik yang sabar dalam drama detektif itu.
w|penyidik.en: Eko plays a patient investigator in the detective play.
w|penyidik.ko: 에코는 그 탐정극에서 침착한 수사관 역을 맡았어요.

w|penyidik.text: Seorang penyidik datang ke toko Ayu untuk melihat rekaman kamera.
w|penyidik.en: An investigator came to Ayu's shop to look at the camera footage.
w|penyidik.ko: 수사관 한 명이 카메라 영상을 보러 아유의 가게에 왔어요.

w|penyihir.en: The children are afraid of the witch.

w|penyiksaan.text: Buku sejarah Andi membahas penyiksaan tahanan politik pada zaman penjajahan.
w|penyiksaan.en: Andi's history book discusses the torture of political prisoners during the colonial era.
w|penyiksaan.ko: 안디의 역사책은 식민지 시대 정치범 고문을 다뤄요.

w|penyiksaan.text: Dokter forensik menemukan bekas penyiksaan pada tubuh korban, menurut laporan polisi.
w|penyiksaan.en: According to the police report, the forensic doctor found signs of torture on the victim's body.
w|penyiksaan.ko: 경찰 보고서에 따르면 법의학 의사가 피해자 몸에서 고문 흔적을 발견했어요.

w|penyimpanan.text: Penyimpanan data di cloud sangat praktis.
w|penyimpanan.en: Data storage in the cloud is very practical.

w|penyimpanan.text: Ruang penyimpanan di gudang hampir penuh.
w|penyimpanan.en: The storage space in the warehouse is almost full.
w|penyimpanan.ko: 창고 보관 공간이 거의 가득 찼어.

w|penyusup.text: Satpam sekolah menangkap seorang penyusup yang memanjat pagar belakang.
w|penyusup.en: The school security guard caught an intruder climbing the back fence.
w|penyusup.ko: 학교 경비원이 뒷담을 넘던 침입자를 붙잡았어요.

w|penyusup.text: Satpam rumah sakit memeriksa rekaman kamera setelah ada laporan penyusup di lantai tiga.
w|penyusup.en: Hospital security checked the camera footage after a report of an intruder on the third floor.
w|penyusup.ko: 삼 층에 침입자가 있다는 신고가 들어와 병원 경비원이 카메라 영상을 확인했어요.

w|pepatah.text: Bu Guru menulis pepatah “rajin pangkal pandai” di papan tulis kelas Agus.
w|pepatah.en: The teacher wrote the proverb "diligence is the root of cleverness" on the board in Agus's class.
w|pepatah.ko: 선생님은 아구스네 반 칠판에 "부지런함이 똑똑함의 뿌리"라는 속담을 썼어요.

w|pepatah.text: Pelatih Wati sering mengutip pepatah “sedikit demi sedikit, lama-lama menjadi bukit”.
w|pepatah.en: Wati's coach often quotes the proverb "little by little, it becomes a hill."
w|pepatah.ko: 와티의 코치는 "티끌 모아 태산"이라는 속담을 자주 인용해요.

w|peperangan.en: History records a long period of warfare.

w|pepohonan.text: Agus suka berjalan di bawah pepohonan rindang saat siang terik.
w|pepohonan.en: Agus likes walking under the shady trees in the blazing midday heat.
w|pepohonan.ko: 아구스는 땡볕이 드는 한낮에 우거진 나무 아래를 걷는 걸 좋아해요.

w|pepohonan.text: Apotek tempat Wati bekerja dikelilingi pepohonan, jadi udaranya sejuk.
w|pepohonan.en: The pharmacy where Wati works is surrounded by trees, so the air is cool.
w|pepohonan.ko: 와티가 일하는 약국은 나무로 둘러싸여 있어서 공기가 시원해요.

w|per.en: The ticket price is cheap per person.

w|per.text: Per hari dia minum banyak air.
w|per.en: Per day he drinks a lot of water.

w|peradaban.en: Ancient civilization left many relics behind.

w|peradaban.text: Buku itu membahas sejarah peradaban dunia.
w|peradaban.en: That book discusses the history of world civilization.

w|perahu.en: A small boat is floating on the lake.
w|perahu.ko: 작은 배가 호수 위에 떠 있어.

w|perahu.en: The fisherman repairs the boat before sailing.

w|perairan.text: Agus dilarang memancing di perairan dekat bendungan karena arusnya deras.
w|perairan.en: Agus isn't allowed to fish in the waters near the dam because the current is strong.
w|perairan.ko: 아구스는 물살이 세서 댐 근처 물에서 낚시하면 안 돼요.

w|perairan.text: Wati menyarankan obat antimabuk kepada pelanggan yang akan menyeberangi perairan berombak.
w|perairan.en: Wati recommends seasickness pills to a customer about to cross choppy waters.
w|perairan.ko: 와티는 파도 높은 바다를 건널 손님에게 멀미약을 권했어요.

w|peralatan.en: The new kitchen equipment has arrived.
Bring all the hiking equipment tomorrow.

w|peramal.text: Bibi Rudi bercanda bahwa seorang peramal sudah menebak jodoh pengantin wanita.
w|peramal.en: Rudi's aunt joked that a fortune-teller had already guessed the bride's match.
w|peramal.ko: 루디의 이모는 점쟁이가 신부의 짝을 벌써 맞혔다고 농담했어요.

w|peramal.text: Rina menulis artikel ringan tentang peramal cuaca tradisional di desa nelayan.
w|peramal.en: Rina wrote a light article about traditional weather forecasters in a fishing village.
w|peramal.ko: 리나는 어촌의 전통 날씨 점쟁이에 대한 가벼운 기사를 썼어요.

w|perampok.en: That robber was successfully caught by the police.

w|perampok.text: Warga melaporkan perampok yang kabur ke hutan.
w|perampok.en: Residents reported a robber who fled into the forest.

w|perampokan.text: Perampokan itu terjadi di tengah malam.
w|perampokan.en: That robbery happened in the middle of the night.
The police are investigating the robbery case.

w|peran.text: Dia mendapat peran penting dalam film.
w|peran.en: She got an important role in the film.

w|peran.text: Setiap orang punya peran di tim.
w|peran.en: Everyone has a role on the team.

w|perangkap.en: A mouse trap was set in the kitchen.

w|perangkap.text: Hewan itu masuk perangkap tanpa sadar.
w|perangkap.en: That animal entered the trap without noticing.

w|perangkat.en: The technician repaired that broken device.

w|perapian.text: Agus iri melihat unit penthouse yang punya perapian listrik.
w|perapian.en: Agus is envious of the penthouse unit that has an electric fireplace.
w|perapian.ko: 아구스는 전기 벽난로가 있는 펜트하우스가 부러워요.

w|perapian.text: Saat menginap di vila pegunungan, Wati duduk dekat perapian karena malam sangat dingin.
w|perapian.en: While staying at a mountain villa, Wati sat near the fireplace because the night was very cold.
w|perapian.ko: 산속 별장에 묵을 때 밤이 너무 추워서 와티는 벽난로 옆에 앉았어요.

w|peraturan.text: Peraturan baru mulai berlaku bulan depan.
w|peraturan.en: The new rules take effect next month.

w|perawan.text: Hutan perawan itu masih belum dijelajahi.
w|perawan.en: That virgin forest has not yet been explored.

w|perawan.text: Pulau perawan tampak tenang dari kapal.
w|perawan.en: The untouched island looked calm from the ship.
w|perawan.ko: 손때 안 묻은 섬이 배에서 고요해 보였어.

w|perawat.en: The nurse checked the patient's blood pressure.

w|perawat.text: Dia ingin menjadi perawat yang baik.
w|perawat.en: She wants to become a good nurse.

w|perawatan.en: Wound care must be done sterilely.

w|perayaan.text: Perayaan ulang tahun diadakan di taman.
w|perayaan.en: The birthday celebration was held in the park.

w|perayaan.text: Seluruh desa ikut dalam perayaan panen.
w|perayaan.en: The whole village joined the harvest celebration.

w|perbaikan.text: Sayap timur museum ditutup sementara untuk perbaikan atap.
w|perbaikan.en: The museum's east wing is temporarily closed for roof repairs.
w|perbaikan.ko: 박물관 동관은 지붕 보수 때문에 잠시 문을 닫았어요.

w|perbaikan.text: Setelah perbaikan saluran air, los daging tidak lagi becek.
w|perbaikan.en: After the drainage repairs, the meat section is no longer muddy.
w|perbaikan.ko: 배수로를 고친 뒤로 정육 구역이 더 이상 질척거리지 않아요.

w|perban.text: Budi mengganti perban di kaki anjing itu dua kali sehari.
w|perban.en: Budi changes the bandage on that dog's leg twice a day.
w|perban.ko: 부디는 그 개 다리의 붕대를 하루에 두 번 갈아요.

w|perban.text: Siti selalu membawa perban di tasnya saat naik ke kebun teh.
w|perban.en: Siti always carries a bandage in her bag when she climbs up to the tea garden.
w|perban.ko: 시티는 차밭에 올라갈 때 늘 가방에 붕대를 넣고 다녀요.

w|perbatasan.text: Perbatasan itu dijaga ketat setiap malam.
w|perbatasan.en: That border is tightly guarded every night.
w|perbatasan.ko: 그 국경은 매일 밤 삼엄하게 지켜져.

w|perbatasan.text: Kami tiba di perbatasan sebelum matahari terbenam.
w|perbatasan.en: We arrived at the border before sunset.
w|perbatasan.ko: 우리는 해 지기 전에 국경에 도착했어.

w|perbedaan.en: There is a big difference between the two.
Differences of opinion are natural in discussion.

w|perbuatan.en: Good deeds will be remembered by people.

w|perbudakan.text: Edisi khusus koran itu membahas sejarah perbudakan di perkebunan zaman kolonial.
w|perbudakan.en: The paper's special edition discussed the history of slavery on colonial-era plantations.
w|perbudakan.ko: 그 신문 특별판은 식민지 시대 농장의 노예제 역사를 다뤘어요.

w|perbudakan.text: Intan membaca buku sejarah tentang penghapusan perbudakan di abad kesembilan belas.
w|perbudakan.en: Intan read a history book about the abolition of slavery in the nineteenth century.
w|perbudakan.ko: 인탄은 십구 세기 노예제 폐지에 관한 역사책을 읽었어요.

w|perburuan.text: Banyak orang berlomba dalam perburuan diskon setiap tanggal kembar.
w|perburuan.en: Many people compete in the hunt for discounts on every double-date sale.
w|perburuan.ko: 많은 사람이 날짜와 달이 같은 날마다 할인을 찾아 경쟁해요.

w|perburuan.text: Guru bercerita tentang tradisi perburuan rusa di desanya pada zaman dulu.
w|perburuan.en: The teacher talked about the old deer-hunting tradition in her village.
w|perburuan.ko: 선생님은 예전에 자기 마을에 있던 사슴 사냥 전통을 이야기했어요.

w|percakapan.en: Their conversation could be heard from outside.

w|percakapan.text: Kami menikmati percakapan panjang malam itu.
w|percakapan.en: We enjoyed a long conversation that night.
w|percakapan.ko: 우리는 그날 밤 긴 대화를 즐겼어.

w|percaya.en: It's hard to believe that news.

w|perceraian.text: Rina pernah menulis skripsi tentang dampak perceraian pada anak.
w|perceraian.en: Rina once wrote her thesis on the effects of divorce on children.
w|perceraian.ko: 리나는 이혼이 아이에게 미치는 영향에 관한 졸업 논문을 쓴 적이 있어요.

w|perceraian.text: Pengacara yang menginap di hotel itu sedang mengurus kasus perceraian artis.
w|perceraian.en: The lawyer staying at the hotel is handling a celebrity's divorce case.
w|perceraian.ko: 그 호텔에 묵는 변호사는 한 연예인의 이혼 사건을 맡고 있어요.

w|percikan.text: Rudi memperhatikan percikan api unggun yang terbang ke langit malam.
w|percikan.en: Rudi watched the sparks from the campfire fly up into the night sky.
w|percikan.ko: 루디는 모닥불 불티가 밤하늘로 날아오르는 걸 바라봤어요.

w|percikan.text: Rina berteriak kegirangan melihat percikan kembang api di akhir lagu.
w|percikan.en: Rina screamed with joy at the burst of fireworks at the end of the song.
w|percikan.ko: 리나는 노래 끝에 터지는 불꽃을 보고 신나서 소리를 질렀어요.

w|percobaan.text: Percobaan ilmiah itu berhasil dengan baik.
Ini hanya percobaan pertama, jangan khawatir.
w|percobaan.en: This is only the first attempt, don't worry.
w|percobaan.ko: 이건 첫 시도일 뿐이니 걱정 마.

w|percuma.text: Kata dokter, sikat gigi keras-keras itu percuma kalau tidak pakai benang gigi.
w|percuma.en: The dentist said brushing hard is pointless if you don't floss.
w|percuma.ko: 의사는 치실을 안 쓰면 세게 양치해도 소용없다고 했어요.

w|percuma.text: Mengecat ulang tembok itu percuma kalau rembesan air belum diperbaiki.
w|percuma.en: Repainting the wall is pointless if the water seepage hasn't been fixed.
w|percuma.ko: 물이 새는 걸 고치지 않으면 벽을 다시 칠해도 소용없어요.

w|perdagangan.en: Trade between countries increased this year.

w|perdagangan.text: Dia bekerja di bidang perdagangan elektronik.

w|perdamaian.text: Mereka berjuang untuk perdamaian di dunia.
w|perdamaian.en: They fight for peace in the world.

w|perdamaian.text: Perdamaian dimulai dari hati yang terbuka.
w|perdamaian.en: Peace begins from an open heart.

w|perdana.en: Their premiere film was a big success.
The prime minister gave a short speech.

w|perdebatan.text: Setelah pertunjukan ada perdebatan seru antara penonton dan sutradara.
w|perdebatan.en: After the show there was a lively debate between the audience and the director.
w|perdebatan.ko: 공연이 끝난 뒤 관객과 연출가 사이에 뜨거운 토론이 있었어요.

w|perdebatan.text: Rapat desa diwarnai perdebatan soal letak pasar baru.
w|perdebatan.en: The village meeting was marked by debate over where to put the new market.
w|perdebatan.ko: 마을 회의에서는 새 시장 위치를 두고 논쟁이 벌어졌어요.

w|perempuan.en: There's a woman in the waiting room.

w|perencanaan.text: Kata Agus, perencanaan yang matang bisa menghemat banyak biaya proyek.
w|perencanaan.en: Agus says careful planning can save a lot of project costs.
w|perencanaan.ko: 아구스는 꼼꼼한 계획이 공사비를 많이 아껴 준다고 말해요.

w|perencanaan.text: Belanja bulanan Wati jadi lebih hemat berkat perencanaan yang rapi.
w|perencanaan.en: Wati's monthly shopping has become more economical thanks to neat planning.
w|perencanaan.ko: 와티의 월간 장보기는 꼼꼼한 계획 덕분에 더 알뜰해졌어요.

w|pergelangan.text: Dia memakai jam di pergelangan tangan kiri.
w|pergelangan.en: He wears a watch on his left wrist.

w|pergerakan.text: Untuk tugas sejarah, Dimas membaca tentang pergerakan pemuda pada masa kolonial.
w|pergerakan.en: For a history assignment, Dimas read about the youth movement in the colonial period.
w|pergerakan.ko: 역사 숙제로 디마스는 식민지 시대 청년 운동에 대해 읽었어요.

w|pergerakan.text: Putri merasakan pergerakan kereta yang halus saat melewati jembatan.
w|pergerakan.en: Putri felt the smooth movement of the train as it crossed the bridge.
w|pergerakan.ko: 푸트리는 다리를 건널 때 기차가 부드럽게 움직이는 걸 느꼈어요.

w|perguruan.text: Perguruan tinggi itu terkenal di kawasan ini.
w|perguruan.en: That college is well known in this region.

w|perguruan.text: Dia masuk perguruan seni tahun depan.
w|perguruan.en: She will enter an arts college next year.

w|perhiasan.text: Perhiasan emas itu disimpan di brankas.
w|perhiasan.en: That gold jewelry is kept in the safe.

w|perhiasan.text: Dia memakai perhiasan sederhana ke pesta.
w|perhiasan.en: She wore simple jewelry to the party.

w|perhitungan.text: Menurut perhitungan Fajar, putusan akan keluar minggu depan.
w|perhitungan.en: By Fajar's reckoning, the verdict will come out next week.
w|perhitungan.ko: 파자르의 계산으로는 판결이 다음 주에 나올 거예요.

w|perhitungan.text: Lestari mengecek ulang perhitungan uang kembalian dengan kalkulator.
w|perhitungan.en: Lestari double-checks the change calculation with a calculator.
w|perhitungan.ko: 레스타리는 거스름돈 계산을 계산기로 다시 확인해요.

w|peri.text: Anak itu percaya pada peri hutan.
w|peri.en: That child believes in forest fairies.

w|peri.text: Peri dalam cerita itu sangat baik.
w|peri.en: The fairy in that story is very kind.

w|perilaku.text: Perilaku baik dihargai di sekolah ini.
w|perilaku.en: Good behavior is valued at this school.

w|perilaku.text: Guru mengamati perilaku siswa di kelas.
w|perilaku.en: The teacher observes student behavior in class.

w|peringatan.en: That warning is written on the board.

w|peringkat.text: Kota Agus naik peringkat dalam daftar kota paling layak huni.
w|peringkat.en: Agus's city rose in the ranking of the most livable cities.
w|peringkat.ko: 아구스네 도시가 살기 좋은 도시 순위에서 올라갔어요.

w|peringkat.text: Wati masuk peringkat tiga besar dalam lomba piano antarsekolah.
w|peringkat.en: Wati made it into the top three in the interschool piano competition.
w|peringkat.ko: 와티는 학교 대항 피아노 대회에서 삼 등 안에 들었어요.

w|periode.text: Selama periode kemarau, Budi menanam kacang karena tidak butuh banyak air.
w|periode.en: During the dry period, Budi grows beans because they don't need much water.
w|periode.ko: 건기 동안 부디는 물이 많이 필요 없는 콩을 심어요.

w|periode.text: Selama periode syuting, Siti tinggal di losmen dekat lokasi.
w|periode.en: During the shooting period, Siti stays at a guesthouse near the location.
w|periode.ko: 촬영 기간 동안 시티는 촬영지 근처 여관에 머물러요.

w|perisai.text: Polisi antihuru-hara berbaris dengan perisai di depan gedung DPRD.
w|perisai.en: Riot police lined up with shields in front of the regional parliament building.
w|perisai.ko: 진압 경찰이 지방의회 건물 앞에 방패를 들고 줄지어 섰어요.

w|perisai.text: Logo tim Dewi berbentuk perisai dengan gambar elang.
w|perisai.en: Dewi's team logo is shaped like a shield with an eagle on it.
w|perisai.ko: 데위네 팀 로고는 독수리가 그려진 방패 모양이에요.

w|peristiwa.en: That event changed his life forever.
w|peristiwa.ko: 그 사건이 그의 삶을 영원히 바꿨어.

w|peristiwa.text: Kami membahas peristiwa penting di kelas.
w|peristiwa.en: We discussed an important event in class.

w|perjanjian.en: That agreement takes effect starting tomorrow.

w|perjuangan.text: Eko menulis kisah perjuangan seorang ibu yang berjualan kue demi biaya kuliah anaknya.
w|perjuangan.en: Eko wrote the story of the struggle of a mother who sells cakes to pay for her child's college.
w|perjuangan.ko: 에코는 자식 대학 학비를 위해 과자를 파는 어머니의 분투를 기사로 썼어요.

w|perjuangan.text: Ayu ingat perjuangan awal membuka toko dengan modal pinjaman.
w|perjuangan.en: Ayu remembers the early struggle of opening the shop with borrowed money.
w|perjuangan.ko: 아유는 빌린 돈으로 가게를 열던 초창기의 고생을 기억해요.

w|perkara.text: Dimas membaca berkas perkara terkenal di bagian buku hukum.
w|perkara.en: Dimas read about a famous legal case in the law book section.
w|perkara.ko: 디마스는 법률서 코너에서 유명한 사건 기록을 읽었어요.

w|perkara.text: Penumpang di sebelah Putri adalah pengacara yang sedang membaca dokumen perkara.
w|perkara.en: The passenger next to Putri is a lawyer reading case documents.
w|perkara.ko: 푸트리 옆자리 승객은 사건 서류를 읽는 변호사예요.

w|perkasa.text: Tukang angkut beras yang perkasa itu memikul dua karung sekaligus ke gudang dapur.
w|perkasa.en: The mighty rice porter carried two sacks at once into the kitchen storeroom.
w|perkasa.ko: 힘센 쌀 배달꾼이 자루 두 개를 한꺼번에 주방 창고로 날랐어요.

w|perkasa.text: Patung kayu berbentuk kuda yang perkasa jadi barang termahal di lapak Lestari.
w|perkasa.en: A wooden statue of a mighty horse is the most expensive item at Lestari's stall.
w|perkasa.ko: 힘찬 말 모양의 나무 조각상이 레스타리 노점에서 가장 비싼 물건이에요.

w|perkataan.en: His harsh words hurt my feelings.
w|perkataan.ko: 그의 거친 말이 내 마음을 상하게 했어.

w|perkawinan.text: Paman Rudi bercerita bahwa perkawinan kakek dan neneknya dulu hanya dihadiri sepuluh orang.
w|perkawinan.en: Rudi's uncle said his grandparents' wedding was attended by only ten people.
w|perkawinan.ko: 루디의 삼촌은 할아버지 할머니 결혼식에 겨우 열 명이 왔었다고 했어요.

w|perkawinan.text: Rina menulis tentang aturan baru soal usia minimal perkawinan.
w|perkawinan.en: Rina wrote about the new rule on the minimum age of marriage.
w|perkawinan.ko: 리나는 혼인 최소 연령에 관한 새 규정에 대해 썼어요.

w|perkebunan.text: Jalan setapak menuju danau melewati perkebunan teh yang luas.
w|perkebunan.en: The footpath to the lake goes through a vast tea plantation.
w|perkebunan.ko: 호수로 가는 오솔길은 넓은 차 농장을 지나가요.

w|perkebunan.text: Konser itu diadakan di bekas perkebunan kopi yang kini jadi tempat wisata.
w|perkebunan.en: The concert was held on a former coffee plantation that is now a tourist spot.
w|perkebunan.ko: 그 공연은 지금은 관광지가 된 옛 커피 농장에서 열렸어요.

w|perkelahian.en: The fight on the street was quickly calmed.
The teacher prevented a fight between students.

w|perkemahan.text: Dari jendela kereta, Dimas melihat perkemahan pramuka di pinggir hutan.
w|perkemahan.en: From the train window, Dimas saw a scout camp at the edge of the forest.
w|perkemahan.ko: 기차 창밖으로 디마스는 숲 가장자리의 스카우트 야영지를 봤어요.

w|perkemahan.text: Putri pernah membuat aplikasi pemesanan tempat perkemahan untuk komunitas pendaki.
w|perkemahan.en: Putri once built a campsite booking app for a hiking community.
w|perkemahan.ko: 푸트리는 등산 동호회를 위한 야영장 예약 앱을 만든 적이 있어요.

w|perkembangan.en: Her child's development is very encouraging.

w|perkembangan.text: Mereka memantau perkembangan proyek tiap minggu.
w|perkembangan.en: They monitor the project's progress every week.

w|perkenalkan.text: Tolong perkenalkan diri Anda kepada tim baru.
w|perkenalkan.en: Please introduce yourself to the new team.

w|perkenalkan.text: Perkenalkan teman saya yang baru pindah ke sini.
w|perkenalkan.en: Let me introduce my friend who just moved here.
w|perkenalkan.ko: 여기로 막 이사 온 내 친구를 소개할게.

w|perkiraan.text: Ternyata perkiraan Andi soal hasil ujian terlalu optimis.
w|perkiraan.en: Andi's estimate of his exam results turned out to be too optimistic.
w|perkiraan.ko: 시험 결과에 대한 안디의 예상은 너무 낙관적이었어요.

w|perkiraan.text: Menurut perkiraan dokter, luka operasi Dewi akan sembuh dalam dua minggu.
w|perkiraan.en: By the doctor's estimate, Dewi's surgical wound will heal in two weeks.
w|perkiraan.ko: 의사의 예상으로는 데위의 수술 상처가 이 주 안에 나을 거예요.

w|perkumpulan.text: Eko ikut perkumpulan pencinta alam di sekolahnya.
w|perkumpulan.en: Eko joined the nature lovers' club at his school.
w|perkumpulan.ko: 에코는 학교 자연 애호 모임에 들어갔어요.

w|perkumpulan.text: Ibu Ayu ikut perkumpulan arisan di kompleks rumahnya.
w|perkumpulan.en: Ayu's mother is in a rotating savings group in her housing complex.
w|perkumpulan.ko: 아유의 어머니는 동네 계 모임에 나가요.

w|perlahan.text: Mobil bergerak perlahan di jalan licin.
w|perlahan.en: The car moves slowly on the slippery road.

w|perlahan.text: Perlahan dia membuka pintu tua itu.
w|perlahan.en: Slowly she opened that old door.
w|perlahan.ko: 그녀가 천천히 그 낡은 문을 열었어.

w|perlahan-lahan.text: Pintu tahanan dibuka perlahan-lahan oleh petugas jaga.
w|perlahan-lahan.en: The cell door was opened slowly by the guard on duty.
w|perlahan-lahan.ko: 당직 경관이 유치장 문을 천천히 열었어요.

w|perlahan-lahan.text: Setelah cedera lutut, Dewi kembali berlatih perlahan-lahan.
w|perlahan-lahan.en: After her knee injury, Dewi slowly went back to training.
w|perlahan-lahan.ko: 무릎을 다친 뒤 데위는 천천히 다시 훈련을 시작했어요.

w|perlakuan.text: Dimas protes karena merasa mendapat perlakuan tidak adil dari wasit.
w|perlakuan.en: Dimas protested because he felt he was treated unfairly by the referee.
w|perlakuan.ko: 디마스는 심판에게 부당한 대우를 받았다고 느껴서 항의했어요.

w|perlakuan.text: Semua tamu mendapat perlakuan ramah di restoran Putri, kaya atau miskin.
w|perlakuan.en: All guests get friendly treatment at Putri's restaurant, rich or poor.
w|perlakuan.ko: 푸트리네 식당에서는 부자든 가난하든 모든 손님이 친절한 대접을 받아요.

w|perlawanan.en: Residents' resistance stopped the construction plan.

w|perlawanan.text: Tim menunjukkan perlawanan keras sampai akhir.
w|perlawanan.en: The team showed tough resistance until the end.

w|perlengkapan.text: Ruang belajar menyediakan perlengkapan seperti stopkontak dan lampu meja.
w|perlengkapan.en: The study room provides equipment such as power outlets and desk lamps.
w|perlengkapan.ko: 열람실에는 콘센트와 책상 스탠드 같은 설비가 있어요.

w|perlengkapan.text: Putri membawa perlengkapan tidur kecil: bantal leher dan penutup mata.
w|perlengkapan.en: Putri brought a small sleeping kit: a neck pillow and an eye mask.
w|perlengkapan.ko: 푸트리는 목베개와 안대 같은 작은 수면 용품을 챙겼어요.

w|perlombaan.text: Kelompok teater Bayu memenangkan perlombaan drama tingkat provinsi.
w|perlombaan.en: Bayu's theatre group won the provincial drama competition.
w|perlombaan.ko: 바유의 극단이 도 단위 연극 대회에서 우승했어요.

w|perlombaan.text: Kantor Intan mengadakan perlombaan dekorasi meja menjelang tujuh belasan.
w|perlombaan.en: Intan's office held a desk-decorating contest ahead of Independence Day.
w|perlombaan.ko: 인탄의 회사는 독립기념일을 앞두고 책상 꾸미기 대회를 열었어요.

w|permaisuri.text: Dengan baju adat yang megah, istri Fajar terlihat seperti permaisuri kerajaan.
w|permaisuri.en: In her grand traditional dress, Fajar's wife looked like a royal queen.
w|permaisuri.ko: 화려한 전통 의상을 입은 파자르의 아내는 왕비처럼 보였어요.

w|permaisuri.text: Lestari sedang menulis artikel tentang permaisuri raja yang dikenal sebagai pelindung seni.
w|permaisuri.en: Lestari is writing an article about a king's consort known as a patron of the arts.
w|permaisuri.ko: 레스타리는 예술 후원자로 알려진 왕비에 대한 기사를 쓰고 있어요.

w|permanen.text: Kelompok teater Bayu akhirnya punya gedung latihan yang permanen.
w|permanen.en: Bayu's theatre group finally has a permanent rehearsal building.
w|permanen.ko: 바유의 극단은 드디어 고정된 연습실 건물을 갖게 됐어요.

w|permanen.text: Setelah masa percobaan, Intan akhirnya diangkat menjadi karyawan permanen.
w|permanen.en: After her probation, Intan was finally made a permanent employee.
w|permanen.ko: 수습 기간이 끝나고 인탄은 드디어 정규직이 됐어요.

w|permasalahan.text: Rapat OSIS membahas permasalahan sampah di kantin.
w|permasalahan.en: The student council meeting discussed the trash problem in the canteen.
w|permasalahan.ko: 학생회 회의에서 매점 쓰레기 문제를 논의했어요.

w|permasalahan.text: Setiap kali keluarga Dewi berkumpul, permasalahan parkir selalu muncul.
w|permasalahan.en: The parking problem always comes up every time Dewi's family gathers.
w|permasalahan.ko: 데위네 식구가 모일 때마다 주차 문제가 생겨요.

w|permata.en: That necklace is decorated with shining gems.

w|permata.text: Permata langka itu disimpan di brankas.
w|permata.en: That rare gem is kept in the vault.

w|permen.text: Anak itu meminta permen di toko.
w|permen.en: That child asked for candy at the store.
w|permen.ko: 그 아이가 가게에서 사탕을 달라고 했어.

w|permen.en: That mint candy freshens the breath.
w|permen.ko: 그 민트 사탕이 숨을 상쾌하게 해.

w|permohonan.text: Rudi mengajukan permohonan untuk meneliti arsip museum.
w|permohonan.en: Rudi submitted a request to research the museum archives.
w|permohonan.ko: 루디는 박물관 기록 보관소를 조사하겠다는 신청서를 냈어요.

w|permohonan.text: Para pedagang mengirim permohonan agar atap pasar segera diperbaiki.
w|permohonan.en: The traders sent a request for the market roof to be repaired soon.
w|permohonan.ko: 상인들은 시장 지붕을 빨리 고쳐 달라는 요청서를 냈어요.

w|permukaan.en: The surface of that table is very slippery.

w|permukaan.text: Air menutupi permukaan jalan setelah hujan.
w|permukaan.en: Water covered the road surface after the rain.
w|permukaan.ko: 비 뒤에 물이 도로 표면을 덮었어.

w|permulaan.text: Pada permulaan semester, setiap murid mendapat jadwal pelajaran baru.
w|permulaan.en: At the beginning of the semester, every student gets a new class schedule.
w|permulaan.ko: 학기 초에 학생마다 새 시간표를 받아요.

w|permulaan.text: Tinggal di kota baru adalah permulaan hidup yang berbeda bagi Siti.
w|permulaan.en: Living in a new city is the beginning of a different life for Siti.
w|permulaan.ko: 새 도시에서 사는 건 시티에게 다른 삶의 시작이에요.

w|pernah.en: Have you ever been to Bali?
I've never been on a plane.
w|pernah.ko: 비행기는 아직 한 번도 안 타 봤어.

w|pernikahan.en: I was invited to that wedding.

w|pernyataan.en: The minister issued an official statement.

w|pernyataan.ko: 그 성명이 많은 사람을 헷갈리게 했어.

w|perompak.text: Di pelajaran sejarah, Eko belajar bahwa perompak dulu sering menyerang kapal dagang.
w|perompak.en: In history class, Eko learned that pirates often attacked merchant ships in the past.
w|perompak.ko: 역사 시간에 에코는 옛날 해적들이 상선을 자주 습격했다는 걸 배웠어요.

w|perompak.text: Ayu menggambar kapal perompak untuk ilustrasi buku cerita anak.
w|perompak.en: Ayu drew a pirate ship for a children's storybook illustration.
w|perompak.ko: 아유는 어린이 동화책 삽화로 해적선을 그렸어요.

w|perpisahan.text: Perpisahan di stasiun itu sangat mengharukan.
w|perpisahan.en: The farewell at the station was very moving.

w|perpisahan.text: Mereka mengadakan pesta perpisahan untuk guru.
w|perpisahan.en: They held a farewell party for the teacher.

w|perpustakaan.text: Saya belajar di perpustakaan setiap sore.
w|perpustakaan.en: I study in the library every afternoon.
The city library stays open until night.

w|pers.text: Majalah sekolah yang Eko kelola diundang ke acara pers di kantor bupati.
w|pers.en: The school magazine that Eko runs was invited to a press event at the regent's office.
w|pers.ko: 에코가 맡은 학교 잡지가 군청 기자 행사에 초대받았어요.

w|pers.text: Ayah Ayu dulu bekerja sebagai wartawan, jadi dia suka bercerita soal kebebasan pers.
w|pers.en: Ayu's father used to work as a journalist, so he likes talking about press freedom.
w|pers.ko: 아유의 아버지는 기자였어서 언론의 자유에 대해 이야기하는 걸 좋아해요.

w|persahabatan.en: Their friendship has lasted for years.
We keep our friendship even from afar.

w|persaingan.text: Pabrik harus menekan biaya karena persaingan dengan produk impor makin ketat.
w|persaingan.en: The factory has to cut costs because competition with imported products is getting tougher.
w|persaingan.ko: 수입품과의 경쟁이 더 치열해져서 공장은 비용을 줄여야 해요.

w|persaingan.text: Putri dan Sari tetap bersahabat walau dulu ada persaingan ketat soal nilai rapor.
w|persaingan.en: Putri and Sari stayed friends even though they once competed fiercely over report-card grades.
w|persaingan.ko: 푸트리와 사리는 예전에 성적표 점수로 치열하게 경쟁했어도 계속 친구로 지냈어요.

w|persamaan.text: Kata Ayah, Budi dan Rina punya banyak persamaan, terutama sama-sama keras kepala.
w|persamaan.en: Dad says Budi and Rina have a lot in common, especially both being stubborn.
w|persamaan.ko: 아빠 말로는 부디와 리나는 닮은 점이 많은데, 특히 둘 다 고집이 세대요.

w|persamaan.text: Siti melihat banyak persamaan antara rumah ini dan rumah masa kecilnya.
w|persamaan.en: Siti sees many similarities between this house and her childhood home.
w|persamaan.ko: 시티는 이 집과 어릴 적 살던 집이 닮은 점이 많다고 느껴요.

w|persatuan.text: Andi meminjam buku tentang tokoh-tokoh yang memperjuangkan persatuan bangsa.
w|persatuan.en: Andi borrowed a book about figures who fought for national unity.
w|persatuan.ko: 안디는 민족 통합을 위해 애쓴 인물들에 관한 책을 빌렸어요.

w|persatuan.text: Dewi mengajak timnya makan bersama untuk menjaga persatuan setelah rapat yang panas.
w|persatuan.en: Dewi took her team out to eat together to keep them united after a heated meeting.
w|persatuan.ko: 디위는 뜨거웠던 회의 뒤 팀의 단합을 위해 함께 밥을 먹자고 했어요.

w|persaudaraan.text: Pesta itu terasa seperti perayaan persaudaraan dua keluarga besar.
w|persaudaraan.en: The party felt like a celebration of brotherhood between two big families.
w|persaudaraan.ko: 그 잔치는 두 대가족의 우애를 기리는 자리 같았어요.

w|persaudaraan.text: Liputan Rina menunjukkan persaudaraan warga yang saling membantu setelah gempa.
w|persaudaraan.en: Rina's coverage showed the solidarity of residents helping each other after the earthquake.
w|persaudaraan.ko: 리나의 기사는 지진 뒤 서로 돕는 주민들의 우애를 보여 줬어요.

w|persediaan.en: The drinking water supply is starting to run low.

w|persediaan.text: Toko menambah persediaan sebelum libur panjang.
w|persediaan.en: The store added inventory before the long holiday.

w|persegi.text: Foto Budi dipasang dalam kotak persegi di samping judul utama.
w|persegi.en: Budi's photo was placed in a square box next to the headline.
w|persegi.ko: 부디의 사진은 주요 제목 옆 네모 칸에 들어갔어요.

w|persegi.text: Ruang baca anak di perpustakaan itu luasnya sekitar empat puluh meter persegi.
w|persegi.en: The children's reading room in that library is about forty square meters.
w|persegi.ko: 그 도서관 어린이 열람실은 사십 제곱미터쯤 돼요.

w|perselisihan.text: Akhirnya perselisihan antara Eko dan penulis naskah selesai dengan damai.
w|perselisihan.en: In the end, the dispute between Eko and the playwright was settled peacefully.
w|perselisihan.ko: 결국 에코와 극작가 사이의 갈등은 평화롭게 끝났어요.

w|perselisihan.text: Tetua desa menyelesaikan perselisihan soal batas kebun antara dua keluarga.
w|perselisihan.en: The village elders settled the dispute over garden boundaries between two families.
w|perselisihan.ko: 마을 원로들이 두 집안의 밭 경계 다툼을 해결했어요.

w|persembahan.text: Kelas Agus menyiapkan lagu sebagai persembahan untuk guru di Hari Guru.
w|persembahan.en: Agus's class prepared a song as a tribute to the teachers on Teachers' Day.
w|persembahan.ko: 아구스네 반은 스승의 날 선생님들께 바칠 노래를 준비했어요.

w|persembahan.text: Tim renang indah menampilkan tarian air sebagai persembahan penutup acara.
w|persembahan.en: The synchronized swimming team performed a water dance as the closing tribute of the event.
w|persembahan.ko: 아티스틱 스위밍 팀이 행사 마무리 공연으로 물속 춤을 선보였어요.

w|persembunyian.text: Dalam cerita itu, sang pahlawan menemukan tempat persembunyian para pencuri.
w|persembunyian.en: In that story, the hero finds the thieves' hideout.
w|persembunyian.ko: 그 이야기에서 주인공은 도둑들의 은신처를 찾아내요.

w|persembunyian.text: Ruang arsip di lantai bawah jadi tempat persembunyian favorit Intan saat butuh tenang.
w|persembunyian.en: The archive room downstairs is Intan's favourite hiding place when she needs quiet.
w|persembunyian.ko: 아래층 문서 보관실은 인탄이 조용히 있고 싶을 때 즐겨 숨는 곳이에요.

w|persen.text: Berapa persen dari kelas yang hadir hari ini?
w|persen.en: What percent of the class is present today?

w|persen.text: Diskon besar diberi dalam persen yang tinggi.
w|persen.en: A big discount is given at a high percent.

w|persenjataan.text: Rubrik luar negeri memuat laporan tentang anggaran persenjataan berbagai negara.
w|persenjataan.en: The foreign news section ran a report on various countries' arms budgets.
w|persenjataan.ko: 국제면에 여러 나라의 군비 예산에 관한 보도가 실렸어요.

w|persenjataan.text: Di gim strategi buatan Intan, pemain bisa membeli persenjataan untuk benteng mereka.
w|persenjataan.en: In Intan's strategy game, players can buy weaponry for their fortress.
w|persenjataan.ko: 인탄이 만든 전략 게임에서 플레이어는 성에 쓸 무기를 살 수 있어요.

w|persetujuan.text: Proyek itu menunggu persetujuan dari atasan.
w|persetujuan.en: That project is waiting for approval from the boss.
w|persetujuan.ko: 그 프로젝트는 상사의 승인을 기다리고 있어.

w|persetujuan.en: Written approval is required before starting.

w|persiapan.text: Persiapan pesta memakan waktu satu minggu.

w|persiapan.en: They finished preparations for tomorrow's trip.

w|persidangan.text: Kelas Eko berkunjung ke pengadilan untuk menonton persidangan.
w|persidangan.en: Eko's class visited the courthouse to watch a trial.
w|persidangan.ko: 에코네 반은 재판을 방청하러 법원에 견학 갔어요.

w|persidangan.text: Kakak Ayu yang kuliah hukum sedang membaca berkas persidangan di kamar.
w|persidangan.en: Ayu's older brother, who studies law, is reading trial documents in his room.
w|persidangan.ko: 법대생인 아유의 오빠는 방에서 재판 서류를 읽고 있어요.

w|persimpangan.text: Agus salah belok di persimpangan dan akhirnya masuk ke pasar.
w|persimpangan.en: Agus took a wrong turn at the intersection and ended up in a market.
w|persimpangan.ko: 아구스는 교차로에서 잘못 꺾어서 결국 시장으로 들어갔어요.

w|persimpangan.text: Mal tempat Wati bekerja berada di persimpangan jalan protokol.
w|persimpangan.en: The mall where Wati works is at a main-road intersection.
w|persimpangan.ko: 와티가 일하는 쇼핑몰은 큰길 교차로에 있어요.

w|persoalan.text: Rapat kelas membahas persoalan uang kas yang selalu kurang.
w|persoalan.en: The class meeting discussed the problem of class funds always running short.
w|persoalan.ko: 학급 회의에서 늘 모자라는 학급비 문제를 논의했어요.

w|persoalan.text: Putri menyelesaikan persoalan dengan pemasok sayur lewat telepon.
w|persoalan.en: Putri resolved the issue with the vegetable supplier over the phone.
w|persoalan.ko: 푸트리는 채소 납품업자와의 문제를 전화로 해결했어요.

w|personel.text: Jumlah personel keamanan ditambah setelah ada pencurian bahan baku.
w|personel.en: The number of security personnel was increased after raw materials were stolen.
w|personel.ko: 원자재 도난 사건 뒤로 경비 인원이 늘었어요.

w|personel.text: Putri menulis bahwa kantornya kekurangan personel sejak awal tahun.
w|personel.en: Putri writes that her office has been short of staff since the start of the year.
w|personel.ko: 푸트리는 연초부터 회사에 인력이 모자란다고 썼어요.

w|perspektif.text: Tinggal di lantai atas memberi Agus perspektif baru tentang kota yang ramai.
w|perspektif.en: Living on an upper floor gave Agus a new perspective on the busy city.
w|perspektif.ko: 높은 층에 사니 아구스는 붐비는 도시를 새롭게 보게 됐어요.

w|perspektif.text: Pergantian musim memberi Wati perspektif baru tentang waktu yang terus berjalan.
w|perspektif.en: The change of seasons gives Wati a new perspective on time passing.
w|perspektif.ko: 계절이 바뀌면 와티는 흘러가는 시간을 새롭게 바라보게 돼요.

w|persyaratan.text: Izin bangunan baru keluar setelah semua persyaratan teknis dipenuhi.
w|persyaratan.en: The building permit is only issued after all the technical requirements are met.
w|persyaratan.ko: 건축 허가는 기술 요건을 모두 갖춰야 나와요.

w|persyaratan.text: Untuk mendapat diskon pelajar, ada beberapa persyaratan yang harus diunggah Wati.
w|persyaratan.en: To get the student discount, there are several requirements Wati has to upload.
w|persyaratan.ko: 학생 할인을 받으려면 와티가 올려야 하는 요건이 몇 가지 있어요.

w|pertahanan.en: That team improved its back defense.

w|pertama.text: Ini kali pertama aku ke sini.
w|pertama.en: This is my first time here.

w|pertama-tama.en: First of all we have to read the instructions.
Let's first of all clean this table.

w|pertanda.text: Awan gelap adalah pertanda hujan akan datang.
w|pertanda.en: Dark clouds are a sign that rain is coming.

w|pertanda.text: Pertanda baik membuatnya lebih percaya diri.
w|pertanda.en: A good omen made him more confident.
w|pertanda.ko: 좋은 징조가 그를 더 자신 있게 했어.

w|pertanian.text: Pertanian menjadi tulang punggung desa itu.
w|pertanian.en: Agriculture is the backbone of that village.

w|pertanian.text: Dia belajar teknik pertanian modern di kampus.
w|pertanian.en: He studies modern farming techniques on campus.
w|pertanian.ko: 그는 캠퍼스에서 현대 농업 기술을 배워.

w|pertarungan.en: He won in the last fight.

w|pertemanan.text: Fajar dan istrinya berawal dari pertemanan di klub lari.
w|pertemanan.en: Fajar and his wife started out as friends at a running club.
w|pertemanan.ko: 파자르와 아내는 달리기 동호회 친구 사이로 시작했어요.

w|pertemanan.text: Lestari menjaga pertemanan dengan narasumber itu sejak mereka kuliah.
w|pertemanan.en: Lestari has kept up her friendship with that source since their college days.
w|pertemanan.ko: 레스타리와 그 취재원의 우정은 대학 때부터 이어져 왔어요.

w|pertempuran.en: They lost in the final battle.

w|pertengahan.text: Pada pertengahan musim hujan, sungai di dekat rumah Budi sering meluap.
w|pertengahan.en: In the middle of the rainy season, the river near Budi's house often overflows.
w|pertengahan.ko: 우기 중반이 되면 부디네 집 근처 강이 자주 넘쳐요.

w|pertengahan.text: Pada pertengahan syuting, kamera utama rusak dan harus diganti.
w|pertengahan.en: Midway through the shoot, the main camera broke and had to be replaced.
w|pertengahan.ko: 촬영 중반에 메인 카메라가 고장 나서 바꿔야 했어요.

w|pertengkaran.text: Budi menyesal atas pertengkaran kecil yang membuat mereka tidak bicara bertahun-tahun.
w|pertengkaran.en: Budi regrets the small quarrel that kept them from speaking for years.
w|pertengkaran.ko: 부디는 몇 년 동안 말도 안 하게 만든 작은 다툼을 후회해요.

w|pertengkaran.text: Ada pertengkaran kecil antara dua pelari yang saling dorong di tikungan.
w|pertengkaran.en: There was a small quarrel between two runners who pushed each other at the bend.
w|pertengkaran.ko: 모퉁이에서 서로 민 두 주자 사이에 작은 말다툼이 있었어요.

w|pertimbangan.text: Harga tiket yang murah menjadi pertimbangan utama Dimas memilih kereta ekonomi.
w|pertimbangan.en: The cheap ticket price was Dimas's main consideration in choosing the economy train.
w|pertimbangan.ko: 디마스가 일반석 기차를 고른 가장 큰 이유는 싼 표값이었어요.

w|pertimbangan.text: Biaya server menjadi pertimbangan besar sebelum Putri memilih layanan cloud.
w|pertimbangan.en: Server costs were a big consideration before Putri chose a cloud service.
w|pertimbangan.ko: 클라우드 서비스를 고르기 전에 서버 비용이 푸트리에게 큰 고려 사항이었어요.

w|pertolongan.text: Pertolongan pertama diberikan di tempat kejadian.
w|pertolongan.en: First aid was given at the scene.

w|pertolongan.text: Mereka meminta pertolongan kepada warga sekitar.
w|pertolongan.en: They asked nearby residents for help.

w|pertukaran.text: Pertukaran ide membuat proyek lebih kaya.
w|pertukaran.en: The exchange of ideas made the project richer.
w|pertukaran.ko: 아이디어 교환이 프로젝트를 더 풍성하게 했어.

w|pertumbuhan.text: Agus mengukur pertumbuhan tanaman kacang hijau setiap hari untuk tugas biologi.
w|pertumbuhan.en: Agus measures the growth of mung bean plants every day for a biology assignment.
w|pertumbuhan.ko: 아구스는 생물 과제로 녹두 싹이 자라는 걸 매일 재요.

w|pertumbuhan.text: Menurut dokter, berenang baik untuk pertumbuhan tulang anak-anak seperti adik Wati.
w|pertumbuhan.en: According to the doctor, swimming is good for bone growth in kids like Wati's brother.
w|pertumbuhan.ko: 의사 말로는 수영이 와티의 동생 같은 아이들의 뼈 성장에 좋대요.

w|pertumpahan.text: Pak Guru menjelaskan bahwa perjanjian damai itu mengakhiri pertumpahan darah di dua negara.
w|pertumpahan.en: The teacher explained that the peace treaty ended the bloodshed in two countries.
w|pertumpahan.ko: 선생님은 그 평화 조약이 두 나라의 유혈 사태를 끝냈다고 설명했어요.

w|pertumpahan.text: Guru seni menunjukkan lukisan sejarah tentang pertumpahan darah di medan perang.
w|pertumpahan.en: The art teacher showed a historical painting about bloodshed on a battlefield.
w|pertumpahan.ko: 미술 선생님은 전쟁터의 유혈을 그린 역사화를 보여 줬어요.

w|pertunangan.text: Rina mengundang Andi ke acara pertunangan di rumahnya.
w|pertunangan.en: Rina invited Andi to the engagement ceremony at her house.
w|pertunangan.ko: 리나는 자기 집에서 열리는 약혼식에 안디를 초대했어요.

w|pertunangan.text: Restoran hotel penuh karena ada acara pertunangan sepasang dokter muda.
w|pertunangan.en: The hotel restaurant was full because of an engagement party for a young doctor couple.
w|pertunangan.ko: 젊은 의사 커플의 약혼식이 있어서 호텔 식당이 꽉 찼어요.

w|pertunjukan.en: We watched a magic show together.

w|perumahan.text: Rumah tua Andi berada di perumahan yang dibangun pada zaman dulu.
w|perumahan.en: Andi's old house is in a housing estate built long ago.
w|perumahan.ko: 안디의 오래된 집은 옛날에 지어진 주택 단지에 있어요.

w|perumahan.text: Kereta melewati kompleks perumahan baru di pinggir kota.
w|perumahan.en: The train passes a new housing complex on the edge of the city.
w|perumahan.ko: 열차가 도시 외곽의 새 주택 단지를 지나가요.

w|perusahaan.en: She works at a new company.

w|perusak.text: Satpam teater menangkap perusak kursi penonton setelah pertunjukan malam.
w|perusak.en: The theater security guard caught the person who vandalized the audience seats after the evening show.
w|perusak.ko: 극장 경비원이 저녁 공연 뒤 관객석을 망가뜨린 사람을 붙잡았어요.

w|perusak.text: Kamera toko merekam perusak spanduk di depan warung Ayu.
w|perusak.en: The shop camera recorded the person who damaged the banner in front of Ayu's store.
w|perusak.ko: 가게 카메라에 아유네 가게 앞 현수막을 망가뜨린 사람이 찍혔어요.

w|perut.en: My stomach has hurt since morning.

w|perut.text: Dia memegang perut setelah makan terlalu banyak.
w|perut.en: He held his stomach after eating too much.
w|perut.ko: 너무 많이 먹은 뒤 배를 움켜쥐었어.

w|perwakilan.text: Budi bertanya kepada perwakilan warga tentang rencana penggusuran pasar.
w|perwakilan.en: Budi asked the residents' representative about the plan to clear the market.
w|perwakilan.ko: 부디는 주민 대표에게 시장 철거 계획을 물었어요.

w|perwakilan.text: Siti menyambut perwakilan sekolah yang ingin meminjam buku dalam jumlah banyak.
w|perwakilan.en: Siti welcomed the school representatives who wanted to borrow many books.
w|perwakilan.ko: 시티는 책을 많이 빌리고 싶어 하는 학교 대표들을 맞이했어요.

w|perwira.text: Perwira muda itu memimpin pasukan dengan tenang.
w|perwira.en: That young officer led the troops calmly.
w|perwira.ko: 그 젊은 장교가 부대를 침착하게 이끌었어.

w|perwira.text: Dia ingin menjadi perwira setelah lulus akademi.
w|perwira.en: He wants to become an officer after graduating from the academy.
w|perwira.ko: 그는 사관학교를 졸업한 뒤 장교가 되고 싶어해.

w|pesanan.en: The food order arrived on time.

w|pesanan.text: Dia membatalkan pesanan karena salah ukuran.
w|pesanan.en: She canceled the order because of the wrong size.

w|peserta.text: Rudi menjadi salah satu peserta lomba makan kerupuk di acara pernikahan itu.
w|peserta.en: Rudi was one of the contestants in the cracker-eating contest at the wedding.
w|peserta.ko: 루디는 결혼식 행사의 끄루뿍 먹기 대회 참가자 중 한 명이었어요.

w|peserta.text: Rina mencatat nama-nama peserta lomba lari anak untuk halaman olahraga.
w|peserta.en: Rina wrote down the names of the children's race participants for the sports page.
w|peserta.ko: 리나는 스포츠면에 실을 어린이 달리기 대회 참가자 이름을 적었어요.

w|pesisir.text: Eko dan teman-temannya berkemah di pesisir selatan yang jarang dikunjungi orang.
w|pesisir.en: Eko and his friends camped on the southern coast, which few people visit.
w|pesisir.ko: 에코와 친구들은 사람들이 잘 찾지 않는 남쪽 해안에서 캠핑했어요.

w|pesisir.text: Rute maraton yang diikuti Ayu menyusuri jalan pesisir yang indah.
w|pesisir.en: The marathon route Ayu ran followed a beautiful coastal road.
w|pesisir.ko: 아유가 뛴 마라톤 코스는 아름다운 해안 도로를 따라갔어요.

w|pesta.en: I was invited to a party.

w|pesulap.text: Anak-anak berkumpul di depan pesulap yang mengeluarkan merpati dari topinya.
w|pesulap.en: The children gathered in front of the magician who pulled a dove out of his hat.
w|pesulap.ko: 아이들이 모자에서 비둘기를 꺼내는 마술사 앞에 모였어요.

w|pesulap.text: Di pasar malam akhir musim panen, Lestari menonton pesulap menghilangkan koin.
w|pesulap.en: At the night market at the end of harvest season, Lestari watches a magician make a coin disappear.
w|pesulap.ko: 수확철 끝 야시장에서 레스타리는 마술사가 동전을 사라지게 하는 걸 봐요.

w|petani.text: Petani itu menuai padi di sawah.
w|petani.en: That farmer is harvesting rice in the field.

w|petani.text: Banyak petani menjual hasil di pasar.
w|petani.en: Many farmers sell their harvest at the market.

w|petarung.text: Andi kaget waktu tahu Rina dulu petarung silat tingkat provinsi.
w|petarung.en: Andi was surprised to learn Rina used to be a provincial-level silat fighter.
w|petarung.ko: 안디는 리나가 예전에 주 대표 실랏 선수였다는 걸 알고 놀랐어요.

w|petarung.text: Seorang petarung tinju terkenal menginap di hotel sebelum pertandingan.
w|petarung.en: A famous boxer stayed at the hotel before the match.
w|petarung.ko: 유명한 권투 선수가 경기 전에 호텔에 묵었어요.

w|peternakan.text: Peternakan sapi itu luas dan bersih.
w|peternakan.en: That cattle farm is large and clean.

w|peternakan.text: Dia bekerja di peternakan ayam sejak muda.
w|peternakan.en: He has worked on a chicken farm since youth.
w|peternakan.ko: 그는 젊을 때부터 닭 농장에서 일했어.

w|peti.text: Peti kayu itu penuh barang lama.
w|peti.en: That wooden chest is full of old things.
w|peti.ko: 그 나무 상자가 옛 물건으로 가득해.

w|peti.en: They opened a chest in the warehouse.

w|petinju.text: Paman Dimas dulu seorang petinju dan sekarang melatih anak-anak di sekolah.
w|petinju.en: Dimas's uncle used to be a boxer and now trains kids at the school.
w|petinju.ko: 디마스의 삼촌은 예전에 권투 선수였고 지금은 학교에서 아이들을 가르쳐요.

w|petinju.text: Seorang petinju terkenal pernah makan tiga piring nasi di restoran Putri.
w|petinju.en: A famous boxer once ate three plates of rice at Putri's restaurant.
w|petinju.ko: 유명한 권투 선수가 푸트리네 식당에서 밥을 세 접시나 먹은 적이 있어요.

w|petir.text: Petir menyambar pohon di depan rumah.
w|petir.en: Lightning struck the tree in front of the house.

w|petir.text: Suara petir membuat anak itu menangis.
w|petir.en: The sound of thunder made the child cry.

w|petualangan.text: Petualangan di hutan itu sangat seru.
w|petualangan.en: That adventure in the forest was very exciting.

w|petunjuk.en: Read the instructions on the front page.

w|pewaris.text: Seorang pewaris tanah luas datang ke balai kota untuk mengurus sertifikat.
w|pewaris.en: An heir to a large plot of land came to city hall to handle the certificate.
w|pewaris.ko: 넓은 땅을 물려받은 상속자가 증서를 처리하러 시청에 왔어요.

w|pewaris.text: Wati adalah pewaris biola tua milik kakeknya.
w|pewaris.en: Wati is the heir to her grandfather's old violin.

w|piala.text: Museum olahraga memamerkan piala pertama yang dimenangkan tim nasional.
w|piala.en: The sports museum displays the first trophy won by the national team.
w|piala.ko: 스포츠 박물관에는 국가대표팀이 처음 딴 트로피가 전시돼 있어요.

w|piala.text: Pasar Rina pernah meraih piala sebagai pasar terbersih se-provinsi.
w|piala.en: Rina's market once won a trophy as the cleanest market in the province.
w|piala.ko: 리나네 시장은 도내에서 가장 깨끗한 시장으로 상을 받은 적이 있어요.

w|piano.text: Piano di ruang tamu butuh disetem.
w|piano.en: The piano in the living room needs tuning.

w|piano.text: Anaknya belajar bermain piano setiap sore.
w|piano.en: Her child learns to play piano every afternoon.
w|piano.ko: 그의 아이는 매일 오후 피아노를 배워.

w|pidana.text: Kakak Andi meminjam buku hukum pidana untuk persiapan ujian kuliah.
w|pidana.en: Andi's older sibling borrowed a criminal law book to prepare for a university exam.
w|pidana.ko: 안디의 형은 대학 시험 준비로 형법 책을 빌렸어요.

w|pidana.text: Dewi mengingatkan tim bahwa pemalsuan dokumen bisa dikenai sanksi pidana.
w|pidana.en: Dewi reminded the team that forging documents can lead to criminal penalties.
w|pidana.ko: 디위는 서류 위조는 형사 처벌을 받을 수 있다고 팀에 상기시켰어요.

w|pidato.text: Pidato Presiden disiarkan di seluruh negeri.
w|pidato.en: The President's speech was broadcast nationwide.

w|pidato.text: Dia menulis pidato untuk acara wisuda.
w|pidato.en: She wrote a speech for the graduation ceremony.

w|piknik.text: Sebuah keluarga sedang piknik di bawah pohon dekat stasiun kecil.
w|piknik.en: A family was having a picnic under a tree near a small station.
w|piknik.ko: 한 가족이 작은 역 근처 나무 아래에서 소풍을 즐기고 있었어요.

w|piknik.text: Untuk merayakan rilis pertama, seluruh tim Putri pergi piknik ke kebun raya.
w|piknik.en: To celebrate the first release, Putri's whole team went on a picnic to the botanical garden.
w|piknik.ko: 첫 출시를 축하하려고 푸트리 팀 전원이 식물원으로 소풍을 갔어요.

w|pil.en: The doctor gave a pill for his fever.

w|pil.text: Dia menelan pil dengan segelas air.
w|pil.en: She swallowed the pill with a glass of water.
w|pil.ko: 그녀는 물 한 잔과 함께 알약을 삼켰어.

w|pilot.en: The pilot announced the landing time.
He dreams of becoming an airplane pilot.
w|pilot.ko: 그는 비행기 기장이 되는 게 꿈이야.

w|pimpinan.en: Company leadership announced a new plan.

w|pimpinan.text: Dia dipercaya menjadi pimpinan tim proyek.
w|pimpinan.en: He was trusted to become the project team leader.
w|pimpinan.ko: 그는 프로젝트 팀 리더를 맡게 됐어.

w|pindah.text: Kami akan pindah ke kota lain.
w|pindah.en: We will move to another city.
Moving house needs a lot of preparation.

w|pinggang.text: Setelah mengangkat anjing besar, Dimas mengeluh pinggang terasa pegal.
w|pinggang.en: After lifting a big dog, Dimas complained that his lower back felt sore.
w|pinggang.ko: 큰 개를 들어 올린 뒤 디마스는 허리가 뻐근하다고 했어요.

w|pinggang.text: Putri memakai sabuk penyangga pinggang saat mengangkat kotak berat.
w|pinggang.en: Putri wears a back-support belt when lifting heavy boxes.
w|pinggang.ko: 푸트리는 무거운 상자를 들 때 허리 보호대를 해요.

w|pinggir.text: Teater kecil itu berada di pinggir kota, dekat stasiun lama.
w|pinggir.en: That small theatre is on the edge of the city, near the old station.
w|pinggir.ko: 그 작은 극장은 옛 기차역 근처, 도시 변두리에 있어요.

w|pinggir.text: Intan duduk di pinggir meja rapat supaya bisa keluar lebih dulu.
w|pinggir.en: Intan sat at the end of the meeting table so she could leave first.
w|pinggir.ko: 인탄은 먼저 나갈 수 있게 회의 테이블 끝자리에 앉았어요.

w|pinggiran.text: Kantor koran tempat Bayu bekerja ada di pinggiran kota, dekat terminal bus.
w|pinggiran.en: The newspaper office where Bayu works is on the edge of town, near the bus terminal.
w|pinggiran.ko: 바유가 일하는 신문사 사무실은 시 외곽 버스 터미널 근처에 있어요.

w|pinggiran.text: Startup tempat Intan bekerja menyewa ruko kecil di pinggiran Jakarta.
w|pinggiran.en: The startup where Intan works rents a small shophouse on the outskirts of Jakarta.
w|pinggiran.ko: 인탄이 일하는 스타트업은 자카르타 외곽의 작은 상가 건물을 빌려 써요.

w|pinggul.text: Bayu memutar pinggul perlahan untuk pemanasan.
w|pinggul.en: Bayu slowly rotates his hips to warm up.
w|pinggul.ko: 바유는 몸을 풀려고 엉덩이를 천천히 돌려요.

w|pinggul.text: Nenek Intan mengeluh pinggul terasa pegal karena kursi restoran terlalu keras.
w|pinggul.en: Intan's grandmother complains her hip aches because the restaurant chair is too hard.
w|pinggul.ko: 인탄의 할머니는 식당 의자가 너무 딱딱해서 골반이 뻐근하다고 해요.

w|pingsan.text: Pingsan di tengah jalan sangat berbahaya.
w|pingsan.en: Fainting in the middle of the road is very dangerous.
w|pingsan.ko: 길 한가운데서 기절하는 건 아주 위험해.

w|pinjam.en: May I borrow your pencil for a moment?

w|pinjam.text: Pinjam buku itu hanya untuk semalam.
w|pinjam.en: Borrow that book only for one night.

w|pinjaman.text: Pinjaman bank membantu membuka usaha kecil.
w|pinjaman.en: A bank loan helped open a small business.
w|pinjaman.ko: 은행 대출이 작은 가게를 여는 데 도움이 됐어.

w|pinjaman.text: Dia melunasi pinjaman lebih cepat dari jadwal.
w|pinjaman.en: He paid off the loan faster than scheduled.

w|pintu.en: The front door is still open.

w|pipa.en: The water pipe in the kitchen is leaking.

w|pipa.text: Teknisi memperbaiki pipa di ruang bawah.
w|pipa.en: The technician fixed the pipe downstairs.

w|piramida.text: Di kereta, Dimas membaca buku tentang piramida kuno di Mesir.
w|piramida.en: On the train, Dimas read a book about the ancient pyramids in Egypt.
w|piramida.ko: 기차에서 디마스는 이집트의 고대 피라미드에 관한 책을 읽었어요.

w|piramida.text: Putri menggambar struktur organisasi perusahaannya seperti piramida terbalik.
w|piramida.en: Putri drew her company's organizational structure like an upside-down pyramid.
w|piramida.ko: 푸트리는 회사 조직도를 거꾸로 된 피라미드처럼 그렸어요.

w|pirang.en: Blonde hair made her easy to recognize.

w|pirang.text: Pirang alami jarang terlihat di kota ini.
w|pirang.en: Natural blondes are rarely seen in this city.

w|piring.en: Dirty plates are piled in the sink.
Please wash the dishes after eating.

w|pisang.text: Tetangga di lantai yang sama memberi Bayu setandan pisang sebagai salam perkenalan.
w|pisang.en: A neighbor on the same floor gave Bayu a bunch of bananas as a welcome.
w|pisang.ko: 같은 층 이웃이 인사 겸 바유에게 바나나 한 송이를 줬어요.

w|pisang.text: Penumpang di sebelah Intan menawarkan keripik pisang dari Lampung.
w|pisang.en: The passenger next to Intan offered her banana chips from Lampung.
w|pisang.ko: 인탄 옆자리 승객이 람풍산 바나나 칩을 권했어요.

w|pistol.en: The police confiscated a pistol from the suspect.

w|pita.text: Topi bekas yang dibeli Bayu masih dihiasi pita hitam di sekelilingnya.
w|pita.en: The secondhand hat Bayu bought is still trimmed with a black ribbon around it.
w|pita.ko: 바유가 산 중고 모자에는 아직 검은 리본이 둘러져 있어요.

w|pita.text: Intan mengikat setiap suvenir dengan pita emas.
w|pita.en: Intan tied each souvenir with a gold ribbon.

w|pizza.text: Pizza panas itu baru keluar dari oven.
w|pizza.en: That hot pizza just came out of the oven.
w|pizza.ko: 그 뜨거운 피자가 오븐에서 막 나왔어.

w|pizza.text: Kami memesan pizza untuk makan malam.

w|planet.en: This planet is very far away.

w|planet.text: Ada delapan planet di tata surya.
w|planet.en: There are eight planets in the solar system.

w|plastik.text: Kantong plastik dilarang di pasar modern.
w|plastik.en: Plastic bags are banned at the modern market.

w|plastik.text: Plastik bekas harus dipilah sebelum dibuang.
w|plastik.en: Used plastic must be sorted before disposal.

w|pohon.en: There's a big tree in the yard.

w|poin.text: Tim kami mendapatkan poin penting tadi.
w|poin.en: Our team got an important point earlier.
w|poin.ko: 우리 팀이 아까 중요한 점수를 얻었어.

w|poin.en: The main point is very easy to understand.

w|pojok.text: Agus meletakkan rak buku di pojok ruang tamu yang kosong.
w|pojok.en: Agus put a bookshelf in the empty corner of the living room.
w|pojok.ko: 아구스는 거실 빈 구석에 책장을 놓았어요.

w|pojok.text: Wati menyimpan payung dan jas hujan di pojok dekat pintu.
w|pojok.en: Wati keeps umbrellas and raincoats in the corner by the door.
w|pojok.ko: 와티는 문 옆 구석에 우산과 비옷을 둬요.

w|pokoknya.text: Pokoknya kita harus sampai tepat waktu.
w|pokoknya.en: Anyway, we have to arrive on time.
He said the main thing is don't be late.

w|pola.text: Pola pada kain itu sangat unik.
w|pola.en: The pattern on that fabric is very unique.

w|pola.text: Dia mengikuti pola tidur yang teratur.
w|pola.en: She follows a regular sleep pattern.

w|polisi.en: I saw a police officer on the street.

w|politik.text: Politik lokal sedang memanas akhir-akhir ini.
w|politik.en: Local politics have been heating up lately.

w|politik.text: Dia menghindari topik politik di meja makan.
w|politik.en: He avoids politics topics at the dinner table.

w|politisi.text: Andi bermimpi menjadi politisi yang benar-benar mendengarkan rakyat.
w|politisi.en: Andi dreams of becoming a politician who truly listens to people.
w|politisi.ko: 안디는 사람들의 말을 진심으로 듣는 정치인이 되는 게 꿈이에요.

w|politisi.text: Di televisi, para politisi menyampaikan ucapan selamat tahun baru.
w|politisi.en: On TV, politicians delivered New Year's greetings.

w|polos.text: Dimas memakai kaus putih polos di bawah seragam pabriknya.
w|polos.en: Dimas wears a plain white T-shirt under his factory uniform.
w|polos.ko: 디마스는 공장 작업복 안에 무늬 없는 흰 티셔츠를 입어요.

w|polos.text: Putri menulis surat di atas kertas polos tanpa garis.
w|polos.en: Putri writes the letter on plain paper without lines.
w|polos.ko: 푸트리는 줄 없는 흰 종이에 편지를 써요.

w|pompa.text: Kru memakai pompa kecil untuk membuat efek hujan di atas panggung.
w|pompa.en: The crew uses a small pump to create a rain effect on stage.
w|pompa.ko: 스태프들은 작은 펌프로 무대 위에 비 효과를 만들어요.

w|pompa.text: Galon di pantri kantor sekarang pakai pompa listrik.
w|pompa.en: The water jug in the office pantry now uses an electric pump.
w|pompa.ko: 회사 탕비실 생수통은 이제 전동 펌프를 써요.

w|pondok.text: Latar panggung babak kedua berupa sebuah pondok di tengah hutan.
w|pondok.en: The stage set for the second act is a hut in the middle of a forest.
w|pondok.ko: 두 번째 막의 무대 배경은 숲속 오두막이에요.

w|pondok.text: Kantor Intan mengadakan rapat tahunan di sebuah pondok di puncak bukit.
w|pondok.en: Intan's office held its annual meeting at a lodge on a hilltop.
w|pondok.ko: 인탄의 회사는 언덕 위 산장에서 연례 회의를 열었어요.

w|ponsel.en: My phone is out of battery.
Don't play on your phone while eating.
w|ponsel.ko: 밥 먹을 때 휴대폰 하지 마.

w|popok.text: Istri Andi mengganti popok bayi di kamar yang sudah selesai dicat.
w|popok.en: Andi's wife changes the baby's diaper in the room that has already been painted.
w|popok.ko: 안디의 아내는 페인트칠이 끝난 방에서 아기 기저귀를 갈아요.

w|popok.text: Penumpang di sebelah Dewi sibuk mencari popok cadangan untuk bayinya.
w|popok.en: The passenger next to Dewi is busy looking for a spare diaper for her baby.
w|popok.ko: 데위 옆 승객이 아기 여분 기저귀를 찾느라 바빠요.

w|populasi.text: Dalam tugas geografi, Andi menghitung populasi kecamatannya.
w|populasi.en: For a geography assignment, Andi calculated the population of his district.
w|populasi.ko: 지리 과제로 안디는 자기 동네 인구를 계산했어요.

w|populasi.text: Berita bilang populasi kota naik karena banyak pemudik datang untuk tahun baru.
w|populasi.en: The news said the city's population went up because many travelers came home for the new year.
w|populasi.ko: 뉴스에서 새해를 맞아 귀향객이 몰려 도시 인구가 늘었다고 했어요.

w|populer.text: Lagu itu sangat populer di kalangan remaja.
w|populer.en: That song is very popular among teenagers.
w|populer.ko: 그 노래는 청소년들 사이에서 아주 인기야.

w|populer.text: Kafe ini menjadi populer setelah ulasan bagus.
w|populer.en: This cafe became popular after good reviews.
w|populer.ko: 좋은 후기 뒤 이 카페가 유명해졌어.

w|positif.en: His test result turned out positive.
A positive attitude helps face challenges.
w|positif.ko: 긍정적인 태도가 도전을 맞이하는 데 도움이 돼.

w|potensi.text: Kepala museum yakin museum kecil itu punya potensi menarik turis.
w|potensi.en: The museum director is sure the small museum has the potential to attract tourists.
w|potensi.ko: 관장은 그 작은 박물관이 관광객을 끌 잠재력이 있다고 믿어요.

w|potensi.text: Rina melihat potensi besar dalam berjualan sayur organik.
w|potensi.en: Rina sees great potential in selling organic vegetables.
w|potensi.ko: 리나는 유기농 채소 장사에 큰 가능성이 있다고 봐요.

w|potongan.en: She got a big price discount.

w|potongan.text: Potongan kain itu sudah cukup panjang.
w|potongan.en: That fabric cut is already long enough.
w|potongan.ko: 그 천 조각은 이미 충분히 길어.

w|prajurit.en: He wants to become a soldier.

w|praktis.text: Rudi membawa tas ransel yang ringan dan praktis ke sekolah.
w|praktis.en: Rudi brings a light, practical backpack to school.
w|praktis.ko: 루디는 가볍고 실용적인 배낭을 메고 학교에 가요.

w|praktis.text: Lemari lipat ini sangat praktis untuk dibawa pindahan, kata Rina.
w|praktis.en: This folding wardrobe is very practical for moving, Rina said.
w|praktis.ko: 이 접이식 옷장은 이사할 때 아주 실용적이라고 리나가 말했어요.

w|pramuka.text: Setiap Sabtu, Rudi ikut kegiatan pramuka di lapangan sekolah.
w|pramuka.en: Every Saturday, Rudi joins scout activities on the school field.
w|pramuka.ko: 루디는 토요일마다 학교 운동장에서 스카우트 활동을 해요.

w|pramuka.text: Rina menemukan seragam pramuka lamanya di dasar kardus.
w|pramuka.en: Rina found her old scout uniform at the bottom of a box.
w|pramuka.ko: 리나는 상자 맨 밑에서 예전 스카우트 단복을 찾았어요.

w|preman.text: Novel yang dibaca Budi bercerita tentang preman pasar yang berubah menjadi guru.
w|preman.en: The novel Budi is reading is about a market thug who becomes a teacher.
w|preman.ko: 부디가 읽는 소설은 시장 깡패가 선생님이 되는 이야기예요.

w|preman.text: Ternyata anak yang dulu dijuluki preman kelas kini menjadi guru agama.
w|preman.en: It turned out the boy once nicknamed the class thug is now a religion teacher.
